Will she ever be able to trust the man who bought her love... or will trusting him cost her everything?
67f4bf3ef677c88e22096ccc.title: Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King

67f62d7be40e2748790ffcf9.synopsis: In After Divorce I Built A Fabulous Life movie, once a talented designer, Mia married Tyler for love and became a housewife post-graduation. However, a three-year marriage ended with a divorce decree. Tyler's heartlessness makes Mia give up hope, leading her to reclaim her beloved career. Eventually, Mia shines in her passion, and Tyler realizes his true feelings, allowing them to rediscover love...
67f62d7be40e2748790ffcf9.title: After Divorce, I Built A Fabulous Life

67f6cbba96412fe9460d57ac.synopsis: In Baby Please Don't Marry Him movie, to secure her boyfriend’s future, Gloria pretends to be superficial and breaks up with him. Seven years later, she's forced into an arranged marriage, only to find her fiancé's uncle is her now-successful ex. As old feelings resurface and misunderstandings unravel, the two are drawn back together for a second chance at love.
67f6cbba96412fe9460d57ac.title: Baby, Please Don't Marry Him

67f6d16f2b53e01e2000118a.synopsis: In My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor movie, Leia, struggling with infertility, is caught slacking off at work by her boss, Alec, while browsing a sperm donor website. Mortified by the encounter, she tries to move on. After carefully selecting a donor at the sperm bank, fate takes an unexpected turn—she ends up choosing Alec’s donation without realizing it. When will Leia discover that the child she’s carrying is actually Alec’s?
67f6d16f2b53e01e2000118a.title: My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor

67f6d31af51c3a3b9e0549f2.synopsis: In Undercover Prison King movie, when ex-soldier Troy Poe inherits a corrupt private prison, he decides to go in undercover as an inmate to expose those responsible. But when the head guard, a man who he trusted, turns out to be the leader of the crime ring , Troy must find a way to convince the officials that he is not a prisoner, but in fact, the owner of the prison... or break out. All the while, he must protect those in danger, including a weak old prisoner whose sentence has been falsely extended, and a beautiful doctor who's caught in the crossfire. Will Troy find a way to escape? Or will he become just another casualty of his own prison?
67f6d31af51c3a3b9e0549f2.title: Undercover Prison King

67f7906c085fd270130b34b6.synopsis: In Pretty Baby movie, Rosy Dolores, the city's most sought-after escort, enters a fake engagement with billionaire single father Tad Williams to locate the daughter ripped away from her at birth. Unbeknownst to her, Tad's charming daughter, Lily, is the very child she's been searching for.
67f7906c085fd270130b34b6.title: Pretty Baby

67f790bf2e5020721707e329.synopsis: In Secret Boss of the Five Keys movie, Grayson Rodgers is a gardener with a secret: Over the last five years, he's taken out the five heads of the Five Nation Syndicate, and taken their Gold Keys: The symbols of their authority, but also the keys to the vault that acts as a bank for their entire fortunes. He's now ready to stop, and give his wife a life of luxury and peace. But before he can reveal himself to her, he discovers her sleeping with a high ranking syndicate general, Ivan. Ivan wants Grayson to use his clearance as a gardner to help him break into the Golden Key Vault. Now Grayson must find a way to prove to everyone that he's the true leader, while catching Ivan in the act... all the while being thought of a just a gardener.
67f790bf2e5020721707e329.title: Secret Boss of the Five Keys

67f790db472487b6b00b8e24.synopsis: In Freeze! Runaway Groom movie, to pay for her father's medical bills, Ivy is forced to marry Byron, a wealthy heir, instead of her stepsister. But on their wedding day, Byron doesn't show up, leaving Ivy humiliated in front of all their family and friends. After they finally marry, they set three rules—agreeing they won't fall in love with each other. Eventually, Byron tells Ivy that the agreement is ridiculous because he's already fallen in love with her. He asks her if she loves him back. So, will Ivy reciprocate his feelings?
67f790db472487b6b00b8e24.title: Freeze! Runaway Groom

67f7910e778a52eee8096337.synopsis: In Mistaken as the Mistress movie, Vivian comes home early to celebrate her son Noah's engagement party. But his fiancée Mia mistakes her as his mistress, resulting in Vivian's public shame and abuse. When Noah arrives and finds his mother missing, he quickly erupts in anger and vows to find his mother at all costs!
67f7910e778a52eee8096337.title: Mistaken as the Mistress

67f7913141ebfd891f0fc824.synopsis: In Fuel to Our Fire My Racer Stepbrother movie, struggling to pay the bills to support her ailing mother and abusive step-father, Elaine turns to her work as a dancer at illegal street races. But, as fate would have it, she unknowingly runs into the world's most-feared and envied world-championship street racer... her step-brother. And gives him her virginity.
67f7913141ebfd891f0fc824.title: Fuel to Our Fire: My Racer Stepbrother

67f791456da404e5a7033b88.synopsis: In My Ex is in the Navy SEALs movie, six years ago, Regina chose to break up with her boyfriend Julian to avoid hindering his promising military career due to her overwhelming debt. Six years later, they reunite in a foreign land, Julian is now a commanding officer, while Regina is a single mother. Their chemistry reignites, but their bonding faces uncertainties of their class differences and pressure from people around them. This time, will they find their way back to love again?
67f791456da404e5a7033b88.title: My Ex is in the Navy SEALs

67f7917b8c6a1df566097a39.synopsis: In Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire movie, small-town girl Emily moves to the city to collect a debt from her ex, Kevin, hoping to pay off her mother’s medical bills. But she discovers Kevin is now a sugar baby living off of wealthy woman, Rose, and together they humiliate her. Just as Emily hits rock bottom, she stumbles across Lucas. Through an unexpected misunderstanding, Emily becomes the contract wife of a CEO.
67f7917b8c6a1df566097a39.title: Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire

67f94b9768edc18a72097275.synopsis: The chaotic pajama party continues! Listen in for a sweet surprise as the trio spills the tea on their crushes, showmances, and the cringiest things they’ve done in the name of love. Things really heat up when they jump on the Hear Me Out trend so prepare yourselves for some hot takes.
67f94b9768edc18a72097275.title: ReelTalk EP17-Hear Me Out…He Is Kind of Hot?

67fce07b81c0454503051544.synopsis: In Love Trap with My Dashing Knight movie, the wealthy heiress Emily White marries Tim Carter, a man from humble beginnings, for love. She spares no effort in elevating him to the position of CEO, using her family’s vast resources to secure his success. Yet, after ten years of marriage, Tim betrays her, secretly engaging in an affair with his secretary, Laura Green. Stripped of power, Emily is reduced to a housewife, trapped in a hollow, loveless marriage, suffering alone. Eager to secure her position, Laura devises a ruthless scheme—she hires a male escort to seduce Emily, planning to obtain "evidence" of her infidelity and force her out of the marriage with nothing. However, in a twist of fate, she mistakenly targets Ryan Clarke, the illegitimate son of the influential Clarke family, believing him to be an escort. The moment Ryan sees Emily, he immediately recognizes her—she is the woman who unknowingly saved him years ago. Harboring unspoken emotions, Ryan seizes the opportunity and infiltrates the White household, becoming Emily’s chauffeur and live-in assistant. He relentlessly flirts and teases her, awakening long-buried desires within her.
67fce07b81c0454503051544.title: Love Trap with My Dashing Knight

67fdc407e4fc584da1068cc2.synopsis: In Love at Dangerous Speeds movie, when Violet flees her abusive fiancé on their wedding day, she hides with Marcus, a notorious street racer. Their protection-for-a-kiss deal ignites into passion, giving her the freedom she craves. Then Marcus confesses a dark secret: the hit-and-run accident that haunts him killed Violet's father. Will she forgive the man who stole her heart but destroyed her family, or return to the controlling life she desperately tried to escape?
67fdc407e4fc584da1068cc2.title: Love at Dangerous Speeds

6800bcd28e63e6be8505c47c.synopsis: In Taming the Mafia Boss He's Mine Now movie: Leah, the daughter of the Cruz family, appears to be a "fierce delicate flower" who throws money around in nightclubs and acts in a cynical way on the surface. In reality, she is a down-and-out heir whose power was seized by her stepfather. During a misunderstanding, Leah, fueled by alcohol, generously spent a large sum of money and "kept" Allen, the "bankrupt noble young master" — little did she know that this man whom she could pin against the wall and whose shirt she tore open was actually the person in power of the Smith family, a mafia clan. A misunderstanding about "keeping someone" kicks off: He can wear an apron and cook dinner, and when she is framed by her stepsister Lisa, he will press the muzzle of a gun against the forehead of the enemy. She once thought that he was a person in distress who needed her protection, but when she herself was in trouble, she discovered that the overwhelming power of the Smith family could be casually wielded by him — she thought she was the hunter, but she didn't know that from the moment she pinned him against the locker, he was willing to shed all his disguises just for her... Let's see how Leah makes a comeback from the "sugar mommy" to become the wife of the mafia boss, staging an ultimate love story between two powerful individuals where "You hide your power to protect my vulnerable part, and I shed my thorns to give you my sincere heart."
6800bcd28e63e6be8505c47c.title: Taming the Mafia Boss, He's Mine Now!

6800ce3fa7f99a96ea011c41.synopsis: In The Double Life of My Deliveryman Husband movie, Verna Collins came to the city to visit her daughter Sheryl Vance, who had just given birth to a baby. However, she met Ivy Wright, who was posing as a beggar to find an ideal wife for her wealthy father Emerson Wright. Ivy was charmed by Verna's kindness and arranged a blind date between Verna and Emerson. Emerson, thinking Verna was a fraud, pretended to be a delivery man. But to his surprise, Verna didn't care. Emerson was captivated by Verna's kindness and gentleness and quickly married her. However, at this time, Verna discovered that Sheryl had been deceiving her by using excuses not to let her see her grandson. Sheryl even hired an actor to pretend to be her at her grandson's party. Verna angrily confronted Sheryl, but the latter accused her of being a fraud. Just as Verna was being beaten by her in-laws, Emerson, who had been attending the party incognito, stepped in to stop them. The Dylan family, unaware of Emerson's identity, learned from Sheryl that Emerson was just a delivery man and insulted him. At this moment, the vice president of the Wright Group was invited to the party and was shocked to see Emerson. He immediately stopped the Dylan family from insulting him. But at Emerson's hint, he didn't reveal Emerson's identity. As a result, the Dylan family lost the cooperation with the Wright Group that was within their grasp, but blamed Verna, thinking she had deliberately embarrassed. Verna was heartbroken after seeing through Sheryl's true colors. To cheer her up, Emerson took her to a real estate agency and said he would buy her a house. Of course, to maintain his poor image, he bought a second-hand house. But they happened to run into Sheryl, who was there with Natalie to buy a house...
6800ce3fa7f99a96ea011c41.title: The Double Life of My Deliveryman Husband

68018b77b5261ea7470d23d6.synopsis: Following the success of Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas, Anna Stadler and Drew Ater reunite over drinks for a candid, celebratory sit-down. In this exclusive close-up interview, the duo revisits the action, the chemistry, and the moments that made it all unforgettable. Expect heartfelt gratitude, behind the scenes stories, and a few never-before-heard secrets along the way.
68018b77b5261ea7470d23d6.title: ReelTalk EP18-Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas: The Reunion

6801aeac13d97639300b240f.synopsis: In Back to the Ring My KO Mom movie, the boxing queen, Tanya Boyle, retires at the peak of her career for love. Unknown to all, Tanya marries Wesley Thomas and devotes herself to looking after the family. Unfortunately, she gets stomach cancer. So, Wesley’s mother introduces a lady to Wesley. Tanya is heartbroken but offers her blessings. After being reborn, Tanya cherishes her health and fights for happiness. But she ends up divorcing Wesley. Then, Tanya rebuilds her life and returns to boxing. At this time, she discovers Wesley’s new girlfriend, Yolanda Lopez, is lying about being the boxing queen. So, Tanya decides to regain her glory. Wesley looks down upon Tanya when fighting her. He even persuades her to quit the game. However, Tanya ignores Wesley and defeats him. Wesley is shocked, and everyone finds out Tanya is the boxing queen. Wesley regrets losing his idol. But Tanya has changed a lot. She only wants to live her life.
6801aeac13d97639300b240f.title: Back to the Ring: My KO Mom

6801aeb838f9fd89470973f2.synopsis: Gordon James left for a battalion the day after his wedding with Daphne Kirk. Seven years later, Daphne took their son Freddy to Gordon's camp to meet his dad. There she found out he got married to another woman in the camp. Conflicts with his new wife Flora and her mom Jane led to Freddy dying on the trip. Daphne swore to avenge her son with help from her father, Marshal Simon Kirk. Gordon killed Jane to win his powerful father-in-law's favor, only to get killed by Flora who then committed suicide.
6801aeb838f9fd89470973f2.title: Revenge of the Commander's Heiress

6801aed132b5013dee039f7e.synopsis: Little Alodia had a tough start. At just five years old, she was stuck living with her mean aunt Rhea who only cared about boys. Life was lonely until she met Jade, the fiery widow everyone in Loess Village talked about. A funny thing happened after Jade took Alodia in. Suddenly, Jade's struggling herb business took off. Bills got paid. Good things just kept happening. Turns out the quiet little girl was what folks called a "luck magnet" - where she went, fortune followed. Of course, nasty aunt Rhea came sniffing around when she heard. The village chief, Larry Greene, heard the rumors, trying to take Alodia back. But Jade wasn't having it. With help from folks like Osmond and the neighbors, they showed Rhea for the cruel woman she was. In the end, Jade got to keep her lucky little girl, proving sometimes the family you choose is better than the one you're born into.
6801aed132b5013dee039f7e.title: Luck Magnet Girl

68022e8fdffc3b1e5d03c02e.synopsis: Vincent Rogers was framed by his wife Lauryn Torres on the charge of having an affair with his mother-in-law and was forced to leave with nothing. At his wit's end, he was unexpectedly recognized as Don Watson's grandson and inherited the Eye of Satan, becoming the heir of the Grand Group. With his ability to see through treasures and his business acumen, Vincent made a comeback, trampling on the Torres family, swallowing up the Evans Group, winning the heart of Sabina Strauss, and making a billion-dollar profit in the stone gambling field, thus foiling the Anti-Grand Group's conspiracy. As Don Watson's tests for him were gradually unlocked, Vincent eventually took over the Grand Group, exposed Lauryn's crimes, married his true love Sabina, and reached the peak of power.
68022e8fdffc3b1e5d03c02e.title: Super Godfather: Ex-wife Begging Me to Get Remarried

6802d2e64af71963930e1931.synopsis: In A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother movie, Olive Parry agrees to be her BFF Sam’s fake girlfriend, and in return, he would pay for her expenses to save her little brother from his evil foster mom. One condition: don't fall in love with Sam’s older brother. Everything was working perfectly until Olive found out that the man she’d secretly pined for after a one-night stand, and Sam’s off-limit older brother were the same person.
6802d2e64af71963930e1931.title: A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother

6805e89858fc9ba8bd070ca7.synopsis: In Royal Heir Breaks My Heart in a Warzone movie, the emergency room doctor fell in love with a special forces officer at first sight. But because of family difficulties, she had to pretend to be unfaithful and break up with him. She didn't know that after breaking up, she found out she was pregnant…and the special forces officer's other identity was actually a royal heir fulfilling his military service. Years later, she was forced to join an international medical team and met him again at the international peacekeeping base. She reunited with her special forces officer, her prince, whom she had been thinking about for a long time, but they were like strangers...
6805e89858fc9ba8bd070ca7.title: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart in a Warzone

6805e8ac23f200c0c408fb2e.synopsis: In Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love movie: The daughter of the world's wealthiest man pursued a man who manipulated and mistreated women for three years, during which she endured emotional abuse. Despite transferring hundreds of millions in assets to this manipulative individual, she received no formal recognition or respect in their relationship. On their third wedding anniversary, this deceitful man brazenly introduced his mistress to her, mocking her lack of wealth, beauty, connections, and desirability, claiming she deserved to be betrayed. Unbeknownst to him, with just a single decision from her, he and his mistress would lose everything. At this critical moment, the male protagonist—a peer of the female lead in terms of wealth and family background—appears. However, due to misunderstandings orchestrated by the antagonistic secondary characters, he is mistaken for a hired model intended to embellish the scene. Ironically, both the male and female leads initially perceive each other as impostors, with the male lead even mistakenly believing the female lead is his arranged marriage partner. Enraged by the betrayal of the secondary male character, the female lead hastily signs a divorce agreement and marries the male lead. Yet, the secondary characters remain oblivious to the gravity of their actions. Let us observe how they are subsequently humiliated in various ways.
6805e8ac23f200c0c408fb2e.title: Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love

68064de0b2e1243e6b03586e.synopsis: In Accidentally Pregnant Forever Spoiled movie: since childhood, Ella has lived with her remarried mother and stepfather after her parents divorced. She endured indifference and abuse in her stepfather's household. After her mother passed away, her stepfather and half-brother treated Ella as nothing more than a tool to make money. Her stepfather even spent all of her college tuition, forcing her to work part-time to pay for her education. While working at a bar, Ella was drugged by a customer, but was rescued by a drunken Edward, leading to a one-night stand. Two months later, Ella discovered she was pregnant! Her stepfather, wanting to sell her off for a good price, attempted to force her into having an abortion. In a critical moment, Edward arrived in time to save Ella and brought her home, offering her care and protection. However, due to her low status, Ella faced insults from Edward's sister and bullying at school. A wealthy heiress, who also had her eyes on Edward, threatened her as well. Yet, Edward remained firm in his commitment to protect her. After overcoming multiple challenges, Ella transformed from a timid, self-conscious girl into a brave and strong woman, gradually winning Edward’s heart. She safely gave birth to their child, and years later, became a brilliant AI researcher.
68064de0b2e1243e6b03586e.title: Accidentally Pregnant, Forever Spoiled

68073d0f8046d9913c066077.synopsis: In Shhh Professor Please Don't Tell movie: Ellie is living a double life as a student by day, masked stripper by night. When the handsome Jackson Steele walks into the club, Ellie takes him on as her new favorite client. But when Ellie realizes that Jackson is her college professor, she must fight the attraction that is burning between them. Can Ellie keep her double life a secret? And can she continue to resist her professor who watches her dance every night?
68073d0f8046d9913c066077.title: Shhh, Professor! Please Don't Tell

68073fc1d5ec063ec302e73c.synopsis: In Freed by the Sexy Farmer movie, after her once-wealthy family loses everything, virgin heiress Lily Holt is sold to Mason Black. He is the notoriously cruel heir of the Black family fortune. Terrified of his violent reputation, Lily runs away from Mason the night of their fake marriage and crashes into Cal Foster, a sweet, sexy farmer who falls for her at first sight. However, when Cal discovers the man Lily’s running from is his landlord and long-time rival, he risks his life and livelihood to protect her.
68073fc1d5ec063ec302e73c.title: Freed by the Sexy Farmer

68074ffb6b4c768240075d9e.synopsis: Noname actress Aria Lynch married Shawn Group CEO Charles Shawn for her family but later asked for a divorce after a one-night-stand pregnancy. Six years later, Charles found out Aria's daughter Nina was his own blood and looked all over town for her whereabouts. Charles saved Aria and Nina from getting bullied at a film set but couldn't tell little Nina was the daughter he'd been looking for. At the birthday party Charles's mom organized for Nina, they finally found out Aria was Charles's ex-wife. Charles got down on his knee to propose to a pregnant Aria, this time with twins.
68074ffb6b4c768240075d9e.title: My CEO Daddy Found Us!

680750400dcb037a8008eb77.synopsis: Rita Sanchez was overly preoccupied with her first love, Aiden Hughes, and his daughter, Ella Hughes, and repeatedly neglected her own daughter, Mona Barnes. After Mona became completely disappointed with Rita, her father, Elliot Barnes, took her away. Only after they left did Rita realize she had ignored her daughter, and she was filled with remorse.
680750400dcb037a8008eb77.title: Baby Don't Cry, Mommy is Sorry

6807504c8046d9913c066083.synopsis: Naomi Chapman was tormented as a poison tester for 10 long years, till her stepmom got her back to get married on her daughter's behalf. Naomi became the antidote for her husband Samuel Hunt, Highvale's most revered general. She found love at her new home and learned to stand up for herself.
6807504c8046d9913c066083.title: His Only Cure

6807507dff120dcf2509b0e6.synopsis: Adela Taylor, a daughter of a noble family, joined the army in her brother's name to secure the family's Duke title. She achieved unparalleled success, but upon returning victorious, her brother stole her glory. She was forced into marriage, and her brother killed her. She unexpectedly was reborn as a princess. Then she started her journey of revenge...
6807507dff120dcf2509b0e6.title: A Princess? No! I'm the Female General!

6807508addf91aecc20954b8.synopsis: Rae's dream was to be a pilot. But when she found out that she was pregnant, she married her boyfriend and settled down as a housewife. Seven years later, while on her husband's flight, Rae discovered his secret: he had been keeping a mistress for years. Adding to the horror was the plane crashing in a thunderstorm; it seemed that certain death awaited them... Until she found herself going back in time with her memories intact. Now, Rae must make new choices to rewrite her future... before it's too late!
6807508addf91aecc20954b8.title: Reborn to Fly

680755a6421039a0780bd65b.synopsis: In Watch Out She's a Mastermind Heiress movie, after growing up in the countryside, 21-year-old Isabella Patton is sent back to her wealthy birth family. Before long, she becomes acquainted with the smoldering (and much older) Oliver Bates, who begins to relentlessly pursue her, oblivious to the fact that she is his fiancée. Meanwhile, Isabella's cousin Eliza, who was raised by the Patton family in her place, is on a desperate mission to turn the whole family against her for good. Unluckily for Eliza, Isabella is a hotshot genius with unparalleled talent in the medical and tech fields, and is able to outduel Eliza at every turn. As Isabella's unique skills are revealed, she wins the support of her five brothers and parents, becoming the crown jewel of the Patton family while always remaining just out of Oliver's grasp.
680755a6421039a0780bd65b.title: Watch Out! She's a Mastermind Heiress

680755cdaf8e465a6c0e8e91.synopsis: I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?! is based on the novel published by Tapas Entertainment, Inc. In I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend movie: when Kaitlyn Sinclair moves into her off campus apartment with her high school sweetheart for her freshman year of college, she immediately catches him cheating on her. She is forced to move into her brother’s apartment and share a space with his best friend who is in grad school on the same campus. When her childhood crush reignites, Kaitlyn and Cole must navigate their newfound adult relationship while evil exes, mean girls, and worst of all- Kaitlyn’s brother, try to tear them apart.
680755cdaf8e465a6c0e8e91.title: I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?!

680755e1c7ae148edd0ee59e.synopsis: In The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate movie, what happens when a student surrogate proposes to her client that they should conceive the baby the natural way? In the movie The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate, desperate to save her father, Harper agrees to carry a baby for Will Trenton— a single, mouthwateringly hot billionaire. As their worlds collide and the boundaries blur, Harper finds herself irresistibly drawn to Will. But beneath the surface, a question remain: Is Will feeling the same?
680755e1c7ae148edd0ee59e.title: The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate

680755f6e2beaa8d5309d902.synopsis: In The Quarterback’s First Love movie, after her quarterback fiancee’s betrayal, cheerleader Maddie’s life unravels. Drawn to Cameron, another football player who feels oddly familiar, she faces new challenges as her ex, the cheer captain, and Cameron's mother plot to tear them apart.
680755f6e2beaa8d5309d902.title: The Quarterback's First Love

6807560ea0676c7b8705a8ba.synopsis: In Song of My Mother's Tears movie, Faith searches for her lost family when she learns that she doesn't have long to live. But turns out, they're the people she hates the most!
6807560ea0676c7b8705a8ba.title: Song of My Mother's Tears

68075635df42c4bb2a02709c.synopsis: In Boss Me Around If You Dare movie: Just after she is falsely accused of sleeping with her boss and fired, Olivia lands a new job at Wilder Conglomerate—only to realize her new boss is Theo Wilder, the man she hooked up with last night! Olivia says they can’t work together, but Theo challenges her to stay and take a bet: he says he can make her fall for him, while Olivia bets she can resist his seduction… but just how long can she last against her boss’ sexy advances?
68075635df42c4bb2a02709c.title: Boss Me Around If You Dare

6807565447c113d594077ca8.synopsis: In My Stepbrother's Dirty Secret movie, Alice transfers to St. Mary's High School after her mom remarries a millionaire--only to butt heads with James, a hot classmate who turns out to be her new stepbrother! Will Alice and James learn to get along? Or will their irresistable chemistry turn into something else?
6807565447c113d594077ca8.title: My Stepbrother's Dirty Secret

6807566fd88a6d32a90a4b12.synopsis: The Cursed Alpha's Mate is based on the novel by Cricket Colson, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish. In The Cursed Alpha's Mate movie: Shay Santos is finally ready to lose her virginity, but when she tries to surprise her boyfriend, she finds him cheating on her instead! Heartbroken, she goes out with her BFF and vows to sleep with the first guy who approaches her… Who happens to be powerful Alpha Mal Haywood. Their attraction is instant, animal, and for a human and a werewolf… Forbidden. But that’s not the only problem: Mal’s been cursed, and if doesn’t mark Shay as his mate and impregnate her with his pup, he’ll die!
6807566fd88a6d32a90a4b12.title: The Cursed Alpha's Mate

6807568174479ad7f60dc6f3.synopsis: In My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me movie, Audrey hides her identity as a CEO to protect Cornell's pride, working behind the scenes to help him secure a major hotel project and climb to the top as the hotel's CEO. As she helps him make his way up the ladder, his first love, Cecilia, returns, putting a strain on their relationship . Meanwhile, Audrey faces relentless pressure from those around her, including Cornell, which pushing her to consider a divorce. After enduring countless humiliations, she finally recognizes her worth and the price of dedicating herself to the wrong person. With her confidence restored, Audrey eventually chooses divorce and fight to reclaim her place as the CEO.
6807568174479ad7f60dc6f3.title: My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me

68075696ff120dcf2509b0ef.synopsis: In The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star movie, Jenna leads a double life: by day, she’s a quiet, unassuming student; by night, she secretly works as a stripper to pay for her sister’s medical bills. Her worlds collide one night when Casper, her cocky school rival and the star of the hockey team, walks into the club. He’s instantly drawn to the enigmatic dancer, Angel, unaware she’s the same girl he spars with at school. But the deeper their bond grows, the closer they come to unraveling each other’s truths.
68075696ff120dcf2509b0ef.title: The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star

680756aa539a46a7960f35f9.synopsis: In Rules of Protection The Bodyguard I Hate movie, Elena and Ace used to be engaged for marriage. But, after Ace is disabled from the war, he pretends to cheat on Elena to save her from his new disability. Three years pass until the CEO of a medical insurance company gets shot. Elena needs a personal bodyguard, and Ace just happens to be the one for the job. Will Elena and Ace repair their rocky past and reignite the love they once had for each other?
680756aa539a46a7960f35f9.title: Rules of Protection: The Bodyguard I Hate

680756c56f852549da0789fa.synopsis: In Accidental Triplets with the Billionaire movie, urgently needing an heir to secure his position in the company, Oscar turns to surrogacy. But unexpectedly, his sperm is accidentally injected into Phoebe, who comes in for a gynecological exam. To ensure Phoebe keeps the baby, Oscar proposes a contract marriage, and the two embark on a journey filled with tests...
680756c56f852549da0789fa.title: Accidental Triplets with the Billionaire

680756e113ea058f2c07f351.synopsis: In Never Underestimate Girl movie Math, Zosha is a poor orphan who gets bullied by all the rich Ivy League kids for working on a farm. But Zosha's about to beat them all at the one thing they least expect: math.
680756e113ea058f2c07f351.title: Never Underestimate Girl Math

680756f542a99850b106f7ff.synopsis: In My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire movie, Archer is nowhere to be seen on his wedding with Alice—rumor has it he died in an explosion during a firefighting mission. Alice’s greedy parents try to marry her off to a sleazy suitor, Philip. At the new wedding, Alice finally sees her husband again—but he’s now engaged to someone else.
680756f542a99850b106f7ff.title: My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire

6807570bacbfcb9dcc0c9bb4.synopsis: Swallow Me Whole is based on the novel by Gemma James, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish. I need to know how to blow a guy. Ashton Levine is my best friend's brother and totally off-limits... until one reckless night under a bar table changed everything. The rules of him being my sex tutor are simple: No kissing. No screwing. No falling in love. But the more I use my body in the name of experimentation, the more I know being friends isn’t enough. Is it too much to want it all with him?
6807570bacbfcb9dcc0c9bb4.title: Swallow Me Whole

68075726bfe31ae241029d10.synopsis: In The Deaf Heiress's Secret movie, A deaf heiress regains her hearing just in time to discover the people closest to her plotting against her. Keeping her recovery a secret, she plays a dangerous game of deception against those who believe her disability makes her weak. As she investigates suspicious events from her past, she must carefully navigate a web of betrayal while pretending not to hear the conspiracies unfolding around her in order to bring those who wronged her to justice.
68075726bfe31ae241029d10.title: The Deaf Heiress's Secret

680856d3954e12ea7a014e46.synopsis: To give her daughter Cher Gould a happy childhood, Leah Gould, whose husband was a CEO, had always been low-key. But Cher's classmates thought her family was poor and bullied her. Fiona Liam's son was Cher's classmate. She used Leah's identity to act in collusion with other parents and teachers to bully Leah and Cher. Fiona didn't realize Leah was the real rich lady until Leah settled scores with them. In the end, Fiona got a taste of her own medicine. And Cher learned how to protect herself and admired her mother more.
680856d3954e12ea7a014e46.title: Until My Vengeance Comes

6809eed09bf946a7480dcde4.synopsis: "For a decade, Ruby Nicholson, a brilliant gynecologist, had been shackled in a loveless marriage to her scumbag husband, Kyle Lane. Barren and unable to conceive, she endured relentless torment from his venomous mother, Jennifer Lane, who never missed a chance to belittle her. Kyle had been entangled in a steamy affair with a younger woman, Freya Riley, who was now pregnant with his child. It was in the hospital that Ruby stumbled upon the gut-wrenching truth. Confronted by the treachery, the taunts, and the suffocating oppression, Ruby launched a breathtaking counterattack. Armed with the law, the power of public opinion, and her razor-sharp professional skills, she was determined to expose Kyle and his family. With every step, she clawed back her stolen wealth and her shattered dignity. And then there was Maxwell Smith, an internet celebrity and paparazzo who'd been quietly adoring her from afar. With him, Ruby lived a life painted in hues of hope and love."
6809eed09bf946a7480dcde4.title: The Gynecologist’s Revenge

680aa8211eef6c4917096b4b.synopsis: This week, we’re going behind bars with ReelShort sensation Marc Herrmann, star of the explosive new series Undercover Prison King. Marc takes us inside the walls of this gritty and thrilling ride. Danger lurks in every shadow, plots shift like smoke, and the next jaw-dropping stunt is always just around the corner. ReelTalk Backstage is your all-access pass to vertical productions. Go behind the scenes with your favorite stars as they take you on set and share unforgettable moments. From intense rehearsals to candid conversations, each episode gives you a front-row seat to the action. Get ready to see your favorite shows like never before.
680aa8211eef6c4917096b4b.title: ReelTalk EP19-Backstage: Behind Bars

680b2b37f9bde1cbed032547.synopsis: In Swept Away by My Janitor Husband movie, Ethan, the CEO of Rutherford Enterprises, is undercover as a janitor to uncover a company mole. However, his secret identity complicates things when he falls for Melanie, a secretary at his company. Meanwhile, Melanie, unaware of his true identity, is dealing with betrayal from her fiancé and best friend, as well as family pressure to prove her engagement with a successful man.
680b2b37f9bde1cbed032547.title: Swept Away by My Janitor Husband

680b2c50310d687b600a1eec.synopsis: In Pride & Prejudice movie, despite societal pressures to marry, Lizzie Bennet, second eldest of the Bennet sisters, has her heart set on spinsterhood. But when her father falls gravely ill, Lizzie is unexpectedly thrust into the classist world of courtship in order to save her family from destitution. After a fateful encounter with the broody, mysterious millionaire, Mr. Darcy, Lizzie’s forced to choose between denying her feelings for the sake of her family or allowing herself to fall recklessly in love.
680b2c50310d687b600a1eec.title: Pride & Prejudice

680b30d100ef4d481807d0c7.synopsis: In The Alpha King and His Virgin Bride movie, the Alpha King Killian Storm is cursed to not live past age thirty. Only finding his true fated mate can break the curse, but what happens when his fated mate is a human? Humans cannot mate with Alphas. If he mates with her, she dies, but if he doesn't... he dies.
680b30d100ef4d481807d0c7.title: The Alpha King and His Virgin Bride

680d8afd1d9f89306b0dbce8.synopsis: Talia Stone comes from a wealthy family. Her dad is a billionaire and her three brothers are bigwigs in the military, showbiz and finance world. She saved her childhood friend Jack Chase in an accident and almost lost her legs. Talia's legs were saved by top doctors in the field, but she remained in a wheelchair at her dad's request, as a test for Jack's feelings. The day before their wedding, Talia found out Jack was cheating with her friend Rachel. Enraged by the pair's brazen denial, Talia pretended to turn the other cheek while setting up a plan to humiliate them at the wedding. She then met Aiden Brooks who got her purse back from a thief and asked him half-jokingly to marry her. To her surprise, Aiden said yes. The next day, Talia's supposed wedding turned into a big stage for drama.
680d8afd1d9f89306b0dbce8.title: Bride of Vengeance

6811affad37becd57a0a6842.synopsis: After years away from home and just donating his entire fortune to charities, global no. 1 gamester Dylan Lynn returned home with his big sister Jane. There he reunited with his two elder sisters, Bella and Sarah, and met his adopted brother Liam. Right away, Liam started plotting to kick Dylan out. At their casino, Dylan won a match against Leon Dunn, also known as the Lightning Hands, and saved the family business. Jane later found out Liam was working with Leon and was killed by him. Dylan swore then to bring his sister's killer to justice. He went on to win matches against Liam's biological brother James Fenn and the owner of Stormhold Hotel, getting back a crucial biochip for his country in the process. Finally, after bringing evildoers to justice, Dylan and his wife spent their honeymoon helping victims of gambling kickstart their new lives...
6811affad37becd57a0a6842.title: The Card Shark Who Plays for Good

6811f44c94a6e4b2610b02bd.synopsis: Seven years ago, Zane Sterling took the fall for his younger brother Hunter Sterling in a fatal hit-and-run. His own fiancée Diana Archer testified against him, sending Zane to prison while his parents Tyler Sterling and Claire Shaw watched in silence. During his seven-year sentence, Zane conducted research on controllable nuclear fusion technology (CNFT), earning recognition from the National Science Institute (NSI). Upon release, he discovered his family never wanted him back. After enduring repeated heartbreak, he chose to walk away.
6811f44c94a6e4b2610b02bd.title: Last Gift to My Love-Hate Family

68150df833b25f40180886bf.synopsis: Sparks flew at ReelShort’s first-ever exclusive screening of Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer is My Ex-Lover. Follow stars Seth Edeen and Nicole Mattox as they reignite their chemistry in the latest sizzling ReelShort show. From the big screen to the Q&A and fan meet and greet, this star-studded night was on fire. Fans, cast, crew, and surprise ReelShort stars showed up for a night full of laughs, dragon slaying, and maybe even a little drama. Watch closely, you might just spot a few familiar faces in the crowd. Don’t miss this behind the scenes look at the hottest premiere of the season!
68150df833b25f40180886bf.title: ReelTalk EP20-Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer is My Ex-Lover Premiere Screening

68191e5408a393374109d3ca.synopsis: In The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex movie, when Layla and Joshua break up, they sign a separation agreement: If they're both still single in five years, they get married. Five years later, after becoming the world's hottest and wealthiest chef, Joshua takes the position of head chef at the restuarant where Layla works. Joshua wants her to fulfill the contract, but with her health in an unstable condition, Layla lies and says she's already engaged. Still, an undeniable chemistry builds between them, and the flames of love become hard to suppress. Will Joshua ultimately discover Layla's lie? Can they bridge the gap of lost time and truly be together again, love conquering all?
68191e5408a393374109d3ca.title: The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex

68196e7ad2cc17fb4e06a5d9.synopsis: After being set up by her own family, Nora Wood becomes pregnant with Tyler Holt's child, who is later named Bryan. Unfortunately, when Bryan turns five, he is diagnosed with leukemia. In an effort to cover medical expenses, Nora decides to sell the family jade pendant Tyler had given her, triggering a city-wide search for Bryan by the Holt family. Meanwhile, Nora joins Holt Group as Tyler's secretary. As they work closely together, their feelings for each other grow, and their relationship flourishes over time.
68196e7ad2cc17fb4e06a5d9.title: Ding! CEO Hubby Online

68197774c01ef1147108cca9.synopsis: "I shouldn't have ever saved you and brought you up this mountain!" My teacher scolded me for ruining his precious ingredients to make the divine medicine, but later was surprised at the outcome, that I successfully made it out! I am an orphan, study divine skilled with my teacher, and now come down the mountain to gain experiences. On the first day, I meet a girl, and saved her fatehr's life. Little did I know, they are my lost family, and little did they know, I'm a powerful figure with strong ability!
68197774c01ef1147108cca9.title: I'm Really Not an Immortal

6819783d58829aea130cc034.synopsis: The boxing queen, Tanya Boyle, retires at the peak of her career for love. Unknown to all, Tanya marries Wesley Thomas and devotes herself to looking after the family. Unfortunately, she gets stomach cancer. So, Wesley’s mother introduces a lady to Wesley. Tanya is heartbroken but offers her blessings. After being reborn, Tanya cherishes her health and fights for happiness. But she ends up divorcing Wesley. Then, Tanya rebuilds her life and returns to boxing. At this time, she discovers Wesley’s new girlfriend, Yolanda Lopez, is lying about being the boxing queen. So, Tanya decides to regain her glory. Wesley looks down upon Tanya when fighting her. He even persuades her to quit the game. However, Tanya ignores Wesley and defeats him. Wesley is shocked, and everyone finds out Tanya is the boxing queen. Wesley regrets losing his idol. But Tanya has changed a lot. She only wants to live her life.
6819783d58829aea130cc034.title: Back to the Ring: My KO Mom

68197864df574f74cc0102bc.synopsis: For seven years, Elle Gold secretly helped Joe Judd build DK Corp into a successful company. On their wedding day, pregnant and ready to reveal the truth, she is humiliated by Joe. In an attempt to please his first love, Sue Cole, Joe allows Sue to steal Elle’s spotlight by wearing a wedding dress. Elle endures their cruelty time and again, only to discover that Joe and Sue are having an affair. Worse, Joe believes Sue’s lie that she’s the founder of DK Corp. Devastated, Elle demands a divorce. With Carl Irwin’s help, she plans her revenge. At the signing banquet, she exposes her true identity, pulls her investments, and watches as Joe crumbles in regret.
68197864df574f74cc0102bc.title: Who's Laughing Now, My Ex?

681978ca58829aea130cc038.synopsis: In a romance-themed observation show, several participants undergo a series of interactions and conflicts filled with love, misunderstandings, and power struggles. In the end, one couple rises to overwhelming popularity, and true love prevails as they happily end up together.
681978ca58829aea130cc038.title: A Tangle of Love

681978ef439c213bc40bf4e4.synopsis: After enduring a seven-year relationship, the couple ultimately breaks up due to various misunderstandings and betrayals. Subsequently, one partner completely loses the other to an idealized love, leading to a profound realization. Determined to make amends, he attempts to win her back through various means.
681978ef439c213bc40bf4e4.title: Mending a broken love

68215ed95a3d5c468a0c289c.synopsis: Hector Kellow, head of the Hall of Mars, lived peacefully with Kira Laird after repelling invaders. Tragically, after their daughter Sophia's birth, Kira was taken by her family, leaving Hector to raise Sophia alone. Five years later, discovering Kira was forced to engage Ian Nelson, Hector attended Harriet Nelson's birthday party with Sophia. There, he revealed his identity, intimidated the guests, rescued Kira, and struck a blow to the Nelson family. Reunited, they returned to Kellow Village, where Hector repaid villagers with gold. However, a misunderstanding led to conflict with his father Jude, putting family ties at risk...
68215ed95a3d5c468a0c289c.title: My Legendary Daddy

682160aac9436610660a77a9.synopsis: Janice Moore, a female CEO abducted as a child, returned from abroad to confront her ungrateful brother and his wife while searching for her birth mother. She elevated her mother into high society and helped her mother find twilight-year love.
682160aac9436610660a77a9.title: Mom, Sis, I Regret Now!

6821631e9ccf07644e0f28ba.synopsis: At five, Lily has a rare gift, Golden Eyes that can see through anything. Raised in the mountains with her great-grandfather to protect the sacred Heartline, she longs to find her real parents and see the world. When Darklanders steal seven priceless national treasures and threaten her homeland, Lily sets off on a mission to recover them and discovers her missing father, Alex, a powerful but blinded billionaire. Together, they enter a high-stakes treasure hunt to save both family and country.
6821631e9ccf07644e0f28ba.title: Daddy, I Got Your Back!

6821637fc3f8d3175d0cc2ca.synopsis: Six years ago, Emma was set up and ended up spending the night with Simon and giving birth to quintuplets. Now, she returns with her five kids to take revenge. But when her youngest daughter, Minnie, runs off to find her birth father and ask for a better name, Emma's plan goes awry. When trying to find Minnie, she accidentally becomes Simon's assistant and walks right back into his life.
6821637fc3f8d3175d0cc2ca.title: Daddy, Guess Who's Your Kid?

682163c006e38da149099c91.synopsis: Reborn warrior queen Victoria, bound to a life-for-love system, must seduce four consorts—a defiant prince, a cunning strategist, a vengeful heir, and her loyal shadow—to survive Your Majesty’s lethal schemes. But as fake affections spark real fire, she rebels against fate: forging rebel merchants into armies, trading empires with commerce, and rewriting the system’s rules. Can a weaponized heart crown her as empire-shaper… or doom her as its martyr?
682163c006e38da149099c91.title: System Alert! Conquer All Gentlemen!

6822a241bcbbb3c4ee08bd30.synopsis: Heather found her mate James was cheating with his uncle's fiancee. She was so hurt that she went into his uncle Antonio’s room to seduce him, and kissed him... However, The cold man seems had feelings for her so that he couldn't control himself and kissed her hardly...
6822a241bcbbb3c4ee08bd30.title: My Accidental Alpha's Desire

68231417a0f7a86c6d08968d.synopsis: A modern romantic psychological thriller in the tone of Fifty Shades of Grey and Secretary, Assistant is dark, seductive, outrageously thought-provoking, and riveting. Directorial debut of genre filmmaker Louisa Warren (Cannibal Cabin, Hard Copy).
68231417a0f7a86c6d08968d.title: Dirty Work

68239ae8c85961939e012759.synopsis: In How to Dump a Hockey Star movie: After leaving behind her life as a billionaire heiress, Renee dedicates herself to helping her husband recover from a vegetative state and pursue his NHL dreams. However, after suffering a devastating miscarriage, she is faced with a brutal truth: the man she sacrificed everything for might have chosen someone else.
68239ae8c85961939e012759.title: How to Dump a Hockey Star

68244b101a86d1ee5f03bfd9.synopsis: Lucy is excited to be chosen for a reality TV style game show, being streamed online, where contestants complete challenges sent in by the audience, to win big cash prizes. The fun soon turns sinister, as the viewer requests become more perverse.
68244b101a86d1ee5f03bfd9.title: Dirty Games

68244ec4c9eccf95e00b3209.synopsis: Sorceress Arden and her warrior girlfriend Katia are deeply in love. But the veil between Earth and the World of Magic keeps them apart. When the evil sorcerer Zareth arises from the dead, Arden and Katia are sent on a quest to defeat him.
68244ec4c9eccf95e00b3209.title: Dagger Kiss: Enchanted Forest

68244f2bc85961939e01276f.synopsis: Brian Cook has been a firefighter for over 15 years, but he is now facing the biggest battle of his life–not the fire in the field, but the fire burning inside.
68244f2bc85961939e01276f.title: Fighting the Fire

68259abb130591adac007a1b.synopsis: In My Cold-Hearted Mafia King movie, after her father's death, Vivian was abandoned by her stepmother Catherine and stepsister Olivia, then kidnapped and trafficked—until she was rescued by Damien Russo, the king of the mafia, and brought into his home. Despite their age gap, Vivian gradually develops feelings for Damien, while he struggles to resist the temptation. When an arranged marriage between Olivia and Damien is revealed, chaos ensues, putting their already complicated and budding romance to the ultimate test.
68259abb130591adac007a1b.title: My Cold-Hearted Mafia King

6825af4b1657d2354b0d8094.synopsis: In CEO Queen A Mother’s Revenge movie, after 15 years of living as a humble orphanage worker, Mary Miller's peaceful life is shattered when a brain hemorrhage leaves her comatose. While her youngest adopted daughter Grace desperately tries to save her life by selling her own blood, her other children Rose and William reveal their true cruel nature. When Mary finally wakes and claims to be Phoenix Group's legendary CEO, she faces brutal mockery and violence. But those who dare abuse the "delusional old woman" are about to learn they've made a terrible mistake—as Mary's vast empire prepares to strike back against all who wronged her family, while rewarding the one daughter who loved her without knowing her true identity.
6825af4b1657d2354b0d8094.title: CEO Queen: A Mother’s Revenge

6825b0364baea997900af476.synopsis: In I Am Bloody Mary movie, Mare and her fiancé Nick may not have much money, but they have love. As a foster kid with no family of her own, Mare dreams of a wedding with Nick’s family by their side, but Nick is secretive about his estranged relatives. Then, unexpectedly, his mother arrives, warmly inviting Mare into the wealthy and mysterious Thornwood family. She even offers to host the wedding at their grand estate. But the morning of the ceremony, a horrifying discovery shatters Mare's dream, and she realizes she’s not walking into a happy-ever-after, but into a nightmare twisted by the Thornwood family’s dark history--one that might end up killing her.
6825b0364baea997900af476.title: I Am Bloody Mary

6825b1146b80c83269085553.synopsis: In Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love movie, Madison was a Manhattan heiress with it all—until she loses everything, including her now-cruel fiancé who stranded her in Texas. Broke and desperate, Madison wanders into a local saloon…and into the arms of Beau Hayes—her ex’s rugged, dangerously sexy cowboy uncle. After a steamy night, Beau offers her a job -- and an unexpected shelter. Now Madison’s trading pearls for cowboy boots, riding bulls, horses—and maybe even a cowboy.
6825b1146b80c83269085553.title: Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love

6825b16d10d861e01708bf53.synopsis: In Hey Boss Your Company is Getting Bombed movie, Clyde is a middle-aged salesman who has been marginalized in his job. One day, he wakes up with a superpower of seeing when and how people would die. He tries to save multiple people from death, but no one believes him. A few days later, his power tells him there is going to be an explosion at his company that will kill everyone in the building. To save everyone, he has to find out who planted the bomb and stop them.
6825b16d10d861e01708bf53.title: Hey Boss, Your Company is Getting Bombed

6825b18899955153a60f7327.synopsis: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy movie shows Jane Wellsy has a secret — she's got a crush on her stepbrother Nate Duncan. No one knows except for her worst enemy, hockey badboy Zach Gates. Even worse, Jane finds out Nate's new transfer student girlfriend was her bully from high school, Melissa! When Melissa finds Jane's smutty story and demands to know if it's about Nate, Zach swoops in to save her, kicking off their fake relationship to keep her secret safe. As they spend time together, Jane finds there's a warm, kind heart under Zach's cold bad boy persona, ready to heal her broken heart and face the world at her side...
6825b18899955153a60f7327.title: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy

6825b19ec7aae107a705218e.synopsis: In The Alpha's Virgin Captive movie, Evelyn never meant to save the ruthless alpha, Dominic—but now she’s his mate. She’s wolfless and already chosen Harrison, but Dominic doesn’t take no for an answer. He kidnaps her, claiming her as his. She tries to run, but the more she resists, the hotter the desire burns between them. What terrifies her most? The way she’s slowly starting to crave him... more than anything.
6825b19ec7aae107a705218e.title: The Alpha's Virgin Captive

6825b1afb6c3cf13af0e26a6.synopsis: In Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy movie: When med intern Molly has a one-night stand with a stranger, she thinks it’s a one-and-done kind of deal. But a month later, she discovers two shocking truths: she’s pregnant with his baby… and the stranger is her new boss, Dr. Graham Weston. As soon as Molly’s secret comes out, so do her rivals, including her jealous family and a figure from Graham's past, each determined to keep her and Graham apart. With pressure mounting from all sides, can they survive the chaos and find love in the process?
6825b1afb6c3cf13af0e26a6.title: Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy

6825b313f981e578730e6174.synopsis: In Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad movie: on her first day of the semester, Emily catches her boyfriend cheating on her. That night, she has a wild one-night stand with a stranger named Charles. The next day, they are mutually shocked to find out that Charles is Emily's new professor. They maintain a professional student-teacher relationship, but there's an undeniable tension between them. Just when Emily thinks everything will get back on track, she unexpectedly finds out she's pregnant...
6825b313f981e578730e6174.title: Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad

6825b32759426343470c833f.synopsis: In The Adjuster movie, after his sister dies due to losing health coverage, Matteo Leone, a broken man, takes justice into his own hands by killing the insurance company CEO. But he isn't just out for revenge, he has a bigger goal: Expose corrupt health insurance companies for preying on their most vulnerable customers. Matteo stays one step ahead of the police, leaving a trail of clues to send his message, soon becoming a hero to the people the evil CEO's thought they could silence.
6825b32759426343470c833f.title: The Adjuster

6825b34d0453c1c8c408726f.synopsis: In Never Reject A Wolf Princess movie: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty—only to be betrayed and rejected by her mate. But she’s not one to stay broken for long. When she unexpectedly bonds with a new mate hiding his own secrets, Lia is thrust into a world of power, deception, and second chances. Now, she’s done following the rules. It’s time to reclaim her throne—and make everyone who doubted her regret it!
6825b34d0453c1c8c408726f.title: Never Reject A Wolf Princess

6825b360f80a554645009d35.synopsis: In How to Kiss a Vampire movie, eight years after Vincent abandoned her, Ella—now a single mom—is pushed off a rooftop and saved by a mysterious, flying masked man. She wakes up to find Vincent at her side. He denies being the masked man but insists his enemies are targeting her and demands she move in with him for protection. Why is the man who broke her heart now acting like her savior? And why does he seem... not entirely human? Can Ella trust him again—or is he hiding more than just a mask?
6825b360f80a554645009d35.title: How to Kiss a Vampire

6825b379ac2e521b7f0db504.synopsis: In Queen Never Cry movie: 7 years ago, Nicole leaves her family fortune behind for her husband Ethan. She thought she's the happiest wife and mother -- until Ethan and her best friend Elaine sent her to jail and took her daughter away. Now seeing their true color, Nicole decides to regain her heiress status, take back her daughter and show everyone what a real queen looks like.
6825b379ac2e521b7f0db504.title: Queen Never Cry

6825b38d4baea997900af478.synopsis: In Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King movie, Vanessa Peters is in for a surprise when she goes to sell her eggs to pay off her boyfriend's debt...and ends up pregnant due to a clinical error. She decides to keep the child after finding out her boyfriend is cheating on her, but begins to fear her decision when she finds out that the father is no other than Marcello Lavigne, a ruthless, murderous Mafia King. After saving her life from thugs who try to attack her for having mafia money, Marcello moves Vanessa to his mansion against her will. As he continuously proves his commitment to keeping her safe from criminals, bullies, and his mafia family, Vanessa begins to develop feelings for him despite his player behavior and his murderous capacity. Will she accept Marcello as the father to her child, and accept his offer to become queen of the Mafia empire?
6825b38d4baea997900af478.title: Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King

6825b3b6ddcc859b080f78d6.synopsis: In The Lost Son Returns as the Duke movie: Kidnapped as a child, Arthur, Duke of Mercia, returns to his village to reunite with his long-lost family. What he didn't expect was to find them abused by everyone in town. With his identity a secret, will Arthur be able to avenge them?
6825b3b6ddcc859b080f78d6.title: The Lost Son Returns as the Duke

6825b3d4440cf7c17309a7db.synopsis: Arianna dies a tragic death on the day of her graduation, while Derek, the driver's son, takes all the spotlight on stage. She gave him everything—her car, her credit card, even her father’s company—only to be used and discarded. While he spoiled Ivy like a princess, he treated Arianna like a servant. Only in death does she realize that Hayden, the billionaire’s heir - had been waiting for her all along. Now, fate gives her a second chance to make things right.
6825b3d4440cf7c17309a7db.title: Reborn to Love Mr. Right

6825b3f25b08ac3a230d912d.synopsis: In Obsessed with His Silent Bride movie, Taken in as a ward of the Calvert family, Eva has always loved Declan Calvert, the boy who grew up as her protector. Nonverbal since birth, she struggles to express her feelings in a marriage built on duty—Declan only married her to honor his grandfather’s dying wish. Trapped in a toxic union, Eva endures Declan’s cruelty and his mistress Selene’s relentless schemes to drive her out. Despite it all, Eva clings to the hope that Declan might rediscover the love they once shared as children. Bound by silence, Eva must decide: fight for his heart or break free before it’s too late.
6825b3f25b08ac3a230d912d.title: Obsessed with His Silent Bride

6825b40ac6c46f2b17055695.synopsis: The wolfless Lyra, has been captive in the Wolfsbane pack for seven years, during which she was constantly abused by Alpha Roland. During one of her escapes, Lyra has an accidental one-night stand with Alpha Alfred, Moonshadow pack's strongest Alpha, and becomes pregnant with his child. Alpha Alfred rescues Lyra from Alpha Roland and brings her back to his pack. To protect her, Alfred and Lyra form a Fake Luna contract.
6825b40ac6c46f2b17055695.title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me

6825b41bf2eb39f1c50606bb.synopsis: In Mother Warrior Unleashed movie, when her teenage daughter is grabbed by sex traffickers, the legendary warrior, Navy SEAL Lieutenant Phoenix Ryan, abandons her life of anonymity as a small town diner owner to rescue her daughter and destroy the Navarro Cartel that has taken her.
6825b41bf2eb39f1c50606bb.title: Mother Warrior Unleashed

6825b45960033dc2750e6ae1.synopsis: When a High Level Mafioso finds himself in the body of a bullied high schooler, he uses it as a second chance at finishing high school. But will his street smarts help him to fulfill his dream of going to college, or will a group of bullies drive him to drop out again?
6825b45960033dc2750e6ae1.title: Mafia Boss Takes High School

6825b4807cc7bf22e3085e15.synopsis: After losing my parents, I move in with my godmother, Aunt Sandra. I live under her roof with her two sons-the Miller brothers-surrounded by love and care. I think I’ll end up with one of them. But everything changes when the maid’s daughter, Lola, moves in. The Miller brother I love most breaks my heart into pieces. After I leave, they lose their minds trying to find me.
6825b4807cc7bf22e3085e15.title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone

6825b496ac2e521b7f0db506.synopsis: In Forgive Me, Forget Me Not movie, Lottie is forced to give up on the man she loves in order to save his life. Year later, she runs into him again and he's a bigshot lawyer with billions at his disposal. But not only that, he has a cold hard vendetta against her... for stabbing him.
6825b496ac2e521b7f0db506.title: Forgive Me, Forget Me Not

682a961c54e2eb6e8803e311.synopsis: In Blossom in Armor movie, Riley Hale joined the army in her father's place and saved the emperor from the enemies. As a reward, the emperor granted her the largest estate as a dowry and promised to fulfill any request with a jade token. Returning home, Riley shed her armor for a wedding dress and married Steve Barron. Five years later, Steve brought his confidante, Fiona Smith, to Riley, asking her to give up her position as his wife and give him the estate because Fiona wanted to hold her wedding there. Steve and his family pressured Riley to leave and even demanded she provide a dowry for Fiona. Humiliated, Riley resolutely went to the palace and requested a divorce with the jade token. She asked to return to the battlefield to defend the borders and the people. There, she met her true love. The Crown Prince fell for Riley at first sight, and together they subdued the turmoil in the north, earning Riley great military merit once more. The Crown Prince was determined to marry Riley, but faced many obstacles... Episode List
682a961c54e2eb6e8803e311.title: Blossom in Armor

682a964a762f80cab90ee692.synopsis: In A Mother’s Wait Mom Dad I'm Back movie, fifteen years ago, Elijah Morton was separated from his mother Sabrina Lester at a fair and adopted by General Hale Gibson. After Gibson became the King, he appointed Elijah Duke of South and ordered him to build a palace in his hometown while seeking his parents. Staying at Lord Gideon Quain's estate, Elijah repeatedly missed recognizing Sabrina, who worked there as a servant. When Sabrina's house was seized for palace construction, her nephew Wyatt Morton attempted to force her out. Elijah intervened, confirming their mother-son bond through a keepsake. Wyatt later kidnapped Elijah to curry favor with Gideon, who panicked upon discovering this and freed Elijah by revealing his status. Sabrina and her husband Alfred Morton sought help from Elijah's fiancée Camille Elwood. Camille's stepfamily framed her for theft, leading her father Larry Elwood to sentence her to marry Chester Quain. Elijah rescued Camille and punished the conspirators. At Sabrina's estranged father Paul Lester's 70th birthday, Sabrina presented Elijah's expensive wine in plain packaging. Her jealous sisters denounced it as fake, prompting Paul to disown her. Elijah arrived with officials bearing lavish gifts, exposing the family's hypocrisy. He departed with his parents as Paul regretted his cruelty.
682a964a762f80cab90ee692.title: A Mother’s Wait: Mom, Dad, I'm Back

682a96bdca30612ac90e6e7d.synopsis: Jesse was wrongfully imprisoned for ten years. Upon release, he discovered that the real culprits were his own wife and daughter, who even caused his mother's death. Disheartened, Jesse decided to divorce and leave town. In Tont City, he rebuilt his life, becoming a senior engineer and falling in love with Lizzie. Returning to his hometown with newfound success, Jesse is determined to bring those responsible to justice.
682a96bdca30612ac90e6e7d.title: Ten Years of Wrong Love

682fbf3caaa19ac5730dfc8c.synopsis: OG ReelShort stars Autumn Noel and Kasey Esser are back and better than ever! The duo reunites on screen in this episode, rekindling their chemistry. Watch them react to their latest show, Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire, and spill all the behind the scenes tea about working together again. Trust us, you won’t want to miss this one!
682fbf3caaa19ac5730dfc8c.title: ReelTalk EP23-New Show, Same Spark

6835831790ff91ab240435a1.synopsis: Left heartbroken at the altar, Liana impulsively marries Jacob, a mysterious billionaire hiding his own pain. What begins as a cold agreement transforms into a journey of passion and healing. As they navigate meddling exes, family drama, and corporate battles, will their whirlwind romance blossom into true love, or will their pasts tear them apart?
6835831790ff91ab240435a1.title: Runaway Billionaire Becomes My Groom

6836676702c5394e880dc4cc.synopsis: When her boyfriend suddenly drops out of their roadtrip to her best friend's wedding, Samantha Smiles is forced to take the long drive from LA to NYC with the boy she's spent the last five years trying to forget. The boy she spent one secret summer night with. The boy she let take ALL her firsts: Tristan Montgomery, AKA her best friend's older brother! Torn between loyalty and her resurfacing (mutual?) feelings for Tristan, Samantha has to make a choice: will she keep living for others, or will she finally, for once, do something for herself?!
6836676702c5394e880dc4cc.title: The Boy I Hate

68366a2ed38353ed2f09f438.synopsis: Jealous of Mitch Harmon for his luxurious life, Javier Harmon attacked Mitch with a knife, and the cousins both died. But when they opened their eyes, they were back on the fateful wedding night in 1977 that had set their lives on diverging paths! With memories of his last life, Javier married Patsy Reeves, the adopted girl, instead of switching brides with Mitch. He thought he could steal Mitch's future—but only sank deeper into misery. Meanwhile, Mitch built a life richer in love, purpose, and success than before with Margie.
68366a2ed38353ed2f09f438.title: Reborn to Swap Fates

68366a3c4fea8590a202f840.synopsis: When Della Avery arrived as the new principal, her first bold move was to appoint Jeromy Munoz—the school's janitor—as the headteacher of its worst class. But Jeromy wasn't ordinary. After a strange turn of fate, he gained a magic system, allowing him to see the hidden talents of each student. As he awakened the potential of these so-called failures, the class began to rise fast. The monthly exam turned into battlegrounds, and the underdogs began defeating the school's top students...
68366a3c4fea8590a202f840.title: When I Can See My Students' Hidden Potentials

68366a4f2ebc78fcaa04bb7e.synopsis: In her previous life, Natalie Simpson, born a nobleman's daughter and the wife of General Eden Richter, was betrayed and murdered by her sister Winona Simpson and the general himself, meeting a tragic end. Reborn into a new life, she vowed revenge and seduced the King to wield him as her weapon. Yet she soon realized her miscalculation because the King had fallen far more deeply than she'd anticipated. To her shock, he resolved to crown her queen against all odds!
68366a4f2ebc78fcaa04bb7e.title: The Emperor’s Doomed Obsession

68366a5f6afb3d584b03c236.synopsis: Stella, the forgotten wife, was left in the countryside while her husband, Joshua, brought his sister-in-law to the city, claiming it was to avoid gossip. He wrote Stella sweet letters every month, but gave all his military pay to his sister-in-law. During a famine, while Joshua's sister-in-law and her children dined on meat buns in his city mansion, Stella and her child starved to death. But death wasn't the end. Stella is reborn, and this time, she's not playing the obedient wife.
68366a5f6afb3d584b03c236.title: Reborn to Ruin You, My DEAR Hubby

68366a7acbd030741a0703e4.synopsis: Naomi James's boyfriend pushed her from the rooftop after getting involved with Jenny Walker, a billionaire's sister. Getting reborn, Naomi decided to approach Matthew Walker, Jenny's rich but sickly brother. Matthew was predicted to never have children and possibly dying young, but none of that stopped Naomi from marrying him. Shortly after getting married, Naomi found out she was pregnant!
68366a7acbd030741a0703e4.title: Pregnant with My Nemesis’ Brother’s Baby

68366a88d89dd7553c06c6db.synopsis: In his past life, Eric gave everything for his family, but got betrayed. He went to jail for his adopted brother Felix, but only got contempt. Abandoned by his family, Eric died. After rebirth, he refused to take the fall for Felix and exposed the truth. But his mom and sisters didn't believe him. Heartbroken, he cut ties with them and rose as a radio star. Using his creative talent, he did better than his sisters and Felix. His family realized Eric was the real genius. Felix was only a thief who stole Eric's works...
68366a88d89dd7553c06c6db.title: When the Snow Stops — Vengeance Rises

6836a4b02ef81742260a5219.synopsis: In Regret is the Punishment movie, MC Karen is a stay at home mom, her husband Tom is a rich Lawyer. While Karen is out, her house catches on fire and their five year old daughter Anna falls to her death. Good samaritan Merry goes with the fire truck to take Anna to the hospital, driven by Bob, the fire captain. They need to take Anna to the ER for surgery as soon as possible. The fire truck hits Karen's car, on her way back from cheating on her husband. She demands they grovel for forgiveness, then pay for damages, wasting their time. Merry and Eve, the paramedic, as well as kind passerbys, try to get her to move. Karen does not give in, not realizing the fire truck is trying to save her own daughter.
6836a4b02ef81742260a5219.title: Regret is the Punishment

6836ad4a5bb9b1a04006257c.synopsis: She died in the year he loved her most. With a billion-dollar fortune, he threw it all away, choosing to follow her in death. When she opens her eyes again, she’s back to the years when she despised him. With a bitter smile, he says, “Want a divorce? Over my dead body.”
6836ad4a5bb9b1a04006257c.title: Titanic Love After Rebirth

6838877ef87c3e88af08a34c.synopsis: A socially shunned columnist finds his romantic match online, but messaging under the wrong account causes his sleazy roommate's picture to be forwarded, creating an identity mix-up.
6838877ef87c3e88af08a34c.title: Is It Just Me?

6838c51e0186d2294806ff06.synopsis: To wrap up Mental Health Awareness Month, Autumn Noel gets real with her bestie Amanda Liguori in a heartfelt conversation. For the first time, Autumn opens up about her experience with bullying, online negativity, and the path she’s taken to heal. From finding strength in songwriting to standing up for herself, she shares how she’s turned her struggles into growth. This is Autumn like you’ve never seen her before. Only on ReelTalk!
6838c51e0186d2294806ff06.title: ReelTalk EP24-Surviving Bullying & Navigating Mental Health

68392804654b9abb0b050279.synopsis: In Crossing The Line To Love movie: three days before her wedding, freelance writer Nichole catches her fiancé in bed with her bridesmaid. In a moment of heartbreak and rage, she storms into a bar and kisses a random stranger—only to realize he’s Fabian Winston, a wildly popular contemporary artist and the sole heir to a powerful elite family. The kiss goes viral overnight. Faced with mounting public pressure and relentless media, Nichole is pushed into a contract marriage with Fabian. What starts as a scandal-driven deal slowly unravels into a messy, irresistible entanglement of power, secrets, and unexpected feelings.
68392804654b9abb0b050279.title: Crossing The Line To Love

68397f706c11557c9d008549.synopsis: Heiress Joy Quinn hides her identity and cuts ties with her family to marry broke boyfriend Ryan Zimmer. But just as she's about to give birth, betrayal strikes. With the baby in the wrong position, Joy checks into a private hospital. But Ryan's best friend Yasmine accuses her of faking it for luxury. Manipulated, Ryan tries to move Joy to a cheaper clinic, sparking explosive drama. Just then, Joy's father, billionaire Raymond Quinn, arrives bearing lavish gifts. But Ryan and Yasmine mock him, refusing to believe his identity. As three elite CEOs show up honor Quinn, the truth is revealed. But it's already too late. Joy loses the baby and demands a divorce. Desperate, Ryan spreads lies online, accusing Joy and her father of murdering the child. The internet turns vicious. Raymond strikes back with evidence, and calls the police. In the end, Ryan and Yasmine are convicted and sentenced.
68397f706c11557c9d008549.title: I Divorced on Delivery Day

683e4a35f75bf8fadc007571.synopsis: Rin, the sole heir of the White Nine-Tailed Fox clan, was kidnapped as a child by the Black Nine-Tailed Fox and raised in darkness. On her 20th birthday, she plans to escape—once her fox powers finally awaken. But fate has a cruel twist in store: her destined mate is revealed to be Hyun Dong-joo, the cold and powerful leader of the Black Nine-Tailed Fox. Rin and Hyun Dong-joo resent one another and reject the bond. But just when White Fox leader Baek Do-yoon steps forward and claims Rin as his fated partner, Hyun Dong-joo suddenly declares he will marry her instead. Who will truly be Rin’s fated mate?
683e4a35f75bf8fadc007571.title: Fated Mate of the Nine-Tailed Fox

683ebfbb2e0e6325b30fe7ff.synopsis: In his past life, Austin ignored his own daughter for a widow named Anna, raising Anna's two sons. But when he got old and ill, Anna and her sons refused to pay his medical bills. So he died in pain. After rebirth, he wouldn't be a stepfather again. He rejected ungrateful Anna, and decided to earn more money to raise his own daughter well. In the end, he also got a nice wife Daisy...
683ebfbb2e0e6325b30fe7ff.title: A Father's Redemption

684205692e68fc317d0f3a28.synopsis: Ever wondered what really goes on behind the scenes of those steamy on-screen moments? Especially in the world of vertical dramas? Renowned intimacy coordinator Olivia Ku joins ReelShort star Tess Dinerstein, known for her bold performances in Surrender to My Professor and How to Tame a Silver Fox, for a candid conversation about the art and logistics of choreographing intimacy. Tess opens up about what empowers her in these daring roles, how she protects her boundaries, and what it takes to bring your favorite romance stories to life. All with safety, trust, and consent.
684205692e68fc317d0f3a28.title: ReelTalk EP25-The Art of Intimacy

6846487491f5e1240800afac.synopsis: Heiress Joy Quinn hides her identity and cuts ties with her family to marry broke boyfriend Ryan Zimmer. But just as she's about to give birth, betrayal strikes. With the baby in the wrong position, Joy checks into a private hospital. But Ryan's best friend Yasmine accuses her of faking it for luxury. Manipulated, Ryan tries to move Joy to a cheaper clinic, sparking explosive drama. Just then, Joy's father, billionaire Raymond Quinn, arrives bearing lavish gifts. But Ryan and Yasmine mock him, refusing to believe his identity. As three elite CEOs show up honor Quinn, the truth is revealed. But it's already too late. Joy loses the baby and demands a divorce. Desperate, Ryan spreads lies online, accusing Joy and her father of murdering the child. The internet turns vicious. Raymond strikes back with evidence, and calls the police. In the end, Ryan and Yasmine are convicted and sentenced.
6846487491f5e1240800afac.title: I Divorced on Delivery Day

68466cf23f6f0588fd06b114.synopsis: In A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss movie: by chance, Tessa, an emergency room nurse, saved Victor, a dangerous and charming gang boss, but was strongly targeted by him. He was closing in on her, and she was running for her life—until fate tore away her last hope. Her brother was dying, and the sky-high medical bills were crushing her. Victor narrowed his cold eyes and said, "Be my woman, and I'll save him." She was forced to sign a marriage contract. She resisted his world but indulged in his protection and tenderness. When she found out that the mysterious man who saved her on the rainy night five years ago was actually him, the boundary between hate and love completely collapsed...
68466cf23f6f0588fd06b114.title: A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss

6848e107c168d1dd800397c2.synopsis: James Bennett suffered amnesia after a car accident, retaining only 5-year-old memories. His passionate pursuit of Claire Reynolds shifted to hesitation after regaining memories. Claire, Ascend Corp's president, battled the Cooper family. James' ex-lover Vanessa Cooper sabotaged their marriage & hired thugs to harm Claire, landing jailed. Despite turmoil—misunderstandings, a rushed wedding & pregnancy—they reconciled & began anew.
6848e107c168d1dd800397c2.title: My CEO Amnesia Puppy

6848e1260776e21c950d776c.synopsis: Maria Dolton and her father, Zeph Dolton, fled the Infernal Abyss to escape the clutches of Chad Delgado, the ruthless ruler of the Infernal Tribunal. Hoping to build a peaceful life in Graton, they crossed paths with Yvonne Garza, the powerful CEO of Eclipse Group. To avoid an arranged marriage, Yvonne married Zeph. When the Malcoms from Ranham gave Yvonne trouble in the competition for the CloudTop project, Maria defeated them—only to discover Chad was their backer. Then, she lured Chad to Graton and defeated him with Zeph once and for all, bringing peace to both Graton and the Infernal Abyss.
6848e1260776e21c950d776c.title: Pigtails & Punches

6848e13e30bd2d120602d65f.synopsis: Mia York impersonated heiress Chloe Lynn to attend CEO Silas Ford's matchmaking, demanding huge dowry but unmasked. Silas later became her boss. He enforced a "Ten-Date Pact"; Mia faced false accusations defending Hart Studio but got Silas' covert aid. Posing as "Eve York" to ease his family's marriage pressure, she became his fake girlfriend. Their charade revealed her authenticity and his hidden warmth.​
6848e13e30bd2d120602d65f.title: Boss in Disguise

6848e15722a3da741103b0e2.synopsis: When Cynthia Hart was battling on the front lines for her country, her daughter fell prey to the Klein family. In a rage, Cynthia rushed home, only to find her husband was getting engaged to Carrie Klein! Cynthia used her power to crush the wicked and rescue her daughter.
