He married for one reason alone—to produce an heir under his mother Elizabeth's pressure, secure the family fortune, and defeat his rival half-brother, Jeff. Now, trapped in a loveless marriage and yearning for freedom, Fiona finds herself drawn into a dangerous affair… with a man whose secrets are even deadlier than her own.
68b1135109ac3c3b58012dfb.title: The Mafia Boss Happens to Be My Sex Partner

68b1781df4d69f56740a6a07.synopsis: Claire Evens, an aspiring actress, is in a secret relationship with producer, Mitch Sterling. All is well until the day Claire finds out that she is pregnant. Her lover turns aggressive and pressures her to abort the child. Heartbroken Claire is forced out of his life till she finds a friend in a struggling screenplay writer, Alex. Claire makes the mistake of threatening to inform the press about the pregnancy. Mitch changes his tone and Claire believes that they have reconciled. Claire goes out with Mitch despite Alex’s disapproval. Mitch betrays Claire and tries to dispose of her and their unborn child in the most gruesome way possible. Alex witnesses the incident and passes out just before they are rescued. Twenty years later, Alex is a highly successful screenplay writer. Clara, Claire’s orphan daughter, has become a renowned actress. Both are highly sought after by everyone in the industry. They are determined to make Mitch pay for what he did…
68b1781df4d69f56740a6a07.title: My Celebrity Boyfriend Killed Me

68b1781df4d69f56740a6a0d.synopsis: After the death of her father, the richest man in all of Australia, Isabella is named the sole heir to his throne and vast wealth. This decision by her father earns her a lot of enemies. Isabella's stepmother is found dead on the morning of her wedding. The wedding is called off and an adept detective with an eagle eye is called upon to crack the case. Will he find the killer? Will Isabella keep her father's fortune...
68b1781df4d69f56740a6a0d.title: The Dumb Billionaire Heiress In Love Part I

68b1781ef4d69f56740a6a0f.synopsis: Antonio inadvertently shoots Isabella, she is in a coma, and wakes up six months later on her bed, but she has lost her memory. Stella is now impersonating Isabella, and she is secretly stealing the family fortune under Isabella's name. Isabella eventually reaches out to an imprisoned Antonio, and Antonio points her in the direction of Detective Gonzalez because he could be a possible ally. After her conversation with Detective Gonzalez, Isabella finds out that she was never in a coma...
68b1781ef4d69f56740a6a0f.title: The Dumb Billionaire Heiress In Love Part II

68b1781ef4d69f56740a6a11.synopsis: Emmaline Castro, the renowned COO and backbone of the Castro enterprises, one of the largest pharmaceutical conglomerates in America. Ruthless in her approach to business and unrelenting in her pursuit for success, Emmeline hits an unanticipated upturn in her career aspirations when her sickly father, Gerard Castro, informs her that he intends to name her irresponsible and nonchalant brother JONAS, as Heir to Castro Enterprises. Emmaline is livid at the absurd proclamation, but her father is resolute and his decision is set in stone. Desperate to change his mind, Emmeline informs her father that she will land the Anderson account, a billion-dollar partnership that will not just boost the company's net worth, but also, its reputation.In a stroke of fortune, Emmaline manages to land a meeting with the anonymous benefactor behind the Anderson account, Mr. X. But it turns out to be no stroke of luck. The meeting was orchestrated by Mr. X himself after he read her proposal. Upon their meeting, Emmaline realizes that Mr. X is a man she humiliated years ago for being poor and wretched. Will Emmaline swallow her pride and consent? Will she be able to beat her devilishly deceptive and cunning brother to the prize? Will she be able to deny the romantic connection forging between her and Mr. X?
68b1781ef4d69f56740a6a11.title: The Crown

68b1781ef4d69f56740a6a13.synopsis: Betty Bennett is a beautiful woman wanted by every rich man in Fraudensia. After all, she is the best escort for a high-end group of personnels. She is approached to murder Austin by his wife, Janice, who promises her a sizeable portion of Austin’s inheritance. However, the night of the murder turns out to be the beginning of the fight for her life. Frightened for her safety, she runs to her brother for help. Betty needs to find out what is really going on. Her stubborn nature won’t let her sit around and let everything fall into place. Terry learns that Janice was once his ex-lover. The end to their relationship was bitter with one almost killing the other. Determined to get revenge on Terry and his family, Janice is blind to how everything will eventually affect her. Betty learns the truth. Betty chases after Janice so she pays for ruining her life and reputation. Betty sets her trap, making sure that Janice never hurts anyone again. A murder, a cover up and a conspiracy story is what drives this series of the Mistress trap. Will Betty finally emerge on top? What secrets will be uncovered in this series?
68b1781ef4d69f56740a6a13.title: The Mistress Trap

68b1781ff4d69f56740a6a1f.synopsis: David and Mia are crazy about each other and have decided to get married. They move in together and their love grows stronger. Mia brings some changes to the house. She employs Sara, an older lady, as the maid. Strange things begin to happen in the house. David falls ill and he hires a nurse, Amy, to care for him. David grows accustomed to her care, which may affect his affection for Mia. Soon, Amy realizes the cause of David’s illness. Would Amy be able to reveal the true identities of his lover and maid?
68b1781ff4d69f56740a6a1f.title: Hidden Agenda

68b1781ff4d69f56740a6a21.synopsis: In "Mysterious Murderer" follow the gripping tale of a brilliant young woman on the brink of medical school, poised for a seemingly idyllic life. However, her world shatters when a distress call from her father draws her back home, only to discover her parents brutally murdered under enigmatic circumstances. Driven by a relentless pursuit of justice, she becomes entangled in a web of town secrets that unravel a haunting mystery. As she delves deeper, she discovers that the elusive clues are not only closer than she could have imagined but also pose a dire threat to her own existence. Prepare for a suspenseful journey as she navigates through shadows, uncovering the unsettling truth that transforms her quest for justice into a battle for survival.
68b1781ff4d69f56740a6a21.title: Mysterious Murderer

68b17820f4d69f56740a6a23.synopsis: Caroline has just picked up her engagement ring that she ordered a few weeks ago. She wants to show the ring to Matthew, her fiancé, at Matthew's apartment. When she arrives at Matthew's apartment, she discovers Matthew having sex with her stepsister, Alexis. Caroline is furious and quickly leaves Matthew's apartment, but accidentally gets hit by a speeding motorcycle. At that moment, Jack, who is overseeing his company's apartment, sees Caroline and immediately saves her. The next day, Alexis and Matthew visit Caroline at the hospital, but Caroline, feeling very sad, asks for the engagement to be called off. While at the hospital, Caroline sees a man attempting to steal the wallet of an elderly patient. Caroline helps the elderly woman. While escorting the woman back to her room, Caroline receives a call from her late mother's company lawyer, informing her that her stepmother plans to transfer ownership of her mother's Rosewood company to Caroline's greedy stepmother, Joana. Upon entering the woman's room, Caroline discovers Jack, the woman's grandson, who has just arrived, and the woman, named Nancy, is seen scolding Jack, who is also unmarried. Jack appears disheveled as he had just returned from inspecting his company, leading Caroline to assume he is poor.A few days later, Caroline meets Jack at a cafe and asks him to marry her. Eventually, the company falls into Caroline's hands, and she struggles to restore her mother's company to its former financial glory, which has suffered a decline.Throughout their journey, Caroline discovers that Jack is the heir to the famous Stone family. However, the conflict is not over as her stepmother, Joana, tries to sabotage their marriage. In the end, Caroline and Jack overcome all obstacles and begin a new, happy life together.
68b17820f4d69f56740a6a23.title: The Day We Got Married

68b17822f4d69f56740a6a37.synopsis: Cassie has always been an ambitious lady, super competitive, smart, an overachiever and supposedly, heir to the Blue Empire. After the death of her father, she discovers she did not just inherit wealth but debts and her father's enemies. Her ego is challenged when she falls in love with Ethan, an employee at her company, embarrassed to admit it, she finds herself having a secret relationship with him. This went on for a while until she finds out that he had been dating her sister, Julia and it was all a scheme to get her to fund the luxurious wedding they plan to have. She blatantly refuses and threatens to fire the guy but then, he threatens to expose her and blackmails her with a deadly secret that Cassie has been hiding.In an attempt to free herself from their grasp, she does her own digging and finds out that Ethan is her step brother who is hell bent on destroying the Blue legacy and that her father’s death wasn’t an accident after all but a calculated plan gone wrong by her sister to take over the company but she has no proof that Julia actually attempted to kill their father. She still went ahead and threatened to expose her sister but can’t do so without dragging herself down and ruining the image of the company. Julia denies having anything to do with her father’s death so they are caught in an endless game of cat and dog...
68b17822f4d69f56740a6a37.title: On One Condition

68b17826f4d69f56740a6a5b.synopsis: Anya Petrova, a brilliant heiress seeking revenge against billionaire Damien Blackwood, infiltrates his inner circle under a false identity. She plans to ruin his reputation and business empire, as Blackwood's actions have led to the downfall of her family. However, as her plans unfold, Anya finds herself unexpectedly drawn to Damien. Despite her initial disdain for him, she is captivated by his charm and intelligence. Their forbidden romance is complicated by their families' bitter rivalry and the secrets of their pasts. Anya must navigate between her desire for justice and her growing feelings for Damien...
68b17826f4d69f56740a6a5b.title: Billionaire’s Betrayal

68b17826f4d69f56740a6a5d.synopsis: Mary, a dedicated narcotics officer, is reeling from the brutal murder of her partner, whose death has been cleverly staged to appear as an overdose. Frustrated by her department's refusal to pursue the case as a homicide, Mary is driven by a fierce determination to avenge her partner’s death and bring down the notorious drug lord, James Sinclair. In a bold move, she goes undercover, infiltrating James's operation as his secretary. As she navigates the treacherous world of drug trafficking, Mary quickly discovers that James is not the heartless criminal she anticipated. Charismatic and complex, he operates under a façade that hides a darker world but also reveals unexpected layers of vulnerability and depth. As Mary gathers evidence against him, she quickly discovers that James is not the heartless criminal she anticipated. Charismatic and complex, he operates under a façade that hides a darker world—but also reveals unexpected layers of vulnerability and depth, she also forms a bond with James's young daughter, Lily, who is innocent and unaware of her father's criminal dealings. The two develop a genuine friendship, creating an emotional tug-of-war for Mary as she grows increasingly fond of the child. This relationship complicates her mission and deepens her internal conflict, blurring the lines between duty and affection...
68b17826f4d69f56740a6a5d.title: Undercovered Heart

68b17826f4d69f56740a6a5f.synopsis: The movie opens with Mr Edward informing him about his engagement which has already been done by both families. Edward is a reserved gentle man who believes in true love, he believes such love can be found in the simplest and natural state, he decided to act as a twin, his intention is to act as a blind twin (Eden) and the other twin who isn’t physically challenged (Adrain). He was able to carry out his plans through the help of his best friend Austine, Mr Edward is away from home and is unaware of his plans. The news of his engagement created the biggest turn for twist and suspense. How will he be able to act as Eden and Adrain? did his plan find him true love? Adrian claims to have a twin called Eden, He also plays two personalities one, is as Adrain who is confident, intelligent, self- centred with a stone face which hardly smiles the second is Eden who is blind, reserved, caring and kind but seen as the black ship of the family. Unknown to Michelle his finance, she openly mocks Eden but acts all well- mannered when Adrain is with her, not knowing that both Adrain and Eden were one person. Michelle constant hate for Clara who is the Edward’s family maid, added layers of tension to the home. As things plays out, Adrian, while acting as a blind person falls in love with Clara for her natural character. Unknown to Michelle she is about to lose her prince charming to a maid.
68b17826f4d69f56740a6a5f.title: Camouflage

68b17826f4d69f56740a6a61.synopsis: Jackie and her mother, Janet have spent most of their lives conning people to get what they want. They’ve never been caught because Janet’s too good at the game. Although, beneath the surface, Jackie strives to get a life of her own, making her own rules, and running her own cons. When Janet marries the affluent widower Job Sterling, the duo moves into his lavish estate. Janet sees the marriage as their biggest con yet, planning to drain his fortune. But Jackie’s plans start to diverge when she meets her new stepbrother, Andrew—a kind-hearted artist who sees beyond her façade.Andrew ignites something in Jackie and she begins to dream of a life completely devoid of her mother and her cons. She finds herself craving to do right and opening her eyes to the wrongs her mother’s been committing. But Janet is not ready to lose her little girl just yet. She tightens her grip on her threatening to destroy everything she holds dear...
68b17826f4d69f56740a6a61.title: In Her Shadow

68b17827f4d69f56740a6a67.synopsis: Rose Barclay is the mistress of a man, named Jon Jackson and acts as the unseen family caretaker. Although Jon’s real-life wife, Lily Jackson, has no idea that Rose is both a call girl and the breadwinner; she keeps Jon and the high-consumption camp running smoothly. When Lily uncovers the shocking truth, she confronts Jon, only to hear his rationalization: Rose’s involvement has however made it difficult to disconnect herself with their lifestyle. Problems escalate when Rose meets Ted Georges an entrepreneur, billionaire, who wishes to find love. Intrigued by his stability and genuine affection, Rose starts to build a new life for herself, one where she wouldn’t be a ghost in someone else’s marriage. When Rose steps back from the Jacksons, Jon and Lily begin to gradually lose the world they’ve become accustom to...
68b17827f4d69f56740a6a67.title: Duty or desire

68b17827f4d69f56740a6a69.synopsis: Ava Dickson, beautiful, calculative and some might say cold, fought to win the heart of Adam Hart. Using her father's influence and money, she helps Adam build one of the biggest Shipping companies in the world. Ava's only request to Adam is that he remain faithful and committed to her even though she knows his heart once belonged to Ella Madden. Ella still waits for Adam to come back to her, and she takes her chance when the opportunity presents itself.Adam believes that he can and will only love Ella, even if Ava's father managed to convince him to marry his daughter. But a chance meeting with Ella reignites old feelings and soon, a romance ensues. They try hard to keep their secret relationship from Ava. Their once beautiful romance produced a child which Adam kept hidden from Ava successfully.Things spiral out of control when Ava finally learns the truth. Will Ava turn the other cheek and forgive Adam for his temporal weakness accepting his other family, or will Adam finally leave Ava and be with the love of his life. The twists and turns of this drama series ask, what if the bad guy wins? Will there be a happily ever after? I guess we have to stay tuned to find out.
68b17827f4d69f56740a6a69.title: Good For Him

68b17828f4d69f56740a6a6b.synopsis: A group of friends meet at a high school ten years later. They were once an inseparable group with one of them secretly out to get them and ruin their lives. Max, one of their friend, drowns under mysterious circumstances but the police rule it out as an accident. They soon find out that that is not so when a video tape from the night resurfaces. Lies and betrayal drive this drama when one of the group members, Sophia Wise, turns out to be the villain. She works with Max’s sister, Vanessa Richardson, in the pretence that she is trying to help her find the truth about what happened to her brother. But things spiral out of control when Max’s death isn’t the only thing they investigate. As the secrets hang on faded threads, the group must decide if the path they are on is worth following. Times get tough and times but the group adamantly stay on track. Will they finally make it out alive, or will the truth make them run and hide?
68b17828f4d69f56740a6a6b.title: Faded threads

68b17828f4d69f56740a6a6d.synopsis: Lucas, once a poor boy raised by his single mother, endured harsh treatment from his wealthy classmates because of his humble background while they were in school. Despite the odds, he grows up determined and becomes a successful CEO of his own thriving company. Ironically, some of his former classmates who once bullied him now work for his company, unaware of his identity because he keeps his life private. Lucas is about to make his first official appearance at the company headquarters, which has everyone excited. On the day of Lucas's arrival, Anna, the only classmate who was ever kind to him, comes to apply for a job at the company. She has no idea Lucas is the CEO, and she doesn’t recognize him as the boy she once helped. However, her job application process turns ugly when the same group of people who bullied Lucas in the past, now his employees, humiliate her. Witnessing this cruelty, Lucas steps in. He decides to hire her directly as his personal assistant, and starts spending time with her, hoping to reveal his true identity gradually. As their connection grows, jealousy brews among other female employees who are drawn to Lucas’s charm and power, including the daughter of Lucas's influential mentor, Daphne, who is set on becoming part of his life. Amid the rivalry and challenges, Lucas and Anna rediscover each other and begin a budding romance that surprises everyone, reminding Lucas of the simple kindness he cherished in his past.
68b17828f4d69f56740a6a6d.title: The CEO

68b17828f4d69f56740a6a6f.synopsis: Yveline McKnight is a hardworking and determined young woman, a trait she's had since her teenage years. However, her life takes a sudden turn when her greedy aunt reveals that she was switched at birth. This revelation strains her relationship with her younger sister, Celine, who begins to treat her coldly, leaving deep emotional scars. Meanwhile, Jaden Harrington is a meticulous right-hand man of Rose Lewis. Known for his unwavering loyalty, he completes every task assigned to him. Jaden is already set to marry Rose’s daughter, Itzel. Even though neither of them has feelings for each other, they have no choice but to proceed for the sake of their secured futures. But everything changed when Itzel got into an accident and required a blood transfusion. It was then discovered that she was not a true Lewis. As a result, the wedding plans were temporarily put on hold, and Rose sent Jaden on a mission to find her real child. During his search, Jaden’s path shifted when he met Yveline and fell in love with her at first sight. He decided to focus on getting to know her rather than fulfilling his mission. However, their love will not come easy, as there are many obstacles—one of which is the truth about Yveline’s connection to the Lewis family.
68b17828f4d69f56740a6a6f.title: Love Lies and Bloodline

68b17828f4d69f56740a6a71.synopsis: Lauretha Thomas, a young woman struggling to find a job after months of rejection, is left feeling hopeless and frustrated. With mounting pressure from her family’s financial crisis and the weight of her own failure, Lauretha decides to escape her problems for a while. She reluctantly agrees to join her best friend, Pamela, at an exclusive, posh nightclub—far beyond her usual standards of living. Hoping for a brief distraction, she drowns her sorrows in a bottle of wine, trying to numb the anxiety that’s been eating away at her. But what should have been a quiet night out takes a dramatic turn when she accidentally spills wine all over the shirt of Jayden McClarke, a powerful and ruthless CEO known for his cold, calculating demeanor. His icy glare makes it clear that he’s not one to tolerate mistakes, but before Lauretha can apologize or even gather herself, he grabs her arm in a tight, controlling grip. In a moment of frustration, Lauretha reacts instinctively and slaps him across the face, stunning everyone around them into silence. The room falls into a tense hush as Jayden, momentarily taken aback, locks eyes with her. But before things can escalate further, Pamela rushes to apologize on her friend’s behalf, trying to defuse the situation. Lauretha, humiliated and overwhelmed, pulls away from her grip and quickly exits the club with Pamela, retreating from the chaos she’s just caused.
68b17828f4d69f56740a6a71.title: Love Me or I Die

68b17829f4d69f56740a6a73.synopsis: Sandra Keith, beautiful, kind hearted and in love with Jade Smith, always wants what is best for her best friend, Amanda Grey. Sandra tries everything in her power to get Jade and Amanda together even though it hurts her. In a final bid to help Jade win the love of his life, Sandra agrees to be with Tony Delvin in order to make Jade a powerful man. With the stench of poverty still hanging around him, Amanda agrees to be with Jade, but she is not invested in the relationship. She confesses to Sandra that she is only with him because her father is on the brink of losing everything and she might be able to use Jade to rebuild her father’s reputation. A hurt Sandra fights between telling Jade the truth, and letting him be happy...
68b17829f4d69f56740a6a73.title: Honey Gold

68b17829f4d69f56740a6a79.synopsis: Hailey Adams becomes the secretary of the rude CEO Mason Anderson. No one else would take the job as Mason had fired five secretaries in a month. Other employees bet on how long she'll last, and when Hailey finds out, she's determined to stay. Mason constantly criticizes her. After a breakdown, Hailey transforms her look and attitude, stunning everyone. Mason's jealous girlfriend, Scarlett, tries to frame Hailey for leaking company info. Mason calls the police, but later learns the truth and breaks up with Scarlett. He apologizes to Hailey and compensates her. Hailey quits but agrees to accompany him to visit his ill mother. There, they grow closer. Back at work, they realize they have feelings for each other. However, Scarlett returns, claiming to be pregnant. Eventually, they find out it's a fake. The story ends with Mason planning a surprise proposal party for Hailey with the help of the employees...
68b17829f4d69f56740a6a79.title: Help! I’m Falling In Love With My Rude CEO

68b1782af4d69f56740a6a7d.synopsis: Nailah Vernon is a successful young woman who built multiple businesses and secured her future entirely on her own. However, she suffers from amnesia caused by an accident she experienced as a child-a tragedy that also claimed her mother’s life. As a result, Nailah grew up under the care of Lumi Young's family, completely unaware of her past. Despite her success, Nailah feels incomplete, haunted by the void of forgotten memories. Her painful, fruitless attempts to recover them make her hesitant to continue. Everything changes when Felix Campbell, Raphael’s close friend, enters her life and offers to help her uncover her lost past...
68b1782af4d69f56740a6a7d.title: Lost and Found

68b1782bf4d69f56740a6a85.synopsis: In the gripping second season, the aftermath of Logan's scandalous affair with Grace continues to ripple through the lives of everyone involved. Logan, compelled by his mistress’s unexpected pregnancy, finally decides to abandon his fiancée, Aurora, choosing to embrace a tumultuous relationship with Grace. As Grace leverages her pregnancy to control Logan, their volatile bond reveals cracks as they navigate the complexities of love, betrayal, and ambition. Meanwhile, Aurora, now finding solace in her successful career, refuses to expose her relationship with Mason—a secret she protects fiercely from the prying eyes of the entertainment industry. Thriving in this new luxury lifestyle, she begins to draw the attention of fans and critics alike, sparking jealousy within Logan as he grapples with the consequences of his choices...
68b1782bf4d69f56740a6a85.title: Trial Marriage To A Billionaire Season 2

68b584328fb9951b7309a046.synopsis: Hundreds of years ago, a contest of power and desire caused the Wolf King to lose the woman he loved the most. The Wolf King was in tremendous inconsolable grief and he had sealed up his memory. Then somehow the two met again. The grievances and affairs from the previous life slowly emerged. "And this time, I will kill everyone who obstructs our love. And you shall be my princess, the one and only."
68b584328fb9951b7309a046.title: The Bride of the Wolf King

68b6a49864e4373c89069cfe.synopsis: Emily, a rising fashion designer, wins big in Paris only to wake up in the 1980s as the infamous "evil wife" of factory owner Hector. Known for abusing her timid son and hated by the village, her new life is a mess: a cold husband, a broken family, and a rival eager to steal her place. Determined to turn things around, Emily sets out to win her family’s trust, rebuild their home, and expose the schemer who plotted against her.
68b6a49864e4373c89069cfe.title: Love That Defies Time

68b6a5e33fbfc2a34e0c2d07.synopsis: Naomi and Francis have enjoyed three years of marriage, with Naomi wholeheartedly supporting Francis's successful career as a top lawyer. But when Iris, Francis's first love, reappears, Naomi's comfortable life is shaken. As her role as a good wife is challenged, memories of her past as the formidable "Queen of Law" resurface, reigniting her inner strength and ambition.
68b6a5e33fbfc2a34e0c2d07.title: The Divorce That Crowned Her

68b92154209a64e4bb0ed28a.synopsis: When Sophia sets out to find her missing twin sister, Tina, the trail leads her to The Red Veil, an elite vampire nightclub ruled by the ruthless Von Drák family. As she digs deeper into its dark, seductive world, Sophia discovers a chilling prophecy, a forbidden romance, and a supernatural war that could consume them all.
68b92154209a64e4bb0ed28a.title: Love & Blood

68b9292947761f335e0a7b74.synopsis: Five years ago, curvy waitress Scarlett saved Brandon's life and spent one unforgettable night of passion with him before vanishing. Now she's back, slimmed down and unrecognizable, and he's the reclusive CEO who unknowingly fathered her daughter.
68b9292947761f335e0a7b74.title: I Had a Baby without You

68b929384c72c7c64907f813.synopsis: In Mistaken as His Mate The Luna’s Regret movie, Alpha Caspian’s pregnant sister Marina arrives for his Luna’s coronation, but Luna Willow mistakes her for a rogue mistress. In a jealous rage, Willow bullies Marina, causing her miscarriage. Now the Brooks siblings want blood.
68b929384c72c7c64907f813.title: Mistaken as His Mate: The Luna’s Regret

68b92943a20880cce40ac468.synopsis: Chloe and Mateo have been best friends for years, until they accidentally spend one fateful night together and end up in a flash marriage! Will Mateo confess he's been in love with Chloe for years, and pull her out of their "friend-zone"? And what will Chloe do, when she finds out Mateo is secretly a billaionire CEO?
68b92943a20880cce40ac468.title: I Flash-Married My Best Friend?!

68b9294ff4e5830a65025e3b.synopsis: In America's Favorite Ex-Husband movie, an aspiring writer’s life is turned upside down when he rescues an up-and-coming Hollywood starlet. Ten years later, Daniel’s the house husband to America’s Sweetheart, ignored and invisible to the paparazzi and his own family. When a megastar old flame comes back to seduce his wife, Daniel’s life reaches a new level of hell and he realizes he must do the unthinkable: divorce America’s Sweetheart! By the time his famous wife realizes what she’s lost, it may be too late to win him back.
68b9294ff4e5830a65025e3b.title: America's Favorite Ex-Husband

68b9295a0725da05b40b9799.synopsis: The day Ellie's IVF process is a success, she finds out her fiance and her best friend are having an affair. Devastated, she decides to raise her child alone. The doctor reveals there's been a mix up at the sperm bank - she's pregnant with the Mafia Boss' baby. Ellie has been unwillingly dragged into a mafia war of succession. In order to protect her unborn baby, she agrees to a contract marriage with the mafia boss. They never thought this would lead them to true love.
68b9295a0725da05b40b9799.title: Ruthless Mafia Daddy

68b92d665fce4a480201102a.synopsis: Joanna, a brilliant ER doctor, collapses from exhaustion after a grueling surgery, only to wake up in a different era. In a twist of fate, she accidentally spends the night with Ethan, a powerful governor, and becomes pregnant. Five years later, Ethan discovers the child and hunts Joanna down, determined to marry her and bring her into his mansion!
68b92d665fce4a480201102a.title: Taming the Governor's Heart

68b92dc5d2a187e0280e4de5.synopsis: On the brink of death, Melody McGee uncovers a shocking secret: her husband, Paul Briggs, is alive and masquerading as his twin brother, Basil, while living with Basil's wife! Given a second chance, Melody is hell-bent on revenge.
68b92dc5d2a187e0280e4de5.title: The Lie Between Us

68b933e4f26feccf5b068869.synopsis: In a world where family ties are tested, Flora, a bright young girl, navigates a turbulent home life. Her father, Shawn, belittles her mother, Winnie, over her looks, while engaging in an affair with his sister-in-law, Mandy. Following Winnie's tragic death, Flora's attempt to thwart Shawn and Mandy's wedding leads to her own demise. Yet, destiny intervenes. Reborn, Flora wields her intelligence to liberate her mother from a toxic marriage.
68b933e4f26feccf5b068869.title: Baby’s Sweet Revenge: Mommy, I found My Dream Daddy！

68b9351ee1c8febbc60b392e.synopsis: Betrayed by her own mother, her sister, and her fiancé during her last life, she won't repeat her mistakes this time. With her relic-storing skills and relationship with the tycoon in Kingcott, she's bound to make her way up to the highest. In this life, she'll only cherish true love and exact her revenge.
68b9351ee1c8febbc60b392e.title: Restoring My Life: From Blood Bank to CEO's Bride

68b93572faf38b4972079a2f.synopsis: In his past life, Felipe, a wealthy heir, was strung along by Myrtle, only to watch his family fall apart after their marriage. Reborn with a second chance, he turns away from his past and chooses Reana, a serene woman he believes he's never met. But what Felipe doesn't know is that this mysterious woman is no stranger at all. They shared a beautiful, forgotten childhood memory.
68b93572faf38b4972079a2f.title: His Second-Chance Bride

68b93639d99f944fec0a3f32.synopsis: Having nothing left to teach his mentee, Victor Hale sent Rhea Kirk, a Go Prodigy, to the Myst Go Club owned by Alaric Drayke. There, she cracked the Ultimate Puzzle and defeated the ruthless Go King. Yet, as the dust settled, hidden secrets began to surface, Rhea and Alaric decided to participate in the Grand Go Game and find the truth of the past!
68b93639d99f944fec0a3f32.title: The Go-Between Girl

68b947fd5fce4a480201102e.synopsis: After a sudden death, Lucy wakes up inside the novel she was reading as the doomed villainess fated to die by Chapter 50. When her presence unexpectedly eases the pain of the story’s feared villain, Julian, he takes her in. But with the novel's hero hunting her down, Lucy decides her only chance at survival is to cling to the villain and hijack the plot. This time, she's rewriting her ending, and it won't be death.
68b947fd5fce4a480201102e.title: My Script to Sweetness: Healing the Villain's Heart

68ba2ab99bb4d6451d05bac2.synopsis: Get ready for a fresh slice of Cooking My Way Back to Love! Host Laze stirs things up with Adam Daniel, taking us behind the scenes of this fiery new show. From the exciting BTS footage to Adam’s take on what makes the series special, you won’t want to miss it. Plus, keep your eyes peeled for another furry guest in this Backstage episode!
68ba2ab99bb4d6451d05bac2.title: ReelTalk EP 38-Backstage: Cooking My Way Back to Love

68babb189531500f4d055438.synopsis: After a flash marriage arranged by her late mother’s best friend, Jenny waits three years for her husband Charles, who left abroad right after the wedding. When he returns, misunderstandings, accusations, and missed chances drive them toward divorce. Just as Jenny is framed by rivals, Charles steps in to protect her, but new twists and family schemes continue to keep them apart.
68babb189531500f4d055438.title: Boss, Your Wife's a Whole Detective!

68bb61123f9c8d053b0d83bc.synopsis: In Alpha Mate Unchained movie, he killed his vicious father to save her. Now the new Alpha King must hide his fated mate and use a decoy fake Luna to keep her alive. But while he’s away battling, she’s discovered by the Fake Luna and brutally tortured. Can she survive long enough for the Alpha King’s return and vengeance?
68bb61123f9c8d053b0d83bc.title: Alpha Mate Unchained

68be7400ec68e798f00be0c7.synopsis: On her coming-of-age day, Princess Lia Torres of the Phoen Dynasty finds her soul transported into the body of an 8-year-old girl in the modern world. This girl, deprived of love by an imposter daughter, met a tragic end through neglect. Fueled by indignation, Lia takes on a new life with a disrespected father who is scorned by all.
68be7400ec68e798f00be0c7.title: Pampered by My Silver Fox Uncle

68bf6f41e98eb0e612057b7d.synopsis: Katie Walker is the janitor’s adopted kid — bullied, humiliated, a nobody. Then the golden Maddox brothers show up looking for their long lost heiress sister: Katie! But the school’s queen bee steals her place. Now it’s Katie’s turn to level up, take back her crown, and make them all regret underestimating her.
68bf6f41e98eb0e612057b7d.title: Lost Heiress of Kingston High

68bfa02557f6da1b110fb43c.synopsis: After quelling external disturbances, the best warrior of Republic of Valoria, Zoe Miller, returns to home. However, she discovers that her daughter has been mistreated by her relatives David's family. In a fit of rage, Zoe unleashes a massacre at the banquet, accidentally revealing herself to be the legendary Secretary of Defense. Later, she learned that her adopted son Jacob had already been betrayed by enemy spy Robert, and what was even more astonishing was that Mia's father, President Louis, was also deeply involved in a power vortex. With Mia critically injured and on the verge of death, can Zoe successfully protect her daughter?
68bfa02557f6da1b110fb43c.title: Don't Mess with Supermom

68bfd6d73b970c475f07d8dd.synopsis: In Hey Mommy Time for a New Daddy movie, reborn as a five-year-old, Talia only wants to protect her mother. But her charm and secret talents soon win over powerful elders and silence the doubters. With a tycoon father, an even richer stepfather, and a future billionaire husband, she grows up as the family's darling, proving that even the smallest star can shine the brightest.
68bfd6d73b970c475f07d8dd.title: Hey Mommy! Time for a New Daddy!

68c0cabeabd4f6e6ea08fe93.synopsis: In search of the "masculine energy" she needs to balance her magical power, naive witch Astrid Hall leaves her all-female coven for a co-ed private school where sparks fly between her and blind but devastatingly handsome Nate Woodford. When she discovers the curse that robs him of his sight, they make a deal: if she cures him and returns his vision, he'll do anything she asks. But Astrid is in for the culture shock of her life when she learns "sleeping together" doesn't quite mean what she thought it did!
68c0cabeabd4f6e6ea08fe93.title: Sleep with Me, Mortal!

68c142206fb90125ea05137b.synopsis: Bennett Lilley is dispatched on a covert mission to protect Rachel Snyder, a formidable billionaire. Disguised as a security guard, Bennett delves deep into Rachel's life. As a host of wealthy adversaries closes in, their worlds become inextricably intertwined.
68c142206fb90125ea05137b.title: The Strongest Bodyguard

68c23465c69194e17d0d5f0d.synopsis: In Was the Heiress Switched at Birth movie, on the same day, two best friends give birth. But Edith, born into poverty, secretly swaps her baby with her CEO friend’s—hoping to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she doesn’t expect is that the CEO sees everything and quietly switches the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Edith’s plan is about to succeed, she discovers the shocking truth: the daughter she’s mistreating all these years is her own.
68c23465c69194e17d0d5f0d.title: Was the Heiress Switched at Birth?

68c234702695ad507e01fc02.synopsis: In My Dear Daughter Love Me Once More movie, The male lead only has eyes for his first love and won’t even let Aria, his own daughter with his wife/the female lead, call him “Dad.” Aria waits all day for him on her birthday, only to witness him propose to his ex. At the school talent show, the mistress and her daughter bully Aria, and the husband helps them. To steal Aria’s summer camp spot, he feeds her a strawberry cake, knowing she’s allergic—she nearly dies. That’s when the female lead decides to divorce him and finally reveals her secret: she’s the daughter of a duke. She uses her true identity to fight for justice for her daughter. In the end, even when he kneels and begs Aria for forgiveness, she never calls him “Dad” again.
68c234702695ad507e01fc02.title: My Dear Daughter, Love Me Once More

68c33943850f8afb9a083c3f.synopsis: We’re thrilled to welcome Nicole Mattox back to the show, alongside first-time guest Eric Guilmette, as they sit down with host Sarah Moliski to talk about their new series Dungeons of Ecstasy. Together, they unwrap this mysterious vertical thriller that’s captivating fans. Shot at a stunning location in Italy, the show not only delivers thrills but also reveals an exciting, more sensual side of Nicole.
68c33943850f8afb9a083c3f.title: ReelTalk EP 39 - Mystery and Sensuality in Italy

68c3e89cb3a6ca84810a4cb2.synopsis: Vesper, who is determined to raise money to save her father, finds Raymond, the boss of the Hell Gang, to become his contracted lover. However, Vesper doesn't know that Raymond has been secretly in love with her for many years. How can they overcome the misunderstandings between money and love...
68c3e89cb3a6ca84810a4cb2.title: Mafia's Tender Torture

68c8fb3a7d022d88b000f0eb.synopsis: Lovestruck, Beatrice Lawson eloped with her college sweetheart Desmond Belmont and has been secretly married to him for ten years. However, when she discovers his affair with a wealthy socialite, Beatrice decides to divorce him and finally stop living in his shadow. As she begins to make a name for herself with a new apartment and new career, she meets the mysterious and attractive Damian Crowley. As the two men fight for her attention, Beatrice wonders if love is worth all the pain and sacrifice, or if she's better off fending for herself.
68c8fb3a7d022d88b000f0eb.title: Trapped in the Boss's Embrace

68c8fb62a739599c100ed1bf.synopsis: Adrian leaves his own daughter Esther in a car while he hangs out with his childhood sweetheart, Stacy and her son Lucas. Under the hot summer sun, the car overheats and shuts down. The A/C stops working and Esther starts to overheat. She's at risk of heatstroke and almost faints. Esther dials Adrian's phone to ask for help. Without listening to her, Adrian hangs up. Just before Esther's tablet runs out of battery, she calls her mother. She begs her mom to save her. However, before Esther can tell Claire her location, the tablet dies. Claire starts to desperately search for her daughter. Will Claire be able to successfully find and save her daughter before the unthinkable happens?
68c8fb62a739599c100ed1bf.title: When Love Walked Away

68c8fb89d2ab7e32980fb28b.synopsis: Ella is wolfless amongst the wolves, but at least she has her mate, Beta Noah Gravens... until she catches him cheating with her rival Ava. Shattered, Ella falls straight into the arms of Noah's brother, Liam Gravens, the newly returned Alpha of the Crescent Pack, who has loved her since childhood and knows she's his fated mate. But with jealous rivals, bitter exes, and two worlds pulling them apart, can Ella and Liam embrace the love they are destined for?
68c8fb89d2ab7e32980fb28b.title: Claimed by My Ex's Alpha Brother

68c8fb9e6073aca9ca08fa5e.synopsis: In Queen of the Court movie, after abandoning her career as a tennis star, Lily Pearson dedicated her life to helping her boyfriend Adam's tennis career. But after helping him win his own Grand Slam...the fame changed Adam for the worse. Adam's not only involved with a younger tennis star Mia Sparks, but he wants Lily to coach her as well. Will Lily accept this betrayal and love a cheating man she no longer recognizes, or will she have the courage to leave, and salvage her potential from all those years ago?
68c8fb9e6073aca9ca08fa5e.title: Queen of the Court

68c8fdfa7b0e6d574202ee0d.synopsis: Autumn Hall, after being betrayed by Daisy Wood, faces the destruction of her family. Consumed by overwhelming resentment, she awakens the Demon Lord Azure within her. Joining forces with Abyss and Fiume, she seeks revenge. As the gods lay siege, they use dreams to mount a counterattack, reuniting the Three Demon Lords and plunging the divine realm into chaos.
68c8fdfa7b0e6d574202ee0d.title: She Shall Reap the Divine

68cc7e93c52547cff3055e67.synopsis: The stars of Miss You After Goodbye are back and bringing the laughs on this episode of ReelTalk! Haley Lohrli talks all about her bold new role while Ben and Josh spill about their own unforgettable characters. Just when you think it can’t get any better, the trio face off in an improv game and a lightning round of ReelFast questions. Chaos, giggles, and roasts guaranteed!
68cc7e93c52547cff3055e67.title: ReelTalk EP 40-Contract Lovers & Heartbreak

68d0c284ef4a1a976900fae7.synopsis: Cecilia Lynch, a brilliant student from a small town, unexpectedly finds herself taken back into a prestigious family in the capital. Despite facing hostility from her newfound relatives and the scheming of a fake heiress, Cecilia remains undeterred. She focuses intently on her studies, leveraging every available resource to excel academically. Her relentless dedication ultimately earns her a place at a top-tier university, securing a remarkable future defined by her own achievements.
68d0c284ef4a1a976900fae7.title: Knowledge Is Her Power

68d3962c02ce0593d106f1a9.synopsis: Yeonju joins Perfect Match, a survival dating show where several men compete for one woman’s heart. Moving into the “Match House,” she begins a seven-day experiment in love — a whirlwind of unexpected chemistry and temptation. From poolside challenges and secret touches to one-night dates, each day brings new excitement, new connections… and new betrayals. As emotions blur between sincerity and strategy, passion and hesitation, Yeonju finds herself sinking deeper into a storm of desire and confusion. With every elimination and every choice she makes, her heart grows heavier — until the final day, when her decision will shape one of five completely different endings. Who will you choose to complete your story of love?
68d3962c02ce0593d106f1a9.title: Love in My Hands

68d59847cf741dba4c0649e7.synopsis: ReelTalk is hitting the streets with hot seat questions! Host Sarah Moliski and vertical star Jeff Lawless take over the Santa Monica Pier, racing to interview as many people as possible while convincing them to download the ReelShort app. From asking if you would date your professor to whether it’s a red flag to discover your boyfriend’s a werewolf, nothing is off limits. Tune in for an episode packed with laughs, competition, and fun in the sun!
68d59847cf741dba4c0649e7.title: ReelTalk EP 41-Street Interview at Santa Monica Pier

68d5a14b7ce82927ad0108bd.synopsis: Wall Street tycoon Ryan Chase is poisoned and pushed overboard by his fiancée, Mia, during a lavish yacht party. He miraculously survives—but loses his voice, his identity, and everything he once had. Left with nothing, Ryan is rescued by a kind mute woman named Sophia, who brings him back to her family's small restaurant and offers him a job. Despite constant abuse from Sophia’s spiteful stepmother Diane, Ryan and Sophia grow close and eventually fall in love. When Sophia’s father, James, falls critically ill, Ryan steps up to help the family. Meanwhile, Mia forges a marriage certificate in an attempt to steal Ryan’s multi-billion-dollar empire. Ryan’s loyal assistant, Thomas, risks everything to protect what’s left. When Diane discovers Ryan’s true identity and still refuses to help James, Ryan finally reaches out to Thomas—ready to return to the battlefield and take back everything that was his.
68d5a14b7ce82927ad0108bd.title: The Beggar King Returns

68d5a240341a3fdc3002f6a0.synopsis: In How I Made the Alpha Mine movie, Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own Pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha -- and older brother's best friend -- Dalton Grey. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the Pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.
68d5a240341a3fdc3002f6a0.title: How I Made the Alpha Mine

68d5a3937492825f6c0a6f08.synopsis: America’s top billionaire, Derek Wolf, is dying and hires elite surgeon Shaun to bring a donor kidney by plane for a secret transplant. But the flight is delayed when Kim — mother of Jessica, who’s engaged to Derek’s grandson Erik — goes to the bathroom. When Shaun urges them to hurry, Jessica humiliates him. After takeoff, Kim suffers a heart attack, and Shaun saves her, breaking her ribs in the process. Ungrateful, Jessica demands Shaun apologize in a humiliating way. When he refuses, she threatens to destroy the kidney. Forced to reveal Derek’s condition, Shaun pleads, but Jessica doesn’t believe him — until she smashes the case and sees the name on it: Derek Wolf, her own fiancé’s grandfather.
68d5a3937492825f6c0a6f08.title: Countdown to Life: Rescue at 30,000 Feet

68d6d9874a593acf1d093be8.synopsis: Cain Hunter is a broken man after his wife betrays him and ruins him financially. Just as all hope is lost, Cain is suddenly brought to the mysterious Don Ludwig, who makes him an offer: pass his tests, and Cain will succeed him as the new Godfather of Bourne Syndicate.
68d6d9874a593acf1d093be8.title: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees

68dadaea23e33857e70a78f9.synopsis: Emma Parker is a new transfer to Maple Elite Academy - and she's picked a fight with The Big Four, on her very first day! Four rich heirs who rule the academy, they've decided she's public enemy number one! But maybe there's more than meets the eye. Rowan Calloway acts like a tyrant, but is he really a ruthless bully? And August Langford keeps helping her out. Have they met before? Who's Emma going to choose - her worst enemy, or her childhood friend?
68dadaea23e33857e70a78f9.title: Taming My Bullies

68debdd66704ca4a470c01cc.synopsis: Daisy and Alex share a one night stand and part ways on one fateful night -- which leaves Daisy pregnant. Alex is on his way to her when he gets into a car accident and loses his memory. 5 years later, Daisy runs into a homeless Alex, and her daughter Poppy insists he's her father. When will Daisy realize this homeless man is her baby daddy? Will the family of three work together to take revenge against scheming villains?
68debdd66704ca4a470c01cc.title: Homeless Billionaire Baby Daddy

68debeedb1751af04908a55f.synopsis: In The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back movie, in a previous life, heiress Emily was a genius in the hacker field. In a global competition, fake heiress Olivia accuses Emily of plagiarism, which totally destroys her reputation. Her family believes these false accusations and kicks Emily out of the house. In the end, she’s killed by fake heiress Olivia. In her second life, not only does Emily cut off her ties with her blind to the truth family, but she also gives Fake Heiress Olivia who was falsely accusing her of plagiarism a slap in the face.
68debeedb1751af04908a55f.title: The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back

68debf6fbf5a7addc00ff0d6.synopsis: When Snow discovers her alpha husband cheating, she offers herself as ritual sacrifice to be eternally frozen. And when she leaves, she will finally break their mate-bond, leaving ice cold regret to be his new forever mate! But what will he do to bring her back?
68debf6fbf5a7addc00ff0d6.title: Leaving My Alpha Husband in Ice Cold Regret

68df0ce15f316838990244f5.synopsis: Now introducing, ReelTalk Dates! Join The Quarterback Next Door’s Chris Quartuccio and Cayla Brady as they race through a shopping challenge, share a bite together, unwind with a romantic picnic, and top it all off with a swan boat ride, all in true Los Angeles style.
68df0ce15f316838990244f5.title: ReelTalk EP 42-Chris and Cayla Went on a Date!

68e60ed916bbd6e5580ffe20.synopsis: When the British heir dies suddenly, a modern royal family spirals into chaos. Party-loving twins Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor are forced to grow up fast—Liam is thrust toward the crown while falling for Ophelia, the palace security chief’s American daughter, and Eleanor hits rock bottom after a dangerous betrayal. As King Simon grieves and the monarchy teeters, ruthless Queen Helena joins forces with scheming Prince Cyrus to keep control at any cost. A dynasty built on glamour is about to face its darkest reckoning. Buy full season: https://www.lionsgate.com/shows/the-royals/the-royals-season-1
68e60ed916bbd6e5580ffe20.title: The Royals

68e611aaaf245aae290e73be.synopsis: I'm a disaster. One minute I'm spilling coffee on my ridiculously hot boss, Simon, the next I'm discovering I have a secret power I can't control. My world is a mess of spilled coffee and tangled feelings, and I'm caught between two unbelievably hot guys. Simon, my mysterious boss, is as alluring as he is dangerous - a vampire who promises to teach me to harness my magic. Then there's Michael, my kind and loyal best friend. But he's hiding a deadly secret: he's a hunter sworn to destroy everything Simon stands for. They both want me. And as my magic gets more powerful, so does the fire burning between us. How can I choose when they both know my darkest secrets?
68e611aaaf245aae290e73be.title: Desired by Two: the Vampire and the Hunter

68e728e41a73cf4c55045fc5.synopsis: After eighteen years away, Sara returns to the powerful Graham family, only to be framed by her scheming adoptive sister and dismissed as a country bumpkin. But beneath her humble facade hides a world-class violinist, a luxury jewelry designer, and a gifted healer. When her ex-fiancé Jonathan discovers the truth, he realizes the woman he cast aside was the one he was destined to love all along.
68e728e41a73cf4c55045fc5.title: Her Turn to Win

68e80feb00e1875fe80e757f.synopsis: Pampered real heiress Ellie is framed and sent to juvenile detention by her family. They believe she lives comfortably, unaware that under the fake daughter's orders, Ellie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she is released, broken inside, but still seen as spoiled. Only when her father beats her and her prosthetic falls off do they realize the truth...
68e80feb00e1875fe80e757f.title: True Heiress Never Lies!

68e811872fbacf89a40a3d79.synopsis: Nessa, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Blaze Ashclaw. But Blaze mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Nessa cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Blaze to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?
68e811872fbacf89a40a3d79.title: Betrayed Alpha Queen Rises from the Ashes

68e8121e74e98090fa074792.synopsis: In You Fired the Backbone of Detroit movie, Hank Walker, mechanic by day and genius auto engineer by night, is fired under new management. Betrayed, Hank is offered a dream job from rival company Mach 15. Will Hank get to build the supercar of his dreams? Or will interference from rivals old and new cost him everything?
68e8121e74e98090fa074792.title: You Fired the Backbone of Detroit

68e84ecfa89b17c90e083dcd.synopsis: Our fashionistas are back! In this episode, host Sarah Moliski teams up with stars Sarah Noelle and Maria Barseghian to tackle a style challenge inspired by some of our favorite ReelShort scenarios. With SHEIN’s different styles, they’ll put together outfits for every situation. On-screen or off. Who will slay the looks and who will improvise? Tune in to find out!
68e84ecfa89b17c90e083dcd.title: ReelTalk EP 43-We Recreated Iconic ReelShort Looks!

68e8cfc00c688dd4be068945.synopsis: The new intern, Isla, never imagined that the cold and demanding CEO Christian — who shoved her relentlessly on the tennis court during the day — was the same person who broadened her view to unknown territories at night in an exclusive BDSM club. But when the mask comes off and secretive identities assimilate into reality, is this a game she can stay afloat… or submerge deep within the shadows of desire seeking unexpected redemption? Produced by：Vantage Entertainment
68e8cfc00c688dd4be068945.title: Hold Me in the Dark

68e9aa284838ef5d700ef20a.synopsis: A college freshman comes home for her family's legendary Thanksgiving feast and starts to suspect there's something very wrong with her parents.
68e9aa284838ef5d700ef20a.title: We're Your Parents

68e9c1180eae149b9d045cd7.synopsis: One day, the only heir of a wealthy family was murdered in his office. The victim was Ki Seungho, the president of DA Entertainment. And the suspect was his secretary, Lee Yeonwoo. The world didn't believe in her innocence, and Yeonwoo was ultimately sentenced to death. “If only I had one more chance.” Perhaps her desperate wish just before her death had been heard. When Yeonwoo opened her eyes again, it was a month before the incident took place. As if to warn her of the fate to come, a chilling red line remained on her neck, like a tattoo. So Yeonwoo made a decision. This time, she would save the president and save herself. But this time, Seungho began to pay attention to her.
68e9c1180eae149b9d045cd7.title: In This Life, I'm Trying To Save The Boss

68e9c1ec6b9e2a04c904a7b7.synopsis: In Crypto Jackpot After Life Failure movie, a man abandoned by his company suddenly gains 399 billion won overnight and acquires the 14-trillion-won conglomerate that abandoned him!
68e9c1ec6b9e2a04c904a7b7.title: Crypto Jackpot After Life Failure

68e9c79d20ca0eb26d0d976e.synopsis: Charles was just a delivery guy until a car accident with powerful CEO Wendy changed everything. The crash awakened a strange ability: he can now see the countdown of everyone’s remaining life. When Charles saves Wendy from a deadly fate, his own life spins out of control. He discovers his wife's betrayal and faces humiliation. But from that moment on, the tables turn. With his newfound power, Charles rises from the ashes, exposing lies, avenging the past, and rewriting his destiny.
68e9c79d20ca0eb26d0d976e.title: Your Time Is Up

68e9c7b7581f2788ac03972d.synopsis: Mavis Addams's only wish is to marry her parents' enemy. Life as their daughter has been tough, filled with her family's relentless humiliation and torture, but to her surprise, she finds herself enjoying the role of the enemy's wife. In the meantime, her heart starts to melt for the one guy she shouldn't. Will her plan work out, or is she better off on her own?
68e9c7b7581f2788ac03972d.title: Trapped in My Enemy's Embrace

68e9c7dc48bb317ef60ab75a.synopsis: Poisoned by her husband, she is reborn at the brink of death. This time, she will not be a victim. She will settle every score they own her, unraveling secrets and reclaiming her life in a world of deceit and power struggles.
68e9c7dc48bb317ef60ab75a.title: From Grave to Glory

68ec5fc14bfbf35b930548ea.synopsis: Trapped in an arranged marriage to the cold and dangerously seductive heir of the New York mafia, LUCA, 18yo sheltered mafia princess from Chicago, ARIA must decide if surrendering her body—and maybe her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance at survival.
68ec5fc14bfbf35b930548ea.title: Bound by Honor

68ec5fd4621a1f21220a397a.synopsis: Brie is the daughter of a servant who works for Teddy’s family. She grew up living in the household with her mother and developed mutual feelings for the young master, Teddy. Once they came of age, Teddy began pursuing Brie passionately, but Brie feels insecure because of her status as a servant’s daughter. Teddy struggles to convince her to be with him. Brie keeps trying to pull away, but through all their back-and-forth, she eventually admits how she truly feels.
68ec5fd4621a1f21220a397a.title: Tell Me Not to Love You

68ec5fe750892c571f0509ae.synopsis: For seven years, Christmas meant grief––until Raphael Stone sees a face he thought he'd never see again. Lucy, his beloved wife, is alive, but she can't move or talk anymore. Worse, she doesn't seem to remember him at all. Will true love triumph over pain and misfortune?
68ec5fe750892c571f0509ae.title: Someone Loved is Never Lost

68ec5ffa149d9ee25f0cb4c0.synopsis: At 16, Bailey's foster mother sold her eggs on the black market, leaving her infertile. Years later, working as a school janitor, she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and meets the child’s father, a secret billionaire caught in a brutal custody battle. As their unexpected flash marriage blossoms into real love, secrets, betrayals, and a vengeful ex-wife threaten to tear apart their fragile new family.
68ec5ffa149d9ee25f0cb4c0.title: Fated to Find You

68ec6010ff5e5a5c120c70fd.synopsis: In Blood & Silver: Rise of the Alpha's Rejected Mate movie, after a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Ann Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Dane Montague—her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she’s responsible for his family's death. For three years, Dane torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Ann shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears—leaving behind only a severed ribbon, a credit card, and a secret she hasn’t even discovered yet. Years later, she returns not as Ann Reed, but as Aurora Moon, heir to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power, and secrets. Her mission is clear: protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Dane at all costs. But when she walks back into his world, she triggers the one thing she feared most: his attention. As Dane fights the pull toward the mate he thought he hated, dark forces stir, old enemies rise, and the truth about the past—and their bond—is about to explode. Because Aurora didn’t come back to be claimed. She came back to conquer.
68ec6010ff5e5a5c120c70fd.title: Blood & Silver: Rise of the Alpha's Rejected Mate

68ec6024a7344dc50f009aff.synopsis: Uncle Jesse's smokin' hot tattoo and great technique on bed awakens Sophie Holland's fantasy in How To Break A DILF Trailer! She might be Jesse's best friend's daughter, and Jesse might have told her to date guys of her age. Still, something about Jesse lures Sophie. So, keep watching to know what lies behind their relationships!
68ec6024a7344dc50f009aff.title: How to Break a DILF

68edaf9f39c176e0ec00259a.synopsis: Once a star diplomat, Winnie gave up everything for love, only to be rejected by her marshal husband, Leo, and their son. Determined to start over, she returns to the diplomatic world as the mysterious "Miss Wan," dazzling allies and rivals alike. When Leo finally regrets letting her go, it's already too late. Betrayals are exposed, war looms, and love turns to ashes. As Leo falls on the battlefield, Winnie walks forward. She's stronger, wiser, and ready to face the world on her own terms.
68edaf9f39c176e0ec00259a.title: Where My Love Went Wrong

68ee05e5b7748f54600ae29f.synopsis: Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her fa
68ee05e5b7748f54600ae29f.title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle

68eeff95f696235bfd0f4e21.synopsis: Leading lady, Jess Gonzales, must whittle down 25 male suitors to four that she wants to actively date. After she makes her choice, the remaining singles she rejected have the opportunity to sabotage her dates for a cash prize!
68eeff95f696235bfd0f4e21.title: Love Under Attack

68f149fea109fbc4220912f5.synopsis: Jesse Morales is taking our vertical stars to the court! Watch as he schools them on the basics of tennis, puts them through a series of warm ups, and challenges them to a thrilling 2v2 match. In the end, Fulop Budavari, Madeleine Rocha-Barnette, and Savannah Coffee face off for a special prize. Who will come out on top?
68f149fea109fbc4220912f5.title: ReelTalk EP 44-Jesse's Tennis Bootcamp

68f1b46b9ce9d16c840c1e3f.synopsis: Ada, a math genius reclaimed by the noble Selivis family, is treated as an outsider and framed by her scheming sister. But they picked the wrong genius to cross.
68f1b46b9ce9d16c840c1e3f.title: The Genius Returns

68f2109c7aac16813a0da66a.synopsis: Karol Sowle was born into a rural family. At 18, she married Joseph Lee, a young intellectual, and followed him to the city. However, Joseph's family scorned her humble origins and subjected her to constant mistreatment. Unable to endure it any longer, Karol left and met Theo Lipsey, a disabled veteran. With Theo's support, Karol pursued education, honed her sewing skills, and eventually founded her own clothing factory. Meanwhile, under her devoted care, Theo's legs gradually healed.
68f2109c7aac16813a0da66a.title: From Ashes, We Rise

68f84079800296744d0e953b.synopsis: Ace pilot Teddy wakes up in the body of his eight-year-old self on the very flight that once took his father's life. With the plane on fire, the captain unconscious, and hundreds of lives hanging in the balance, Teddy must use his adult mind in a child's body to change fate and save everyone before history repeats itself.
68f84079800296744d0e953b.title: Fly, Little Captain

68f9fb1cb7440dd5500facba.synopsis: In a psychiatric hospital, Raff Hess, the most dangerous patient, finally passes his 144th mental evaluation and is released. However, unbeknownst to everyone, his condition remains unchanged—his late fiancée, Freya Kim, still whispers vengeance in his ear. Four years after Freya's murder, Raff is now free and ready to set his meticulously planned revenge into motion against her four killers.
68f9fb1cb7440dd5500facba.title: Her Whisper in the Dark

68fa86aafdc5b2a097072ba2.synopsis: Can you tell the difference between Dominos and Pizza Hut? We put Jeff Lawless, Mariah Moss, and Eric Guilmette to the test! Watch our stars do the Blind Taste Test Challenge and see if they can guess some of our favorite snacks. From spicy noodles to sour candy, they race with their senses to come out on top! The products and brands featured in this episode are used for entertainment and reference only. All trademarks and product names belong to their respective owners.
68fa86aafdc5b2a097072ba2.title: ReelTalk EP 45-Blind Taste Test Challenge

68fad4c3ae2a8190890bbdf1.synopsis: Eliza Spencer, self-made billionaire, survives a murder attempt and wakes with amnesia. Rescued by Justin Patton, a handsome stranger in a wheelchair- she marries him unaware he's also a billionaire faking his disability. When her memory returns, she keeps her identity a secret to reclaim her company from her greedy family and protect Justin from his vicious half-brother and step-mother.
68fad4c3ae2a8190890bbdf1.title: Sweet Wild Bride of Mine

68ff3421a33542ff5f01f133.synopsis: When Olivia signs up for a life-saving surgery that will erase every memory - including the man who broke her heart - she's finally ready to walk away from her painful marriage. But with 14 days left on the clock, her cold, distant husband realizes too late what he's about to lose.
68ff3421a33542ff5f01f133.title: The Art of Letting Go

690170b76deb145032038b64.synopsis: Leonard Poe, descendant of Veronica Poe, falls for Ivory Sowle—unwittingly making an enemy of her jealous admirer, Frank Lawson, who ruins his career and forces him into delivery work. Witnessing her three powerful adopted heirs abuse their power to oppress her own great-grandson, Veronica decides to reshuffle Great Arkland's elite families, overthrow the corrupt order, and raise the kind-hearted Leonard to power.
690170b76deb145032038b64.title: Great-Grandma is the Supreme Cultivator

6901a97b980a77ba00062787.synopsis: Fresh out of prison, Irene just wants to start over, but she accidentally falls into John's trap. Now her creditor, John, forces her into a cruel game: to repay her debt by seducing his brother, Eric. But as the dangerous game unfolds, John's revenge turns into obsession, and his heart begins to betray his plan. By the time he realizes he's fallen for her, it's already too late to turn back.
6901a97b980a77ba00062787.title: The Devil's Bargain

6901d9e7ca3906084109d870.synopsis: Keira West is coerced into marrying Clyde Irving, with her mother's well-being held as leverage. Neglected by her husband, Keira finds herself entangled with his uncle, William, the true power behind the family. But as their forbidden relationship deepens, can she build a future with this man, or will their love bury them alive?
6901d9e7ca3906084109d870.title: Only For You

6901ebd0b5a967b5cd020c3c.synopsis: Lillian hides her true identity as the chairwoman of a listed company, living as an ordinary sales rep. But when she discovers her husband Milo's betrayal and his plan with his mistress, Whitney, to steal her fortune, her world collapses. Broken but not defeated, Lillian awakens. With quiet precision and the power she once hid, she exposes Milo's schemes, protects her daughter, and makes him choke on the consequences of his own greed.
6901ebd0b5a967b5cd020c3c.title: A Wife's Revenge

6901ed28777b640c0f04a88b.synopsis: Charlotte helped her "best friend," Jasmine, over and over again and even died saving her. Reborn, she’s done playing the martyr. This time, she’ll stand back and watch as Jasmine and her psycho boyfriend sink into the hell they made.
6901ed28777b640c0f04a88b.title: Her Turn to Burn

6901ee82ef68b1a7b0031b5b.synopsis: Eleonora Vaughn, the fallen Aurevian Princess, died in shame—only to awaken three years earlier, gifted with a second chance. Now, she must mastermind her rise in this land, outmaneuvering every enemy who wronged her. But in this lethal game of power and revenge, the most dangerous move might be losing her heart to the very man she vowed to use.
6901ee82ef68b1a7b0031b5b.title: Reborn in Flames

6901f085226ad16009091964.synopsis: Grassroots singer Matt Lipsey lost his sight three years ago after saving his girlfriend, Sapphire Steele, from a fire. Deceived by Sapphire and his sister Ruth, he was coerced into becoming a stand-in singer for Neal Arnold, who promised to help him launch his career but ultimately betrayed him. Tragically, Matt died due to their betrayal. Reborn, Matt resolves not to be exploited again, embarking on a path of vengeance while rising to stardom.
6901f085226ad16009091964.title: Lost In It

6901f18e53e372cb0903e908.synopsis: Luca was a musical genius until someone stole everything from him, including his life. Given a second chance, he vows revenge and gives those who betrayed him the ultimate downfall. This time, his voice will be heard.
6901f18e53e372cb0903e908.title: The Stutterer's Symphony

6901f2d906967f11bc0470df.synopsis: Charli Kaplan, the new transfer at Maple Elite Academy, quickly becomes the school's most controversial figure. But appearances can be deceiving. Rowan Hawkins may seem like a tyrant, but is he truly a heartless bully? Meanwhile, Noah Tucker frequently comes to her aid—what's his motive? Now Charlie must decide: Will she choose her enemy or the golden boy?
6901f2d906967f11bc0470df.title: How to Tame Your Bully

690305826deb145032038b86.synopsis: In He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive movie, heiress Iris gave up her family fortune to marry Dorian, a poor average-joe. Three years later, she's about to welcome her first child, when suddenly, her crazy control-freak mother-in-law (Tessa) insists the hospital she's staying at is too expensive. Tessa manages to convince Dorian that they should switch to a cheaper hospital. Dorian, being a spineless mama's boy, gives in to all of Tessa's demands and starts bullying Iris too. Iris fights off increasingly unreasonable demands, all while dealing with unbearable pain in her heavily pregnant belly. Just as she can't take it anymore, Iris's father finally appears, bearing gifts for his new grandchild. How will Alec defend his daughter? When will Iris give her husband and mother-in-law a slap in the face?
690305826deb145032038b86.title: He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive

6903061c4578d838e3076c28.synopsis: Med student Cora never expected to get pregnant—let alone with the baby of Damon Hawkins, the city’s most eligible billionaire bachelor... and her new visiting professor. She planned to keep the child a secret, but Damon kept pushing past her walls—until he dropped to one knee and asked her to marry him. What Cora thought would be a fleeting romance turned into a whirlwind of unexpected tenderness and indulgent love. But the closer they grow, the more dangerous secrets begin to surface. As betrayal and hidden bloodlines come to light, Cora must face the ultimate question— Can she truly find happiness... and reunite with the family she never knew she had?
6903061c4578d838e3076c28.title: Dear Professor, You Are My Baby Daddy

690306819de921f53b0046c8.synopsis: In The Christmas Switch movie, sixteen years ago, Molly has an affair with Colton, the son-in-law of the powerful Grant family. When she gets pregnant, Colton heartlessly tells her to get an abortion. Furious and heartbroken, Molly secretly swaps her newborn daughter with the baby girl born to the Grant family’s heiress, Rachel. That baby—Rachel’s real daughter—grows up as Dolores, raised in the slums. Meanwhile, Molly’s biological daughter, Sara, is brought up as the Grant family’s beloved princess. Now, both girls attend the same prestigious school. Their paths cross again. Dolores, strong and kind, catches the attention of Aaron—Rachel’s father and the Grant family patriarch. At the same time, Sara’s longtime crush, Ryan, starts falling for Dolores. Feeling threatened, Sara begins scheming against her, afraid of being replaced. As tension builds, the secret behind their true identities slowly starts to unravel...
690306819de921f53b0046c8.title: The Christmas Switch

690306d7afd90472c800cf3a.synopsis: In Step Aside I'm the King of Capital movie, for six years abroad, Cassius builds the world’s top financial empire, the Enros Group, under the name “Mr. S,” even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend Isabella, she dumps him, chasing wealth and claiming only the mysterious Mr. S is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor lands Cassius in a sudden marriage to Freya, the beautiful CEO of Mirror Media. At Isabella’s inauguration party, she tries to kick Cassius out again and again, never guessing who he really is—until Cassius finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.
690306d7afd90472c800cf3a.title: Step Aside, I'm the King of Capital

690326f4e9780ee1680b2591.synopsis: Wendy got pregnant after a one-night encounter at a hot spring. Five years later, now a stunning and powerful CEO, she launches a city-wide hunt for her mystery baby-daddy, only for her daughter to find him in the countryside, living as a humble farmer. Determined to secure her company's future, Wendy brings him home as a live-in husband until she discovers the "simple farmer" is actually the hidden Lord of the Dragon Sanctum, a man far more powerful than she ever imagined.
690326f4e9780ee1680b2591.title: My Husband Is a Hidden Big Shot

6903ba9c65c6a5dc9c098489.synopsis: For this special Halloween episode, a tarot card reading with Nicole Mattox and Kirby Ellwood takes a spooky turn! Listen in on their scary stories, dating life, and what the future holds for them. Will they survive a haunting on set? Tune in to find out!
6903ba9c65c6a5dc9c098489.title: ReelTalk EP 46-Halloween Special: A Ghost on Set!

690431ebb2b880f039018f4d.synopsis: Tessa and Asher were first loves. Asher left without a word due to family reasons. Three years later, they reunite, but Tessa is now the fiancée of Asher's nephew.
690431ebb2b880f039018f4d.title: The Secret Between US

690963626fb7eaa6140c219c.synopsis: To pay for her grandmother's treatment, Savannah leaves her rural hometown and heads to Hadleyburg to ask her estranged father for help. On the train, she unexpectedly saves the life of Hudson, the ruthless, untouchable mafia king of Hadleyburg, after he's ambushed and severely wounded. When Savannah arrives in the city, Hudson returns for her, fiercely, publicly, and with an obsession the whole city fears.
690963626fb7eaa6140c219c.title: Pampered by the Tyrant

6909dd1ffe4f8d9c3a0682a2.synopsis: In The Fallen God & His Mute Muse movie, Levi Tran, an immortal, is reborn to escape a massive debt. He awakens in a gambler's body, only to find his mute wife's voice stolen. Now, will he be able to give the woman her voice back with his mortal body?
6909dd1ffe4f8d9c3a0682a2.title: The Fallen God & His Mute Muse

690afdf57658ff7b8c047b36.synopsis: In I Leashed A CEO movie, a drunken woman walking her dog late at night was led by the dog to a tycoon’s private car. Chasing the car, her clothes got caught and torn by the door. The two had an intimate SM encounter in the car, fully photographed by paparazzi and making gossip headlines. To calm public anger, the tycoon lied that the woman was his fiancée and searched for her using a dog leash as a clue. His stepsister faked her identity after seeing the news. The woman knew the man that night was the tycoon but dared not tell anyone, nor did she know her sister’s impersonation. She later became his personal bodyguard via an interview, and affection grew between them. Yet the stepsister kept sabotaging their relationship, causing constant conflicts. Will this scandal - triggered farce reveal the truth? Will the two lovers finally get together?
690afdf57658ff7b8c047b36.title: I Leashed A CEO!

690be20bffab2ea5a40fe66b.synopsis: Penny and Mason are childhood best friends who’ve quietly fallen in love. But after spending their first night together, Penny is diagnosed with cancer—and makes the agonizing choice to push Mason away to protect him from the pain of losing her.
690be20bffab2ea5a40fe66b.title: To My Romeo, with Love

690c02e21abfb598fb03d2b2.synopsis: After being betrayed and murdered by her boyfriend, Samuel, and his lover Jessica, Nina wakes up before it all happens. Determined to rewrite her fate, she secretly records their affair and plots her revenge. When Samuel tries to scam her again, Nina walks straight into his trap to spring her own. At a tense family gathering, she reveals the proof of their lies, exposing their affair and fraud for everyone to see. This time, it's not Nina who's ruined, it's them.
690c02e21abfb598fb03d2b2.title: The Betrayal Game

690c0823446c91f3a20cd95e.synopsis: Once a heavenly spirit of fortune, Ivory is reborn as a princess, only to be cast aside by her own father. Saved by a disgraced prince, she uses her gift to turn misfortune into blessing, heal the wounded, and uncover her true identity. When a false "blessed girl" steals her name, Ivory must rise again, defying fate to reclaim her destiny and the love that was meant to be hers.
690c0823446c91f3a20cd95e.title: The Cripple Prince's Lucky Star

690c09e2437f52eec40a0fac.synopsis: The mysterious secret agent Peter Rogers was awarded the National Medal of Honor by the President and had retired from the military. While dining out with his daughter Leslie, Peter is mistaken for a blind date by the beautiful CEO Sydney Greenfield, and the two unexpectedly get married. When his classmate and ex-girlfriend, who were unaware of Peter's true identity, encountered him again, they subjected him to various insults and ridicule. Upon hearing about this, Sydney publicly revealed that Peter was her husband, putting everyone to shame.
690c09e2437f52eec40a0fac.title: Daddy's Got Girls and Guns

690d4f180ea18882c301d49d.synopsis: In The Ghost of You and I movie, Lieutenant Ryan Cross is fighting on the front lines, but he doesn't tell his wife, Alice, for fear of worrying her. Tragically, Ryan is killed in action while trying to save his comrades. However, his lingering regrets cause him to transform into a ghost and return to his wife’s side. Back home, Alice, who thinks Ryan is just hiding from her, is convinced he's been cheating! Pissed, Alice decides to get back at Ryan by marrying another man. On the day of the wedding, Alice’s bridal car passes Ryan’s funeral procession.
690d4f180ea18882c301d49d.title: The Ghost of You and I

690d4f2bc93a882dd301aa1a.synopsis: Their families slaughtered each other, and they’re sworn to hate one another… but the pull between them can't be denied. Maeve, the alpha princess, enters Luperiom determined to survive the kingdom’s brutal war college. What she doesn’t expect is a fated bond with Saxon Blackmoor—the most powerful wolf there… and her enemy. Now, the one wolf she shouldn’t want might be the only one who can save her.
690d4f2bc93a882dd301aa1a.title: Bound to the Rebel Wolf

690d4f4012285b6b6f0df08a.synopsis: In Callsign Legacy movie, when lowly enlisted man Cole Summers sneaks into a Navy Flight Simulator and completes mission simulation that no one else can, the Navy realizes that he's their only hope to prevent WWIII... but first he must deal with crooked politicans, evil tech billionaires, and even his own disgraced family legacy.
690d4f4012285b6b6f0df08a.title: Callsign: Legacy
