6911b9ba3e53ee21aa0892b1.synopsis: Levi Tran, an immortal, is reborn to escape a massive debt. He awakens in a gambler's body, only to find his mute wife's voice stolen. Now, will he be able to give the woman her voice back with his mortal body?
6911b9ba3e53ee21aa0892b1.title: The Fallen God & His Mute Muse

6911c20d530058750f0642ee.synopsis: For years, Jade Spencer's heart has belonged to Gerard Glover. Yet, Gerard, blinded by his own desires, sees Jade as nothing more than a tool to incite jealousy in the woman he truly loves, Sydney Black. Manipulating Jade, he urges her to draw closer to Philbert Ford, the heir to the Duke of Josville, hoping to disrupt Sydney's impending marriage to Philbert. Disappointed, Jade and Philbert's act turns into reality, and they get married, leaving Gerard full of regret.
6911c20d530058750f0642ee.title: The Love I Could Not Speak

6911f4debb25322b200bb973.synopsis: Gloria Cooley is reborn on the day she was married to Alistair Payne. In her past life, she managed to marry him, only to earn his hatred and witness her country fall. This time, she chooses to marry Alvin Walsh, the King of Sabulon, and finds that the King falls in love with her. Meanwhile, Alistair realizes too late that he has always loved her.
6911f4debb25322b200bb973.title: My Princess, Return to Me

691402b5797f05d2a70f5a41.synopsis: Sara throws herself at Edward and becomes the city's biggest joke. Everyone thinks she is hopelessly in love until the truth comes out. Edward is just a stand-in for someone else, and she never loves him at all. But when Sara tries to walk away, the man, once incapable of love, snaps. Now, he'll do anything to keep her.
691402b5797f05d2a70f5a41.title: Love in the Shadow

691412c149ca3c10d00a39cd.synopsis: A modern female doctor unexpectedly travels back in time to become Elara, second daughter of the disgraced Blair family. To save her family, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the close servant of the war god, Noah Croft. Using her talents and modern medical knowledge, Elara repeatedly saves lives in times of crisis. Noah develops feelings for her but struggles with his perception of her gender until her true identity is revealed. Then, together, they overcome challenges and forge a magical romance that transcends time.
691412c149ca3c10d00a39cd.title: Your Highness, Your Family Doctor Is Actually a Girl!

69143a1e3b4503c4ac04e8fe.synopsis: When ambitious casting assistant Cleo Marlowe risks everything to convince movie star Blake Wilder to act in her movie, she doesn’t expect him to say yes, or for the paparazzi to catch her walking out of his house. Branded as the girl who slept her way to a get ahead, Cleo becomes Hollywood’s favorite rumor. But while her reputation takes a nosedive, the notoriously cold and gruff Blake starts to show up for her in ways she never saw coming.
69143a1e3b4503c4ac04e8fe.title: How to Land a Movie Star

69163cfea0a95eb3a80f92c3.synopsis: It’s back to school for the cast of Taming My Bullies! Meg Bush, Cameron Porras, and Travis Owens face off in a series of games in this High School Challenge episode to see who really rules the school. Plus, they spill stories about flirting on set, first kisses, and even a few fights!
69163cfea0a95eb3a80f92c3.title: ReelTalk EP 48-Flirting, First Kisses, and Fighting

6916d8d9dd25ee45d80e29f7.synopsis: Diane makes a deathbed promise to her grandmother to have a baby—only to immediately uncover proof of her husband Miles' affair. Devastated, she ends their seven-year marriage. In a drunken rebound move (courtesy of her bold bestie Maggie), Diane spends a wild night with a gorgeous callboy named Eddie… but her night blindness hides a jaw-dropping truth: Eddie is actually Dominic—her and Miles'college classmate who's been secretly in love with her for years. After studying abroad, he's now returned as a ruthless billionaire… and he'll stop at nothing to win Diane back. By day, he's a powerful tycoon; by night, he voluntarily plays her devoted callboy, determined to make her fall for him.
6916d8d9dd25ee45d80e29f7.title: Fated To My Billionaire Call Boy

6916da7c686e13455b00b9b5.synopsis: After a passionate night together, Ava is shocked to discover that Edmund is the new CEO of her company—and she’s assigned as his secretary. Forced to keep their night a secret, she struggles to navigate their professional and personal boundaries. Meanwhile, her friend Chloe schemes her way into Edmund’s mansion by claiming to be the mysterious woman from that fateful night. As Chloe seduces Edmund and torments Ava, their schemes only bring Edmund and Ava closer. In a stunning twist, Ava learns she is the true heiress to a luxury hotel empire. With the truth revealed, Edmund and Ava finally claim their happily ever after.
6916da7c686e13455b00b9b5.title: Damn! The Duke Got The Wrong Girl

6916da7d686e13455b00b9b7.synopsis: Maid's Vendetta tells the story of Diana, whose perfect life was destroyed when her father had an affair, her younger brother died in a tragic accident, and her mother suffered a mental breakdown—all because of one woman. Swearing vengeance, Diana sets in motion a dangerous game of revenge. Twenty years ago, Diana lived a charmed life as the beloved heiress of a wealthy family—until her family tutor, Sophie, seduced her father and tore her world apart. Now, under the alias Raven, she infiltrates Sophie's household as a maid, determined to make her pay for ruining her family.
6916da7d686e13455b00b9b7.title: Maid's Vendetta

6916da7f686e13455b00b9b9.synopsis: Selina Murphy, a wealthy heiress, goes undercover as an intern at her fiancé's company—only to cross paths with Grace, a cunning opportunist from the wrong side of the tracks. Grace brazenly steals Selina's identity and, with the help of their coworkers, relentlessly bullies the "new girl." But Grace picked the wrong target this time. The real heiress is about to fight back.
6916da7f686e13455b00b9b9.title: Undercover Heiress

6916da80686e13455b00b9bb.synopsis: They mistook each other for the partner in the contractual marriage. After the flash marriage, they discovered that they were meant for each other.
6916da80686e13455b00b9bb.title: Flash Vows

6916da82686e13455b00b9bf.synopsis: Mia died on her third wedding anniversary—abandoned and ignored by her cheating husband until her last breath. But fate gives her a second chance. Reborn into the past, she serves her husband divorce papers the moment she wakes up. This time, the queen is playing for keeps.
6916da82686e13455b00b9bf.title: I Became My Ex-Husband's Boss

6916da85686e13455b00b9c3.synopsis: After a one - night stand with a handsome stranger, Sarah, a young campaign intern, realized that he was her boss, Senatorial candidate Christopher. In a tough campaign, their affair would be a career - ending scandal for both of them, so she concealed her identity. But did Christopher fall in love with her or the role she was playing? Will their love story destroy them or can they survive the scandal and become a powerful couple in the political world?
6916da85686e13455b00b9c3.title: Campaigning For Love

6916da88686e13455b00b9c7.synopsis: After enduring six humiliating years of her husband Jake’s public infidelity, Anna finally snaps. She files for divorce and reignites her long-abandoned dream—reclaiming her status as a world-class pianist. Enter Ethan, her seemingly ordinary piano teaching assistant who’s actually a billionaire tycoon in disguise. With his unwavering support, Anna stages a breathtaking comeback, humiliates her ex-husband, and reclaims her glory. And as for Ethan? He gets the happy ending Jake threw away.
6916da88686e13455b00b9c7.title: Divorced Queen Returns to The Stage

6916da89686e13455b00b9c9.synopsis: Prince Philip of the young Kingdom of Lavinia went to the US to avoid being pressured into marriage. There he met and helped Anna, an American girl who had just been betrayed by her boyfriend. Philip claimed to be a royal gardener and agreed to a flash marriage with Anna. After their marriage, the two worked together to take on Anna's stepmother and stepsister, helping Anna successfully inherit her mother's company and obtain the authorization for royal portraits. In the end, Philip revealed his true identity, got his parents to accept Anna, and the two lived a happy life in California.
6916da89686e13455b00b9c9.title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince

6916da8a686e13455b00b9cb.synopsis: Amelia, a young widow, was pregnant with the posthumous child of her late husband Daniel. She was taken back to the Tuscan estate of the ancient and powerful Di Maggio family in Italy for protection. At first, Anthony, Daniel's older brother, was hostile towards Amelia, seeing her as a threat. But through repeated conflicts and time spent together, he was deeply attracted to her resilience and sincerity. Under the pressure of family disputes and traditional responsibilities, Amelia and Anthony overcame suspicion and prejudice and gradually developed a sincere and passionate relationship. In the Tuscan sunshine and the shadow of the ancient estate, they jointly protected the unborn child and the future of the family while experiencing a new chapter of love for each other.
6916da8a686e13455b00b9cb.title: Irresistible love with my brother in law

6916da8b686e13455b00b9cd.synopsis: Evelyn, who had been severely hurt by her scumbag biological father and vicious stepmother, was saved by Francis, who had secretly loved her for years. Evelyn had plastic surgery and changed her identity. She carried out her revenge plan as Francis' sister. Even though Evelyn was focused on revenge, she couldn't help falling in love with Francis. After going through many hardships, Evelyn and Francis finally got married.
6916da8b686e13455b00b9cd.title: Secret Love With My Billionaire Revenge Partner

6916da8c686e13455b00b9cf.synopsis: Kate, an airline heiress, wanted to work as a regular flight attendant without revealing her true identity. But on her first day, Jasmine stole her identity and turned the crew against her. Meanwhile, Glen—the captain Kate was supposed to marry for business—fell for her without knowing who she really was. He even wanted to call off their arranged marriage! When Kate’s true identity was finally exposed, Jasmine got the humiliation she deserved—and Kate got her happy ending with Glen.
6916da8c686e13455b00b9cf.title: Heiress Hidden In The Clouds

6916da90686e13455b00b9d5.synopsis: In a tale of transformation and revenge, bullied high schooler Alexandra reinvents herself as "Lexi" with the help of childhood friend Dan, returning to expose her tormentors, reclaim her dignity, and find true love.
6916da90686e13455b00b9d5.title: The MVP's Plus Size Love

6916da93686e13455b00b9d9.synopsis: Against the backdrop of raging wildfires in Los Angeles, the contractual marriage between firefighter Liam and novelist Natalie is thrown into crisis due to misunderstandings, betrayal, and life-and-death trials. As the wildfires spread, Liam gradually realizes his true feelings for Natalie, while she reexamines their relationship through the pain. The two grow closer amid disaster and conspiracy, ultimately rekindling their love from the ashes.
6916da93686e13455b00b9d9.title: Wildfire Between Us

6916da94686e13455b00b9db.synopsis: In the chaos of a brutal gang shootout, Violet, a nurse, instinctively saves Mattia, the ruthless leader of a powerful crime syndicate, from the brink of death. Little does she know that this act of mercy will ensnare her in a dangerous web of obsession. Caught in a deadly game of love and betrayal, Violet must confront a heart-wrenching dilemma: stay true to her promise or succumb to Mattia’s seductive yet perilous affection. With each passing moment, the line between love and deception blurs, leading to a suspenseful showdown where only one truth can survive.
6916da94686e13455b00b9db.title: 7 Steamy Days with a Ganster

6916da95686e13455b00b9dd.synopsis: After divorcing her indecisive husband, the mysterious writer Dorothy chose to prove herself through her talent — she created her most important work, silenced her jealous sister-in-law, and finally found her true love.
6916da95686e13455b00b9dd.title: After the Divorce, the Heiress Takes It All

6916da98686e13455b00b9e1.synopsis: On the male lead’s wedding day, his mother (the female lead), who’s been abroad, comes to attend the ceremony—but the bride-to-be (the female villain) mistakenly accuses the male lead of cheating. The villain, along with her family and bridesmaids, bullies the female lead. When the male lead arrives, the truth comes out: the villains realize she’s his mother. To get her son to call off the wedding, the female lead reveals the villain’s true, malicious motives for marrying him. With the female lead holding power that could bankrupt them with a single call, the villain is betrayed by her family and friends one after another. Finally, her own infidelity is exposed publicly. The male lead sees through her, cancels the wedding, and the villain ends up being brought to justice and losing everything.
6916da98686e13455b00b9e1.title: Bridezilla, Never Provoke The Billionaire Mother

691a80c389691cf53d0e04fe.synopsis: Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?
691a80c389691cf53d0e04fe.title: The Price of Loving You

691a80e9dd802345220ceb09.synopsis: In Operation Christmas Trap movie, six years ago, Winnie and Logan fell in love and had twin daughters. But after Selina sowed discord between them, a misunderstanding drove the couple apart. Six years later, with a little help from their twin daughters swapping places, the truth comes to light.
691a80e9dd802345220ceb09.title: Operation Christmas Trap

691a8b145672b8ae5e0de240.synopsis: After three years of marriage to Edward Lowe, Serena Tate discovers his obsession with her sister-in-law, Miranda Sharpe, and his manipulative ways. Disillusioned, Serena divorces Edward, reclaims her assets, and revives her career in traditional medicine. Throughout her journey, Larry Sims stands by her side, helping to expose Miranda's plot to sabotage Serena. Eventually, Serena and Larry marry in a whirlwind romance, and Serena's cancer drug "New Life" achieves great success. Edward realizes his mistake, but his regret comes too late.
691a8b145672b8ae5e0de240.title: Broken Vows, Healing Love

691a9cadc86ec5406f0bda5d.synopsis: In Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage movie, Iris and Benjamin were once the ultimate power couple—total relationship goals for everyone, and loaded to boot. They went from college sweethearts straight to tying the knot, and he even gave her a kidney to save her life, swearing he’d love her forever. But by their third year of marriage? Benjamin was hooking up with his mistress out in the open, no shame at all. Crushed and done with his nonsense, Iris set a "15-day countdown" and quietly planned her divorce and escape. But his pathetic lies and the mistress’s bold-faced disrespect pushed her over the edge—she lost the baby. Completely broken, she finally took off, all by herself. Benjamin had no clue how much he’d hurt her until she was gone. That’s when his brutal "redemption tour" started—you know, when someone messes up bad and then begs for forgiveness, but it’s already too late. He offered a reward worldwide to find her, but Iris outsmarted him at every turn. His career and reputation? Gone in a flash. Even after he dumped the mistress, got on his knees to beg for mercy, and took a knife for Iris (ending up seriously hurt), he couldn’t melt her cold heart. In the end, he just had to watch—lonely and full of regret—as she built a new, happy life. And that’s when he finally got it: "Belated love ain’t worth squat"—affection that shows up too late? It’s totally useless.
691a9cadc86ec5406f0bda5d.title: Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage

691c49f5645b6ad1e50eba16.synopsis: The racing king, Alexander, was framed by his adopted brother Cade during the championship and ended up at the Apollo Club, working as a mechanic. But the Apollo Club was threatened by Cade’s underlings. Alexander had no choice but to return to the racing world — the king of racing is back...
691c49f5645b6ad1e50eba16.title: Return of the racing king

691d9ce58ec4a2044c092150.synopsis: On their anniversary, Tessa is finally ready to gift her boyfriend her virginity—only to discover he's already sleeping with her cousin. Meanwhile, her work life is no better, with a toxic manager who steals her ideas and makes her daily life a living hell. When she's blindsided with a terminal Leukemia diagnosis, she snaps: quits her job, dumps the cheater, and begins checking off the items on her bucket list. After a chance encounter at her lowest, captivating CEO Cassian Vaughn can't get her out of his head. Knowing she needs help, he offers her a deal: he'll fund the entirety of her last wishes if she does him the small favor of posing as....his fiancée!
691d9ce58ec4a2044c092150.title: Billionaire Completes My Bucket List

691e716e522560fd53040fbf.synopsis: Amelia Glyn, heiress to the Glyn Group, enters university posing as a commoner—only to be targeted by the bully, Vivian Lowe, who steals her admission spot. But when Amelia's true identity is revealed and an explosive secret about her father’s illegitimate daughter is uncovered, a fierce battle over family name and fortune erupts.
691e716e522560fd53040fbf.title: The True Heiress’s Revenge

691e719845e47cc81207c981.synopsis: Aurora Lee wakes up reborn on her first day of college, memories intact of being betrayed and murdered by her best friend, Auria Bowen. This time, the real heiress hides her identity while Auria—the imposter—invites everyone on a fancy overseas trip, secretly plotting to steal Aurora's fortune again. As Aurora plays along with Auria's deception, she maneuvers to unmask the truth in a deadly game of revenge where everyone is a pawn, and no one leaves unchanged.
691e719845e47cc81207c981.title: Oops, Roomie, You Picked the Wrong Girl!

691e71c0c8e09399a70c45eb.synopsis: In the 1980s, Milo secretly admired the factory director's daughter, Hailey. He even risked everything to save her from losing her virginity, only to be falsely accused of assault, ruining his life. Now, reborn on that fateful day of final reckoning, Milo seeks justice. This time, who else will regret crossing him?
691e71c0c8e09399a70c45eb.title: Reborn: To Tear Off Her Mask

691e71ea8997e2481d064125.synopsis: Jorie is reborn before her life was stolen, before her fiancé and stepsister destroyed her future. This time, she flips the script by marrying Uncle Theodore, a steadfast, powerful man fourteen years older, and kicks her ex-fiancé out of the family for good.
691e71ea8997e2481d064125.title: Sweet Revenge: From Betrayal to Beloved

691e722c2b9ef41a0f0ed3d8.synopsis: Rita Carr, an ancient Channeler, returns as the Carr family's daughter after experiencing a hundred wrongful reincarnations. Amid family feuds, gang conflicts, and the conspiracies of the Krana Empire, she breaks the chains of destiny, achieves female awakening, and ultimately rekindles her past connection with Louie Bale, the young leader of Aegis Syndicate, concluding this time-transcending legend.
691e722c2b9ef41a0f0ed3d8.title: Through Every Life to Find You

691e729f5d700ec2690bc3eb.synopsis: Felicia Snook donates a fortune to aid her cousin, Crown Prince Ollie Gill, with disaster relief, in return for his promise to make her his Crown Princess. Yet, upon his victorious return, Ollie and his father strip her of her title and status and grant them to her half-sister. Feeling betrayed, Felicia empties the marquis's estate, expels the scoundrel, aids her mother in obtaining a divorce, and uses her fortune to secure her position as a princess. With a strategic grip on commerce, she is determined to make all those who wronged her regret their actions.
691e729f5d700ec2690bc3eb.title: Destined to My Prince's Embrace

691e72c4830ac6669109f3cc.synopsis: Ethan, the village's toughest hunter, lives by two rules: hunt wild beasts and stay feared. But when time-traveling Molly insists on marrying him, the man everyone avoids finally meets someone who won't run and maybe even tames his wild heart.
691e72c4830ac6669109f3cc.title: Claimed by My Hunter Husband

691ec6cd73a4ab3e37065193.synopsis: Mia Langford, a talented but financially struggling art student, never expected her quiet life to collide with power, desire, and betrayal. A single reckless moment in class—an impulsive gaze and a forbidden sketch—draws the attention of her professor, Wesley Winslow, a brilliant yet dangerous man whose presence alters the trajectory of her world. Before Mia can understand the shift, her manipulative stepmother arranges a sudden engagement between her and Wesley’s entitled son, Darius—an alliance designed entirely for wealth and influence. But everything changes on a fateful night when, drugged and blindfolded, Mia ends up in Wesley’s arms instead of her fiancé’s. What should have been a mistake becomes an irreversible entanglement—emotionally, physically, and morally. As their forbidden bond deepens, Mia becomes trapped between two powerful men—one who seeks to possess her and one who risks everything to protect her. Darius, driven by jealousy, control, and entitlement, escalates his obsession. He forces Mia into humiliation, threatens her reputation, and captures evidence meant to destroy her future, using blackmail and emotional warfare to keep her under his control. Meanwhile, Mia fights for dignity in a world determined to shame and silence her. Rumors spread on campus, classmates turn against her, and her image becomes a weapon used to dismantle the life she worked so hard to build. Wesley becomes her only refuge—but also her biggest contradiction: the man she should run from, and the only one she wants. Their connection grows from forbidden desire to something dangerously close to love—forcing both to confront their fears, ethics, and the power structures binding them. In a world where everything—her body, her name, her future—is being claimed by others, Mia must decide whether to surrender…or fight for her identity, her freedom, and her own voice.
691ec6cd73a4ab3e37065193.title: Creation Itself Is Love

691ecb1b08c36d04eb04d6dd.synopsis: Clara Chavez, the daughter of a wealthy merchant, is reborn on the night of her wedding, where her groom, Cole Kerrigan, humiliates her by marrying his sister-in-law as well. Determined to reject this fate, Clara vows revenge and sets out to reclaim everything she has lost. Along her journey, she forms a profound bond with Prince Adrian, leading to the Kerrigan family's downfall and securing her rightful place in the royal lineage, ultimately finding happiness with Adrian.
691ecb1b08c36d04eb04d6dd.title: How to Tame a Royal Heart

691f2187a8a29c755f013765.synopsis: Village doctor, Ava Fleming, works hard to support her fiancé Luke Bax through college, only to discover that he has secretly married and started a family in the city. Determined to cut ties with Luke, Ava inadvertently saves the life of a powerful figure, Jesse Mills, who falls in love with her at first sight and proposes. To Ava's surprise, the ruthless Jesse is actually a gentle and obedient partner at home...
691f2187a8a29c755f013765.title: After Marrying the Mob Boss

691f7130a400c714ca0e2dfa.synopsis: Spend a day with Meg Bush as she gets red carpet ready for the International Short Drama Festival. Go behind the scenes of her glam process and catch the stunning dress reveal before she heads to the event. Stay tuned! You might spot some familiar faces along the way.
691f7130a400c714ca0e2dfa.title: ReelTalk EP 49-Red Carpet Ready with Meg

691fcad3e34279d3bf0a8e93.synopsis: In I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy movie, during her first year in high school, Hannah Morrow is losing her virginity to the powerful Jamie St. Clair in their prestigious private school’s library. Jamie breaks up with her in front of the whole school and she loses her scholarship. When the two are reunited their final year, they fake a relationship despite hating each other. But real feelings lay underneath their fake relationship. Will Hannah get back the boy who broke her heart? Or will she lose everything when their fake relationship is exposed?
691fcad3e34279d3bf0a8e93.title: I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy

692102b1d1572c3b2c014967.synopsis: Jax Carter, the bastard son of a disgraced housekeeper and a fight gym patriarch, secretly trains under three outlaw coaches. When he's entered into The Crucible, an elite, once-in-a-generation MMA proving ground, he must carry the weight of betrayal, shame, and thousands of pounds of hidden resistance training. As rivals rise and family tries to crush him, Jax must prove once and for all: he wasn’t born to break... he was built to fight.
692102b1d1572c3b2c014967.title: The Knockout King

6923bbb1bc38afa96f0f43c5.synopsis: In Once Upon A Breakup movie, after being abandoned on her birthday by her college boyfriend, Mia impulsively proposes to Carson, the charming but dangerous leader of the Moretti crime family. Though their relationship begins as a rash escape, it quickly turns into something real. But Mia’s ex refuses to let go. Obsessed, jealous, and spiraling out of control, he’ll stop at nothing to win her back, even if it means destroying the new life Mia’s trying to build with Carson. However, Mia isn’t looking back. She's thriving with Carson by her side and ready to show Aiden exactly what he threw away.
6923bbb1bc38afa96f0f43c5.title: Once Upon A Breakup

6923bbc3a1220fce8708b39f.synopsis: After being dumped by her ex, Nola unexpectedly finds herself in the arms of Ryan Laren—her ex’s future father-in-law, a man of immense wealth and power. Learning of her complicated bond with his daughter, Ryan tries to stay away. But Nola keeps breaking his rules, drawing him deeper into a dangerous attraction.
6923bbc3a1220fce8708b39f.title: Seducing Mr. Larsen

6923bbd68bc07cff53085ab4.synopsis: Carl Oliver, the legendary sharpshooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for longest confirmed kill then vanished from the public eye. He hid his identity, working as maintenance at a shooting range. He endures humiliation from the dismissive shooting club captain, Albert, unaware of his true identity. The shooting range is facing a hostile takeover. In order to protect Jane, the owner, and her daughter Rebecca, Carl steps up and shows his legendary shooting skills, drawing attention to his mysterious identity...
6923bbd68bc07cff53085ab4.title: American Sniper: The Last Round

6923bcc2a37f3ee825092cd5.synopsis: A deranged female flight instructor obsesses over her handsome student, using her piloting skills to destroy the people in his life and seduce him into loving her.
6923bcc2a37f3ee825092cd5.title: Deadly Mile High Club

6923d351ecf66c42f009faf1.synopsis: After dying in disgrace, Leo Vance wakes up reborn—back to the day Ramona Finch, a pregnant woman, first targeted him on the bus. Last life, he was framed as the father of her twins. This time, he refuses to fall into her traps—yet she hunts him down with fake DNA tests, a forged marriage license, and a twisted public trial. Leo must expose Ramona's web of lies before his life is ruined again.
6923d351ecf66c42f009faf1.title: No More Mr. Nice Guy

6923d4f2ad8ce2ab45048d5c.synopsis: In her past life, Lydia was betrayed and left with nothing. Given a second chance, she refuses to marry the same man and repeat her fate. Instead, Lydia chooses to marry the dying Crown Prince, a decision that has the entire city anticipating her downfall. But what if the "sickly" prince isn't so sickly after all?
6923d4f2ad8ce2ab45048d5c.title: Reborn Bride: Saving the Crown Prince

6923e0461dbdb285bf07e30b.synopsis: On Fiona's wedding day, both she and her sister Amber are reborn, but Amber seizes the chance to steal Fiona's wealthy groom, Leo Lynch, leaving Fiona to marry the seemingly poor security guard, Noah Porter. Fiona, aware of the Lynch family's deceptive allure, embraces her new path in search of tranquility. Yet, Noah's enigmatic background earns him the respect of powerful business figures. Meanwhile, Amber's dream of a luxurious life crumbles as her husband is unfaithful, leading her to pursue the affluent Porter family, only to find a shocking resemblance between their heir and Noah.
6923e0461dbdb285bf07e30b.title: My Backup Husband is a Tycoon

6923e074488cef03520439c9.synopsis: Deeply in love with her husband, Dane, Veronica gave him everything and became a housewife. In return, she was cheated on and brutally murdered by the love of her life. Now reborn back to a year ago, she chooses to return to the legal world and use her future vision for revenge. This time, she sees Dane for who he truly is: a good-for-nothing cheat.
6923e074488cef03520439c9.title: After the Divorce, She Takes It All

6923f673bc065b99e9011f9e.synopsis: Elara Raven's daughter was declared dead. Her lover abandoned her. Now, six years later as a music diva, a little stranger's song on a competition stage reminds her of the very song she wrote for her daughter. Her child is alive. The fight to reclaim the life stolen from her begins now.
6923f673bc065b99e9011f9e.title: Never Stopped Loving You

6924200211e56d83a80583cc.synopsis: In The One I Never Forget movie, five years ago, a tragedy that claimed the lives of loved ones from both sides forced Sofia​ and Justin​ apart, a separation further complicated by Doris's​ lies, Sofia's miscarriage, and Justin's severe injury. Five years later, Sofia returns to Los Angeles as a renowned journalist, while Justin has become a baseball superstar. Their reunion is fraught with conflict, fueled by misunderstandings (Sofia falsely claims to be married; Justin mistakenly believes Sofia left him for money), obstructions (continued opposition from Doris and schemes by Esther), and danger (Esther's plot to commit murder). Ultimately, Justin uncovers the whole truth about the past, Doris confesses her wrongdoing, and Esther is exposed for her crimes and arrested. Transcending their pain, Sofia and Justin achieve dual fulfillment in their careers (Sofia completes her major report; Justin wins a championship) and in love. Their story highlights how honesty and forgiveness can allow love to be reborn from the ruins of lies and violence.
6924200211e56d83a80583cc.title: The One I Never Forget

69250e4843e34efeda07ac5d.synopsis: College student Lian Cabot transmigrates into the illegitimate son of the Duke. His mother was murdered, and he is forced to marry into the Croft family, taking a foolish bride. After the marriage, Lian uses his poetic talent to win over his alluring mother-in-law and beautiful sister-in-law during the day, while at night he trains in martial arts with a mysterious woman. However, it seems that the person he shares his bridal chamber with each night is different.
69250e4843e34efeda07ac5d.title: Tell Me Your Secret, My Bride

69250e572a301b17350be15e.synopsis: A car accident gave Moxie aphasia, yet her husband, eager to please his secret lover, proposed a fake divorce. Moxie finally wakes up. He wants a divorce? He's going to get one. But guess who will be regretting it?
69250e572a301b17350be15e.title: Silent Divorce, Loud Regrets

69250e6537c83914ce03a17c.synopsis: When Evelyn Hewitt, a general from hundreds of years ago, wakes up as modern-day heiress and stepmom to rebellious Killian Foster, she brings battlefield tactics to household wars. Armed with pressure points and a fierce spirit, she must tame her spoiled stepson, navigate a marriage of convenience with CEO Stephen Foster—who shares the face of her lost love—and conquer high society’s doubts. This time, her empire is the Foster family.
69250e6537c83914ce03a17c.title: Surrender, My Stepson

69250e767490e12a6c0d3d75.synopsis: Betrayed by his wife, Yvonne, and left with nothing, Lennox Hayes suddenly inherits ancient powers that change his destiny. When Amelia Langford—heiress to the powerful Langford family of Grimwood—reveals their long-lost engagement, Lennox must navigate a dangerous new world of cultivation and conspiracy. From the streets of Riverain to the heights of Grimwood's elite, he'll prove that even the most broken can rise to rule.
69250e767490e12a6c0d3d75.title: My Rise To Power After She Left

69250e84b656aef4560fc18b.synopsis: When actress Zoe Sanchez is transported to ancient times, she becomes a concubine to Prince Alfred. Trapped in his treacherous harem, she must outsmart rivals and win the Prince's heart using her modern wit. From unwanted servant to undeniable favorite—her most dangerous role begins now.
69250e84b656aef4560fc18b.title: When a Morden Girl Fell Into the Prince’s Harem

69250ea9f861a41f2f08dd2d.synopsis: From the ashes of a legend, Grace Stoll emerges as an adopted daughter and a stand-in bride for her "sister." Everyone assumes she's just a country girl with no manners and that her husband is an outcast from his influential family. But is that really the case?
69250ea9f861a41f2f08dd2d.title: The Genius Bride Returns

692533f4d678a7952809f6fb.synopsis: Aurora Lee wakes up reborn on her first day of college, memories intact of being betrayed and murdered by her best friend, Phoebe Bowen. This time, the real heiress hides her identity while Phoebe—the imposter—invites everyone on a luxurious overseas trip, secretly plotting to steal Aurora's fortune again. As Aurora plays along with Phoebe's deception, she maneuvers to unmask the truth in a deadly game of revenge where everyone is a pawn, and no one leaves unchanged.
692533f4d678a7952809f6fb.title: Oops, Roomie, You Picked the Wrong Girl!

69266ea181434623840e442a.synopsis: Village doctor, Ava Fleming, works hard to support her fiancé Luke Bax through college, only to discover that he has secretly married and started a family in the city. Determined to cut ties with Luke, Ava inadvertently saves the life of a powerful figure, Jesse Mills, who falls in love with her at first sight and proposes. To Ava's surprise, the ruthless Jesse is actually a gentle and obedient partner at home...
69266ea181434623840e442a.title: After Marrying the Mob Boss

6927a3f9e7f4adf8670b0251.synopsis: We’re giving thanks with the dynamic duo, Sarah Moliski and Aaron Oberst! Join them as they catch up over a delicious Thanksgiving dinner, share what they’re grateful for, and reminisce about their time working together on Her Double, His Trouble. They even unwrap some special gifts from Laifen. Tune in. You might just win 100 coins to watch even more on the ReelShort app!
6927a3f9e7f4adf8670b0251.title: ReelTalk EP 50-Happy Reelsgiving!

6927acdb367fb321d80b0843.synopsis: Mina Shaw, is reborn as the daughter of Prince Henry—a man hellbent on revenge. She can read minds, turn anything to gold, and her inner thoughts are broadcast to everyone around her! Now, she must navigate a chaotic court, tame her vengeful father, outwit a cunning crown prince, and win over a grumpy emperor—all while accidentally melting hearts and turning the royal world upside down.
6927acdb367fb321d80b0843.title: I Crowned My Useless Dad

6927f33413f454d0280ff0d7.synopsis: Hannah, a Farm-raised Ballerina, uses a contract engagement to secure her place in the prestigious Hargrove Ballet Company, but she's interrupted by Jack, a handsome assassin, who coerces her to help him. He's a dangerous obstacle, until Hannah discovers he could actually give her everything. As she finally surrenders, he pulls away... But when they face death together, they realize, life's too short to waste true love.
6927f33413f454d0280ff0d7.title: Love Is a Dangerous Dance

6927f357e88b7499a30d49ea.synopsis: In The Prince's First Love movie, Lucas never expected to kiss a prince—least of all in front of the entire school. What began as a feud with Prince Nicholas turned into a forced friendship, and that into something far more complicated. Every glance, every brush of hands, pulls them closer... but Nicholas is torn between his royal duty and his growing feelings for the boy he once called an enemy. Neither dares to speak the truth—until the moment it can’t be hidden.
6927f357e88b7499a30d49ea.title: The Prince's First Love

6927f387c28b39cdd0021af3.synopsis: Nicole loses everything the night she’s framed—her freedom, her child, and the love of her life. Seven years later, she returns as a nanny in the very house that once destroyed her. Ethan, her ex-fiancé, still haunted by the woman he once loved, starts to feel something for the new nanny—without knowing it’s her. Secrets simmer, memories resurface, and Lila, their stolen daughter, is the unexpected thread pulling them back together. He doesn’t remember her. But his heart never forgets.
6927f387c28b39cdd0021af3.title: Daddy Forgot, but Mommy Remembers

692906731cbfe9006d05a137.synopsis: The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?
692906731cbfe9006d05a137.title: Legally Bound To Love

692cf23c0c7340328c077938.synopsis: Jocelyn gave up her tech career for marriage, only to be betrayed and forced to serve her husband's mistress. She divorces him, takes back her patents, and tanks his company overnight. After a flash marriage with her former rival Steven, she returns to the tech world and rises higher than ever, leaving her ex with nothing.
692cf23c0c7340328c077938.title: Divorced, Devoted & Dominating

692cf44f5129d4d5a80d0c03.synopsis: In her past life, Lydia was betrayed and left with nothing. Given a second chance, she refuses to marry the same man and repeat her fate. Instead, Lydia chooses to marry the dying Crown Prince, a decision that has the entire city anticipating her downfall. But what if the "sickly" prince isn't so sickly after all?
692cf44f5129d4d5a80d0c03.title: Reborn Bride: Saving the Crown Prince

692cf83632d7750c2700f47b.synopsis: Gloria risked her life to save her husband, Felix. But the remedy requires two doses, taken three years apart, for a complete cure. Felix has already taken one, while the other could save the poisoned Prime Minister. Meanwhile, under the guise of "virtue", Felix pressures Gloria to step down as his legal wife and make way for the Kingsfall Princess. Now with the remedy in her hands, will she still give it to her husband or simply divorce him?
692cf83632d7750c2700f47b.title: I Divorced My Husband for The Chancellor

692cfd3ceb081406610ff7aa.synopsis: Bailee was betrothed to the wealthy Dante from a young age. However, Dante had no love for her and left for overseas studies on their wedding night for three years. Seeking revenge, Bailee took a lover, a man she believed to be insignificant. But when Dante returned, she planned to end her affair. Meanwhile, Bailee learned that the marshal of the country had returned from abroad exactly three years ago. Could the marshal be the lover she has been supporting all along?
692cfd3ceb081406610ff7aa.title: For Her, He Never Moved On

692cfdae465a8f6e290dee7a.synopsis: Evelyn, once a poker champion and now a single mother, left the game after Julian's betrayal. However, her innate strength pushed her to confront the challenges of raising her ailing daughter, Rainie, alone. With courage and resilience, and support from Caleb, she triumphantly returns to the poker world, securing a promising future for herself and her daughter.
692cfdae465a8f6e290dee7a.title: The Queens Take Everything

692cfe7398fa80880c024d3e.synopsis: She is the true heiress as well as an adopted daughter in two families. But her biological parents favor the adopted daughter, her foster mother constantly challenges her, and even her own little brother sees her as an enemy. Bound by a marriage contract, she weds the business mogul Jamie. Luckily, there's one man who stands as her protector, shielding her from the storm.
692cfe7398fa80880c024d3e.title: Simmering Love

692cfee470649864b1078cfd.synopsis: In her previous life, Cara Sinclair sacrificed everything for love, supporting her husband in starting a business and leading him to the pinnacle of success. However, after both are reborn, her unfaithful husband abandons her for her stepsister. Cara decisively chooses Joe, a man disguised as a beggar, as her husband. To her surprise, Joe is capable of anything, and most importantly, he can cook, clean, and keep her warm at night. Together, they embark on a sweet marital journey.
692cfee470649864b1078cfd.title: Spoiled by My Supernatural Husband

692d30b2bf422e0689096291.synopsis: Reina is a long-lost heiress with a secret: Over the years, she's taken over a mysterious overseas syndicate once controlled by her adoptive father, until he was murdered: The very reason she returns and agrees to a marriage of convenience with Edwin Fletcher. Now she's ready to find the truth, but are the Fletchers entirely innocent?
692d30b2bf422e0689096291.title: Killer Wife, Spoiled Life

692e59651acc3aab160b09ad.synopsis: Betrayed by his wife, Yvonne, and left with nothing, Lennox Hayes suddenly inherits ancient powers that change his destiny. When Amelia Langford—heiress to the powerful Langford family of Grimwood—reveals their long-lost engagement, Lennox must navigate a dangerous new world of cultivation and conspiracy. From the streets of Riverain to the heights of Grimwood's elite, he'll prove that even the most broken can rise to rule.
692e59651acc3aab160b09ad.title: My Rise To Power After She Left

6930f2d9c67621345b0ec786.synopsis: Separated from her mother as a child, Cara is raised by Hudson, the gentle, mute grandfather who protects her through every storm. But as life keeps hitting them hard, Winona, Cara's birth mother, turns a blind eye to her daughter's suffering, unaware that her indifference is breaking the family she still has a chance to save.
6930f2d9c67621345b0ec786.title: Forgive Me Not

6930f37ae99ff3263a053f5a.synopsis: Gemma took the fall for a crime she didn't commit so her little sister, Wenny, could live a good life. But the day Gemma walks out of prison, she learns that Wenny is dead. Together with her brother-in-law, Ronan, they find a conspiracy bigger than they thought. Now with both families involved, who's the real murderer?
6930f37ae99ff3263a053f5a.title: Love in Her Shadow

6930f3b01cc54679ca078825.synopsis: In Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas movie, seven years ago, they shared one night. Now they’re fake-married—with a child he doesn’t know is his.
6930f3b01cc54679ca078825.title: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas

6930f5f87c536330fe0b0ed9.synopsis: Cecilia Campbell thought she had a happy family until she found out that her husband had cheated on her with Sarah. When her hearing secretly returns, she turns from prey to predator—masterminding a high-stakes corporate and personal counterattack. But the ultimate revelation—a swapped childhood, a tragic patricide, and a sisterhood forged in lies—threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.
6930f5f87c536330fe0b0ed9.title: Fatal Heiress

6930f62e76c738231109f99c.synopsis: The Crown Princess of the Qoit Dynasty unexpectedly time-travels to the modern entertainment world, inhabiting the body of a struggling actress named Aurora. Armed with exceptional skills, she captivates everyone, including the initially disdainful superstar Julian. Just as their relationship blossoms, Julian's first love, Claire, returns and schemes to create misunderstandings between them. Despite these challenges, Julian remains determined to win Aurora back.
6930f62e76c738231109f99c.title: In This Life, Crown Princess Steals the Spotlight

69312d24f70d7b1eba0774ed.synopsis: Sadie has always been a good girl, but she falls for Ethan, her sister's rival. To please him, they indulge in many secret, scandalous encounters. After a passionate camping trip, Sadie discovers the shocking truth: Ethan's love was a revenge scheme against her sister. Sadie is heartbroken and makes the painful decision to walk away.
69312d24f70d7b1eba0774ed.title: He Loved Her Sister First

693175b7212e00c11e0a6a54.synopsis: Joyce Shaw, a gifted girl from the countryside, enters Juhama University with big dreams, only to be framed for crimes she didn't commit. Expelled and blacklisted, she works in the shadows for five years. Her world changes when Liam Rute, a powerful heir, saves her, seeing the star she truly is. When her past is brutally exposed and her mother falls ill, Joyce decides to fight back. With Liam by her side, she's ready to reclaim her name, her future, and her stolen spotlight.
693175b7212e00c11e0a6a54.title: Silent Star, Shining Scars

6931fdc264bfdd136302d647.synopsis: Who doesn’t love a little nostalgia? Watch as our vertical stars relive their favorite ReelTalk moments with ReelTalk OG Rachel Bencosme. Luke Charles Stafford, Richard Sharrah, Autumn Noel, and Haley Lohrli get heartfelt, hilarious, and everything in between.
6931fdc264bfdd136302d647.title: ReelTalk EP 51-Flashback Friday

69325529b9a87e8d310f3bec.synopsis: Seven years after a chaotic one-night stand, Thea's son, Sean, accidentally reunites with his biological father, a man with a powerful diviner lineage, Everett. A DNA test exposes everything, pulling the powerful Hopper family into a frantic search for their lost heir. Thea becomes Everett's assistant. Sparks fly, misunderstandings explode, and love nearly collapses until the truth forces them all back together.
69325529b9a87e8d310f3bec.title: My One-Night Stand Made an Heir?

69329368b3c98473ec0e75d2.synopsis: Audrey Sterling endured three years of abuse after marrying into The Crawford Family. Her mother-in-law forces her to care for her husband's pregnant cousin, Veronica, who is actually the homewrecker. Meanwhile, Audrey's three long-lost brothers finally find her, and Master Tristan heads to Oakmont to bring her home.
69329368b3c98473ec0e75d2.title: Divorced: Spoiled Rotten by an Adorable Daughter and Three Billionaire Brothers

6932939c1e2a4c5c5906798f.synopsis: Six years ago, Aria Denton was set up by her fiancé and sister and forced to leave. Now, she returns with her three genius children. She’s determined to expose the lies, reclaim her legacy, and make the man who once shattered her pay for what he did. But as secrets unravel, Aria finds that revenge comes with a price she may not be ready to pay.
6932939c1e2a4c5c5906798f.title: Triplets' Revenge: A CEO’s Regret

693295be911f18fa0f01a390.synopsis: Penny and Elliot have been married for three years when she is suddenly betrayed by him and her best friend, Viola. Elliot suspects Penny isn't the woman who saved his life years ago. While struggling to pay her mother's medical bills, Penny is kidnapped and disfigured, after which Elliot demands a divorce. Though he covers the surgery costs, he forces Penny to work as a waitress at Buckingham, a shady men's club. Enduring constant abuse from customers and imprisonment by Elliot, her only comfort is her tough but kind-hearted friend, Fay. However, Viola soon discovers their bond and murders Fay to crush Penny. Viola burns down Buckingham to destroy the evidence and threatens their parents to stop Penny from testifying. Penny assumes the torment is over, but it is just beginning. To completely isolate her, Viola kills Penny's sick parents and nearly murders Nelson, the sole heir of the Fords. Pushed to the absolute limit, Penny realizes enduring the pain is useless. She risks everything and teams up with Nelson to unleash ruthless revenge on Elliot and Viola.
693295be911f18fa0f01a390.title: Cruel Boss, Broken Heart

693295fed031c86dc50919d7.synopsis: Framed by her half-sister, Blair, during childbirth, Aria is cast out by her family. Blair seemingly kills Aria's newborn, Noah, and leaves Aria to burn alive. Surviving the ordeal, Aria discovers she is still carrying a second child. She flees the city, vowing revenge. Five years later, she returns with her child to crush the family business. During a clash with Blair, she crosses paths with the city's top wealthy heir, Vincent Sterling. To prevent him from interfering with her plans, she arranges a fake engagement with him. But once she gets involved with the Sterlings, Aria realizes Vincent's Noah is actually her supposedly dead baby stolen by Blair. Reunited with her lost child and his father, the two kids ultimately help turn their fake marriage into true love.
693295fed031c86dc50919d7.title: The Fraternal Twins

6932ad594c7881f9f704cdb5.synopsis: Wild heiress Yuki Ford marries into the Moores to flip their scheme—only to find Jason Moore faking illness to escape her. But when her counter-move traps him instead, their battle turns explosive… and one kiss could ruin everything.
6932ad594c7881f9f704cdb5.title: My Sassy Wife

6935836eea941f157c0d77f6.synopsis: In a world where choices can reshape destinies, two sisters awaken to a mysterious system that demands a life-altering decision: choose between a billion dollars or their own mother. In their past lives, Hannah's younger sister, Ingrid, chose the billion and entered a life of luxury, only to face a downfall. While Hannah chose family and thrived through her own hard work. Consumed by envy, Ingrid killed her sister. Now reborn to the day of their choices, Ingrid chooses family instead, while Hannah reluctantly takes the billion. But as Ingrid basks in her supposed victory, Hannah smiles. After all, who knows if her sister just picked hell?
6935836eea941f157c0d77f6.title: Fate Won't Stop Me

69362dca0f1ca1629406d3d7.synopsis: "Retired special forces soldier Cole Slade—codename “Reaper”—goes into hiding as a security guard to fulfill his fallen comrade Alexander’s last wish: protect his younger sister, Victoria. On Victoria’s wedding day, the groom runs away, the guests vanish, and a carefully planned corporate conspiracy comes to light. When the proud Victoria forces Cole into a fake marriage, they’re pushed into an uneasy alliance against their sworn enemy, Tristan—an ambitious man set on taking over the Kingsley family’s tech empire. As Cole’s lethal battlefield instincts resurface—from a bloody fight in the church to displays of overwhelming power at high-society banquets—they face not only Tristan’s deadly retaliation, but also the shocking truth that Victoria’s uncle, Conrad, is the mastermind. When a bloodstained dog tag reveals what really happened to Alexander, Cole must use the most extreme measures to protect this marriage—born from a lie—through both corporate warfare and gunfire."
69362dca0f1ca1629406d3d7.title: Understated Guardian King

69362e9306cdcec2b60d306a.synopsis: In Ex-Husband Roll Out of My Life movie, Trina, a housewife betrayed by her husband and humiliated by her entire family, finally finds the strength to leave a loveless home. Thus begins her countdown to freedom.
69362e9306cdcec2b60d306a.title: Ex-Husband Roll Out of My Life

6936765bd40cb2ad9905d82b.synopsis: Rosalind Lawson died betrayed by her husband, William Sloan. Reborn as the true heir of Prince Jason, she returns with a healer’s hands and a vengeful heart. Now, with Commander Damian Shaw at her side, she will reclaim her title, her fortune, and her future—no matter the cost.
6936765bd40cb2ad9905d82b.title: She Writes Her Own Crown

693679844d463b0707067bea.synopsis: Rosia Monroe, the fierce General of Zhenri, finds herself in a scandalous predicament after her body is inhabited for three years by a transmigrator. Upon regaining control, she discovers her reputation tarnished as a lovestruck fool, and her husband disillusioned. Determined to restore her honor, Rosia confronts villains and rekindles her love. Finally, she picks up her spear to defend her country in the battlefield.
693679844d463b0707067bea.title: Hey General, Your Disabled Husband’s Running Away

69367abbe88c446d1702882d.synopsis: Lia's dream to follow her father's footsteps as a police officer was cruelly shattered when the ruthless crime lord, Caleb, wiped out her family. Surviving the massacre, Lia assumes a new identity as the private tutor of Caleb's child, all for her perfect revenge. However, when she discovers what is in the hidden room of Caleb's house, her world shatters again.
69367abbe88c446d1702882d.title: Love Was Never Part of the Mission

69367af780caf7d5cd0efc7d.synopsis: Forced to abandon his martial path for a scholarly life, Sean was betrayed by his fiancée, Luna. Her harsh words, "My husband must be a general, not a weak scholar!" ignite a fire in him. With his dignity shattered, Sean vows revenge. Leaving the scholar's life behind, he rises from the ashes to conquer the land and reclaim his destiny as a legendary general. No one can stop the man who's destined to rule.
69367af780caf7d5cd0efc7d.title: The Weak Scholar Who Would Rule

69368a23c76a5e4f5802b8a6.synopsis: After ten years of marriage, Leah is betrayed by her husband, Jeremy, who demands a divorce and leaves her with nothing. As she battles cancer and moves into a basement with her daughter, Leah's feelings for him remain complicated. She struggles and grows, torn between love, betrayal, and personal strength.
69368a23c76a5e4f5802b8a6.title: I Didn’t Know That Was Goodbye

6936a0838e664d8b090a9bc7.synopsis: In her past life, when the legitimate daughter Leah Bates became pregnant, Elara Bates was deceived into becoming her brother-in-law's concubine. Unbeknownst to her, Leah's childbirth marked the end of Elara's life. Given a second chance, Elara carefully orchestrates her rise, first winning over her brother-in-law's influential father to secure her role as Duchess. She then reclaims her rightful place in the Bates family, exacting vengeance on those who wronged her.
6936a0838e664d8b090a9bc7.title: Obsessed With My Son’s Bride

6937760c0dbba5e2ee0f4a43.synopsis: Natalie's conniving grandmother and sister marry her off to a rural farmer, Rhett. He's a single father, looking after a mute daughter, Ellie. Natalie's presence isn't taken kindly, as she is shunned by Ellie and the woman next door. Over time, she learns the woman next door is actually abusing Ellie. She develops a bond with Ellie, which deepens when Ellie speaks up for the first time to save her. But as Natalie starts settling in, new troubles arise. Ellie is bullied at school, and Natalie gets tangled in conflicts involving both her old and new families. She vows to protect the hard-won love and family she's built.
6937760c0dbba5e2ee0f4a43.title: In Love with a Single Farmer-Daddy

69377d8c7fce15132e076e63.synopsis: In Monster in His Eyes movie, based on the book MONSTER IN HIS EYES by J.M. Darhower! Karissa Reed, 19, is trapped by her controlling mother and abusive ex, Tommy, but her world shifts when Naz Conti, a dangerous ex-con mafia boss, rescues her. Drawn to his danger, she challenges him to let her be his, with every kiss and daring move, risking everything for desire, curiosity, and forbidden love. Can she survive his world, and dare to love the man everyone warns her to fear?
69377d8c7fce15132e076e63.title: Monster in His Eyes

6937be183ec117888d00e7cf.synopsis: Klem Shaw, an actor from modern times, wakes up as the stand-in of the missing Emperor of Argentea, controlled by the ruthless Empress Dowager. Trapped in a palace of lies, he must outwit the Empress and cunning concubines while playing the deadliest role of his life. Using his modern savvy and acting chops, he turns from a puppet into a player.
6937be183ec117888d00e7cf.title: The Pretender Emperor

6937fa98c17a6ed211038bc9.synopsis: Hailey's father adopted three boys from the orphanage - the Miller brothers, who showered her with endless love and care. She even thought she would end up with one of them. But everything changed when the maid's daughter, Blair, came. They robbed Hailey's family fortune and her life. Now reborn, Hailey chooses to punish the Miller brothers and allies with the one person they fear. This time, the Miller brothers' world is going to shatter.
6937fa98c17a6ed211038bc9.title: Revenge Heiress

693a26b23f605a1a2301c3b8.synopsis: ReelTalk Backstage is back and reloaded for the action-packed new series American Sniper: The Last Round. Join Marc Herrmann, Jesse Morales, and Aaron Russell as they take you behind the scenes for explosive moments you won’t find anywhere else. Find out their super powers and maybe even some first impressions of each other!
693a26b23f605a1a2301c3b8.title: ReelTalk EP 52 -Backstage: American Sniper: The Last Round

693a765233a7f9fe2e0f1baa.synopsis: Betrayed, robbed of her inheritance, and murdered by her cheating boyfriend and his mistress, Nancy gets a second chance at life. Upon rebirth, she stuns everyone by marrying Riverport's richest man, Lincoln, and turning the tables on those who destroyed her. To save her late father's company, Nancy must survive a ruthless six-month business wager. With Lincoln as her ally, she crushes her enemies, reclaims her power, and rewrites her fate.
693a765233a7f9fe2e0f1baa.title: Her Second Life, Her Rules

693b8e4d64a3329d740a60c9.synopsis: Driven to despair after losing both her husband and baby, Vivienne only lives for one thing - REVENGE! But simple murder doesn't torture enough. Why not steal her husband and make her watch!
693b8e4d64a3329d740a60c9.title: Your Husband Is Mine

693b8e7d692897a1a4073d7c.synopsis: In Seduction Cove movie, Seduction Cove is a show designed to test couple's loyalties with hot baddies, cash prizes and insane challenges. After Hayley's cheating ex runs off with her sister, she's reunited with Adam, a man who saved her from a near death experience. Will the reunited soulmates survive Seduction Cove?
693b8e7d692897a1a4073d7c.title: Seduction Cove

693b8f146a2054699d00944d.synopsis: In Reborn for the Lycan King movie, reborn after her stepsister’s deadly betrayal, Diana shoots an arrow to choose her mate. It lands on Alexander, the hidden Lycan King. But with Ivy still plotting and her bond with Alex unclear, Diana must fight to change her fate—before it’s too late.
693b8f146a2054699d00944d.title: Reborn for the Lycan King

693bd01a3ce1caf8de0b1a9c.synopsis: Jocelyn gave up her tech career for marriage, only to be betrayed and forced to serve her husband's mistress. She divorces him, takes back her patents, and tanks his company overnight. After a flash marriage with her former rival Steven, she returns to the tech world and rises higher than ever, leaving her ex with nothing.
693bd01a3ce1caf8de0b1a9c.title: Divorced, Devoted & Dominating

693bfcc140445cf26a085be5.synopsis: In Family Is His Only Weakness movie, Wyatt, once known as Hades, the man who whipped the infamous No-Escape Prison into shape, returns to the city to uncover the truth behind his family's murder. Backed by seven formidable sworn sisters from every corner of power and influence, he cuts through criminal empires, crushes old enemies, and protects what's his. As the underworld collapses in his wake, Wyatt moves closer to the truth of his past and the reckoning that awaits.
693bfcc140445cf26a085be5.title: Family Is His Only Weakness

693bfcefc4adc02b0a026687.synopsis: Cindy Sutton seems the perfect submissive companion to Winston Scott—but secretly, she is executing a careful revenge. When Winston’s fiancée, Chloe Ashwood, returns, a dangerous game unfolds involving power, betrayal, and transplanted hearts. Everyone is playing to control others while falling into someone else’s trap.
693bfcefc4adc02b0a026687.title: She Played Obedient, He Paid in Blood

693bfd37e3617b5e930bb1b8.synopsis: Lila Lawson, the daughter of the Murphy family's maid, used her connections to her advantage, posing as the real heiress. Meanwhile, the real heiress, Macie Murphy, faced disgrace when she was accused of cheating, and no one believed that Lila had framed her. Humiliation. Bankruptcy. Death. Now reborn, Macie is back in high school.
693bfd37e3617b5e930bb1b8.title: True Heiress Takes High School

693f8089156da5dbac020e83.synopsis: In her previous life, Stella mistook Isaac for her savior and, out of gratitude, agreed to marry him. Unbeknownst to her, the true hero, Adrian, had lost his memory due to an accident and ended up as her bodyguard, silently protecting her. It wasn't until her final moments that Stella realized the truth: Isaac's heart belonged to her stepsister, Ivy. This ruthless pair not only wove a web of lies but also meticulously plotted against her. Stella passed away with a heart full of resentment. However, fate granted her a second chance...
693f8089156da5dbac020e83.title: Bound to My Heiress

693fc3a8d44b0db5060a6dd7.synopsis: On his way to treat his sick father, Finn saves a drowning old man, unaware he‘s Harborhaven’s richest tycoon. Soon after, Finn is tricked into marrying into the ruthless Spencer family, where he‘s humiliated and exploited. When their cruelty leads to his father’s death, Finn awakens, exposes their schemes, earns the tycoon‘s backing, and rises from despised son-in-law to chosen heir.
693fc3a8d44b0db5060a6dd7.title: When the Son-in-Law Strikes Back

693fdd8e88b329db9504362e.synopsis: With no way out, Vera sets her sights on Yael Brown, a top-tier powerbroker known for his coldness and ruthlessness. Yael sees through her intentions from the start, but chooses to indulge her, drawn in despite himself. What begins as a calculated game slowly turns into an emotional entanglement, pulling the untouchable man down from his pedestal and binding him to her fate.
693fdd8e88b329db9504362e.title: I Seduced the Wrong Man

6940bcfd7970cce0950d142b.synopsis: Serena Smith’s picture-perfect life shatters when she discovers her husband’s affair with her cousin, Raina. Pushed to the edge by betrayal and humiliation, the pregnant heiress drops the docile facade and unveils her power as the true heiress to the Smith empire. This is not a breakdown. This is a takeover.
6940bcfd7970cce0950d142b.title: I Don't Need a Husband

6940cc043952a12e7d0ca13b.synopsis: Phoenixhold lies on the Southern Frontier of Valoria, bordering the Empire of Ostia. Vivian Vance, founder of The Shadowguard known as Lord Vance, retreated here after her husband died. Living in seclusion with her daughter Amelia Vance, she runs a butcher shop. Years pass quietly until Commander Fiona Frost of The Shadowguard appears at her door.
6940cc043952a12e7d0ca13b.title: My Mother the Shadowguard

6940f3e203ba77505807cc2d.synopsis: Sammy and Shane were childhood sweethearts, but a devastating fire left Shane under the mistaken belief that Sammy had deliberately failed to save him. This misunderstanding festered, turning Shane's love into a lingering resentment. Over three tumultuous years of marriage, Shane has filed for divorce 100 times, each time met by Sammy's pleas for forgiveness. When Shane files for divorce for the 101st time, Sammy's heart finally shatters. Resolved to let go of this unrequited love, she makes the bold decision to walk away and accepts the mysterious marriage proposal of a stranger.
6940f3e203ba77505807cc2d.title: The 101st Time I Let Go

6940f95564acd01a81063aee.synopsis: In her past life, Gloria was married off to the ruthless crown prince by decree, only to be killed after three childless years. Given a second chance, Gloria decides to wed the infertile emperor instead. Now, she's pregnant. Guess who's the true phoenix?
6940f95564acd01a81063aee.title: Reborn to Marry the Infertile Emperor

69411cf6384e5d3fe50c93de.synopsis: Student Body President Kaden Russell just made an enemy of Star Quarterback Donovan Miller. When the two clash over school activity funds, Donovan goes too far with a cruel remark. As revenge, Kaden dyes the football uniforms rainbow. But when the prank gets Donovan injured during a game, Kaden is sentenced to serve as Donovan’s “waterboy”. The forced proximity stirs up feelings Donovan never expected, and when their rivalry turns romantic, both boys have to decide what they’re willing to risk for love.
69411cf6384e5d3fe50c93de.title: Waterboy

694127ed32068fe1bd05a6eb.synopsis: With only seven days to live after sacrificing himself, Sword Master, Caelan Evans, watches Empress Lydia Lockwood become convinced of his jealousy and selfishness—even as she sends him divorce papers. His final battle at Heavenate and the blossoming of the Eon Lotus will reveal a truth: every step of his fall was a step taken to protect her throne… and her heart.
694127ed32068fe1bd05a6eb.title: Abandoned, Betrayed... Now I Rise

694128e3a47d4515360db861.synopsis: Murdered by her sister Serena, Grace Thorne awakens on her wedding day to the Quinn family. Armed with memories of betrayal, she sees the truth: her charming husband Mason is hollow, her sister is venomous, and her new family is greedy. This time, Grace plays a different game. She'll reclaim her power, expose the conspiracy that destroyed her bloodline, and make every traitor pay. But as her vengeance unfolds, the secrets of her frail husband, Cyrus Quinn, may change everything.
694128e3a47d4515360db861.title: Swapped Brides, Swapped Fates

69412a2428a2e4d7a60388db.synopsis: Bonnie was born into wealth and privilege, but thanks to Isabel’s schemes, she married the wrong man, suffering disfigurement, betrayal, and the ruin of her family. Reborn, she quietly sets her sights on the seemingly lowly adopted son of the Nail family. Only she knows that this boy, now overlooked, is destined for greatness. Power, wealth, and influence await him.
69412a2428a2e4d7a60388db.title: His Secret Heiress

69412a613e8c2d8e90007d5e.synopsis: When Rosemary wakes up, she discovers she's been transported into the body of a woman from ancient times, burdened with four stepchildren and a deadbeat husband. The family is so emaciated they look like refugees, and to top it off, debt collectors come knocking! Furious, Rosemary kicks her useless husband out. Then, with her sleeves rolled up, she sets out to rebuild the family, excelling at hunting, carrying loads, and defeating bandits...
69412a613e8c2d8e90007d5e.title: Surviving Ancient Times with a Useless Husband

69412a81602822d53f0423cb.synopsis: The Emperor yearns for a daughter after 28 royal sons in a row. He vows to cease his ruthless ways. In response to his prayers, Lady Quinn gives birth to Nora, a girl blessed with luck and foresight. Cherished from a young age, Nora uses her abilities to prevent the Emperor's violent impulses, saving lives along the way. Among those she rescues is Simon, a wolfish boy of unmatched strength, who becomes her loyal guardian and protector. Join Nora and Simon as they outsmart spies from enemy nations and safeguard their empire's future.
69412a81602822d53f0423cb.title: The Tyrant Emperor's Lucky Princess

69412acd28a2e4d7a60388dd.synopsis: In a past life, Beatrice was utterly betrayed. After being reborn, she publicly exposes her fiancé's hypocrisy and turns to collaborate with the wildest member of the Sterling family. "Shall we cooperate, Sebastian Sterling?" she proposes, only to be unexpectedly outmaneuvered. "I want to be your devoted ally!" From then on, the lofty heir of the Sterling family bows only to her...
69412acd28a2e4d7a60388dd.title: Entangled with My Ex's Brother

69412aef16fb41af01034c20.synopsis: Abandoned on her wedding night, noblewoman Vera is divorced after her husband returns from war with a mistress and child. Refusing to be discarded, she reinvents herself, using her rare medical talent to cure the Prince Regent and earn power of her own. As court enemies close in, Vera rises from betrayed wife to a woman capable of changing the empire's fate.
69412aef16fb41af01034c20.title: Wrong Woman to Betray

69412b148a1b6393bf0a8f31.synopsis: Tyler Clerk, an Uber driver, has to works his ass off to pay for rent and his sister's treatment. After a one-night stand gifts him X-ray eyes, every rough stone he scans spills jade—and secrets. With Chaya's help, he's become an antiques appraiser and earned enough money to cover his sister's medical expenses.
69412b148a1b6393bf0a8f31.title: Nothing Can Hide from Me

69426f2c776d01014f056a25.synopsis: In Golden Feather: Temptation Game movie, at the Golden Feather Academy, after being rejected, Queen Celine offers her playboy stepbrother Leo a night with her if he can seduce and destroy the boy who refused her—the president's son, Logic. But when Leo's fake pursuit turns real, Celine loses control of Leo forever...
69426f2c776d01014f056a25.title: Golden Feather: Temptation Game

6943c6a9d3f874f0cb082c91.synopsis: Nina Yeats, battling a debilitating illness, becomes entangled with a monster, Jack Xavier, while trying to fulfill her late mother's last wish. Exploiting her vulnerabilities, Jack seems inescapable, yet Nina refuses to yield. As the icy facade of this devilish figure begins to crack, Jack finds himself unexpectedly bending to Nina's will. Nina discovers that Jack is not as fearsome as he seems, and slowly, she finds herself drawn to him.
6943c6a9d3f874f0cb082c91.title: Yielding to Her Charm

6943c6f440c54ca3700d3c30.synopsis: Julia Cullen has spent over a decade serving in the court, living her life for others. It wasn't until she was deeply hurt that she realized true love comes from those who accept her as who she's and support her journey to become her best self.
6943c6f440c54ca3700d3c30.title: The 'Puppet' Emperor & His Clever Strategist

6943c717d1f8f8d4f105ff89.synopsis: Abandoned as a child, Sylvia is taken in by Yale and raised like a princess, but she mistakes his care for love. Years later, after being sent abroad by the Shepherd family, she returns to find them trapped in a scheme. To repay Yale, she becomes Theo's secret lover, unaware that he has loved her quietly for years. Through his unwavering devotion, Sylvia finally learns what true love really is.
6943c717d1f8f8d4f105ff89.title: Careful, You're Dangerous

69449f2795b99db0dd02c040.synopsis: Happy Holidays, Hollywood! The first annual ReelShort holiday shoot is here. Your favorite lead stars come together to reflect on their journeys in verticals, share dream collaborations, and spread festive cheer in this must-watch holiday special.
69449f2795b99db0dd02c040.title: ReelTalk EP 53-Happy Holidays, Hollywood

6944c157d9fba745670a0931.synopsis: Reporter Nina successfully gains the trust of crime lord Leon Mann and takes him down. Three months later, Nina encounters Leon again at a TV network's gala, only to find he has transformed into Chase Kane, with a spotless reputation. Through investigation, Nina confirms that Chase is indeed Leon and suspects he seeks revenge. As she navigates this elaborate deception, Nina feels dwarfed by the cunning Leon, but with no other choice, she must risk everything for a desperate counterattack.
6944c157d9fba745670a0931.title: Forever Your Prisoner

6944c2df99168e41550ee057.synopsis: Framed by Noble Consort Sheffield, Josephine died in a palace fire with her newborn prince. Reborn with a mysterious fertility system, she returns to the inner court determined to change her fate. Battling scheming concubines, a calculating emperor, and a ruthless empress dowager, she climbs the ranks through strategy, alliances, and the children she bears. In the end, Josephine helps Princess Serena claim the throne and secures ultimate power as Empress Dowager.
6944c2df99168e41550ee057.title: Empire of Secrets

694512e61429aa9289039897.synopsis: Aiden Reed, a social elite and eligible bachelor, finds himself reborn in 2002 on his way to college registration. Armed with foresight, he actively expands his network and seizes the e-commerce wave by founding Rocket 101 Delivery. Meanwhile, Aiden is torn between choosing the treasure girl, Isla Sutton, and his first love, Sophia Shaw...
694512e61429aa9289039897.title: Back to 2002: I Built My Empire

694518d010b7c5bc87065fff.synopsis: Legendary gambler Henry Smith is framed by his nemesis and fellow gambler, Lip Orville, and forced into hiding after Lip kills his brother, David. On the run and out of options, he’s saved by Sophia and assumes a new identity——Carl, a janitor at an underground casino (a speakeasy officially) in Chicago. But when Lip returns, now allied with the mafia, and the infamous mob boss, Don Bazzini, Carl is dragged back into the dangerous world of gambling. At the same time, Carl/Henry begins plotting his revenge.
694518d010b7c5bc87065fff.title: The Last Gambling God

694523451c6f6ec24705e29e.synopsis: Mocked her classmates, Jessie Stark gains x-ray vision suddenly and can spot priceless antiques, predict stocks, and even see illnesses. From hustling in backstreet markets to dominating high-society auctions, Jessie turns her gift into a fortune—all while dodging rivals, outsmarting bullies, and untangling a web of secrets involving Gordon Graham, Leo Lawson, and a mysterious tycoon who knows more about her power than she does.
694523451c6f6ec24705e29e.title: With X-Ray Eyes, Desire Ignites

6945b6f11429aa92890398aa.synopsis: There was a time when Nina believed her happiest moment would be walking down the aisle with Evan, her college sweetheart. But betrayal shattered that dream, teaching her that true love and forever were rare illusions. After their divorce, she vowed never to give her heart away again. Then Damon—Evan’s youngest uncle—stormed into her life, refusing to let her run. She tries to keep her distance, not wanting ties with her ex’s family, but Damon’s relentless pursuit leaves her breathless.
6945b6f11429aa92890398aa.title: Swapped My Ex for His Billionaire Uncle

6947f405bcbab02e330b5133.synopsis: Clarissa Ainsworth unexpectedly discovers that Isabelle is not her biological sister, that her real sister, Celeste, was switched at birth and endured years of abuse. Determined to make things right, Clarissa brings the timid Celeste home, helping her establish her identity while navigating Isabelle's numerous schemes. As Clarissa delves deeper into the mystery, she uncovers that her great-uncle Walter is the mastermind behind the sinister switch. Ultimately, she ensures Walter faces justice for his actions.
6947f405bcbab02e330b5133.title: By Your Side, I Fear No More

6948e3a32622c78abe0c6040.synopsis: When Leo begins his 'job' at a nightclub, he unwittingly crosses paths with the supervisor and inadvertently aids the charming general manager. This sets off a chain of events, all secretly orchestrated by an unseen mastermind from the moment Leo stepped into the club. As he pieces together the clues and delves deeper into the mystery, Leo uncovers a truth that leaves him completely astounded...
6948e3a32622c78abe0c6040.title: Love Under Fire

6948e3f9b1c3533af20c104f.synopsis: In The Melon Seller Is the King movie, bentley, the true power behind Apex Constructions, hides his identity to raise his son right, posing as a night-market fruit vendor while sending Sam to learn the hard way on a construction site. But when a ruthless bully, Hunter, the spoiled son of Bentley's own subordinate, targets Sam, steals his girlfriend, and crushes him at every turn, Bentley steps in. His secret is revealed, yet the bully still dares to strike until Hunter's father arrives, and the truth finally hits home.
6948e3f9b1c3533af20c104f.title: The Melon Seller Is the King

6948e4319d0ddf2a960b1c04.synopsis: To save his reputation, CEO Raymond Hawk makes a deal with "Hotel Queen" Zoe Jonald: a fake marriage. Zoe thinks it’s just business… until she uncovers the secret Raymond has kept for ten years. When their contract ends and she tries to walk away, he makes it clear their arrangement is far from over. Now, a simple deal turns into a dangerous game of love, secrets, and a past that refuses to stay buried.
6948e4319d0ddf2a960b1c04.title: Married on Paper, Claimed for Life

694910830d4fda7998038ecd.synopsis: Once the formidable underground king of the Northeast Provinces, Linden Holt has traded his notorious past for a quiet life as a butcher. But when the young thugs demand protection money, his loyal lieutenant, Dominic Walden, arrives just in time with a team of bodyguards to send a clear message. Linden confides that his retirement was meant to provide a stable life for his son, Felix. However, a sudden call reveals that Felix has landed in hot water. Will the retired kingpin be forced to re-enter the fray and reclaim his throne to protect his family?
694910830d4fda7998038ecd.title: Dad Was a Street King

6949fb14eac1be121b0cf6a1.synopsis: When Sheila Collin comes to visit her billionaire brother Nathan Collin, his fiancée Megan mistakes her for a poor nobody and unleashes torrents of abuse. Little does Megan know, Sheila is the real big boss of the Collins Group. At a lavish birthday gala, the truth unravels, sealing the arrogant fiancée's fate.
6949fb14eac1be121b0cf6a1.title: Don’t Mess With Her

6949fb5b1f537d4e930d3542.synopsis: Leo, the prodigious heir of the Divine Healer, descends from the mountains to find his engagement abruptly canceled by his fiancée, Isabelle, who dismisses him as a mere country boy and relegates him to the morgue. To everyone's astonishment, Leo revives the CEO, Eleanor, in the morgue, leaving the entire hospital in awe. With his unparalleled medical and martial arts prowess, Leo swiftly carves out a remarkable reputation in the city, navigating complex relationships with Isabelle, Eleanor, and other intriguing women.
6949fb5b1f537d4e930d3542.title: The Healer’s Romance

6949fbe9394c02d17000fac1.synopsis: Legendary pilot Hilary Archer awakens decades in the future—trapped in the body of a 9-year-old girl, Naomi. On a turbulent Zenith Air flight, a catastrophic engine failure leaves the crew incapacitated. As the plane plummets and panic erupts, only Naomi remembers how to fly. Dismissed as a scared child, she must reclaim her past-life skills, battle passenger disbelief, and defy a raging storm to perform an impossible landing and save everyone on board.
6949fbe9394c02d17000fac1.title: Reborn as a Genius Pilot

694a5e0212fdc2623f00fbbd.synopsis: Nora, after three lifetimes of failed attempts to change the Prime Minister's household, encounters an apocalyptic warrior destined for an animal reincarnation. She boldly offers her place to the warrior. As the new Nora takes charge, she swiftly reshapes the household by punishing the corrupt servants and hateful siblings. As the two Noras join forces, what kind of explosive drama awaits?
694a5e0212fdc2623f00fbbd.title: The Heiress of Blood

694a5e2badfd9f446d026959.synopsis: Originally Urania, a celestial goddess, Seraphina is thrust into the modern world as a Morrow heiress after a failed breakthrough. To reclaim her divine status, she must complete the unfinished business of her mortal counterpart. Upon returning to the Morrow family, she is enraged to find her parents being humiliated and swiftly takes a stand, showing no mercy.
694a5e2badfd9f446d026959.title: Not Your Ordinary Heiress—She’s a Goddess

694a7051cfaa1f0d7e00d662.synopsis: In CEO and the Country Girl movie, when her sister betrays her and a ruthless CEO targets her family farm, fiery small-town cowgirl Avery Rogers clashes—and sparks—with Tyler Sinclair, the corporate heir sent to take her land.
