69c0a237f86334e9ff0acfd6.synopsis: In The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride movie, for five years, Alexis poured her entire heart into Ryder Kane—the golden boy of the racing world. She thought they were building a future together. But on the day she planned to propose, she learned the truth: Ryder never saw her as a partner. Just a placeholder. A “practice girlfriend.” Shattered, Alexis accepts an unexpected proposal from billionaire Everett Hale—and cuts Ryder out of her life for good. Now Ryder is forced to face the fallout. Will he let her walk away… or will losing her push him into a spiral of obsession, regret, and the fight of his life?
69c0a237f86334e9ff0acfd6.title: The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride

69c0a24ec1a92e4f5603fd9f.synopsis: On their wedding night, the CEO of the Walker Group, Griffin Walker, is tied up to a chair and forced to witness his wife Isabella cheat on him with three men at the same time. Enraged, he seeks revenge, but Isabella stops him in his tracks with a single photograph. For the next eighteen years, Griffin willingly raises Isabella's twins - a boy and a girl - born from her and one of those men, Ethan. He endures humiliation and mockery from them and is forced to transfer his company and all assets to the twins when they turn eighteen. Everyone thinks Griffin is held captive by that single photo, but at the moment Isabella's family celebrates their triumph, Griffin finally reveals the truth...
69c0a24ec1a92e4f5603fd9f.title: The Photo that Changed Everything

69c0a262b5d57818100485ef.synopsis: In Hating and Loving My Adopted Brother movie, after Abigail's parents both die in an accident, she gets adopted by her dad's friend. She transfers to a new high school and clashes with Chris, who acts like a total selfish prick — only to discover that he's her new adopted brother! Living under the same roof, she falls for him... but does he like her back?
69c0a262b5d57818100485ef.title: Hating and Loving My Adopted Brother

69c0a298c87f09a7e10d8ffe.synopsis: Hannah gave up everything for her fiancé, only to be brutally betrayed and abandoned in the States. Desperate to stay, she flash-married Alex, the "street thug" she accidentally saved with a single kiss during his escape. Passion ignites as Alex shields her from her vengeful ex and every threat. As their new life unfolds, Hannah starts to realize Alex might be more than just a street stranger...
69c0a298c87f09a7e10d8ffe.title: Married The Mafioso I Saved

69c0a2a5f468bb5e37047f72.synopsis: In The Comeback Play movie, once a legendary player, a disgraced alcoholic starts coaching his estranged son’s underdog NBA team, determined to prove to his haters that he can save the team and still be the God of Ball.
69c0a2a5f468bb5e37047f72.title: The Comeback Play

69c0a2b3f2e814722a05379e.synopsis: Ella fell in love with Holden, the Alpha of the High Mountain Wolf Clan, when they were children after he promised to protect her. Due to a witch's prophecy about destined mates, she became his Luna. However, Holden mistakenly thought she married him just to be Luna, so he grew to hate her. Due to the scheming of Ivy, Holden's childhood sweetheart, Ella thinks they're romantically involved and overhears Holden's plan to abort Ella's unborn child. She divorces him and leaves with the baby, then reuniting with her own clan, the Silver Snow Clan, and learns she's their long-lost princess.
69c0a2b3f2e814722a05379e.title: Divorce Tears from the Alpha, but I Shine Alone

69c0a2c0679a90fdc80d4ec2.synopsis: In Lucifer's Bride movie, the King of Hell, Lucifer, hides his true identity and comes to the human world in search of the girl who keeps appearing in his dreams. He unexpectedly saves Angela from mortal danger, only to be forced to leave. When he returns, Lucifer realizes Angela is the one he’s been searching for—but she is once again facing a life-or-death crisis. Unable to use his magic powers, can Lucifer overcome escalating threats and protect her?
69c0a2c0679a90fdc80d4ec2.title: Lucifer's Bride

69c0a327d4ec88728c059554.synopsis: Family outcast Ella Davenport's father arranges for her to marry a scumbag, but when she shows up to sign the papers, she realizes she's already married. And this mystery hubby isn't just anyone - it's smoking-hot CEO Cole McBride! Cole refuses to believe that they're really married, but with his aging grandmother taking an instant liking to Ella, getting rid of her might prove harder than he thought. Can this accidental couple take the unlikely path from mystery marriage to real love??
69c0a327d4ec88728c059554.title: My Double Proxy Marriage to a Billionaire

69c0a33b8189b0616e0020e1.synopsis: In Silicon God Strikes Back movie, Leon is a genius engineer who has a special knack for creating computer chips. His life was perfect – great job, loving wife – until one day, his family doctor informs him that his wife has stage four cancer! Leon does everything he can to save her, but soon realizes that his wife isn't who he thought she was. He decides to change his entire life. He's ready to prove that his talents can dominate the tech world.
69c0a33b8189b0616e0020e1.title: Silicon God Strikes Back

69c0a350789b84f50b0c232c.synopsis: In She's Not Homeless She's Healer Goddess movie, Everyone accuses Trixie of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Lysander Armstrong! (And win his heart too)
69c0a350789b84f50b0c232c.title: She's Not Homeless, She's Healer Goddess!

69c0a362451b1ea26300fc5f.synopsis: After Romeo Costa ruins Dallas Townsend's reputation at the debutante ball and forces her into a marriage, Dallas makes a new plan: seduce him, break his rule, and get the family she’s always dreamed of. But Romeo is not easy to break. And Dallas isn't the type of girl to give up.
69c0a362451b1ea26300fc5f.title: My Dark Romeo

69c0a5c18b8c069eb70b4a31.synopsis: Art world mogul Jeremy Finch concealed his identity to pave the way for his fiancée Crystal Klein's career. However, she used sexy painting with the wandering artist Collin Dupont to hold an art exhibition. Jeremy went to the scene and wrecked it completely. When Crystal arrived, she chose to trash Jeremy rather than blame Collin. Jeremy finally realized that she never cared about him. He finally decided to give up on this relationship.
69c0a5c18b8c069eb70b4a31.title: Love Beyond the Canvas

69c0a6ed8296dce39103665f.synopsis: Iris, a rich CEO's wife, harbored regrets for never meeting her biological parents. Upon receiving news of her mom, she took her daughter Eva back to reunite with them. However, the fake daughter Sophie and her brother Lawrence mocked Iris for being crude. At the family dinner, Sophie bragged about her daughter Clara's competition awards, but she didn't know Iris's daughter was a genius. Later, Sophie framed Eva of stealing, and Iris's mom just said Iris was only her goddaughter. Iris felt utterly disappointed. Then her billionaire husband came...
69c0a6ed8296dce39103665f.title: Fake Daughter, Real Heiress

69c0b23fe648744cc70abcb5.synopsis: Natalie Summers was a doctor of traditional medicine—until she woke up as the most useless princess in the realm. She wanted a quiet life. Instead, she found her fiancé tangled up with her scheming half-sister. She tried to coast. The world forced her to become the top scholar. She thought about keeping a handsome companion. He turned out to be a spy. She looked for a powerful patron to lean on. Instead, she ended up tricked into marriage with a prince who answered to no one. She tried to do nothing. Fate made her an empress.
69c0b23fe648744cc70abcb5.title: They Pushed Me to Be Empress

69c1108b0dba61bc200e9065.synopsis: Reborn a week before the apocalypse, Ethan Cross binds the Omni-Loot System—absorbing stats from every creature he kills. From underground arenas to doomsday chaos, he rises fast: claiming mythical artifacts, outsmarting rival factions, and leveling up with every battle.
69c1108b0dba61bc200e9065.title: Doomsday Looter: Stats and Beauties

69c110900dba61bc200e906d.synopsis: Mason Vale 's new life begins as a flea—until he unlocks an infinite evolution system. Contracted to the most popular girl in school, he's mocked as useless. But with each drop of her blood, he evolves: from pest, to predator, to planet-shattering beast. Time to shut everyone up.
69c110900dba61bc200e906d.title: Flea to Fearsome

69c110920dba61bc200e906f.synopsis: Reborn two hours before the zombie apocalypse, Alex Carter remembers everything—and refuses to fail again. Gathering allies, stockpiling weapons, and building a base, he becomes the ultimate protector.
69c110920dba61bc200e906f.title: Apocalypse Reborn: Leveling Up My Family

69c12378a443620f8e030532.synopsis: In Her Final Bet movie, Scarlett Spades, a seemingly ordinary housewife, is secretly the last heir of the murdered Gambling King, forced into hiding since her family was wiped out. When her devoted husband is framed by a rigged casino and driven to the edge, Scarlett is dragged back into the underworld she swore to abandon. Playing the naïve "lucky girl", she seduces cheaters into arrogance and destroys them with impossible wins—until her revenge awakens the true mastermind behind her parents' deaths, and one final bet demands blood, love, even her life...
69c12378a443620f8e030532.title: Her Final Bet

69c239a8772ad41e3d0eed17.synopsis: Fletcher Ward, honoring his master's last wish, blinded himself and destroyed his spiritual core to guard the tomb for five years. However, it was actually a test. Serena Horton came to break off their engagement, and his junior sister, along with a sect disciple, took the opportunity to steal his Divine Bone and push him off a cliff. At that moment, Fletcher completed the test, underwent a transformation, and resolved to participate in the Seven Divisions assessment to return to the sect!
69c239a8772ad41e3d0eed17.title: The Line: Savior or Destroyer

69c23ebb5f4fcb025b077126.synopsis: Clara, secret heiress to the Solarian Empire's richest man, teaches in a remote mountain village under a hidden identity. After she disciplines a spoiled student who happens to be her father's fiancée Vanessa's son, Vanessa storms in and publicly humiliates her. Only later does she learn the truth: the "poor teacher" she hurt is the tycoon's only daughter. By then, regret comes too late.
69c23ebb5f4fcb025b077126.title: The Heiress They Tried to Break

69c23f5368325d2264072f05.synopsis: A serving of street‑market food. A security guard named Ethan Carter. A chance encounter with Grace Harrington, CEO of the Uleah Group. Then came the freak electrical accident—and the dormant cultivation power passed down from his grandfather Frederick Whitaker roared awake. Now Ethan doesn't bow to the Whitakers. He doesn't kneel to the Harringtons. Names, titles, legacies—none of it matters. There's only one law he answers to: strength. His fists? They're the final argument.
69c23f5368325d2264072f05.title: The Invisible Bodyguard

69c33cc521e71f8b180e4a9d.synopsis: Ryan Carter was a billionaire—until he woke up as a high school nobody. Everyone still sees him as the clumsy kid crushing on the class queen, Olivia. But Ryan doesn't care about old reputations. He has one goal this time: save Grace Sinclair, the girl he lost to a fatal disease in his past life. While building a fortune, he'll rewrite the future, protect her at all costs, and finally win the love that slipped away. This life, he's playing for keeps.
69c33cc521e71f8b180e4a9d.title: I Came Back for You

69c33d05cccf9b134e0158a8.synopsis: Ryan Carter was a billionaire—until he woke up as a high school nobody. Everyone still sees him as the clumsy kid crushing on the class queen, Olivia. But Ryan doesn't care about old reputations. He has one goal this time: save Grace Sinclair, the girl he lost to a fatal disease in his past life. While building a fortune, he'll rewrite the future, protect her at all costs, and finally win the love that slipped away. This life, he's playing for keeps.
69c33d05cccf9b134e0158a8.title: I Came Back for You

69c33d18f133e8d8940a40d0.synopsis: Chasing a better future, she ends a seven-year relationship and leaves Milo to face his mother's cancer and mounting debt alone. What she doesn't realize is that the business simulation game Milo mastered is turning real, along with the vast empire and fortune that come with it. She thought she was shedding dead weight. Instead, she walked away from a kingdom she'll never reach again.
69c33d18f133e8d8940a40d0.title: The Cost of Betrayal

69c33df9586fba0a790b83d4.synopsis: Evan Collins gets fired and loses his year-end bonus just before the holidays because a heroic act made him late. Jobless and pressured by his parents to marry, he hits rock bottom—until a daughter suddenly appears at his doorstep. She grants him the superpower to see the true value and origin of anything. Now, Evan Collins wins the lottery, uncovers priceless jade, puts arrogant blind dates in their place, and wins the girl. This year, he's having the best New Year ever!
69c33df9586fba0a790b83d4.title: My Lucky Star Daughter

69c33e58e9114074500a9a56.synopsis: Logan Ward runs a small shop. Unremarkable. Just an ordinary man with an ordinary life. Except the wooden carvings he casually whittles can manifest into towering divine forms. The doodles he tosses in the trash can grant mortals instant ascension. The stray dog he feeds could swallow the sun and moon. Even the loach he boils on a whim could pass for a dragon lord of the four seas. But, he has no idea...
69c33e58e9114074500a9a56.title: Above All Limits

69c3d947e91c4aa4220f15fc.synopsis: After a life of betrayal, Natalie Lawson wakes up on the day her husband Dylan Mercer asks to marry her stepsister Chloe. Instead of fighting, she walks away. She leaves for Myana, a lawless land, to rebuild her late father's empire. There, she finds an unexpected ally—Vincent Hawkins, a powerful commander bound to her family by an old debt. Together, they rise. When Natalie finally stands at the top, Dylan realizes what he lost. But this time, she's not looking back.
69c3d947e91c4aa4220f15fc.title: She Let Go, He Lost All

69c4970606f3f30fb509989f.synopsis: Reborn, he awakens as an SSSS National Fortune Builder. The Great Wall, Godslay Swords, and ancient gods all answer his call. With millions of souls behind him, one strike decides humanity's fate.
69c4970606f3f30fb509989f.title: Fortune Builder: The Nation Levels Me Up

69c4ab9dc8c4ce838d0ebabb.synopsis: Banished from the Celestial Court, Destiny must grant her destined mortal's deepest wish to return to heaven. She lands beside Naomi, a powerful CEO, and awakens the ability to read minds. With magic and mischief, she helps defeat corporate rivals and protect Naomi. After completing her trial, Destiny ascends only to return, drawn back to the family she found on earth.
69c4ab9dc8c4ce838d0ebabb.title: Heaven Sent

69c4abe9643ef48c6c0df8c5.synopsis: Calvin Lane descends from the mountains to honor a childhood pact—only to have his promised bride burn the contract. After saving the patriarch of the Hayes family, Calvin finds himself bound to the cold heiress Tessa Hayes. But as dark forces from his master's past resurface, Calvin learns his own bloodline hides a truth that threatens everything.
69c4abe9643ef48c6c0df8c5.title: Born to Heal, Built to Reveal

69c4ac67fc1ac60211043cfe.synopsis: Asher Vale, CEO of the Vale Group and a fishing enthusiast, never expected his own life to end in water. Betrayed by his wife Talia and her scheming friend Blaine, he was drowned in a lake—only to wake up as a fish. But death was not the end. The Human Shock System activated within him: every time he shocks someone, he gains evolution points. Meanwhile, the Grand Fleet is closing in on Arcton, and Talia and Blaine are racing to seize Asher's inheritance. What they don't know is that Asher—now watching from the water—has just unlocked a mission: revenge, and more importantly, save his parents.
69c4ac67fc1ac60211043cfe.title: Reborn as a Fish, I Fought Back

69c4ca564db287da4b035e4a.synopsis: Cael Ashworth spent five years on Azure Star pretending to be blind, secretly mastering the powers of the legendary Blind Swordsman through his Roleplay ability. When the Forbidden Zone opens and every nation sends a champion into a live-streamed death match where the spoils manifest at 100x scale, Cael gets drafted for Dragonland. Now the whole world is watching a "blind nobody" fight for a nation's survival, and they have no idea what's coming.
69c4ca564db287da4b035e4a.title: Saving My Country as the Blind Swordsman

69c4ee622562c633460f52bb.synopsis: In Banish Me Bury Your Empire movie, he held the border for a hundred years. She threw him away like trash. The day he left, her empire burned.
69c4ee622562c633460f52bb.title: Banish Me? Bury Your Empire

69c588478f4cedad8805dfbf.synopsis: Seth Edeen returns to the ice in this exciting episode of ReelTalk Backstage. Follow along as he takes us inside his new show Pucked in the Friend Zone, showing how he prepares for game day and what it really takes to suit up for hockey. His co-stars also dish on why hockey players are so irresistible and share behind the scenes tea from set. Catch all the action now!
69c588478f4cedad8805dfbf.title: ReelTalk EP 67-Backstage: Pucked in the Friend Zone

69c5e8db74fdaf823e045405.synopsis: Cast out by his family, James Carter runs an AnoMart in the apocalypse. His employees are S-Level Creatures. His business model is based on capitalism. Between fending off rival bases, dodging assassination attempts, and managing a staff of literal monsters who somehow follow his rules, James builds a commercial empire that might just save humanity, if Anomaly Lord doesn’t destroy the planet first.
69c5e8db74fdaf823e045405.title: AnoMart: Rules of the Wasteland

69c618fc2ce83ba04c099be5.synopsis: To find a good wife for his son Ivan, the richest man, Richard Lee, hides his identity and has Ivan work as a deliveryman. Little does he know, after six years of battles, Ivan has become the foremost of the four great vassal lords, known as Prince Redflame, and has also hidden his identity. As New Year's Eve approaches, at Richard's request, Ivan brings Lillian Hades home for the holiday, unaware that Lillian, the governor's daughter, is already preparing for a wedding with the Wilder family. At this moment, Jason Wilder arrives to confront them.
69c618fc2ce83ba04c099be5.title: The Delivery King

69c62cbed2944e2f97045de2.synopsis: Office worker Elias York wakes up in a matriarchal world as the Grand General's son, only to be framed before a political marriage. His mother Diana York is jailed, his family ruined, and the Empress humiliates him by marrying him off to five convicts. But Elias awakens the Shock System: the more people he shocks, the more Shock Points he earns for gear and rewards. Will he survive in a world of matriarchy?
69c62cbed2944e2f97045de2.title: Wrong Time, Right System

69c66c0c03e82c80ed093e46.synopsis: In My Secret Lover Is His Brother movie, to forgive Piper's family debt, she's promised to marry one of the Bellfort brothers. Will she choose the star lacrosse player Drew? Or the handsome loner Noah? How can she decide when she has a connection with both?
69c66c0c03e82c80ed093e46.title: My Secret Lover Is His Brother

69c855f282da40c1a4016859.synopsis: Journee, a modern forensic examiner, suddenly wakes up as the Seventh Princess Consort of the Solarian Kingdom. Her husband, Prince Liam, is rumored to be ruthless and cursed. With only the Dimensional Nexus System to guide her, she must raise his intimacy and clear his long-buried wrongful case to return home. She focuses on the mission, but Liam's growing attention may turn her carefully planned escape into something far more dangerous.
69c855f282da40c1a4016859.title: Trapped with the Cruel Prince

69c9e193595a6d5dd609dea5.synopsis: Reborn in the body of a youth with no awakened skill, Evan Collins rises from humiliation to lead his team to a World Cup berth. When the Decem Court kidnaps his sister, he faces the Dreadwyrm in a decisive soccer duel.
69c9e193595a6d5dd609dea5.title: World Cup with 11 Beauties

69c9e195595a6d5dd609dea7.synopsis: A university student with superhuman hearing, Flynn Lowell escapes a brutal mining town and rises to Arkdiff City. Partnering with Charlotte Warren, he conquers the stock market, real estate, and rivals like the Croft family. From defending Star Harbor to building the world's tallest skyscraper, he transforms from a poor miner into a billionaire tycoon, shaping an era and fueling a nation's technological future.
69c9e195595a6d5dd609dea7.title: Back to '90s: From Miner to Billionaire

69c9e19a595a6d5dd609deaf.synopsis: Liam Gray died once after being betrayed and watching his sister die. Now he wakes up three days before the apocalypse with a second chance. He's done playing by anyone else's rules. He masters Zombie Transformation to become the Red Terror Zombie, a nightmare that the apocalypse fears. He hunts down his enemies, tames high-level zombies, and seizes control of the end-times to rebuild order and protect those he loves.
69c9e19a595a6d5dd609deaf.title: Apocalypse Game: Mess with Red, Get Dead

69c9e4c7295373c72e025fa0.synopsis: To escape the pressure of marriage, Vonny accidentally crosses paths with Jay, a young man from the countryside hiding his true family background and they decide to enter into a fake relationship. Jay has no idea that Vonny is actually the Executive Director of his company until he is reassigned as her assistant. As their families begin to meddle, Jay's true identity is slowly revealed and the story really starts to heat up.
69c9e4c7295373c72e025fa0.title: New Year with My Pretty Boss

69cb049f09f7ccfc8506736c.synopsis: Nadia Mercer never saw death coming from the people she loved most. Betrayed by her husband Brandon and her best friend Marnie, she was drugged, locked inside a shipping container, and cast into the open sea—pregnant and left to die. But a kick from within changed everything. Fighting for two, she endured the impossible. Now Nadia is back. She walks into Brandon and Marnie's wedding—not to congratulate them, but to destroy them!
69cb049f09f7ccfc8506736c.title: Born at Sea, Born for Revenge

69cc7dfd6f3ec598700a7b00.synopsis: Reborn as the most hated woman in a beast world, Selene must seduce six commanders who despise her or die. She just wants to rack up points and disappear. But the Wolf loses control. The Elk goes feral. The Eagle melts. The Lynx won't let go. Now all six are at her door, eyes bloodshot. "You think you can play with our feelings and leave?"
69cc7dfd6f3ec598700a7b00.title: Otome System Activated: Driving the Galaxy Wild

69cc80aee1ea79a0310e832b.synopsis: Campus belle Brooke snuggles close, petite cutie Paige innocently flirts, and Dr. Tessa turns up the heat! As the apocalypse cycles between The Scorching and The Eternal Night, Vaughn thrives using his Goddess Roommate System. He builds an AC fortress and throws hot pot parties. Villains begging for supplies? He zaps them with lightning! Hoarding resources, superpowers, and goddesses, Vaughn dominates the wasteland in style!
69cc80aee1ea79a0310e832b.title: Doomsday Grad: Trillionaire Tycoon

69cc80bae1ea79a0310e833d.synopsis: Zombies swarm the city. A haunted Ordinary Guy awakens the power to command goddesses in Mutation combat. They must fight to survive and uncover the truth of his origins.
69cc80bae1ea79a0310e833d.title: Creating an Otherworld Valkyrie

69cc80cae1ea79a0310e8357.synopsis: Caleb Wright, a Heavenly Sovereign with 600 years of cultivation, failed his Tribulation Transcendence. Reborn on Earth with the supreme Empyrean Godstone, he seeks vengeance for his ruined family and dead wife. His vow for all past grievances: In my current life, blood will be paid with blood! Watch him crush elite families and wipe out ancient sects with a snap of his fingers. Wealth, women, and power are his for the taking as he stages an epic comeback against all odds!
69cc80cae1ea79a0310e8357.title: Return of the Urban Ascendant King

69cc80cbe1ea79a0310e8359.synopsis: In a mutant beast apocalypse, a blind youth tames deadly Triple-S beasts with nursery rhymes, believing he is just tending to the weak and disabled in his Sanctuary. This sweet illusion risks exposure only with enemies at the gates.
69cc80cbe1ea79a0310e8359.title: Apocalypse: The Sanctuary is Full of Triple-S Beasts

69cc80cee1ea79a0310e835d.synopsis: Arthur Thorne lost everything and died tragically with Mia. Reborn, he dumps his toxic ex and enters the game The Genesis Rule with Mia! He vows to reach the top, slay gods, and become the invincible Mage. With forbidden spells as a basic attack, an infinite mana bar, and endless healing, even the GM is panicking! Arthur Thorne is way too overpowered this time!
69cc80cee1ea79a0310e835d.title: Mage Exploit: My Mana Bar is Infinite

69cc80d3e1ea79a0310e8365.synopsis: In a collapsed post-apocalyptic world, Callan Reed is betrayed, robbed of his SSS-tier Dream Whisperer gift by Starlace City’s heir Gavin Voss, then left to die in the Frostlands. But he awakens Hope Haven, a system-powered sanctuary. In just one year, he builds it into an impenetrable utopia with energy shields, plasma weapons, super farms, and tamed beasts. When enemies invade, Callan unleashes the full power of his haven and stuns the wasteland.
69cc80d3e1ea79a0310e8365.title: Hope Haven: Doomsday Utopia

69ccb20ba27eff94a50716b5.synopsis: A man is transported into Leo Smith, the son of a general in the Empire of Flame. In just three days, his entire family is set to be executed. At the height of his desperation, the system redirects his objective to Layla Sanchez, his former fiancée, only for him to discover that her affection is already maxed out. In the end, Leo uses modern weapons from the system store to seize the capital, overthrow the emperor, and claim the throne for himself.
69ccb20ba27eff94a50716b5.title: Three Years as a Simp to Activate the System

69ccb20fa27eff94a50716bb.synopsis: Reborn before a doomed polar expedition, Madeline tried to warn about ice worm massacre. With only Owen trusting her, betrayal and chaos consumed the team. Armed with the Stone of Silence, she survived as the traitors fall, finding a new beginning with Owen.
69ccb20fa27eff94a50716bb.title: Glacial Swarm

69cd07b53166c53b880a9bab.synopsis: Abandoned by his fiancée and exiled by his sect, Adrian Vale awakens the Abyssal Serpent, a spirit beast mocked by all as worthless. Bound by blood, they evolve and rise, becoming a terror the world has never seen. In the final battle, Adrian merges with the serpent, ascending as the Dragon Emperor to shatter the old order and forge a world where all beings stand as equals.
69cd07b53166c53b880a9bab.title: The Rise of the Beast Monarch

69cdd2c078e31913330cf339.synopsis: After being abandoned by his fiancée and exiled from his sect, Adrian Vale awakened the Abyssal Serpent—a spirit beast dismissed as worthless by all. Bound by a blood pact, he and the serpent evolved together. They consumed. They rose. They became something the world had never seen. In the final battle, Adrian merged with the serpent and ascended as the Dragon Emperor. He shattered the false gods, tore down the old order, and rewrote the rules of existence—so that all beings, great or small, could stand as equals.
69cdd2c078e31913330cf339.title: Beast Monarch Rising

69cdd3455621cabbba074d8f.synopsis: Reborn before a doomed polar expedition, Madeline tries to warn about ice worm massacre. With only Owen trusting her, betrayal and chaos consume the team. Armed with the Stone of Silence, she survives as her traitors fall, finding a new beginning with Owen.
69cdd3455621cabbba074d8f.title: Glacial Swarm

69ce415907eda6f231015eb5.synopsis: She stepped back to support her husband's rise, then he cheated, his mistress attacked, and her daughter nearly died. Now this queen is done playing nice. She's freezing his power, exposing their crimes, and taking back everything—one ruthless move at a time.
69ce415907eda6f231015eb5.title: Queen's Gambit

69ce416cf82e624bc200b94f.synopsis: I died once because I trusted the wrong man. Never again. At the auction that destroyed me last time, I humiliate my rival, buy a "worthless" mega-project for billions, and suddenly—a dark, powerful stranger offers me eighty billion like it's nothing. He says he's loved me for two lifetimes. I say: prove it.
69ce416cf82e624bc200b94f.title: Reborn for My Mr. Right

69cebf23cd56b63d7c0063c9.synopsis: We’re reuniting the stars of Wrong! and How to Break a DILF for an episode that will keep you spinning. Richard Trotter and Miah Green take on a playful game of Spin the Bottle with a Truth or Dare twist. From first kisses to first impressions, they reveal what they're really like off-camera, who’s got the best word on beat skills, and maybe even show off a little pole dancing.
69cebf23cd56b63d7c0063c9.title: ReelTalk EP 68-Richard & Miah Play Spin the Bottle

69cf19bdb14ad648350d2e5f.synopsis: Claire witnessed her husband Julian's abnormal relationship with 50-year-old nanny Debbie in her previous life, and was tragically killed by Julian, his mother-in-law Barbara, and the nanny. After rebirth, she returned to the time before the tragedy, no longer weak and crying, but calmly plotting her revenge. Claire made Julian and the nanny embarrass themselves in public. She also exposed the shocking scandal that the nanny was carrying her father-in-law's baby. She tried to reclaim her assets, sending the bad people to their doom, and ultimately breaking free from the nightmare life.
69cf19bdb14ad648350d2e5f.title: My Husband Cheated on Me With His Dad's Mistress

69cf7a7fad56d70a480cea8f.synopsis: They thought she was just another spoiled rich girl coming home to marry her fiancé, but they were dead wrong. That's when she found out what he did to her sister. After ten years of secret training, she didn't scream or cry. Instead, she struck. She doesn't call the police because she calls the shots. Bones break, blood spills, and empires crumble. Now everyone wants her head, but too bad for them — she wants their throats.
69cf7a7fad56d70a480cea8f.title: Home for Blood

69cf7b1b1f58e9cb600b7ce2.synopsis: Riley marries Simon Lewis to save her brother and treat her first love, but becomes a tool in a marriage filled with neglect. When Simon's ex, Sarah, returns, Riley plans to divorce and start her own business. She turns every challenge into an opportunity while outsmarting her rival and Simon's schemes. As Simon's feelings shift from indifference to obsession, Riley stays focused on her goal: independence and control over her life, no matter what he wants.
69cf7b1b1f58e9cb600b7ce2.title: Checkmate, Mr. CEO

69cf7c2dfc20163d170cc0cc.synopsis: Jack Lewis is a construction worker. On the day of his girlfriend's graduation, he buys a ring to propose—but she suddenly has a change of heart and gets engaged to his best friend instead. Amara Green, the president of the Green Group, happens to witness the entire scene. Moved by Jack's kindness and genuine heart, she decides to enter into a flash marriage with him.
69cf7c2dfc20163d170cc0cc.title: Dirt & Diamonds

69cfeb5a0b83f67ab101d8f1.synopsis: After courting Kira Lawson for seven years, Eli Bennett becomes a laughingstock on their wedding day when her first love, Trent, steals her away. In despair, Eli awakens the Anti-Simp System, which rewards him for not being a pushover. He immediately cancels the wedding and has a flash marriage with Nina Quinn, who is disguised as a cleaner. Little does he know, she's a billionaire heiress!
69cfeb5a0b83f67ab101d8f1.title: Anti-Simp System: Loved by the Heiress

69d466cc4079cd50aa0bce4b.synopsis: A ten‑year‑old boy falls into a zombie world and discovers his secret weapon: nepotism. The S‑class Head Nurse is his aunt. The Red‑Clad Woman, Bronze Coffin Bride, and Nether King are all family. With his undead relatives backing him up, dungeons are just family gatherings. He ends up king of two worlds. Who needs fighting when you have family?
69d466cc4079cd50aa0bce4b.title: Nepo Zombie: My Relatives Run Every Dungeon

69d499e0b76bb5cec60a94a5.synopsis: Skye, Marchioness of Everford, devoted her life to managing her estate, only to be betrayed and killed by the very children she raised. On the brink of death, she discovers the shocking truth: the heirs she loved were not her own, while her true-born children suffer in silence. Reborn on the night before her murder, Skye awakens with crystal-clear clarity and a plan for ruthless revenge.
69d499e0b76bb5cec60a94a5.title: Revenge Before Dawn

69d4a0ca8f717f6a440e7444.synopsis: A man is transported into Leo Smith, the son of a general in the Empire of Flame. In just three days, his entire family is set to be executed. At the height of his desperation, the system redirects his objective to Layla Sanchez, his former fiancée, only for him to discover that her affection is already maxed out. In the end, Leo uses modern weapons from the system store to seize the capital, overthrow the emperor, and claim the throne for himself.
69d4a0ca8f717f6a440e7444.title: Three Years as a Simp to Activate the System

69d4a8ace6759de8e00da63d.synopsis: He held the border for a hundred years. She threw him away like trash. The day he left, her empire burned.
69d4a8ace6759de8e00da63d.title: Banish Me? Bury Your Empire

69d4a8ec6e4c0b24090de738.synopsis: Reborn, he awakens as an SSSS National Fortune Builder. The Great Wall, Godslay Swords, and ancient gods all answer his call. With millions of souls behind him, one strike decides humanity's fate.
69d4a8ec6e4c0b24090de738.title: Fortune Builder: The Nation Levels Me Up

69d4aabe6a0c73fc890d539d.synopsis: Reborn in the body of a youth with no awakened skill, Evan Collins rises from humiliation to lead his team to a World Cup berth. When the Decem Court kidnaps his sister, he faces the Dreadwyrm in a decisive soccer duel.
69d4aabe6a0c73fc890d539d.title: World Cup with 11 Beauties

69d4aba7627c71e6b50876e3.synopsis: A university student with superhuman hearing, Flynn Lowell escapes a brutal mining town and rises to Arkdiff City. Partnering with Charlotte Warren, he conquers the stock market, real estate, and rivals like the Croft family. From defending Star Harbor to building the world's tallest skyscraper, he transforms from a poor miner into a billionaire tycoon, shaping an era and fueling a nation's technological future.
69d4aba7627c71e6b50876e3.title: Back to '90s: From Miner to Billionaire

69d4b027f96739d60e009c2b.synopsis: On a snowy night in Northhaven, Sarah is abandoned by her first love, Sean, and reluctantly marries Simon, who has secretly loved her for over a decade. After four years of a cold marriage, with her ex returning, family pressure, and rumors swirling, Sarah discovers the truth: Simon's love for her was always real, and their marriage was his deep, unwavering devotion. As the truth comes to light, she runs into his arms, saying, "For the rest of my life, please guide me."
69d4b027f96739d60e009c2b.title: The Deceitful Marriage

69d4b0d05bc3fe10a10fcbf5.synopsis: Robert achieved great military achievements. The Emperor granted him the title of Lord Guardian of the Empire. Robert returned to his hometown with honor, but knew his sister had been assaulted by the county magistrate's son and his mom had been severely injured. He angrily punished the villains in court, and also exposed the shocking scheme of collusion between local officials and the powerful in the capital, as well as the embezzlement of compensation for those injured soldiers. He investigated this case, faced with the ruthless counterattack of the Empress's brother. Ultimately, he executed corrupt officials and brought justice to the fallen soldiers and their families.
69d4b0d05bc3fe10a10fcbf5.title: General's Wrath: The Fallen Corruption

69d4b101452902d5c60dbd7a.synopsis: Betrayed heiress is murdered by the fake daughter who stole her life. Reborn with a darkly hilarious system called Supreme Yoink. Their money? Yoink. Hers. Their secrets? Yoink. Exposed. And the fake daughter? Evidence straight to the police. Arrested.
69d4b101452902d5c60dbd7a.title: Take It All

69d5f56a1ffcf3fe490343c5.synopsis: Adrian, the deadliest hitman from Villains' Vale, descended from the mountains on a routine mission. But nothing was routine about finding Vivica—the Crime Lord's daughter—poisoned with a lust-inducing toxin. He saved her without a second thought. The Crime Lord was grateful. The reward? Vivica's hand in marriage. But Trenton, the most eligible bachelor of the underworld, had loved Vivica for years. Furious and humiliated, Trenton was dead-set a trap on destroying Adrian. To which, the hitman smiled, "Extermination it is."
69d5f56a1ffcf3fe490343c5.title: The Professional's Vow of Blood

69d7089ecbf23c60e409d039.synopsis: Ford Clark got kicked out by his family in the middle of an apocalypse, though he inherited a zombie‑filled fortress, Nine Dragons Walled City. Now he's the landlord, and the SSS-rank zombies pay rent in crystals. He builds an automated food plant, partners with psychics, destroys a cult, and fights the Zombie King, turning a hellhole into the last safe place on earth.
69d7089ecbf23c60e409d039.title: Rent or Rot: I'm the Landlord of the Apocalypse

69d708a8cbf23c60e409d049.synopsis: After his past life was ruined by women, Charles Gray only wants to stay away from them and cultivate in peace. But his system has other plans: marry or die. So he kidnaps a holy maiden, charms an ancient empress, and somehow ends up with a harem he never asked for. Along the way, he unlocks insane powers, a hundredfold return cheat, and a divine body that makes him irresistible. The catch? Every new wife might just drain him dry. He says he's not a playboy, but the system says otherwise.
69d708a8cbf23c60e409d049.title: Forced to Marry, Forced to Rule

69d74a79d711169d5107443c.synopsis: The Langley family regarded one of their twin girls Adela as a jinx due to the ignorant ancestral teachings of "twin sisters jinxing their father". Adela was almost suffocated at birth and later found as a drug guide and substitute for her twin sister Kelly. Adela was imprisoned and tortured for many years. When attending an appointment for her sister, Adela met Frank, who turned out to be the person she saved as a child. But Frank mistakenly identified Kelly as the savior. After the tragic death of Adela's nanny, Adela completely awakened and reached a deal with Frank to marry him and escape from the Langley family.
69d74a79d711169d5107443c.title: The Cursed Twin: Substitute Bride

69d7757a641e3b05c6023801.synopsis: Ryan Cole marries city girl Natalie Cole but neglects his seven-month pregnant wife for his widowed sister-in-law, causing her tragic death in childbirth. Revealing his greedy and sexist nature, Ryan abandons their sick daughter, steals Natalie's assets, and remarries. However, mother-in-law Claire Sutton sets a trap to make him pay, seeking justice and raising her granddaughter alone.
69d7757a641e3b05c6023801.title: You Can't Take Her Inheritance

69d83718ca7a94dcd706851b.synopsis: Step into the confessional. Sister Sarah is here to hear your secrets and offer her blessing. In this episode of ReelHotline, fans call in with their voicemail confessions, sharing their most guilty, messy, and surprising truths. Nothing is off limits and some of these sins might be a little juicier than expected. Will Sarah grant forgiveness or call them out?
69d83718ca7a94dcd706851b.title: ReelTalk EP 69-ReelHotline with Sarah

69d86537420d3f6dc7057c8e.synopsis: He could devour the dark. She could read his soul. When the Sanctum came to reclaim its monster, she fused her life into his heartbeat, and he chose a broken flashlight over the throne of a god.
69d86537420d3f6dc7057c8e.title: Sequence 001: The Wasteland's Secret

69d873e12a13839228075b49.synopsis: To outmaneuver her stepmother, Ella Swan, CEO of Swan Group, marries the handsome yet seemingly penniless Yates Lloyd to secure a 10% share from her grandfather. However, Ella soon notices something amiss. Isn't he a broke guy? But why is everyone bowing to him?
69d873e12a13839228075b49.title: Poor Husband, Hidden Tycoon

69d8b053bc346736a603e7fd.synopsis: After 50,000 years of cultivation, Ethan returned to Earth as a Divine Emperor—only to find that just five years had passed. Using immortal arts to rewind time, he witnessed everything: his wife, broken but unyielding, fighting to save their dying daughter; his mother, frail and forgotten, withering away; and his enemy, circling like a vulture, feeding on their pain. He didn't hesitate. He didn't forgive. One by one, he righted every wrong. And before the city even understood what had happened, Ethan wasn't just a returning cultivator anymore. He was the shadow that ran the city—whether they knew it or not.
69d8b053bc346736a603e7fd.title: After 50,000 Years, I Came Back to Earth

69d8bf5594c199cff7067074.synopsis: In the rural areas of the 1990s, David was intelligent but pretended to be dumb. He gave up the opportunity to go to school to his brother and sister, and helped his parents manage a pig farm at home. Due to his natural talent for pig raising, he received high praise from farmers in the village. Then he decided to go to the city to find his brother Caleb and sister Nina. Caleb and Nina were doing well in the city, but they criticized David for not doing his job properly and not taking care of their parents in the hometown. They looked down on David and thought he had no future...
69d8bf5594c199cff7067074.title: They Underestimated Me

69d918f2b996ba0ba60e8597.synopsis: After Nora's stepsister Bianca steals her AI-matched partner, Nora is forced to marry a janitor and becomes the laughingstock of her family. Little does she know that the janitor is the billionaire behind the AI matchmaking system, using their marriage to test her true feelings...
69d918f2b996ba0ba60e8597.title: The Janitor Billionaire & His Swapped Bride

69d91aac64eba2f58b0ac51c.synopsis: In Ace The Golf King's Reconquest movie, "Lion" was once the Grand Slam champion that ruled the world of golf. Devastated by the loss of his wife, he disappears to take care of their baby daughter at the peak of his career, leaving behind his insurmountable legacy. Hiding away as a gardener, "Lion" pulls weeds and mows the lawn at a golf club to make a living. Desperate to give his daughter a better life and pay for her tuition, "Lion" steps back on the golf course to reclaim his former glory! The roar of the mighty "Lion" will be heard around the world!
69d91aac64eba2f58b0ac51c.title: Ace! The Golf King's Reconquest

69d91abd6d72cb24d6089473.synopsis: Head over heels for Ethan Sutton, it-boy of Lowell Private Academy, Maddie Sinclair has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with heiress Vanessa Archibald, Madeline hatches a grand escape plan with Ethan's opportunistic mother. Will Ethan capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Rhys Wyndham, mysterious new bad boy from London end up sealing the deal before Maddie even boards the plane?
69d91abd6d72cb24d6089473.title: Private School Playboys

69d91acc42de055eb105ab81.synopsis: In Runaway Single Mom Safe in His Arms movie, single mom Maria escapes abuse and fights to protect her daughter, Judy. From factory struggles to elite schools, she faces enemies, family betrayal, and unexpected love. When billionaire Levi enters her life, everything changes...
69d91acc42de055eb105ab81.title: Runaway Single Mom, Safe in His Arms

69d91ada60fde4d6ec0efc04.synopsis: Ellie wants to be a world famous model, but no one'll give a chubby girl a chance. She has a one-night stand with fashion company CEO Eason, raising their son Lucas alone. Hoping to land a job as a model, she answers HALE Group's casting call only to discover that the boss interviewing is her baby daddy, Eason Hale himself!
69d91ada60fde4d6ec0efc04.title: XL Stands for Xtra Love

69d91ae716a9a0df82015651.synopsis: In Cyberking Reclaims His Throne movie, Max Lennox is the world's number one hacker, CYBERKING. Just when he's about to uncover the Pentagon's secrets and expose them to the world, he gets betrayed by his girlfriend, who shoves him off the roof! He miraculously survives, but loses all his memories... except for his genius hacking skills. He gets saved by a kind-hearted programmer, Suki Ruskin. Together, they try to get Max's memory back, hoping to figure out who did this to him. Will he ultimately reclaim his throne as The CYBERKING?
69d91ae716a9a0df82015651.title: Cyberking Reclaims His Throne

69d91af7ff2f5a4b160bb1e3.synopsis: The Sherwoods are the most respected witches in all of Witchingdom, and as heir it's Leona's duty to protect her family's ancient wand and enter an arranged marriage. But all her plans go up in pixie dust when she crosses paths with notorious bad-boy witch Erik Svensen... and ends up magically bound to him in an unbreakable marriage! To undo her mistake and preserve her family legacy, she must accompany Erik on a magic-filled road trip to get him to cast a divorce spell, but the longer she spends with her husband, the more she feels all her walls and duties come crashing down.
69d91af7ff2f5a4b160bb1e3.title: Head Witch in Charge

69d91b034e68ac09390185be.synopsis: In the End of the World, Start of My Empire movie, after World War III, Arthur Morgan is reduced to scraping by in the chaos, surviving on scavenged goods while being bullied and robbed by former high school classmates—until a chance discovery of alien technology changes everything. He rescues three women who become his wives and sets his sights on using this power to rise as the King of the Wasteland.
69d91b034e68ac09390185be.title: End of the World, Start of My Empire

69d91b111840476dfa0eba40.synopsis: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. After a devastating senior year of high school, Kennedy made two rules for herself. 1. No one will know she's related to her brother and 2. She will never fall for another one of her brother's rivals. When Shay Coleman barges into her life with his irritating and irresistable charm, she's treatened to break both of them...
69d91b111840476dfa0eba40.title: Hate to Love You

69d91b270f63b3f86a055321.synopsis: Believing that Celeste had indirectly caused his sister Gloria’s tragic death in prison, Byron let love curdle into hatred. For five years, he tortured Celeste’s body and soul—until the day he learned she was dead. Only then did regret set in.
69d91b270f63b3f86a055321.title: Don't Watch Me Waste Away

69d91b3ee15105112e0dc022.synopsis: Aria won Luca’s love in an arranged mafia marriage, but when she secretly helps her sister flee the life, she betrays him. With their families at war and a baby on the way, Aria must decide whether love can survive when loyalty is paid for in blood.
69d91b3ee15105112e0dc022.title: Bound by Love

69d91b64f25269180009b384.synopsis: In Djinn Under Contract Movie, Eli Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Eli freedom– but on one condition: Eli must marry his granddaughter, Christine Parrish, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Eli transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Eli starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. Then, when Christine's old flame reenters the picture, Eli's heart is completely shattered. Now, Eli is faced with a tough decision– should he stay by Christine's side once the final wish is granted, or is it time to for him to divorce Christine and finally live his own life?
69d91b64f25269180009b384.title: Djinn Under Contract

69d91b7760fde4d6ec0efc06.synopsis: In The Seduction Game movie, when a brilliant, dirt-poor teen earns a scholarship to an elite prep school, she becomes the target of a cruel queen bee and her bad-boy pawn who’s tasked with seducing and destroying her before Ivy League admissions are announced — but what no one expects is that the girl from the trailer is playing them all, and she might just take the crown, the scholarship… and his heart.
69d91b7760fde4d6ec0efc06.title: The Seduction Game

69d91b89a61a85c6f30a4e80.synopsis: Once enemies, now lovers, Rowan and Emma face new challenges as a couple: an heiress fiancée who'll stop at nothing to win Rowan over, an overbearing mother obsessed with the status quo, and Emma's own fears that she'll never fit into Rowan's world. Emma used to believe their hard-won love could triumph over their differences... but what if leaving Rowan is the right choice?
69d91b89a61a85c6f30a4e80.title: Taming My Bullies 2

69d91b958836620d0a0d5bdf.synopsis: The Master of Magic, Daniel Angier, went into hiding after losing his brother in a tragic casino heist gone wrong. But after reconnecting with a close friend of his brother’s, Daniel sets out to reclaim the title of the Master of Magic in order to save his childhood orphanage.
69d91b958836620d0a0d5bdf.title: Don't Blink, You'll Miss It

69d91bb436000f5c4603b71f.synopsis: In Falling for My Nemesis Stepbrother movie, Nicole has always been the good girl. While Kane, her stepbrother, is the opposite. To the world, he’s a dangerous bad boy. To Nicole, he’s the boy she never stopped loving. On the night of a deadly street race, Nicole runs into the road to stop Kane from destroying himself, while Kane fights feelings he knows he shouldn’t want.
69d91bb436000f5c4603b71f.title: Falling for My Nemesis Stepbrother

69d91bcb9f6094e9250565a5.synopsis: In the When Forever Fell Apart movie, for their sixth anniversary, Natalie wants to surprise her husband Ethan, so she goes to the clinic to check on the sperm he stored… only to find out he took it out long ago! Turns out, he donated to his ex and childhood crush so she could have his baby! And now that woman is back—with the child. Worse, Ethan actually brings them into their home, as if they belonged there. After being let down again and again, Natalie finally makes up her mind. She’s done. She wants a divorce. She’s walking away. For good. Will Ethan manage to save their marriage before it's lost forever, or will Natalie disappear before Ethan realizes that he's lost a truly good woman?
69d91bcb9f6094e9250565a5.title: When Forever Fell Apart

69d91bd627497358110ee7ce.synopsis: In Double Life of a Cell Block King movie, Harrison hits rock bottom after a betrayal by his own stepfamily. He deliberately goes to prison to gather evidence of his stepfamily’s crimes. After his release, a sudden marriage ties his fate to Sophia, and the two are quickly pushed to the margins, facing humiliation, poverty, and open scorn from those in power. As Sophia chases a chance at a new future, Harrison is repeatedly branded as a ex convict—until a single moment inside the Maple Group building signals that everything they believed about him may be wrong.
69d91bd627497358110ee7ce.title: Double Life of a Cell Block King

69d91be663ac6594310ce48b.synopsis: Rowan and Emma's relationship reaches a new stage, but new challenges lie ahead. Will they finally get their happy ending? Emma and The Big Four's story is coming to its finale. Stay tuned for the ending you've been waiting for.
69d91be663ac6594310ce48b.title: Taming My Bullies 3

69d91bfc493c1bdb3e018ee6.synopsis: In Power Lies and Marriage movie, Aurora may seem like an ordinary housewife, but in reality, she is the only daughter of the impossibly powerful Redmond family. On their wedding anniversary, she catches her politician husband, Shawn, cheating with her best friend, Tiffany, in his office. She also learns that her late young daughter was denied her life-saving transplant because of them. After learning the truth, Aurora contacts her family and decides to leave Shawn. She secretly gets him to uniwttingly sign a divorce agreement. Completely unaware of what’s happening, he continues his endless string of betrayals, practically rubbing her face in his affair. Aurora endures humiliation and anger. She plots her revenge. She exposes her cheating husband in front of the public at a campaign event, revealing his true nature to all of his supporters. She decides to run against him in the gubernatorial election, not only to end his political career, but to usurp it.
69d91bfc493c1bdb3e018ee6.title: Power, Lies, and Marriage

69dbacb15ea98d73b80f05a1.synopsis: Elian Voss doesn't run from the apocalypse. He builds an army. He unlocks the Terror Zombie Synthesis System. Unbeatable nightmares like Samara and Freddy Krueger serve him alone. He exposes the Shadow Court, claims the Map of Creation, and rises as the Nether Lord.
69dbacb15ea98d73b80f05a1.title: Horror Descends: My Zombies Are Unbeatable

69dbad1d1c3ebd28360f5488.synopsis: Mission count: 100. Destination: Blue Star. Actual arrival: zombie world. Now, Cara is the Duchess's daughter, and she has five beastmates who can't stand her. But still, only she can stop them from going feral. Now the system wants her to win them over. No pressure.
69dbad1d1c3ebd28360f5488.title: One Lady, Five Beastmates, Zero Affinity?

69dbaecb4b88bd70a40c9e13.synopsis: Boris was reborn seven days before the apocalypse broke out. He accidentally awakened the "Hatred Value System", which made him stronger when hated. To build the strongest safehouse in the zombie-infested doomsday, he embarked on a tyrant's path of ruthlessly provoking hatred. Eventually, he defeated all humanity and the Zombie King, dominating for all eternity amid curses.
69dbaecb4b88bd70a40c9e13.title: Hatred Makes Me Tyrant

69dc6a6fb9f7e62ddc0df4ef.synopsis: On New Year's Eve, Felix Quinn is just another wage slave working overtime for his mother's hospital bills. But when the office lights go out, a survival game begins without warning. The building suddenly becomes a death maze, each floor ruled by a zodiac animal boss. There's no law here, only life and death — and it's all decided by grabbing Red Packets. Who's going to be the "lucky one"?
69dc6a6fb9f7e62ddc0df4ef.title: Survival Game: Who's the Lucky One?

69dc91bb278ade00dd08596d.synopsis: At 52, chief physician Sarah's "perfect" life shatters when she discovers her husband Joshua's affair with her son's fiancée, Molly. As Molly fakes a pregnancy and Joshua plots to profit from her hospital and even insure her life, Sarah gathers proof. At the engagement party, she exposes them with surveillance footage. Divorced and promoted to hospital president, she cleans house, destroys their schemes, and reclaims her power.
69dc91bb278ade00dd08596d.title: The Fitting Room Scandal

69dc92f5cab4dc26f50e9cd8.synopsis: In his last life, Caleb's cheating wife and her secret lover murdered him and took all his money. After rebirth, he went back to he day of winning the billion dollar lottery. In this life, he's done being a simp. As his toxic wife and her lover ruin themselves, he begins his revenge with a mysterious female CEO by his side.
69dc92f5cab4dc26f50e9cd8.title: I'm Done Being Your Simp

69dc9420ca82f8f1260ea784.synopsis: In his last life, Caleb's cheating wife and her secret lover murdered him and took all his money. After rebirth, he went back to he day of winning the billion dollar lottery. In this life, he's done being a simp. As his toxic wife and her lover ruin themselves, he begins his revenge with a mysterious female CEO by his side.
69dc9420ca82f8f1260ea784.title: I'm Done Being Your Simp

69dc94cf1015a88977031811.synopsis: Lillian transmigrates into the doomed consort as tyrant Felix orders her family's execution. Using a reset system, she alters their fate by rewinding time. Felix, aware of the loops, suspects witchcraft but plays along. As Felix falls for Lillian, they shift from enemies to lovers, combining her reset ability and their wits to defeat the rebels together.
69dc94cf1015a88977031811.title: Reset: Taming the Tyrant

69dc952ecbcd7ecc090955a7.synopsis: Charlie survives on guts and hustle. When he uncovers mine boss Denver's scandal, he uses it to force his way into the operation. By day, he schemes to ransom a tycoon's daughter; by night, he secures Emily as his backer. After a daring rescue boosts his rise, Denver's sudden death throws the mine into chaos. Borrowing big and outplaying rivals, Charlie flips the board and claws his way to the top.
69dc952ecbcd7ecc090955a7.title: The Blackmail Ladder

69dcd8702167faeaa1042524.synopsis: Adrian Vale, a worker at Elixir Works in the Immortal Realm, dies in a car accident, only to be reincarnated in the body of Henry, the neglected eldest son of the Lynch family. Once a bitter man mistreating his wife and in-laws, Henry is now touched by the warmth and care he receives. Inspired by this newfound love, Adrian, a thousand-year seeker of immortality, decides to lead his family on the path to power and eternal life.
69dcd8702167faeaa1042524.title: Died at Work, Got a Family

69dde3d7a493a40dc8095415.synopsis: Reborn after her colleagues betrayed her in a flood, elite exec Robyn Shaw tears up her termination notice and becomes a badass. With janitor Martha, she turns an unfinished tower into a fortress. When the flood comes, the former chairman begs. When cold comes, Martha's salted fish saves them all. Nobody could help them, but these two women survived.
69dde3d7a493a40dc8095415.title: Flood: Lady Boss's Teammate Is a Janitor

69dde3dba493a40dc809541b.synopsis: Branded a ruthless capitalist in her past life, she was locked in a frozen tower and left to die, saved only by her timid assistant. Reborn one month before the apocalypse, she liquidates fortunes, buries her betrayers in debt, and builds a mountain cold-storage fortress. When the world freezes, she thrives in luxury while enemies beg in the snow, now "laid off" by the end of the world. And her once-quiet assistant? He becomes her deadliest weapon.
69dde3dba493a40dc809541b.title: KPI: Love Me or Die

69dde3dca493a40dc809541d.synopsis: Aurelia Carter drowned in the flood once. Reborn two weeks before it hits, she takes the pigsty everyone laughed at, turns it into a fortress, and waits. When Cedar River breaks, the mansion drowns. The pigsty stands. And everyone who mocked her is pounding on her door.
69dde3dca493a40dc809541d.title: The Pigsty Ark: Reborn Before the Rain

69dde3e0a493a40dc8095423.synopsis: Seven days before the catastrophic flood, Serena Hale is reborn. Using her severance pay, she buys a discarded steel tank, gives up a respectable life, and frantically hoards supplies—turning the tank into Noah's Ark and humiliating her sneering ex-coworker Celine Shaw. When disaster strikes, she coldly watches Celine and the others fall, driving off looters and her vicious former landlord Victor Kane again and again. Surviving brutal cold through sheer ruthlessness, she uncovers the coordinates to Dawnhaven Base, sails there, hides her supplies, blends in as a refugee—and rises to claim her place in the new world.
69dde3e0a493a40dc8095423.title: Iron Ark: Rebirth

69ddec0dd9c31aed8405f4ae.synopsis: Seven days before the catastrophic flood, Serena Hale is reborn. Using her severance pay, she buys a discarded steel tank, gives up a respectable life, and frantically hoards supplies—turning the tank into Noah's Ark and humiliating her sneering ex-coworker Celine Shaw. When disaster strikes, she coldly watches Celine and the others fall, driving off looters and her vicious former landlord Victor Kane again and again. Surviving brutal cold through sheer ruthlessness, she uncovers the coordinates to Dawnhaven Base, sails there, hides her supplies, blends in as a refugee—and rises to claim her place in the new world.
69ddec0dd9c31aed8405f4ae.title: Iron Ark: Rebirth

69ddee6267094642d40650f1.synopsis: Aurelia Carter drowned in the flood once. Reborn two weeks before it hits, she takes the pigsty everyone laughed at, turns it into a fortress, and waits. When Cedar River breaks, the mansion drowns. The pigsty stands. And everyone who mocked her is pounding on her door.
69ddee6267094642d40650f1.title: The Pigsty Ark: Reborn Before the Rain

69ddef1589d1ae4eea079927.synopsis: Past life, I was a hated capitalist. Betrayed and locked in a -112 degree office tower to die, only my assistant Ethan Cross tried to save me. Reborn a month before the freeze, I grabbed his tie: 'No more reports. You get a 10x raise. Just stay alive!' We both awakened. I cashed out 600 million USD, dumped 300 million in debt on the traitors, and built a mountain bunker. When the world froze, my enemies fought over crumbs while I relaxed in my 79-degree room with wine and strawberries. Over the megaphone, I told the begging traitors: 'Sorry, you are laid off.' Meanwhile, my wimpy assistant became the God of Slaughter, destroying raiders and turning foes into ice. Whispering in my ear, he said, 'Boss, my KPI tomorrow is to love you 10,000 times.'
69ddef1589d1ae4eea079927.title: Cold Blood, Hot Revenge

69ddf0a24ee72a9ee602b5f9.synopsis: Architect Callum Cole saw the end coming before anyone else. He sold his penthouse, turned an abandoned warehouse into a doomsday fortress, and locked his wife Serafina and five-year-old daughter Lily inside just as the sky caught fire. When raiders, mutants, and killer weather came for what was his, only one thing mattered. Keep his family alive.
69ddf0a24ee72a9ee602b5f9.title: The Architect of the Apocalypse

69ddf157d4ea39a5260cc929.synopsis: Reborn after her colleagues betrayed her in a flood, elite exec Robyn Shaw tears up her termination notice and becomes a badass. With janitor Martha, she turns an unfinished tower into a fortress. When the flood comes, the former chairman begs. When cold comes, Martha's salted fish saves them all. Nobody could help them, but these two women survived.
69ddf157d4ea39a5260cc929.title: Flood: Lady Boss's Teammate Is a Janitor

69de4b3cdd17c84dd90b5044.synopsis: Ted Lewis, Emperor of the Celestial World, shattered the Three Realms’ barriers, returned to the mortal world, and seized Heaven Sect. However, after returning, he found his mother, lover and daughter were humiliated. He stood up for them and punished his ex fiancee. Later, in the stone gambling competition, he turned bricks into jade. Finally, he displayed his supreme immortal aura, defeated the immortals summoned by his brother, and shook the world.
69de4b3cdd17c84dd90b5044.title: Make My Lover Your Concubine? Die!

69de4b6e3aeff61210018516.synopsis: Snubbed and looked down on by his in-laws this New Year’s, Adrian Cross hides a earth-shaking secret: he is none other than the powerful chairman of the elite Wonston Group!
69de4b6e3aeff61210018516.title: A Fortune Reclaimed

69de4b9ed0f341be2f0c0880.synopsis: Ethan Mercer, a humble antique shop apprentice, is betrayed and abandoned by his wife Vivienne Sterling after she strikes a billion-dollar jade fortune. Left broken and humiliated, he unexpectedly awakens the legendary Golden Eyes! Blessed with the power to identify priceless jade and see through all deception, he rises from rock bottom to dominate the jade world—and build his own empire on his terms!
69de4b9ed0f341be2f0c0880.title: Golden Eyes

69de4bca2118c9d96f082c90.synopsis: After seven years abroad, Adrian York returns as the Chairman of Aetheris Consortium, a global financial titan. His plan? To help his girlfriend, Nina Sterling, secure a job at Langford Group. But Nina, blinded by ambition and greed, betrays him to pursue the elusive Chairman. Heartbroken yet resolute, Adrian meets Claire Langford—and they marry swiftly. At a high-profile signing gala, Claire shocks everyone, revealing that Adrian is not just a business partner... he’s her husband.
69de4bca2118c9d96f082c90.title: Skyward Ambitions

69de4c263446358bea0caa58.synopsis: Destined to be broke, Faye, a gifted mountain healer, saves the life of Mrs. Hayes, who welcomes her into the most powerful family in town. She calls the cold, wheelchair-bound billionaire Jackson Hayes "Dad" and sets out to heal his legs and lift a dark curse. But when a jade pendant falls from her pocket, identical to Jackson's own, a long-buried secret threatens to change everything.
69de4c263446358bea0caa58.title: Heal the CEO: Little Doctor's Journey

69de4c46cc571f37380efe68.synopsis: Bella Shaw, a mischievous celestial being who can turn anything into gold, gets banished to the mortal world for gobbling up all the immortal peaches. Tasked with bringing fortune to mortals during the New Year, she fails spectacularly—until a down-on-her-luck CEO takes her in. Suddenly, the CEO's luck flips—her failing restaurant booms, and she even stumbles upon a gold mine.
69de4c46cc571f37380efe68.title: The Lucky Charm Who Fell To Earth

69def43569dc6fef82020edf.synopsis: Victor, the heir of Yates family, married into the Walton family as a live-in son-in-law, enduring five years of abuse from his cruel wife, Yolanda Walton. Forced to drink foot water, beaten by thugs, and trapped in her web of manipulation, he finally decided to get a divorce. Reclaiming his business empire, he reunited with his true love, Claire Shaw. Enraged and abandoned, Yolanda faked a pregnancy and stormed their wedding, only to have her lies exposed by her own lover. She fell. They rose. Love wins.
69def43569dc6fef82020edf.title: Kneel No More: The Billionaire's Divorce

69def43669dc6fef82020ee1.synopsis: Billionaire heiress Aurora Ashford gave her cheating husband the hospital, the black card, and her whole heart—then walked in on his mistress smashing his mom's $10M cochlear implant and claiming the VIP suite as "the boss's wife." Big mistake. Because the real boss just came home.
69def43669dc6fef82020ee1.title: The Mistress in My Hospital

69defb149bfc2c680800ea06.synopsis: Kyle, once deemed unable to cultivate, was forced into a deadly succession trial as a disposable pawn. His parents were killed protecting him. After three years in hiding, he returns, awakened by a mysterious black tome through his unyielding will, inheriting a forbidden power. Reborn through suffering, Kyle rises step by step to the peak of strength, no longer the boy they discarded, but a force that challenges so-called invincibility.
69defb149bfc2c680800ea06.title: Unworthy No More

69df0837a9981a3d7c0f277e.synopsis: Holden Stone wakes from a 3-year daze with immortal powers. Armed with godly healing and martial arts, he conquers the city, enjoying supreme power, loyal friends, and romance!
69df0837a9981a3d7c0f277e.title: Fool No More, King Returns

69df08661151acb7120993ae.synopsis: Holden Stone wakes from a 3-year daze with immortal powers. Armed with godly healing and martial arts, he conquers the city, enjoying supreme power, loyal friends, and romance!
69df08661151acb7120993ae.title: Fool No More, King Returns

69df086f585e2fb9020b5f04.synopsis: Joseph and Julia built a successful company, but without a child, their wealth draws the greed of his scheming brother. Bound by family ties, Joseph endures until Julia becomes pregnant. With an heir on the way, he stops holding back, exposes their plots, and fights to protect his family and fortune. In the end, he secures his legacy, leaving everything to his child and no one else.
69df086f585e2fb9020b5f04.title: The Child Changes Everything

69df09199f171564560b932a.synopsis: Jason gave everything for his dream girl, Mia — only to catch her cheating with a wealthy rival. On the verge of a breakdown, he awakens the Trillion-Dollar Subsidy System, which rewards him with luxury homes and supercars for completing tasks. He rises from rock bottom, humiliates the cheating woman and her lover, then saves his father by confronting his own cousin, gaining hotel equity and launching his business empire. Along the way, he protects a childhood friend and helps a woman named Sophie, steadily expanding his wealth until he becomes the richest man in Cloudhaven.
69df09199f171564560b932a.title: Cashback Over Crushes

69df09353885a1cc3e054158.synopsis: Betrayed by the Emperor, Leon Thorne, the Prince Regent of the Solarian Empire, reincarnates as a timid high schooler. Shedding his cowardly shell, he crushes the bully Chad Keller and meets Elise Mercer, a classmate identical to his past-life fiancee. After destroying her cursed necklace to dispel its dark magic, he settles the debts of his gambling brother, Jared Thorne. When the Sanctum, including Dexter Cross, targets the Mercer fortune, Leon unleashes his Prime Grandmaster powers. He obliterates their assassins, dismantles the syndicate, and wins the loyalty of Riverton's wealthiest man, Edward Langdon, ultimately redeeming his past regrets.
69df09353885a1cc3e054158.title: From Throne to Classroom: The Warlord Reborn

69df0955b5c679e3cf0d1ee3.synopsis: Audrey Harrington, the adopted daughter of the Harrington Estate, is betrayed and murdered by the trueborn child, Stella Harrington, and the rest of House Harrington. Reborn, Audrey vows revenge. Calculating her every move, she reclaims the steward's power only to strategically let it go, plunging House Harrington into financial ruin. She then exposes Stella Harrington's schemes, completely humiliating her. Meanwhile, she allies with His Highness Rowan Lancaster to uncover the dark secrets of House Harrington. Ultimately, Audrey exposes their crimes, leading to the family's exile. Free from their grasp, she finds her happily ever after with Rowan Lancaster.
69df0955b5c679e3cf0d1ee3.title: Not My Clan, Not My Problem

69df29aacc56265d4b029699.synopsis: In a future wasteland world, genius AI engineer Clara is devastated when her ex, Marcus, turns her warm companion robots into cold service tools. She quits and takes PWL-000, a Reject Robot slated for destruction. Little does she know, it holds a massive secret.
69df29aacc56265d4b029699.title: Beyond Us

69df535afcf0fce6cb0ce779.synopsis: Disguising herself as ugly, Clara marries elite heir Jace to honor her mother's wish. She thinks he loves her true self, but she's just his pawn to defy his family and shield his first love. After three years of abuse, she divorces him, unveils her beauty, and shocks everyone. Jace begs for a second chance, but Clara is done. Is his belated love too late?
69df535afcf0fce6cb0ce779.title: Love After Lies

69df535cfcf0fce6cb0ce77d.synopsis: Grace spent fifteen years loving a family that never loved her back. Then her cousin stole her college spot, her fiancé, and her wedding—so Grace walked out, vanished into the desert, and became a legend.
69df535cfcf0fce6cb0ce77d.title: Burn the Past, Guard the Nation

69df535efcf0fce6cb0ce77f.synopsis: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.
69df535efcf0fce6cb0ce77f.title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal

69df53b59eb806ddd80723eb.synopsis: Mrs. Gallagher receives a massive relocation payout and plans to split it between her two biological sons. But Mr. Henderson warns that her sons may not be truly devoted, unlike her adopted girl. He suggests testing their loyalty. The test proves her sons are greedy, while her adopted eldest girl is genuinely loving. Yet, clinging to the traditional belief of raising sons as a retirement plan, Mrs. Gallagher gives the payout to her sons and rotates living with them. Her daughter graciously accepts this. However, Mrs. Gallagher faces severe mistreatment from her sons and daughters-in-law, and it is the eldest girl who defends her every time. Through these ordeals, she gradually realizes that raising sons as a retirement plan is no guarantee. Blood isn't the only family bond, and only a grateful heart deserves true devotion...
69df53b59eb806ddd80723eb.title: Mom's Relocation Payout

69df53b69eb806ddd80723ed.synopsis: Housewife Audrey Hayes suffers endless torment from her mother-in-law Edith Miller and husband Derek Miller for giving birth to Audrey. Favoring boys over girls, Edith relentlessly bullies Audrey Hayes, knowing she has no family backing. Meanwhile, her deadbeat Derek leeches off his parents, games all day, cheats repeatedly, and cowardly ignores their conflicts. Pushed to the limit after catching Derek with a prostitute again, Audrey Hayes demands a divorce but gets trapped in battles over property and custody. Later, her biological mother Josephine Kingsley steps in, empowering her to start over. She fights back, reclaims her life, and wins the house and Audrey's custody, while her toxic ex-in-laws finally get what they deserve.
69df53b69eb806ddd80723ed.title: A Mother's Rebirth

69df53bd9eb806ddd80723f9.synopsis: 18 years ago, Avery Stanton was switched at birth. Now, fake heiress Chloe Dawson shows up at the Stantons with a forged paternity test and transcript. She frames Avery for stealing the class fund and getting terrible grades, deceiving their parents to steal Avery's life. Misunderstood, Avery is kicked out of the master bedroom and mocked by her school. Aided by her cousin Riley Yates, Avery investigates and secures ironclad proof that Chloe bribed the lab and teachers. At the welcome-home gala, the truth comes to light. Chloe is arrested and Avery's name is cleared, but a wounded heart takes time to heal.
69df53bd9eb806ddd80723f9.title: The Straight-A Cousin Is the Real Heiress

69df5f70827a5e662a0c672b.synopsis: Disguising herself as ugly, Clara marries elite heir Jace to honor her mother's wish. She thinks he loves her true self, but she's just his pawn to defy his family and shield his first love. After three years of abuse, she divorces him, unveils her beauty, and shocks everyone. Jace begs for a second chance, but Clara is done. Is his belated love too late?
69df5f70827a5e662a0c672b.title: Love After Lies

69df5fd2827a5e662a0c677f.synopsis: Grace spent fifteen years loving a family that never loved her back. Then her cousin stole her college spot, her fiancé, and her wedding—so Grace walked out, vanished into the desert, and became a legend.
69df5fd2827a5e662a0c677f.title: Burn the Past, Guard the Nation

69df6020827a5e662a0c67a9.synopsis: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.
69df6020827a5e662a0c67a9.title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal

69e06ab4fef68f21b602f27e.synopsis: College junior Gabriel dumps his gold-digging girlfriend, only to be dragged home by a stunning CEO. His dad married a billionaire, making the CEO and the campus belle his stepsisters! They suspect he is after the Tatum family fortune, but Gabriel suddenly awakens the Foresight System! With its power, he rises to the top!
69e06ab4fef68f21b602f27e.title: Dumped, My Step-Sisters Want Me

69e077e0e7501eebf60c5835.synopsis: Audra Valecrest, a 9-9-6 corporate drone, dies and wakes up as the Empire’s vicious Second Princess in a world ruled by women. The original princess abused her four S-rank mates and was obsessed with Damien Vale, a little schemer, until she was poisoned. But this time, Audra gets a luxury-spending system: spend on her mates to unlock 10x cashback and special powers. She saves the badly wounded General Hawthorne Adrian Hawthorne, calms the raging White Tiger War God Rhett Valecrest, rescues the merfolk marshal Nereus Blackwell at sea, and wins over Lucien Ashbourne, the scheming nine-tailed fox council president. As she puts First Princess Celia Valecrest and every villain in their place, she awakens her SSS golden bloodline, stops the Empire’s beast transformation crisis and rebellion, then rises as Queen to rebuild the Empire with her four lovers.
69e077e0e7501eebf60c5835.title: Villain Princess, Four Lovers

69e07a2ccc56265d4b029700.synopsis: In his past life, James's wife cheated on him and always spent time with her first love. Reborn, James decided not to marry Jane. This time, he tossed the marriage application paper away and left for college, building a fortune through grit and sharp instinct. Yara's sincerity healed what Jane broke. When James rose to the top, Jane realized her chance was gone forever. That man would never come back. He had met his true love.
69e07a2ccc56265d4b029700.title: Reborn: This Time I Won't Marry You

69e07a323cd16879a80298f4.synopsis: In his previous life, James Lewis married his three childhood sweethearts one by one, only to be trapped in miserable marriages and labeled a jinx who doomed his wives. In this life, he rejects them all and turns to marry Vivian Shaw, the illegitimate daughter of a wealthy family in the Northern City. Little does he know that the future aloof business tycoon has been his secret admirer for years. Post-wedding sweetness strikes hard, with face-slapping revenge dialed to the max!
69e07a323cd16879a80298f4.title: Childhood Sweethearts, Get out of My Way

69e07a3498c748e19c0ff351.synopsis: Two years ago, Sarah Cole's life was destroyed by her ex-husband's powerful family. Her mother died disgraced, and Sarah disappeared. Now she returns as a world-class surgeon. When the Hayes family faces a life-or-death crisis, the only doctor who can save them is the woman they once crushed. Looking at her former father-in-law, she asks coldly, "My ex father-in-law, right? Need my help?" The media erupts, but one thing is clear. The old Dr. Cole is gone. She came back for revenge.
69e07a3498c748e19c0ff351.title: Scalpel of Revenge

69e07a3736efb1d52f0bd7be.synopsis: In his previous life, James Lewis married his three childhood sweethearts one by one, only to be trapped in miserable marriages and labeled a jinx who doomed his wives. In this life, he rejects them all and turns to marry Vivian Shaw, the illegitimate daughter of a wealthy family in the Northern City. Little does he know that the future aloof business tycoon has been his secret admirer for years. Post-wedding sweetness strikes hard, with face-slapping revenge dialed to the max!
69e07a3736efb1d52f0bd7be.title: Childhood Sweethearts, Get out of My Way

69e07c8e75b7bc26be0f6839.synopsis: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.
69e07c8e75b7bc26be0f6839.title: Exiled to Emperor
