Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.
69fad8547b11a0bb350e64a4.title: The Immortal's Return

69fae1475d993aaf0d039292.synopsis: Heir Rowan Kingsley survives a cliff fall, rescued by poor farmer Theodore Palmer and his daughter Nora. The Palmers sacrifice everything to send him abroad. Nora hides her own college acceptance to support him. Five years later, Rowan returns to repay the family who saved him.
69fae1475d993aaf0d039292.title: True Love Prevails

69fae3db71ec89999c062a98.synopsis: Amnesiac John Miller and his daughter Mia keep a low profile at Sinclair Group until John accidentally provokes Zachary Sinclair. Brutally harassed, John's fate takes a turn when Zachary recognizes a unique charm. The shocking discovery transforms Zachary from bully to bewildered son: his victim is Jonathan, the father he never knew.
69fae3db71ec89999c062a98.title: The Father They Never Knew

69faeb5bc5ebabd7cd07a9d2.synopsis: In her past life, Karol Eisen married Prince Harold Jackson by royal decree. She gave him her heart, only to discover he loved someone else. After a life of neglect and abuse, she died in despair. Reborn, she swears never to repeat her tragic mistakes!
69faeb5bc5ebabd7cd07a9d2.title: Too Late for Us

69faf2dc3fb84d2dda0de3f4.synopsis: On the fifth day of the New Year, delivery guy Dylan Hardy wins a prize and becomes the Acting Money God for a day. Endless jackpots. Enraged in-laws. No one believes in his luck and chaos keeps happening in his life. Little do they know, he's the actual Money God!
69faf2dc3fb84d2dda0de3f4.title: Cash, Chaos, and a Temporary God

69faf9b835cf4a063b0a624d.synopsis: College student Jason time-traveled to the Cultivation World. After cultivating for 10,000 years to become a Sage, he returns to Earth to find only one day has passed! Before he left, his father died, his adopted brother forced his mother into debt, his buddy Derek stole his patent money, and his crush Alyssa was stolen by his rival. Now back, Jason ruthlessly crushes those bullies! He dismantles loan sharks, saves the head of Reed Group, and helps his secret admirer Zoe make a stunning comeback. Facing hidden enemies on Earth, he uses his 10,000 years of cultivation power to crush everything in his path.
69faf9b835cf4a063b0a624d.title: Sage in the City: 24-Hour Comeback

69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.synopsis: Seraph was a princess cherished by her family her entire life, until her sister was murdered. When her husband and best friend helped the killer escape justice, she was forced to grow up overnight.
69fb80fb9feee94a1309f720.title: Your Love Broke My Heart

69fbf3647af8964bc00a85cf.synopsis: Dossey Hope, intellectually disabled since childhood, was deceived by her parents into taking the fall for her sister and went to prison, where she secretly learned martial arts. Upon her release, her parents attempted to commit her to a mental hospital. At that moment, Nathan Gannon, heir to the wealthiest family in the Capital, suddenly proposes marriage.
69fbf3647af8964bc00a85cf.title: Fool Me Once

69fc26fa701aa19375023e5d.synopsis: Penny Stirling transmigrates into a romance novel as the loyal sidekick and lackey to the villainess Evelyn Sterling. In the original plot, Evelyn meets a ruinous end after crossing the lead couple—and Penny is dragged down to the same tragic fate right alongside her. Now, the Overseer tasks Penny with fixing Evelyn's foolish obsession with love. She helps Evelyn expose the scumbag. While completing her mission, she sticks close to Miss Sterling, achieving both career success and massive wealth!
69fc26fa701aa19375023e5d.title: Saving My Villainess Boss

69fc32ee5ba48485ef0d2898.synopsis: After three years of wrongful imprisonment, Claire Hayes emerges from the Eternal Penitentiary as the Fury of the Midnight Ward. On the day of her release, she pins the cold, untouchable Warden — Vincent Vance — against a water cell wall and kisses him. Not out of love, but survival. He holds the key to her future. Together, the Fury and the Warden will burn every enemy who ever wronged her. And along the way, the cold man who never bends... discovers that for her, he will break all his own rules.
69fc32ee5ba48485ef0d2898.title: The Fury and the Warden

69fc3afbfdb63161f2087c2e.synopsis: In Got Dumped. Got LadyAid movie, a broke delivery guy, Gavin, is dumped by his girlfriend the day she graduates for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78K. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to mansions, a restaurant empire, and a law firm. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back. She ends up in jail. Gavin walks away with Paige's heart, a fortune, and no regrets.
69fc3afbfdb63161f2087c2e.title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.

69fc66ba27c436701c0aa300.synopsis: The true heiress, Stella, was unloved. On her deathbed, her parents celebrated the fake daughter's birthday. Only her aunt and uncle said goodbye. Reborn, she chooses them. They worry they're powerless, but she'll reclaim everything her father, Edward, stole. At the family party, she challenges him: whoever secures the order becomes head. The loser is erased. He takes the bet. The contract? It goes to her uncle.
69fc66ba27c436701c0aa300.title: True Heiress: Trading Up My Family

69fc82d7d30acc2a0b072463.synopsis: Seattle's relentless rain brings a chilling nightmare to Marilyn's doorstep: her husband's secret mistress has been brutally murdered. Overnight, the illusion of her perfect marriage completely shatters. Four months pregnant and seemingly blindsided, Marilyn is thrust into a terrifying police investigation where her husband, David, is named the prime suspect. Yet, as Detective Sarah Green digs deeper into the dual tragedies, eerie inconsistencies begin to surface—most notably, a ghostly figure caught on a neighbor's security camera in the dead of night. Everyone has a deadly motive, and no one is truly innocent. Trapped in a twisted game of cat and mouse, how far will a desperate widow go to survive? In a city where the truth is obscured by deception, the most chilling question remains: who is the real puppet master orchestrating this bloodbath?
69fc82d7d30acc2a0b072463.title: My Husband's Mistress is Dead

69fc8a93a90184a23e042ccd.synopsis: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.
69fc8a93a90184a23e042ccd.title: The Husband Delivered by Fate

69fc8ab8802fea273d001ccb.synopsis: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.
69fc8ab8802fea273d001ccb.title: The Husband Delivered by Fate

69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.synopsis: In My Boss Loves Me Too Much movie, Ella planned to challenge herself by taking a new job after years of managing crises, but her world is turned upside down when her new boss, Christian, drags her in a fake marriage! What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes something far more intense. Every touch, every kiss, draws Ella deeper into his world. But what she doesn’t know is that Christian has been playing a dangerous game all along, determined to make her his forever.
69fc97f7f35208d08800c854.title: My Boss Loves Me Too Much

69fd0c482d20ccc4be08afe5.synopsis: We’re hitting the road for festival season! Cole Gerdes and Mellisa Goodwin hop behind the wheel for a special carpool karaoke-style Finish the Lyrics challenge. Can they recognize the songs or will they completely flop under pressure?
69fd0c482d20ccc4be08afe5.title: ReelTalk EP 73-Can Vertical Actors Sing a Justin Bieber Song?

69fd0d45fe565cebed0b600b.synopsis: For Mental Health Awareness Month, Gabrielle Brown opens up about the unglamorous side of the industry and overcoming hardships. From setting boundaries to navigating healing after marriage, Gabrielle discusses growth, resilience, and protecting your peace. Tune in for a vulnerable discussion on mental health and advice for anyone navigating a difficult time.
69fd0d45fe565cebed0b600b.title: ReelTalk EP 74-Gabrielle Brown: Surviving Betrayal and People Pleasing

69fd0d804bd18783fa0c5c1c.synopsis: Join Savannah Coffee and Chris Quartuccio as ReelTalk goes international for its first-ever ReelTrip to Thailand. From the vibrant streets and skyline of Bangkok to iconic landmarks like Wat Pho, these costars dive into Thailand’s culture through unforgettable food, shopping, sightseeing, and makeovers. Experience the flavors, fashion, and beauty of Thailand through their adventure abroad.
69fd0d804bd18783fa0c5c1c.title: ReelTalk EP 75-ReelTrip: Thailand

69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.synopsis: Our iconic enemies-to-lovers is back and better than ever! Go behind the scenes of Taming My Bullies 2 and discover how Meg's signature look comes together. Cam also gives the inside scoop on filming some of the shirtless swimming scenes, while the director breaks down the inspiration behind key shots and what it really takes to bring this story to life.
69fd0ddb105a230d0c0da6c3.title: ReelTalk EP 76-Backstage: Taming My Bullies 2

69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.synopsis: Four breakout stars from ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series come together for an intimate Pride Month special short video, sharing their most genuine crush confessions through cinematic monologues inspired by real emotions, memories, and love stories. Set against dreamy summer nights, camcorder footage, and coastlines, Crush Confessions captures the quiet ache of longing, youth, and the moment every love song finally starts to make sense.
69fd0dfdb6f786ada703b918.title: ReelTalk EP 77-Love Whisper

69fd0e2ced0c035c1a0f2e52.synopsis: Spend a day shopping with Cam! Follow along as he searches for Hironos at Pop Mart, shows off his nerdy side, and opens about his journey from modeling to acting. This is a side of Cam you won't want to miss!
69fd0e2ced0c035c1a0f2e52.title: ReelTalk EP 78-Day in the Life of Cam: Pop Mart & Untold Stories

69fd0e55314c2ba12f081ad8.synopsis: What better way to celebrate Father’s Day than with a very special announcement: Jackson Tiller is going to be a girl dad! In this heartfelt episode of ReelTalk, Jackson sits down with Sarah Moliski for an emotional conversation about fatherhood, family, and life in the spotlight. From preparing to welcome a daughter to balancing a growing career with being a devoted husband and father, Jackson opens up about the moments that matter most.
69fd0e55314c2ba12f081ad8.title: ReelTalk EP 79-Jackson Tiller Is a Girl Dad!

69fd0e6cfa888249920d5ef5.synopsis: BroTalk is BACK! The Big Four from Taming My Bullies are taking over the pool. Cam Porras is hosting a pool party with friends (Travis Owens and Grant Garcia) when a mysterious lifeguard (Luke Dodge) crashes the fun and starts enforcing strange beach rules. Plus, stick around as the cast answers the burning questions fans have been buzzing about.
69fd0e6cfa888249920d5ef5.title: ReelTalk EP 80-BroTalk: Pool Party

69fd7b4838f9bd5d450845a9.synopsis: Abigail married honest Timothy in her past life, toiling hard as he rose to Culture Bureau Director. Her cousin Vanessa wed wealthy Harrison Lockwood, yet fell into poverty after the family went bankrupt and killed Abigail out of spite. Reborn, Abigail finds Vanessa has taken her original match. She chooses to marry Harrison instead. The two start a marriage of convenience, which later turns into love, and Abigail helps revive the declining Lockwood family.
69fd7b4838f9bd5d450845a9.title: Reborn Swap Bride in the 70s

69fda53c9e256a13e106cd49.synopsis: A thousand years ago, Celeste Monroe sealed a world-destroying demon, tasking her servant Enoch Seaton to guard it forever. Seeking her lost memories, she returns to the Seaton family at Ophelia's request. Though treated with polite hospitality as the Progenitor's descendant, she is clearly unwelcome...
69fda53c9e256a13e106cd49.title: The Last Demon Slayers

69fda53d9e256a13e106cd4c.synopsis: Carly Tubert dropped out of high school to support her boyfriend, Jacob Celis, and spent seven years building the Rosewood Group into a global empire while secretly funding his education and career. Returning to propose, she finds Jacob dumping her publicly for another. After meeting Wendel Group CEO Clement, Carly reveals her billionaire status, ready to watch Jacob regret his decision.
69fda53d9e256a13e106cd4c.title: The True Queen Returns

69fda62bf596069ae30b9691.synopsis: Twenty years ago, a car crash tore Sebastian away from his parents. He was adopted by the CEO of the Carrington Group. Twenty years later, he returns. Not as the lost child they remember, but as the most powerful man in the room. All he has to prove who he really is — is a pendant, broken in half twenty years ago. One piece with him. One piece with the mother who never stopped waiting. When the two halves finally meet, the truth comes crashing down. The boy they thought was gone forever has come home — not just to reunite, but to protect. And this time, nothing will tear them apart again.
69fda62bf596069ae30b9691.title: The Lost Son Comes Home

69fda62df596069ae30b9694.synopsis: When security guard Ethan Mercer saves a drugged heiress, Elena Hawthorne, she marries him. But the Hawthorne family sees him as nothing but a kept man who married up for money. Ethan doesn't fight back, but as crisis after crisis strikes the Hawthorne family, Ethan begins to unlock abilities he never knew he had. And somewhere along the way, the woman who married him out of gratitude falls for him for real.
69fda62df596069ae30b9694.title: The Unwilling Heir to an Immortal

69fda62ef596069ae30b969a.synopsis: Taught to protect herself, Kiera Thorne disguises as a man. By chance, she has a one-night stand with Vance Group's Boss, Rhys Vance, and gives birth to Mila Thorne. Six years later, Kiera joins Vance Group as Rhys's male secretary. The Vance family discovers Mila but fails to track them down due to Kiera's disguise. After hilarious misunderstandings, Rhys and Kiera reunite and live happily ever after.
69fda62ef596069ae30b969a.title: Mr. Secretary, Mrs. Vance

69fda62ff596069ae30b969d.synopsis: Ethan, the Supreme War God, hides his true power to help his wife, Evelyn, rise. But on the day she's crowned War God, she divorces him and mocks him at every turn. Vowing to reclaim every ounce of power he bestowed upon her, Ethan makes a startling discovery: the girl who once saved his life was never Evelyn, but Aria. Now, he is determined to elevate Aria to the pinnacle of glory, leaving Evelyn with nothing but regret.
69fda62ff596069ae30b969d.title: Supreme War God Strikes Back

69fda631f596069ae30b96a0.synopsis: In Kingsford, Sydney Gage is the revered business Queen, while Ruben Cloud is a scruffy security guard. Ruben's son, Oliver, and his wife secure a rare chance to meet Sydney at a party, only to bump into Ruben on duty. To their horror, Ruben publicly declares his intention to court Sydney. But as Oliver freezes in embarrassment, Sydney steps up, links arms with Ruben, and stands proudly by his side.
69fda631f596069ae30b96a0.title: My Security Guard Dad Dates a Queen!

69fdbda2dc0ca9e97a077ead.synopsis: Betrayed by the Emperor, Leon Thorne, the Prince Regent of the Solarian Empire, reincarnates as a timid high schooler. Shedding his cowardly shell, he crushes the bully Chad Keller and meets Elise Mercer, a classmate identical to his past-life fiancee. After destroying her cursed necklace to dispel its dark magic, he settles the debts of his gambling brother, Jared Thorne. When the Sanctum, including Dexter Cross, targets the Mercer fortune, Leon unleashes his Prime Grandmaster powers. He obliterates their assassins, dismantles the syndicate, and wins the loyalty of Riverton's wealthiest man, Edward Langdon, ultimately redeeming his past regrets.
69fdbda2dc0ca9e97a077ead.title: From Throne to Classroom: The Warlord Reborn

69fe1c0a5f7c3dc081045d91.synopsis: Join Adam Daniel, the Master of Magic, as he takes you behind the scenes of Don't Blink, You'll Miss It! Get an exclusive look at how the stunning special effects and mind-blowing magic tricks are brought to life. Adam also shares a candid, personal conversation about what this project means to him and why it's one he'll never forget.
69fe1c0a5f7c3dc081045d91.title: ReelTalk EP 81-Backstage: Don't Blink, You'll Miss It

69fecf5b20ab8d80080befaf.synopsis: Mafia Camorra family boss Michael is assassinated, forcing his 20-year-old only daughter, Gloria, to take over the family business. While dealing with internal and external threats to the clan, she falls in love with Theo, her late father's close friend and a 34-year-old former FBI agent turned bodyguard. After spotting her own photo inside Theo's pendant, she becomes convinced that he loves her back—only to later discover that the photo is actually of her mother. As their romance intensifies, Theo's past as an FBI agent leads Gloria to suspect he may have been involved in her father's murder, plunging their relationship into crisis.
69fecf5b20ab8d80080befaf.title: Mafia Heiress’s Forbidden Obssession

69ff6d7cede0e22567066f36.synopsis: Autumn Noel returns for an intimate catch up with her best friend, Amanda Liguori. From prioritizing her mental health to creating new music and embracing a new style, Autumn opens up about everything she's been working on behind the scenes. Then, the bestie duo heads out for a fashion challenge as Autumn attempts to build the perfect outfit for Amanda. Will her styling skills earn Amanda’s approval, or will the fitting room have the final say?
69ff6d7cede0e22567066f36.title: ReelTalk EP 84-Day in the Life of Autumn

6a0165d3d296326d110c1224.synopsis: Maya Hayes is a straight-A student with one goal: study hard, escape her violent father, and never look back. But when she stumbles into a tattoo parlor — fleeing a beating — she comes face-to-face with Oakridge High's resident rebel, Jude Sinclair. Soon, the well-behaved scholar and the rich kid with a broken past are thrown together as desk mates. Late nights turn into shared secrets. Insults give way to understanding. Bit by bit, they begin to see through each other's armor — and find something real underneath. Together, they make a pact: break free, fight back, and burn down everything that tries to keep them down.
6a0165d3d296326d110c1224.title: The Rebel and the Scholar

6a016b9302e127d1610ca819.synopsis: After witnessing Reginald murder his wife, Lottie feigned muteness to survive. Years later, she fell for her rescuer Julian, but they were separated by her mother. When her family fell, Lottie sought Julian, only to have her identity stolen by Natalie. To escape Reginald, she married Julian. Pregnant and mistrusted, she fled, later returning disguised as a kidnapper. Their conflict ultimately exposed the truth, allowing them to take down Reginald together.
6a016b9302e127d1610ca819.title: The Mute Bride's Revenge

6a017e1b1c1dd49c430ae6b6.synopsis: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. Emma killed a mafia prince to save her best friend, and now the city wants her dead. There’s only one place left to turn: Carter Reed - the most feared man in the city and the man her dying brother trusted with her life. Carter promised to protect her from monsters, even from himself. But the more time she spends under his protection, the more Emma realizes she’s falling for a monster. And the more Carter wants the one woman he swore to never touch. Will they give in, or will their enemies catch them first?
6a017e1b1c1dd49c430ae6b6.title: Carter Reed

6a0188ad9ed9b087a70f47ba.synopsis: Timothy, exiled prince and secret heir to the deadly Reaper legacy, now lives as a street beggar after his throne is stolen by his treacherous brother. When Winnie, a daring noble heiress, publicly proposes and elopes with him, she thinks she's saving a pauper, but Timothy has secretly mastered unmatched martial arts and lethal poisons. As the empire reels and assassins close in, he waits for the perfect moment to reclaim his throne and rule with unstoppable power.
6a0188ad9ed9b087a70f47ba.title: Don't Mess with That Beggar S2

6a01896f2a7c88e6fa0ae09c.synopsis: Timothy, exiled prince and secret heir to the deadly Reaper legacy, now lives as a street beggar after his throne is stolen by his treacherous brother. When Winnie, a daring noble heiress, publicly proposes and elopes with him, she thinks she's saving a pauper, but Timothy has secretly mastered unmatched martial arts and lethal poisons. As the empire reels and assassins close in, he waits for the perfect moment to reclaim his throne and rule with unstoppable power.
6a01896f2a7c88e6fa0ae09c.title: Don't Mess with That Beggar S2

6a019d79a24318e13e0c5201.synopsis: Battle queen Chloe died saving trafficked Nora, then woke up in her body. Nora was exiled and sold by her own father to the Naka Valley, just so her stepsister could steal her fiancé. Now, Chloe unleashes hell, ruthlessly reclaiming everything stolen from Nora!
6a019d79a24318e13e0c5201.title: Reborn Heiress: Total Takeover

6a019e7d82816f7b63008443.synopsis: Reincarnated as the Bingley family's abandoned wife, Cordelia is betrayed, slaved for them, then cast out. When her ex returns to steal her fortune after faking his death, she divorces, takes her inheritance, and vanishes. At a royal banquet, the Bingleys realize: the kingdom's most powerful Regent is Cordelia's new man, who truly loves her and has the power to back it up.
6a019e7d82816f7b63008443.title: Divorce the Fake, Marry the Throne

6a019e7f82816f7b63008447.synopsis: Born poor, Sansa Miller tends to her sick mother and disabled father. As a living lucky charm, she brings bullies karmic payback and rewards kindness, inspiring good. She forgives cruel neighbors, making them repent. She befriends a vendor who once stole her stall. Then a crisis hits. And her estranged grandpa finally sees her pure heart. Filled with regret, he makes amends and reunites the family.
6a019e7f82816f7b63008447.title: The Lucky Koi Girl

6a019f1d30eabd647906e6ab.synopsis: The whole Faxon Village is waiting for the National Exams' results at the ancestral hall. But Mason and his daughter can't get in because of a baseless report. Not only do they face baseless bullying from villagers, they also receive countless slanders from their own family. However, when Janet reveals her final scores, the whole village is in shock!
6a019f1d30eabd647906e6ab.title: Top Scholar's Reckoning

6a019f1e30eabd647906e6ad.synopsis: Engaged for four years, Roberta Depp's fiancé changed girlfriends like clothes. She faked tears but secretly cheered, marrying into wealth with no wifely duties is a steal! After a wild one-night stand with a hot stranger, she thought she'd never see him again. Yet at a family dinner, the man sat at the head of the table. Guess who just slept with her fiancé's uncle?
6a019f1e30eabd647906e6ad.title: Addicted to My Fiancé's Uncle

6a019f1f30eabd647906e6af.synopsis: Marcus Hale gifts his girlfriend his prized patent, securing her an award from the Zenith Group. But at the ceremony, she turns on him and orders his legs broken to impress a richer man. As the beatdown starts, Zenith's CEO freezes. She recognizes the bloodied young man. He's her son, who lost years ago. Now, hell will break loose.
6a019f1f30eabd647906e6af.title: Return of the Heir

6a019f2230eabd647906e6b7.synopsis: Duke Snook gives his all to Chloe Fletcher. But on New Year's Eve, she humiliates him by bringing her first love home. She acts the loving girlfriend, devours his dinner, seizes his mansion, then steals everything! Reborn on that fateful night, Duke vows to make them pay. He reclaims everything that belongs to him and leaves Chloe's family with absolutely nothing.
6a019f2230eabd647906e6b7.title: Eve of Vengeance: Reborn to Rise

6a019f2430eabd647906e6bb.synopsis: After Helly Riggs gave Ethan Wright her savings 3 years ago, he has returned in glory as the CEO of Apex Group. Hoping to share his wealth with her, he is met with the Riggs family's scorn and their plan to remarry her off. The tables turn instantly when Ethan reveals his identity as a big shot, leaving the family to face the crushing weight of their regret.
6a019f2430eabd647906e6bb.title: From Mocked to Millions

6a019f2430eabd647906e6bd.synopsis: On the train home, Oliver Chase watches as Sharon Kingsley ruins his wife and son's only meal, then demands money. Battling severe combat-related PTSD, Oliver tries to keep the peace. But when Sharon threatens to smash a bottle over his wife, his repressed trauma explodes in a blood-red rage...
6a019f2430eabd647906e6bd.title: When the Reckoning Takes the Train

6a019f4a7af4c87e2302da84.synopsis: After June and her parents die in a freak accident, she finally sees her family's true colors. Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.
6a019f4a7af4c87e2302da84.title: Queen of Letting Go

6a01ab308d0d811f4e0eeac5.synopsis: I'm Luke, dropped into a wraith apocalypse. While others cower, I see only irresistible succubi. I steal a kiss from the Scarlet Bride, turn Wraith Queen Carmine into my pampered loli, and seduce the Gloom Weaver Empress into my wife. Scarlet & Ivory Twin Wraiths, the Gloom Lion Sovereign, even SSS-level wraiths, all fall to me. Apocalypse? Wraiths? I am the true chaos, the ultimate threat.
6a01ab308d0d811f4e0eeac5.title: My Demon Harem Runs This Endgame

6a028e182a7c88e6fa0ae0eb.synopsis: Humanity shrinks to mere centimeters, turning the world into a deadly jungle. University student Mark awakens the Infinite Evolution System, gaining power by consuming biomass and rival abilities. Alongside the brilliant yet guarded Winter, he faces mutated beasts, treacherous awakened foes, and a sinister cult. As the secret of the Xeno-Core unfolds, Mark must gather the scattered cores to save humanity and survive.
6a028e182a7c88e6fa0ae0eb.title: The Shrinkocalypse

6a02bf5a631c8645a00bc6c9.synopsis: Sofía is short on money and desperate to pay her mother's expensive medical bills. Her relatives agree to help her on the condition that she marries the billionaire Samuel, who is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it won't be long before the infamous Samuel wakes up from his coma and discovers he's engaged to a complete stranger.
6a02bf5a631c8645a00bc6c9.title: Wake Up, My Billionaire Husband

6a02ed06ab20a7f49c084c9f.synopsis: Trapped in an arranged marriage with Luca, the cold and dangerously seductive heir to the New York mafia, Aria, the innocent little princess of the Chicago mafia, must decide whether giving her body—and perhaps her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance of survival.
6a02ed06ab20a7f49c084c9f.title: Bound by Honor

6a030bfee910f8b87a032fa6.synopsis: Engaged for three years, I once believed Lorenzo—the man who took a bullet for me—was my salvation. Until that night, after toying with me in the car, he tossed me like trash onto rival gang territory. The three years of devotion were all an act. To protect his so-called ""sister-in-law"" Sophia, he stole my pregnancy medication, letting me hit the table and miscarry. To vent for Sophia, he locked me in a water tank at an underground club and let everyone bid: ""The Saint of House Valenti, starting at one dollar."" My heart died. I shattered the glass, grabbed his archrival Antonio's hand, soaked in blood: ""Take me away. I'll help you kill him."" When I returned, a black datura was tattooed on my lower back. Lorenzo knelt and begged me to come home. I drew my blade and slit his flesh: ""This cut is for the child you killed.""
6a030bfee910f8b87a032fa6.title: Sacrificial Saint

6a040f9cc605bc3d130a7c1f.synopsis: Starving beggar Zoey eats the Crown Princess' funeral offerings and gets caught by the ruthless Crown Prince! Luckily, she can understand plants, and they tell her how to save the princess. Now she's the Crown Prince's whole world!
6a040f9cc605bc3d130a7c1f.title: That Beggar's Dad Is the Crown Prince!

6a040f9ec605bc3d130a7c23.synopsis: Billionaire Blake Thorne returns on Chinese New Year's Eve to surprise his wife, only to find her pregnant. He reveals his true wealth, leaving her family in regret as he cuts all ties.
6a040f9ec605bc3d130a7c23.title: Billionaire's Return

6a040f9fc605bc3d130a7c25.synopsis: Labeled a tea boy, apprentice Jed Simon is kicked to the curb by his wife. Little do they know, he suddenly gains X-ray eyes! Determined to play no more nice, Jed starts gambling stone and cutting more and more imperial green! Look who's rising to the top now?
6a040f9fc605bc3d130a7c25.title: Careful, He's Got X-Ray Eyes!

6a040fa0c605bc3d130a7c29.synopsis: Born poor, Lily Vance studies relentlessly. Trusting her father that education is the best escape, she aces her exams and earns everyone's respect.
6a040fa0c605bc3d130a7c29.title: From Rags to Top Scholar

6a0531be0131488d3c02ae9c.synopsis: Veteran Robin Spacey returns to his village with newfound powers. From a magic cream that hooks a female CEO to mystic eyes that make a widow's son call him Dad, his rise is unstoppable. Join this country boy as he crushes bullies, builds a business empire, and wins the hearts of beauties!
6a0531be0131488d3c02ae9c.title: The Soldier's Divine Legacy

6a0531c00131488d3c02aea0.synopsis: Gavin Wright spent three years funding his girlfriend Mandy Parker. On their wedding day, Mandy, now at the elite Sewell Group, tests him by demanding a massive bride price and publicly insulting him. Fed up, Gavin Wright cancels the wedding. Little does she know, he is the Sewell Group CEO's long-lost child. The next day, Mandy is shocked to find he is now the Sewell Group's Mr. Wright, her direct boss.
6a0531c00131488d3c02aea0.title: My Ex Is My Boss

6a053e9366069cbaea07e5b9.synopsis: Margaret was betrayed, abused, and poisoned by the Granda family—for her fortune. Rescued by a vampire count, she is reborn with the power to strike back. No longer a lamb, she uses wealth, foresight, and cunning to make the noble family kneel. But vengeance comes with desire—the cold count hides a forbidden love that could destroy them both.
6a053e9366069cbaea07e5b9.title: Bloodbound Vengeance

6a05405e58a1ffb47e005e00.synopsis: Silas Hayes died betrayed. Then he woke up — back on the eve of an Anomaly Tide. This time, he has one goal: protect his little brother Cody, and stay far away from the people who sold him out. Then he finds a stray dog in an alley. Scrawny. Pitiful. Begging for scraps. He names it Grim. Except Grim isn't a dog. He's an S-Rank Anomaly — the Shadow Wolf — capable of tearing through reality with a single howl. And Silas accidentally binds him with a power he didn't know he had: the Absolute Contract. Now he can tame any Anomaly. And here's the thing — his "weak" little brother Cody is not what he seems to be either...
6a05405e58a1ffb47e005e00.title: My Pet Is an S-Rank Nightmare

6a0563dd37f9bcda0900318a.synopsis: After finally connecting with the mystery neighbor she’s been “charming” through her Crocs Jibbitz ™ charms, hopeless romantic Lexi is crushed when Tyler never calls—unaware he lost her number by accident. While Tyler launches a viral online search to find her again, Lexi escapes to a tropical wedding and sparks an unexpected connection with another charming stranger, unknowingly carrying the same heart-shaped Jibbitz ™ charm that could reunite her with the guy fate keeps pulling her back toward. ​
6a0563dd37f9bcda0900318a.title: Charmed to Meet You, Too

6a05db5311d6e19d88047587.synopsis: On her anniversary with her fiancé, Jay Neale, co-pilot Joyce Blair accidentally sleeps with Elliot Neale. Wracked with guilt, she tries to distance herself, unaware that Jay is cheating with her stepsister, Abigail! On their wedding day, Jay dumps Joyce for Abigail, turning her into a laughingstock. Devastated, Joyce is stunned when Elliot steps forward to propose.
6a05db5311d6e19d88047587.title: Captain, Mayday for Love

6a05db5411d6e19d88047589.synopsis: Modern office worker Finn Morgan accidentally transmigrates into the body of the Stanley family's deadbeat son-in-law, who was an abusive gambler plotting to steal the family's fortune. Now, with a math Ph.D. and expertise in medicine, Finn reforms to protect his wife, Elena. But it looks like this is a lot of work.
6a05db5411d6e19d88047589.title: The Househusband's Hustle

6a06477801cfe98f60076ded.synopsis: Based on the novel by L. Steele. After her fiancé cheats on her, Vivian flash marries a hot silver fox… only to realize he’s her ex’s dad. The deal is simple: two weeks of marriage, a CEO title for Quentin and enough money for Vivian to save her sick dad. But as her ex keeps humiliating her and his dad keeps saving her, Vivian's fake marriages starts to cross very real lines.
6a06477801cfe98f60076ded.title: The Imperfect Marriage

6a0671cb10666b879b076b3a.synopsis: In Stableboy movie, openly gay city kid Evan Brooks is sent to a Midwest ranch with one condition: compete on the high school rodeo team or lose his dream of culinary school in Paris.
6a0671cb10666b879b076b3a.title: Stableboy

6a068936bc8399208400d1a2.synopsis: Betrayed and cast out by his scheming cousin George, culinary prodigy Ryan starts from scratch with just $30,000 and a dream. Across from his nemesis, he turns his tiny restaurant into a powerhouse, dazzling the city with his unmatched skills. With the loyal Nina by his side and powerful allies backing him, Ryan rises from underdog to culinary titan, while George's treachery boomerangs, leaving him ruined and humiliated.
6a068936bc8399208400d1a2.title: Dish Slap: Revenge Served Hot

6a06bab46594b8844c073b9e.synopsis: Jackson and Elena endured poverty and scorn to care for their ailing father. Hoping for a better future, Jackson enlisted in the army. For a decade, Elena stayed behind to raise their three kids and care for the old man. Now, Jackson returns as the Grand Marshal of Northgard, reuniting with his family to finally give them the happy life they deserve.
6a06bab46594b8844c073b9e.title: Back with Glory, No More Laughs

6a06bb6351a5d1e3b304e6a5.synopsis: Lydia dies and finds out she's the tragic ex in some trashy novel—ran off pregnant, died young, and her kids? Just there to make the heroine's perfect kids look good. Her son Cole ends up a thug in prison. Her daughter wrecks her hand going for first violin, loses it, gets dumped. Meanwhile the heroine steals her man and lives happily ever after. Lydia's pissed. Then she wakes up—18 again, but Cole's 17. Fine. She's gonna fix this. Game on.
6a06bb6351a5d1e3b304e6a5.title: Reborn as My Kids's Saviour

6a06bb6451a5d1e3b304e6a7.synopsis: 14 years ago, favoring her grandson Tristan, Dowager Venere drains Elora's frostblood to save him and casts the girl out. Rescued by farmer Thomas Finch, she's raised as Elora Finch. Now, she returns to Venere Manor as a maid. Her mother, Lady Venere, desperately searches for her lost daughter, unaware that the maid she scolds and humiliates is her precious daughter!
6a06bb6451a5d1e3b304e6a7.title: Blood and the Veil: The Maid Returns

6a06bb6551a5d1e3b304e6a9.synopsis: On her deathbed, Empress Rosa clings to life over an unfulfilled wish, while her three sons ruthlessly vie for the throne. Meanwhile, Celeste arrives to help the Empress. Dismissed by the skeptical princes, Celeste enters the palace, where the dying Empress miraculously revives, kneels, and addresses her as her lady...
6a06bb6551a5d1e3b304e6a9.title: The Empress's Final Wish

6a06bd9323f87aebfc0dca0b.synopsis: In a frozen apocalyptic wasteland, Elara harbors a deadly secret: her blood runs like liquid fire, making her the world's last living heat source. Kael, the Citadel's most lethal and emotionless cryo-assassin, is sent to eliminate her. But a desperate struggle permanently binds their fates, injecting her burning blood into his icy veins. Now, a lethal curse forces them together—if they step more than ten meters apart, his system will combust and she will freeze to death. To survive, this ruthless killing machine must do the unthinkable: keep his prey dangerously close. As the freezing nights force them into intimate, skin-to-skin embraces, Kael's cold survival instinct morphs into a dark, irresistible fever. He was built to feel nothing, but as he strips away his armor to absorb her heat, he realizes he would burn the entire world down just to keep her safe. She was his target, but now, she is his only cure.
6a06bd9323f87aebfc0dca0b.title: Frost and Fever Bound to the Monster

6a06c76b9171ea7a5d0bc052.synopsis: After saving Zach's life, Malese Accola marries him, only to suffer four years of neglect. Zach's heart belongs to his childhood sweetheart, Kayla, who torments Malese with impunity. Kayla steals her work, then causes her miscarriage, and Zach enables it all. Devastated, Malese divorces him and flees abroad to chase her art dreams. Her absence finally opens Zach's eyes to his true love and Kayla's venom. He chases her across the globe, but she won't look back. Meanwhile, powerful CEO Joseph Cohan, Malese's secret admirer, gives her the love she deserves...
6a06c76b9171ea7a5d0bc052.title: Never Look Back

6a0808d427a430a82600d199.synopsis: Christine catches her fiancé Jack cheating with his childhood sweetheart. In her past life, she revealed the other woman’s HIV diagnosis—so Jack livestreamed her rape and torture, then had her murdered. Now fate gives her a second chance. Standing outside that same door, listening to the filthy sounds inside, she tears up the report and walks away. This time, she won’t save anyone......
6a0808d427a430a82600d199.title: Fatal Wedding

6a0808d627a430a82600d19d.synopsis: Ten years ago, Amelia was framed for a fire by her adoptive sister Lucy and sent to a remote island prison. Her parents, her brother, and even her fiancé Louis all helped send her away. Now she’s out. Gaunt, scarred, and broken, she returns home—only to find her family celebrating Lucy’s birthday. Lucy smiles sweetly and asks for Amelia’s fiancé as her gift. No one objects. Then a phone call comes: Professor Lucas, who once believed in her art, offers her a new life in Paris. One month. She only has to endure one more month. But will they let her go?
6a0808d627a430a82600d19d.title: Broken Strings, Unchained Melody

6a0808da27a430a82600d1a7.synopsis: Seven days before Awakening Day, Seraphina's mother asked her to choose a blood-bond partner from the candidates.In her previous life, she chose Kaelen, the heir of the Golden Dragon lineage. But Kaelen abandoned her for a commoner woman named Elara. Three years later, when Seraphina finally found him, he personally drove his sword through her heart.The three knights who had sworn undying love for her had been helping Kaelen cover up his betrayal all along. Instead, it was Damien — the Black Dragon Lord she had considered her enemy — who avenged her, collected her body, and guarded her grave until his own death.Now reborn, which one will Seraphina choose as her blood-bond partner?
6a0808da27a430a82600d1a7.title: Wrath of the Forsaken

6a09430c495774c51907927b.synopsis: Ava is finally discharged from the mental institute after years of treatment, thanks to her therapy dog Luna. She is determined to live a happy, normal life in the suburbs and buys a new house for her new beginning, but her neighbors won't stop harrassing her. Ava keeps a tight grip over herself with her therapy dog's help, staying calm and collected in the face of constant harrassment. Her neighbors won't stop, even threatening to kill Luna! Ava starts to slip, fighting back against her neighbors... after all, with an insanity plea, she can do whatever she wants in revenge...
6a09430c495774c51907927b.title: The Neighbor They Should've Left Alone

6a0945fa01947ebc8f0814ac.synopsis: As the most powerful Sorcerer on Earth, billionaire CEO Darian Douglas moves through the world with authority—but beneath the surface is a deep, unresolved pain: the disappearance of his younger sister, Anna, who vanished at age 8 to shield him from her dangerous, untamed magic. Now, 10 years later, Darian finally finds her—at the elite Douglas Academy of Magic. But she's lost her memory and doesn’t recognize him. As Anna becomes the target of betrayal, bullying, and heartbreak, Darian must conceal his identity while punishing those who hurt his little sister.
6a0945fa01947ebc8f0814ac.title: Never Cross a Supreme Sorcerer

6a09d4fcaa03b0107d0eb696.synopsis: Catherine wakes up in a new world, where she's the notorious second princess. She has four beastmen husbands who hate her. To make matters worse, she's completely broke. And on top of that, the crown princess is plotting against her. Then she unlocks a tycoon system. Every time she spends money, it returns to her tenfold. With unlimited leverage and a modern mindset, Catherine begins her rise. She turns from the most hated princess into the most untouchable woman in the empire.
6a09d4fcaa03b0107d0eb696.title: The Princess's Cash Multiplier: To Spoil Her Men (updating)

6a0a7e3bf6a248cf8a0d7bd5.synopsis: Dylan Wilson time-travels to Valoria, becoming the goofy Marquess of the Wilson family. He wants a lazy life but finds himself engaged to Princess Valerie! To stay carefree, he tries everything to annul the marriage. However, he accidentally turns into the pillar of the state and the God of War! With titles piling up, Dylan is in despair. Why is annuling this marriage so hard?!
6a0a7e3bf6a248cf8a0d7bd5.title: The Unwanted Goofy Son-in-Law

6a0a82c0d4a965dda20e8af3.synopsis: Valerie looks like a nobody, but she's the secret daughter of crime lord Arthur Morgan. To save her mother, she's thrown into the underworld, a pawn in a deadly game. But she survives. Feeding intel to the police, she orchestrates a bloody trap, watching the syndicate destroy itself. When the smoke clears, she walks away from the bloodshed, aces her exams, and rewrites her destiny.
6a0a82c0d4a965dda20e8af3.title: Rise of the Hidden Heiress

6a0a82f9f51ead12c80b16d4.synopsis: To save her mother, Crestmont genius Audrey Hayes joins Vance Group, unexpectedly becoming physically bound to CEO Damon Vance and pregnant with his quintuplets. Though Damon initially thinks she is a gold digger, he falls for her resilience. He protects Audrey from Stella Cole and Lila Quinn's schemes. Ultimately, misunderstandings fade. Audrey's mother recovers and Audrey becomes the cherished wife of the Vance family.
6a0a82f9f51ead12c80b16d4.title: Shared Senses, Sweet Love

6a0aadd3135363957a079986.synopsis: Tristan Corwin is Doom Valley's top talented assassin. His master gifts him five armed women meant to kill him, yet he easily defeats them and gains full recognition. Upon leaving the mountain, he runs into Ghost Syndicate Ninjas hunting a drugged Isabella Kaelen. She begs Tristan for help, but he coldly pushes her away. As he turns to leave, the arrogant ninjas tell him to get out. Suddenly, Tristan's glare turns deadly, and a terrifying murderous aura instantly fills the air...
6a0aadd3135363957a079986.title: The Cold Blade

6a0aae29612852026906cd9b.synopsis: Tristan Corwin is Doom Valley's top talented assassin. His master gifts him five armed women meant to kill him, yet he easily defeats them and gains full recognition. Upon leaving the mountain, he runs into Ghost Syndicate Ninjas hunting drugged Isabella Kaelen. She begs Tristan for help, but he coldly pushes her away. As he turns to leave, the arrogant ninjas tell him to get out. Suddenly, Tristan's glare turns deadly, and a terrifying murderous aura instantly fills the air...
6a0aae29612852026906cd9b.title: The Cold Blade

6a0ac84fb7d7d2bfe20421a5.synopsis: Ten years ago, Elara was adopted by the Alpha of the Stormfang Pack and was destined to choose one of his five sons as her mate. However, the five brothers fall for a manipulative omega maid named Jenny, who schemes to humiliate and torment Elara. Heartbroken and exhausted, Elara publicly rejects her mate bond with the five brothers on her eighteenth birthday and announces her engagement to the mysterious and powerful Lycan Prince, Xavier Lockhart. As the brothers finally uncover Jenny's deception and desperately try to win Elara back, they realize it is too late. Elara finds her true mate in Xavier, breaking his deadly curse, and moves on to a new life, leaving her painful past behind.
6a0ac84fb7d7d2bfe20421a5.title: The Luna's Second Choice

6a0b56759c107ac109085e21.synopsis: In Alpha Queen Rising movie, Aurora gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But, when he’s promoted to Alpha’s General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Aurora is the lost wolf princess--destined to be Alpha Queen--and he'll regret letting her go.
6a0b56759c107ac109085e21.title: Return of the Alpha’s Daughter

6a0bb0d95d746c96610bb8fe.synopsis: The football captain humiliates me and has nude photos taken of me at school. At my lowest moment, I inherit my late father’s powerful conglomerate and a ring that activates five superpowers. I shed my weakness and turn my pain into revenge.
6a0bb0d95d746c96610bb8fe.title: Campus Saga: Superpower Teen

6a0bc38b1be3c578bb0832d9.synopsis: On Drywell’s worn-down streets, I swallowed the insults of relatives who mocked me and even stole my mom’s medical money. Basketball became my only weapon, and every bruise on my hands carried a stubborn kind of faith. When a chance to change our fate finally appeared, I knew it wasn’t just a game—it was my way of proving to everyone who dismissed us that even street-grown weeds can break through concrete and rise toward the sun.
6a0bc38b1be3c578bb0832d9.title: Draft Dreams

6a0bc7d203581e265c095499.synopsis: Broke girl Daisy inherits a family pharmacy and finds a time portal. To clear her debts, she trades modern medicine with a young General, Victor Thorne, and tribal leader Bram. She helps Victor end wars and heal troops, but fellow time-traveler Colin Sullivan frames her, sparking a crisis. Daisy teams up with Victor and Bram to expose Colin's plot. Ultimately, the portal resets, and the trio settles down for a peaceful life in the ancient world.
6a0bc7d203581e265c095499.title: Time Portal: Meds to an Ancient General

6a0bcafcddab579b46043910.synopsis: Reborn as a post-apocalyptic underling, Finn binds the "Wife Pampering System" and chooses three women everyone despises: a paralyzed S-rank, a mutant, and a dying clone. Laughter turns to shock as Finn's serum awakens their powers, telekinesis, super strength, and instant teleportation. Together, they crush enemies, but Colonel Zeller's missile strikes and city-wide hunt threaten to wipe them out. Survival just became war.
6a0bcafcddab579b46043910.title: Oops, I Leveled Up the Apocalypse

6a0bcafdddab579b46043912.synopsis: Humanity shrinks to mere centimeters, turning the world into a deadly jungle. University student Mark awakens the Infinite Evolution System, gaining power by consuming biomass and rival abilities. Alongside the brilliant yet guarded Winter, he faces mutated beasts, treacherous awakened foes, and a sinister cult. As the secret of the Xeno-Core unfolds, Mark must gather the scattered cores to save humanity and survive.
6a0bcafdddab579b46043912.title: The Shrinkocalypse

6a0bcaffddab579b46043916.synopsis: Silas Hayes died betrayed. Then he woke up — back on the eve of an Anomaly Tide. This time, he has one goal: protect his little brother Cody, and stay far away from the people who sold him out. Then he finds a stray dog in an alley. Scrawny. Pitiful. Begging for scraps. He names it Grim. Except Grim isn't a dog. He's an S-Rank Anomaly — the Shadow Wolf — capable of tearing through reality with a single howl. And Silas accidentally binds him with a power he didn't know he had: the Absolute Contract. Now he can tame any Anomaly. And here's the thing — his "weak" little brother Cody is not what he seems to be either...
6a0bcaffddab579b46043916.title: My Pet Is an S-Rank Nightmare

6a0bd79d0a3bfd7eb10ef07c.synopsis: After June and her parents die in a freak accident, she finally sees her family's true colors. Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.
6a0bd79d0a3bfd7eb10ef07c.title: Queen of Letting Go

6a0c410f9545ca14d2014eb8.synopsis: Battle queen Chloe died saving trafficked Nora, then woke up in her body. Nora was exiled and sold by her own father to the Naka Valley, just so her stepsister could steal her fiancé. Now, Chloe unleashes hell, ruthlessly reclaiming everything stolen from Nora!
6a0c410f9545ca14d2014eb8.title: Reborn Heiress: Total Takeover

6a0cb99ac2308bcd5308bc59.synopsis: In Dark Notes movie, based on the novel by Pam Godwin. When Ivory Westbrook catches the attention of her new music professor Emeric Marceaux, she discovers his dominating discipline goes beyond the classroom, unfurling a torrid and taboo relationship that could destroy everything she’s worked for, or fulfill desires she never knew she had.
6a0cb99ac2308bcd5308bc59.title: Dark Notes

6a0d1c67164885350509d9b4.synopsis: Mary Foster and her daughter are critically injured in a crash. When her doctor husband Justin Hayes arrives, he ignores them to save his first love Natalie Collins and her son...
6a0d1c67164885350509d9b4.title: A Mother's Dark Vow

6a0d1c69164885350509d9ba.synopsis: Eight years after giving her son a kidney, Helen Miller is broke and has two months to live. She visits him, only to be disowned. Meanwhile, Cole Group's chairman, Andrew Cole, is searching for his long-lost wife...
6a0d1c69164885350509d9ba.title: Her Kidney, His Regret

6a0d1c69164885350509d9bd.synopsis: Returning from the army, Ethan Ford is betrayed by his fiancée and loses everything. However, a mysterious system grants him X-ray vision and ultimate martial arts. Mastering high-stakes gambling and antique appraisal, Ethan rises to the top. Surrounded by beautiful women, he begins his legendary journey!
6a0d1c69164885350509d9bd.title: The X-Ray Maverick

6a0d1e90cbe683eabe04f14e.synopsis: Eight months pregnant, Allison Grant lands a $5 million bonus. Joking, she's fired; she gets a vicious slap instead of support. Worse yet: her mother-in-law is drugging her to force a miscarriage, while her husband cheats and plots to steal her fortune. Raging, Allison vows revenge. With her best friend and business partner, she plans a brilliant counterattack, making the traitors pay dearly.
6a0d1e90cbe683eabe04f14e.title: Payout & Payback

6a0d1e92cbe683eabe04f157.synopsis: Betrayed by her cheating husband and bullied by his arrogant mistress, antique clerk Valerie Edebiri is forced into divorce. But this heartbreak awakens her omniscient eyes and supreme healing arts! Now able to see the true value of all things, she dominates the blind gem bidding world. Along the way, she catches the attention of top elites. After effortlessly helping CEO Dave Cole avert a massive crisis, the two get together!
6a0d1e92cbe683eabe04f157.title: Divine Sight, Supreme Love

6a0d487adbe9f1ac9d0d574f.synopsis: Valerie Reed, the true head of Zenith Group, stepped down to become a housewife to support her husband, Calvin Hayes. For seven years, she tirelessly cared for the family and nursed him through a severe illness. Yet, her devotion was met with utter betrayal. At their son Noah Hayes's 100-day celebration, Calvin openly brought home his mistress, Mia Reed, and their illegitimate son, Jackson Hayes. Backed by his parents, he gave Valerie an ultimatum: let Mia move in while remaining a nanny for the Hayes family, or divorce and lose your son.
6a0d487adbe9f1ac9d0d574f.title: No More You In My Days

6a0d4ed88f2cd3e9b7013306.synopsis: In a wasteland where a drop of water is worth more than gold, Sira, the last Siren Princess, is the ultimate living prize. To avenge her fallen race, she disguises herself as a withered assassin, only to fall into the merciless hands of Kael, a cold-blooded Commander who treats her as his captive plaything. She survives on blood and tide, possessing a miraculous healing touch even as her body shrivels from thirst. He is a killing machine haunted by a paralyzing fear of the deep, yet he is the only one who nourishes this dying "beast" with his own veins. What begins as a cruel game of exploitation spirals into a dark, forbidden obsession fueled by primal instincts and shared trauma. As brutal possession turns into fatal devotion and a jealous rival's gun finds its mark, the truth bleeds out. While the High King masks his monstrosity behind a veil of holy benevolence, Kael uncovers the visceral reality of a genocide through the memories in Sira’s blood. When a subterranean river erupts from the desert floor, she plunges into the abyss, and he leaps after her. Bound by a destiny of sand and sea, their dark romance defies the laws of survival. Will he clap the shackles onto her wrists once more, or will he follow her down into the crushing depths?
6a0d4ed88f2cd3e9b7013306.title: SAPPHIRE IN THE WASTELAND

6a0d5434c2308bcd5308bc72.synopsis: In Don't Make Me Come Out movie, Chance lived a quiet life, keeping to the streets and caring only for his family's safety. But when danger strikes his daughter, he can no longer stay in the shadows. Once celebrated, now forgotten, he rises again, not for fame, but for love. Old friends heed the call, past glories quietly resurface, and with skill and heart, he protects those dear to him, guarding a fragile peace in a turbulent world.
6a0d5434c2308bcd5308bc72.title: Don't Make Me Come Out

6a0d6210aa4cf16c9f0e0c66.synopsis: CEO Tristan Kelly's mistress, Vivian Camp, injures his wife, Clara Finch, with a falling object. Tristan's mother, Katherine, rushes to save her daughter-in-law only to face more hostility...
6a0d6210aa4cf16c9f0e0c66.title: Falling Objects, Fallen Mistress

6a0e685906e1d264830cdd06.synopsis: Ray gave up everything for his family, only to be betrayed before the zombie apocalypse. Now he hides with his daughter in a doomsday bunker while the elites starve above. But when she is infected, Ray returns to the surface as The Silent Reaper. To save her, he will kill, conquer, and make the wasteland kneel.
6a0e685906e1d264830cdd06.title: Apocalypse: I Have a Super Fortress in Advance

6a0f7cb70736a2e9de0e9c52.synopsis: In Alpha Daddy Make Me Yours movie, Wolfless Omega Lyra has always been called the unwanted runt. But she never thought that during this year's summer, when she moved back into the house of the alpha that she's secretly had a crush on for a long time, Alpha Damon-- he would also be her best friend's dad! At home, she can't hold back her long accumulated desires anymore-- they explode out. She fantasizes about Alpha Damon taking her virginity, dreaming about him, even while she knows that an Alpha like Damon would never fall in love with an omega like her. Moreover, Damon is her dad's best friend! When they finally have a forbidden touch, the truth slowly comes out.... could it be... that they're fated mates?
6a0f7cb70736a2e9de0e9c52.title: Alpha Daddy Make Me Yours

6a0f8432be29f7108105f4f8.synopsis: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?
6a0f8432be29f7108105f4f8.title: I Accidentally Sexted My Enemy

6a0fb34c37d61055380bde78.synopsis: Top assassin Riley Bishop retires to protect her mother, Jade Lynch, and seek revenge. Once an heiress, Jade was betrayed and abused for years. Witnessing her mother's suffering, Riley becomes the Shadow Queen of an international team. Discovering Jade's ongoing torment, Riley returns to expose the Douglas family's hypocrisy and reclaim the Lynch Group. Old debts, new scores, she's wiping them clean once and for all!
6a0fb34c37d61055380bde78.title: Mama's Girl, Killer Mode

6a107d9af7107c524f091ef9.synopsis: When succubus Veronica relocates to a new town, her guardian binds her powers to curb her seductive antics. But mischief is in Veronica's blood, especially when she meets a seemingly nice boy, whom she suspects has everything to do with the four missing virgins. She decides to play along with his plan, even without the magic to protect herself. Can she sucessfully take her power back? Can she stop the evil ritual that burns the souls of four innocent virgin girls?
6a107d9af7107c524f091ef9.title: Veronica's Sinister Spell

6a13084db79995ad2e085145.synopsis: Reborn as an F-rank trash dog, he unexpectedly gains Anubis's devour-evolution power! He devours beasts and gems to level up nonstop, crushes villains, protects the heroine, and finally becomes an SSS-rank underworld god to save the world!
6a13084db79995ad2e085145.title: Level up! From a Stray Dog to the God of Death (updating)

6a13abd7bfaa03cecd0792d1.synopsis: In a world where heroes are worshipped and mutant beasts are feared, I was cast out of the shelter—discarded as worthless for not being a hero.But by sheer chance, I gained the power to control the life and death of those beasts.So I set up a supply outpost beyond the walls, dealing in the crystals harvested from within them.In this apocalypse, I play by my own rules—and rise to the top.Heroes? So what.Even S-ranks end up working for me.
6a13abd7bfaa03cecd0792d1.title: Doomsday Supply Station: All My Staff Are Total Tough Nuts

6a13b47821f0101cd60e3ff5.synopsis: Reborn with the overpowered Rejection Cashback System, Hendrick grows stronger every time he ruthlessly refuses others. He feeds a priceless Providence Fruit to a dog and gains a legendary immortal peach, gangs up on a so-called Chosen Man to enslave the Sword Guardian, and crushes righteous cultivators with the world-devouring Sovereign's Banner. This time, Hendrick won't cultivate virtue. He'll cultivate absolute power and force the entire cultivation world to kneel.
6a13b47821f0101cd60e3ff5.title: This Villain Doesn't Play Fair

6a13b8fb58196120b8005bd9.synopsis: Blake Prescott, a sickly child, was sold off by his gambling-addicted uncle, Ray, believing his parents had abandoned him. Years later, Blake returns wealthy and powerful to make them regret it, only to learn Ray had manipulated everything.
6a13b8fb58196120b8005bd9.title: Too Late for Regrets

6a13b987dc6489c2a50eca3c.synopsis: Left to die in a river, the boy is raised by a poor couple who give him everything. Years later, he returns a billionaire, only to find his adoptive father dead, his mother forced to remarry, and the family grave set for demolition. Now they'll all pay.
6a13b987dc6489c2a50eca3c.title: Return of the Lost Tycoon

6a13b98adc6489c2a50eca45.synopsis: Haunted by a bloody past, retired commander Arthur King must keep his heart rate below 200 BPM, or risk unleashing a violent rage. He tolerates relentless abuse from a powerful, entitled couple to protect his fragile new peace. But they make the fatal mistake of targeting his devoted service dog, breaching his absolute limit and awakening "The Alpha" within.
6a13b98adc6489c2a50eca45.title: Redline: Cross It and You Die

6a13b98cdc6489c2a50eca4b.synopsis: Five-year-old Nova has reached Energy Refining Level 30,000—invincible, yet stuck. Tired of her endless appetite, Master Calvin tricks her into leaving to find Jalen. Believing she is just a weak cultivator, the invincible Nova clings to Jalen, a top fighter in Rivergard, sparkling hilarious adventures.
6a13b98cdc6489c2a50eca4b.title: 5-Year-Old Cultivator: Not Weak

6a13b98edc6489c2a50eca51.synopsis: Don left the army and returned home. He just wanted to be with his parents and help run their small business. But then a local thug tried to skip out on the bill, and everything went wrong.
6a13b98edc6489c2a50eca51.title: The Last Fight

6a13c64994826c1ddf0822ab.synopsis: Down on his luck, Caleb McGovern awakens the "Make-It-Real" System, where any fake becomes reality! When a scam text from a stock genius's "illegitimate son" pops up, Caleb plays along and receives $10 billion! He even buys a supreme combat skill for just $9.99, gaining the strength to fight 10 men at once! Now, reality bends to his will. His word is law! He can turn any fake into reality!
6a13c64994826c1ddf0822ab.title: Real or Fake? I Decide

6a13e06f7d91ed33a5086087.synopsis: Eight years of grinding got Callum a home, a wife, a daughter. One livestream lover took it all. Callum's wife Vanessa tipped half a million to her favorite streamer, and then helped him run down Callum's father in a hit-and-run. She framed Callum for domestic abuse, stolen his identity to take out loans, and watched the internet crucify him. Now Callum has a new name, a new fortune, and one mission—to throw his cheating wife and her secret lover into jail.
6a13e06f7d91ed33a5086087.title: My Wife's Boy Toy Killed My Dad

6a13e06f7d91ed33a508608a.synopsis: Cole grew up in a small-town massage parlor. There were two strange rules in the store. Only women under the age of 35 were welcome, and his master must wear gray pants when massaging. For eighteen years, he heard those women's moans, saw the soaked fabric, and never asked. Tonight, he finally opens the forbidden door. What he finds will burn his whole world down.
6a13e06f7d91ed33a508608a.title: The Truth Behind Women's Moan

6a13ebf5735c32c050052856.synopsis: On the day she’s supposed to become a bride, Jennifer is thrown from a thousand-meter magic tower by the man she once saved. Her crime? Healing the blind duke whose heart belonged to another woman. But death gives her a second chance. When Jennifer awakens in the past, she refuses to save him again—even as the kingdom’s most powerful families beg for her healing blood. Instead, she makes a shocking wager before the entire royal court: while the duke’s beloved struggles to cure blindness, Jennifer will attempt the impossible—reviving a man whose soul is already dead. Ten days. One sacred blood pact. And only one woman will walk away from the capital alive.
6a13ebf5735c32c050052856.title: To Heal or to Burn

6a140f77dc6489c2a50eca77.synopsis: Princess Lilith is cruelly betrayed by her husband Prince Patrick. While she lies unconscious and gravely injured, Patrick cheats on her with his mistress Kalixi right by her hospital bed. Lilith records the truth and dies in despair. Reborn on her wedding day, she resolves to change her fate with past memories and hatred. Pretending to marry Patrick, she secretly allies with Jervis, a double agent with a secret mission to create royal scandals. Their relationship shifts from mutual use to deep trust. Lilith gains power through royal resources and a charity foundation, exposes scandals, and brings Patrick to justice. She divorces him, rises as the Queen of the Underground, finds love with Jervis, and completes her revenge and redemption.
6a140f77dc6489c2a50eca77.title: The Royal Scandal

6a140f78dc6489c2a50eca7a.synopsis: A modern office worker, Aria, dies in a car crash—only to wake up in the Animus Realm as a rabbit beastkin. Cast out by the Leonine Tribe for having no male to claim her, she is saved by Valerius, the last of the legendary Orme Clan and the most powerful being in the realm. Cold, distant, and deadly, he never expected her to survive—let alone carry his triplets. By a twist of fate, their lives become inextricably bound. Together, they defy the gods, shatter a conspiracy, and rebuild their world.
6a140f78dc6489c2a50eca7a.title: Crashed into the Beast Realm, Claimed by the Serpent King

6a1507d84240073bb00d306f.synopsis: In the 80s, military doctor Colin endures his parents' favoritism toward his adopted brother Justin and his fiancée's betrayal. He breaks the engagement, cuts ties with the Davis family, and prepares to transfer to the capital with Commander Kirk in seven days. Blinded by Justin's lies, his family keeps hurting him — until he leaves for good. By the time they realize the truth, Colin is already gone.
6a1507d84240073bb00d306f.title: Don't Beg When I'm Gone

6a1507d94240073bb00d3072.synopsis: On Alexis Bancroft's wedding day, her father, Raymond Bancroft, plans to name her Chairman. But his retirement post sparks rumors of the Bancroft family's bankruptcy! Snobs show their true colors, and her fiancé's family publicly humiliates her. Seeing their betrayal, Alexis calls her sister, Supreme Commander Natasha. Now, the Bancroft heiress is out for blood!
6a1507d94240073bb00d3072.title: Fake Bankruptcy, Furious Heiress

6a1507db4240073bb00d307b.synopsis: After entering a novel, five-year-old Joanna becomes a doomed princess destined to die under her tyrant father, Emperor Evan. The twist? He can hear her inner thoughts. At first, he ignores her warnings, but as her predictions come true, he starts following her "advice," promoting her mother, naming her heir, and changing the empire. Together, without realizing it, father and daughter rewrite fate, turning a doomed kingdom into a thriving empire.
6a1507db4240073bb00d307b.title: My Tyrant Dad Can Hear My Thoughts

6a1507dc4240073bb00d307e.synopsis: Zack sets up his dad, Henry, on a dating show. But when the cameras roll, secrets explode. A stunning CEO. An underground queen. A movie legend. Turns out they are all Henry's confidantes. Even a global tycoon begs for his investment. One question haunts Zack: who is this man he calls "Dad"?
6a1507dc4240073bb00d307e.title: My Dad Is a Secret Tycoon

6a1507dd4240073bb00d3081.synopsis: An apocalypse survivor time-travels with a pocket dimension packed with supplies into six-year-old Heidi during a famine. Abandoned by her wealthy family and saved by Matt, the poorest villager, Heidi uses her endless supplies to help him find a wife, grow food, and revive an orange grove. But just as they prosper, her greedy birth father returns to claim her.
6a1507dd4240073bb00d3081.title: Famine, Space, and a Second Life

6a1507de4240073bb00d3084.synopsis: The orphan Nina's family raised became the man who drove her to the edge. He took her home, her fortune, and almost her life. But X-ray Vision has given her a second chance. Now she sees the truth, the treasure, and the path to justice. And she's walking it on her own.
6a1507de4240073bb00d3084.title: Rise of the Heiress with X-Ray Vision

6a1507df4240073bb00d3087.synopsis: For thirty years, devoted housewife Helen scrimped and saved while her husband Howard secretly funneled every paycheck to his first love. Belittled by her husband and son as worthless, Helen finally reveals her true identity—the legendary Professor Sage who mentored billionaires and diplomats. Now she'll take everything back.
6a1507df4240073bb00d3087.title: The Housewife Was Their Legendary Professor

6a1507e14240073bb00d3090.synopsis: Her boyfriend chose a maid's daughter. Her father locked her in a mental ward. Her family let her die. Now Vivienne Lancaster is reborn, and she's coming for what's hers and every single person who ever betrayed her.
6a1507e14240073bb00d3090.title: Reborn Princess From the Madhouse

6a151b9cf307b00bef0775d9.synopsis: Willa buys a ground‑floor home but is bullied by vicious neighbors. Her counterattack of building an ash room unexpectedly exposes a buried corpse. The haunting rumors, midnight digging, and murder cover‑up unravel; the killers are jailed. Willa receives compensation and a fresh start.
6a151b9cf307b00bef0775d9.title: The Ash Room for Bad Neighbors

6a163f4a5b5895ea0a0bd65e.synopsis: Killed by his family, Matt Nield died watching his true savior fall. Reborn, he switches the babies. The love child of his cheating wife gets her abuse; the adopted son from his last life gets the throne. The cheaters never suspect, until the reveal shatters them. Broke and desperate, they plot to kill him again. Then he rises from his own funeral. And the grave they dug? It's theirs now.
6a163f4a5b5895ea0a0bd65e.title: I Let Her Raise the Wrong Son

6a1669166a418ed0c6044080.synopsis: Once feared as the "Ruthless Dragon," Yale Cooper left his violent past to protect his wife and daughter, living quietly for 18 years. When his daughter Nina is bullied and humiliated at school, she hides the truth to avoid trouble. But when the aggressor brings trouble to Yale's repair shop, his buried past resurfaces. The Ruthless Dragon awakens. After settling the matter, Yale moves his shop next to Nina's university, vowing to protect his family and live a life of redemption.
6a1669166a418ed0c6044080.title: You Woke the Wrong Dad

6a18943221fde96a100f8ed8.synopsis: In My Alpha Boss Gave Me Triplets movie, Evie, a talented but vulnerable human designer, becomes bound to Leopold, the ruthless Alpha of the Stonehearth Pack, leaving her pregnant with his rare triplets. To protect her, Leopold forces her to move in with him, presenting their relationship as purely transactional while privately struggling with uncontrollable mate-bond instincts that cause him to share Evie's pain and emotions. As Evie is drawn into Leopold’s corporate and pack world, Darleen, a powerful she-wolf from another pack determined to claim Leopold, escalates from professional threats to phsyical ones. Evie's estranged family piles on by attempting to kidnap her. Will Leopold be able to prioritize his mate over everything, and save her from the whirlwind he brought her into?
6a18943221fde96a100f8ed8.title: My Alpha Boss Gave Me Triplets

6a18ab0e0a3fa9b1e70b3cb9.synopsis: Stephen Adams is just your average construction worker. A hardworking, single dad who stays humble... or at least that's what his son thinks. Turns out, Stephen actually runs the biggest construction corporation in America! But he's hiding his identity from his son to keep him humble and teach him the value of hard work. But, when an arrogant bully threatens his son, Stephen has no choice but to step in. Will Stephen's son finally discover his true identity?
6a18ab0e0a3fa9b1e70b3cb9.title: The Hidden Empire of Stephen Adams

6a18b1c2bbfcc4fcd30a20b9.synopsis: In The Hockey Captain That Hates Me movie, plus-size figure skater Skylar Carter hates the arrogant hockey team captain, Mason Reed, with good reason. When Skylar’s prank against the team leaves Mason injured, she’s forced to be his assistant or risk losing her own sports future. Forced together, their rivalry turns into undeniable chemistry. But after the school announces only one program will survive to next season, Skylar and Mason may be falling for the one person whose victory could destroy their dreams.
6a18b1c2bbfcc4fcd30a20b9.title: The Hockey Captain That Hates Me

6a18bf73a88aedd7ff0e368b.synopsis: Nora Harrison thought she killed mafia boss Luca Moretti. But he survives and resurfaces as a billionaire investor, trapping her in his world and forces Nora into a dangerous game: become his woman or lose everything she loves.
6a18bf73a88aedd7ff0e368b.title: Caged by His Twisted Love

6a18c2f9d083d51c99070fb9.synopsis: In Rose in Chains movie, hate has chained their fates together, love is the only key. Mafia Boss Liam swore to destroy the man that killed his father, even keeping his daughter Rose captive. Torn between his thirst for revenge and obsessive fascination with the fallen heiress, Liam finds himself just as much a prisoner to Rose. When the bloody truth behind their past is finally revealed, they realize they were never meant for devastating hatred, but instead love.
6a18c2f9d083d51c99070fb9.title: Rose in Chains

6a18ed9554265615cc04d81a.synopsis: In Alpha's Regret After His Pregnant Luna's Death movie, Alpha Declan is tricked by his brother's treacherous widow, Olivia, into locking his pregnant Luna, Evelyn, in a Silver Cage for three days. He thought he was teaching her a lesson, but it was all part of Olivia's schemes to take Evelyn's place as Luna! Declan refuses to believe Evelyn, even as she begs him to save her, convinced it's all an act. He only realizes he's condemned his own Luna and their pup to death when he sees their dead bodies with his very own eyes.
6a18ed9554265615cc04d81a.title: Alpha's Regret After His Pregnant Luna's Death

6a1bf0eb8c7cc3a12d0fb4dd.synopsis: For five years of marriage, I gave up my career and left everything behind to follow my brigadier general husband—only to end up living as an illegal resident on the base. He gave my military dependent slot to the girl we sponsored, and even had the lock on our home changed for her. Heartbroken, I left in the dead of night and started over in a new city. Seven years later, at a military arts festival, we crossed paths again. He was full of regret, but I was already standing next to another man. This time, I didn't look back.
6a1bf0eb8c7cc3a12d0fb4dd.title: Paper Marriage

6a1bf0f03645558cb00f7d2e.synopsis: High school star student Eleanor Vance has been best friends with Leo Carter for 16 years, until he knocks her out and ties her to a goalpost as a “prank” to impress the popular girl Savannah. Humiliated in front of the whole school, Ellie transfers to California without a word. There, she finds real friends, academic success, and a caring new boyfriend. Meanwhile, Leo loses his mind with regret, but Ellie has learned that some betrayals can never be forgiven.
6a1bf0f03645558cb00f7d2e.title: The Prank That Broke Us

6a1ce924405f24321a041f83.synopsis: She died on an altar with her Divine Core ripped from her chest by the man she loved.Now, Aurelia has been sent back to the day she must choose a husband before all of Mount Olympus.Everyone expects her to kneel for the golden prince who once betrayed her. But this time, Aurelia chooses differently. Instead of the celebrated heir to the Throne of Storms, she turns to the silent half-blood prince mocked by the gods—a man who, in her last life, was the only one who mourned her death. And when the heavens unleash the deadly Ninefold Thunder Trial, Olympus is about to witness a choice that will change the fate of the gods forever.
6a1ce924405f24321a041f83.title: I choose that halfblood prince

6a1cebc72b3d482f1904ee1d.synopsis: Driven to save her dying brother, Olivia Bennett is forced to pose as a debutante to win over wealthy Lian Cullen-until she catches the eye of his uncle, the powerful and intimidating Ethan Cullen. By day, she plays the elegant debutante; by night, a masked stripper in a dimly lit club. But as Lian's kindness hides hidden agendas, and Ethan's scheming fiancée Kim Smith closes in, Olivia finds her lies crumbling under Ethan's relentless pursuit.
6a1cebc72b3d482f1904ee1d.title: The Fake Debutante and the True Billionaire

6a1cf36a75cb6d05d00f47fb.synopsis: On her eighteenth birthday, Zara finally awakens the power that has been sealed inside her since childhood. For fifteen years, she has lived as a castless servant in House Greth—mocked, controlled, and humiliated by Lord Rowan, the man fate itself chose for her. But when their sacred bond appears, Rowan rejects her in front of the gods and throws her away like she was never worth loving. Then Lord Theron Blackwell arrives. Cold, powerful, and feared by every house in the realm, Theron sees what everyone else refuses to see: Zara is not a servant. She is the missing heir of a destroyed bloodline, the daughter of House Solenne, and the bearer of a divine gift powerful enough to expose every lie in the kingdom. Now Rowan wants her back. Isolde wants her ruined. And the council wants proof. But Zara is done begging for a place in someone else’s world. The rejected girl is about to become the woman every house fears.
6a1cf36a75cb6d05d00f47fb.title: Claimed by the Cursed Kingdom

6a1cf5597f16a7bcc30bbdaa.synopsis: For four years, I raised the foolish son my scumbag duke had with his mistress. The moment he returned, he humiliated me in front of everyone. “You're only fit to be my mistress.” I let out a cold laugh and signaled for my attendants to escort the child into the carriage. What he didn't know was that four years ago, on the day he forced me to swear before his iron gauntlet, I turned around and married the most powerful man in the entire kingdom. And now… my king has come to stand behind me.For four years, I raised the foolish son my scumbag duke had with his mistress. The moment he returned, he humiliated me in front of everyone. “You're only fit to be my mistress.” I let out a cold laugh and signaled for my attendants to escort the child into the carriage. What he didn't know was that four years ago, on the day he forced me to swear before his iron gauntlet, I turned around and married the most powerful man in the entire kingdom. And now… my king has come to stand behind me.
6a1cf5597f16a7bcc30bbdaa.title: The Regent’s Secret Wife

6a1cf55a00b7b65a47006766.synopsis: After a terrible car accident, I was rushed into the emergency room. The nurse called Cassian, but he was out of town with his lover. All he asked the nurse to tell me was: “This is the punishment she deserves.” Just because I refused to give his lover the Moonstone my late father left me… he treated me like this. What he never knew was that I am the last daughter of the Evenrose bloodline— and the only rightful heir.
6a1cf55a00b7b65a47006766.title: A Princess's Return

6a1cf563afffd0728e0e7c9a.synopsis: Seven years ago, my parents'adopted daughter, my younger sister Selene, a delicate Omega, got drunk, caused a hit and run, and left blood spilled across the Human Territory Border. My Alpha father, my Luna mother, and my biological younger sister all came to me with the same patronizing plea. “Selene is an Omega. She’s too fragile for prison. If she goes to Silvermoon Penitentiary, her wolf won’t survive it. Lyra, take her place. Please.” I refused. But on a stormy night filled with thunder, my father used absolute Alpha Command. He crushed my will, took control of my mind, and personally delivered me to the prison transport. My fiancé, my Fated Mate, Kaelen, the strongest Alpha in the Pack, held back his raging Wolf Aura and said to me, “Lyra, when you get out, we'll complete the Mate bond. Endure these seven years for now.”
6a1cf563afffd0728e0e7c9a.title: Betrayal and Rebirth
