6a1d20be7bad31c4c409e0e1.synopsis: Connor Reed, the world's most powerful arms dealer, saves Charlotte Hayes and spends the night with her while undercover. Four years later, still in hiding, Charlotte shows up... with his son. Now Connor must protect them both... without revealing his true identity.
6a1d20be7bad31c4c409e0e1.title: The CEO and Her Daughter's Secret Father

6a1d3073ec7b60ff380b3017.synopsis: When Marin’s five-year-old daughter is locked in a sweltering car, her husband Ryan ignores her desperate calls—too busy playing “daddy” to his mistress’s son. By the time Marin tears across the city to save her, Lily is barely breathing. Devastated and clear-eyed at last, Marin walks away from the marriage and rebuilds her life, only to find that the man who betrayed her—and the woman who stole him—are far from done with her.
6a1d3073ec7b60ff380b3017.title: Tarpped in the Summer Heat

6a1d30788e3424eb5d018b1b.synopsis: After spending three years suffering as the unwanted “real daughter” of the Davis family, Chloe is drowned by her scheming adopted sister Mia—while her own family rushes past her to save the impostor. Reborn three years earlier, Chloe refuses to be the family doormat again. She cuts ties with the Davises, returns to the only man who ever truly loved her—her adoptive uncle Julian—and rises as a genius hacker, prodigy designer, and the heiress they will all beg to win back.
6a1d30788e3424eb5d018b1b.title: Second Chance No More Mrs. Nice Girl

6a1d307a443ba49530020c66.title: From Prison to Palace_ Revenge of the Mad Queen

6a1d38c59de72af09d0856c2.synopsis: When the Blaires turn Elena, the black sheep of the family, into a scapegoat to cover for their adoptive daughter's crimes, she is sent to a reform school to be tortured. Three years later, on the eve of her release, Elena just wants a fresh start—but her evil family has other plans.
6a1d38c59de72af09d0856c2.title: After the Reformatory, My Family Begs Me Home

6a1d4f1da4496cd23e0b1374.synopsis: The night before her wedding, Elena catches her fiancé in bed with another woman. After five years of helping him rise to power, she’s discarded as a traitor and thrown out without mercy. But Matteo never realizes the woman he humiliated is actually the daughter of one of New York’s most powerful mafia families. And on the very day he claims his throne and new bride, Elena decides to destroy everything he built.
6a1d4f1da4496cd23e0b1374.title: The Backup Bride's Revenge

6a1d5d2db3b37119e207b71d.synopsis: For three years, Ava believed her husband was slowly dying after saving her father’s life. While her family begged for help in the freezing streets of Brooklyn, she spent every dollar trying to save him. Then one snowy night, Ava follows a tracking chip to a luxury penthouse—and finds him perfectly healthy, wrapped around another woman, laughing about how easy she was to fool. But the man who scammed her made one dangerous mistake:He chose the wrong woman to betray.......
6a1d5d2db3b37119e207b71d.title: He Faked Illness To Betray Me

6a1e3c84d2fcba9d3b040d30.synopsis: After her selfless attempt to save her football team led to betrayal and death, Katlyn Baker is reborn. In this life, she refuses to intervene as the ungrateful Maple Giants self-destruct, watching them lose their crucial game due to a sabotage scandal she exposes. Expelled and undervalued by her former team, she is approached by their rivals, the Alpha Wolves, who recognize her strategic genius. She leads them to a crushing victory over her old teammates, publicly humiliating the bully Jessica and the betrayer Logan who orchestrated her downfall, reclaiming her dignity and finding her own path to success with her new allies.
6a1e3c84d2fcba9d3b040d30.title: Reborn at the Final Play: You Lost Me for Good

6a1e9701607f35eda0069352.synopsis: Adrian Shaw, the Night Monarch, returns home after his grandpa's sudden death. He must uncover the truth, revive the Shaw family, and handle an arranged marriage to Celia Vaughan. Faced with the Vaughan's snobbery, Adrian mercilessly crushes them. He forms the business aliance with Eva Vane, to fight their enemies. Adrian eventually learns the mastermind behind his grandpa's murder is the Vaughan head, Jonathan Vaughan. He defeats him, finally avenging his grandpa.
6a1e9701607f35eda0069352.title: Blood & Betrothal

6a1ea844852965597f00555c.synopsis: Adrian Shaw, the Night Monarch, returns home after his grandpa's sudden death. He must uncover the truth, revive the Shaw family, and handle an arranged marriage to Celia Vaughan. Faced with the Vaughan's snobbery, Adrian mercilessly crushes them. He forms the business aliance with Eva Vane, to fight their enemies. Adrian eventually learns the mastermind behind his grandpa's murder is the Vaughan head, Jonathan Vaughan. He defeats him, finally avenging his grandpa.
6a1ea844852965597f00555c.title: Blood & Betrothal

6a1f52bda2705ccbd5071c79.synopsis: Vera Marchesa just wants one thing: freedom from the dangerous mafia world she grew up in, and her overprotective bodyguard Dante, who refuses to love her. Determined to prove she's not a helpless princess, Vera pushes the one line Dante swore never to cross… even if that means they will crash and burn together.
6a1f52bda2705ccbd5071c79.title: Breaking My Bodyguard

6a1fa002b01d328ba8099905.synopsis: Martina, a farm-raised dancer, uses an engagement contract to secure her spot in the prestigious Bianchi Tango company, but Julian—a handsome assassin—interrupts her plans and forces her to help him. He is a dangerous obstacle, until Matina discovers he might actually give her everything she has ever wanted. Just as she finally gives in to her feelings, he walks away... But when they face death together, they realize that life is too short to waste true love.
6a1fa002b01d328ba8099905.title: Dance Until the End

6a1fa00db01d328ba809994d.synopsis: After six years abroad, Zacarías Montiel builds the world's largest financial empire—the Centurion Group—under the alias "Mr. Z," even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend, Isabela, she leaves him to pursue wealth, claiming that only the mysterious Mr. Z is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor leads Zacarías into a sudden marriage with Fernanda Salazar, the beautiful CEO of Prisma Media. At Isabela's housewarming party, she repeatedly tries to kick Zacarías out—unaware of his true identity—until he finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.
6a1fa00db01d328ba809994d.title: Stand Aside, the Billionaire Is Here

6a1fa01bb01d328ba8099995.synopsis: Forced into marriage by her scheming grandmother and sister, Natalia becomes the wife of Leonardo, a rugged rural rancher and devoted single father to his mute daughter, Lilly. Unwanted by both Lilly and a hostile neighbor, Natalia struggles to find her place—until she uncovers the neighbor's abuse of the little girl. As she earns Lilly's trust, an unbreakable bond forms, culminating in Lilly speaking her first words to save Natalia. Just when Natalia finally begins to feel at home, new challenges threaten everything she's fought to build. With Lilly bullied at school and both her old and new families turning against her, Natalia must fight to protect the love, home, and family she never expected to find.
6a1fa01bb01d328ba8099995.title: Falling for the Cowboy Dad

6a1fa025b01d328ba80999dd.synopsis: At sixteen, Sofia’s adoptive mother sold her eggs on the black market, stealing her chance to ever become a mother. Years later, Sofia is just a school custodian—until she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and catches the attention of her mysterious billionaire father. Desperate to protect his daughter from a vicious custody battle, he offers Sofia an unexpected deal: marry him. What starts as a fake marriage soon turns into a love neither of them can resist. But his ruthless ex-wife, buried secrets, and deadly betrayals threaten to tear their new family apart. Sofia has already lost her chance at motherhood. Will she lose the family she finally found?
6a1fa025b01d328ba80999dd.title: His Daughter Chose Me

6a1fa1e93d80264639051d5d.synopsis: After three years of marriage, CEO Wes Sterling is convinced his wife Kira is a gold-digging cheater. Tired of Wes's accusations and mistreatment, Kira finally divorces him and reclaims her true identity... a billionaire heiress! What will Wes do when he realizes he's made the biggest mistake of his life? Will Kira make him pay... or fall for him again?
6a1fa1e93d80264639051d5d.title: The Billionaire Heiress's Double Life

6a1fa1f73d80264639051da5.synopsis: Rejected by her partner, Selena feel hopeless and discouraged, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for her!
6a1fa1f73d80264639051da5.title: My Alpha, My Forbidden Fate

6a1fa20d3d80264639051e35.synopsis: Carlos, the legendary shooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for long-distance confirmed kills and then vanished from the public eye. He hides his identity and works as a maintenance technician at a shooting range. There, he endures the humiliations from the club captain, Andre, who despises him without knowing his true identity. The shooting range is about to face a hostile takeover. To protect Joana, the owner, and her daughter Rebeca, Carlos finally decides to act, revealing his legendary shooting skills. His extraordinary performance immediately draws attention to his mysterious identity…
6a1fa20d3d80264639051e35.title: The Legend in Disguise

6a1fc43760dad0b33f0e947c.synopsis: Cole was the undisputed Supreme Sorcerer — until he died in a cataclysmic magical war. His soul reincarnated into the body of a young boy named Leo — a boy afflicted with a Death Curse, with little time left to live. The only hope: the Starlight Potion, guarded by the arrogant Westwood family. Leo’s mother, Clara, a powerless ordinary woman, humbled herself before the Westwoods, begging for the potion to save her son.They ridiculed her. Humiliated her. But Clara never backed down. Until Leo could take it no more.Something inside Leo shattered. A pressure so immense it cracked the marble floor exploded from his tiny frame. The entire Westwood mansion trembled. Every sorcerer in the room was forced to their knees — their faces pressed to the ground, unable to breathe, unable to speak. But no one knew: Clara herself had also been struck by the Death Curse. And in the end, for the sake of her child, she gave the only life-saving potion to Leo.
6a1fc43760dad0b33f0e947c.title: This Child Is a Legendary Sorcerer

6a1fe6e094171de24004ffe7.synopsis: Years ago, Jake Hudson entered the Los Angeles business school on a Collins family scholarship. During a fraternity incident, he was rescued by Clair, the eldest daughter of the Collins family, and developed feelings for her. However, a drugging plot led Jake to mistakenly enter Clair's room. To protect the family's reputation, the elder Collins arranged a contract marriage between the two, while secretly entrusting Jake with investigating a traitor within the corporation. During the marriage, Clair misunderstood Jake's scheming nature, becoming cold and distant towards him, even allowing others to humiliate him. Jake, however, remained patient, concealing his feelings, protecting Clair while silently contributing to the corporation. Three years later, Jake, believing he had repaid her debt of gratitude, decided to leave. Only then did Clair realize that Jake was not only not the mastermind behind the poisoning incident but had also made significant contributions to the corporation. Feeling deeply guilty, she began to pursue him. She gradually discovered Jake's resilience and independence, as well as his deep affection for her.
6a1fe6e094171de24004ffe7.title: Too Late, Clair Collins

6a20e5a64fca1d79840c2763.synopsis: Aria, a kind-hearted veterinary intern, wakes up inside a novel — as a despised character in the beast-shifter world, who was cruel to her four bound spirit beasts. Now the entire tribe laughs at her. Then the system activates. With one mission: use spiritual soothing to cure her four mates. They glare. They reject. They push her away. But Aria is a vet. She has never met an animal she couldn't heal...
6a20e5a64fca1d79840c2763.title: Reborn Villainess: Healing Hearts, Breaking Walls

6a210e9bdd61d087070d184f.synopsis: When André Brandão, son of famous NFL quarterback Thiago Brandão and former beauty queen Cristina, disappears in a devastating fire, the psychotic fan Dinho sees an opportunity to swap André for his own son, Vitor. Twelve years later, the two boys meet at soccer tryouts, where André surpasses Vitor. The Brandão family, unaware that André is their long-lost son, relentlessly attack him. They subject him to physical and mental torture, encouraged by their adopted son. Until they discover the shocking truth—André is the one they were looking for. The Brandão family then do everything to beg for forgiveness while Vitor and Dinho plot revenge.
6a210e9bdd61d087070d184f.title: The Return of the Lost Striker

6a2110356b23d0adf20042a3.synopsis: Julian's wife Vicky cheated on him with his friend Harry, and then they murdered him. Now he's reborn, seven days before his wedding. Instead of stopping the wedding, Julian makes sure the cheaters marry each other and he marries another girl, Rachel, Harry's abandoned fiancée. Julian and Rachel make the cheaters drown in debt with a cursed land deal and loans they'll never repay. In the end, justice is served cold.
6a2110356b23d0adf20042a3.title: This Time, I Won't Marry You

6a211c74b6d9a41c8b01403f.synopsis: In High Society movie, Adele was born with nothing: no last name, no family, no home. But then she meets Cesare Buonaparte. The Duke. The most feared man on their island nation. And finally, she has a chance to become something more. To bring herself out of poverty and save her friend's life, she makes a deal with the Duke: she'll help him escape an arranged marriage by pretending to be his long-lost sister. Though he's the most gorgeous, infuriating man she's ever met, siblings—even fake ones—can never fall in love. So... why does he keep looking at her like that?
6a211c74b6d9a41c8b01403f.title: High Society

6a213796485cd422e7049746.synopsis: Forced to spy on heir Lucien to pay her father’s debts, Elara finds herself trapped in a web of betrayal, lost love, and tragic loss. After the truth of her noble lineage surfaces, she must face a vindictive rival and a complicated past. Amidst power struggles and life-threatening danger, can Lucien’s ultimate sacrifice heal their broken bond?
6a213796485cd422e7049746.title: Our Love, Built on Lies

6a215117e35446e0970e138a.synopsis: The day Rose gives birth, she discovers her husband Tyler and protégée Sarah have been having an affair—and have just swapped her newborn daughter for their illegitimate son, leaving her real baby to die in the rain. Rose rescues her daughter in secret and spends the next two decades raising her into a billionaire heiress, while quietly playing the doting “mother” to the impostor child. When her revenge finally lands, no one will be left standing.
6a215117e35446e0970e138a.title: Divorce Me？Bow to My Billionaire Daughter!

6a21d0a1ce8c0095bc03942d.synopsis: In Waterboy Second Down movie, three years after Kaden broke Donovan’s heart to save his NFL dreams, superstar quarterback Donovan Miller is back — and signed with the agency where Kaden is barely surviving as an intern. Donovan says he came to Boston for revenge… but the tension between them says otherwise. In a world that could destroy Donovan’s career if the truth comes out, falling for each other again might cost them everything.
6a21d0a1ce8c0095bc03942d.title: Waterboy: Second Down

6a21e90ced9cf53ee8067221.synopsis: Asher, Layla's mate, betrays her by eloping with her sister, Vivian, who was supposed to marry Lucian, the most dangerous Alpha King in history. To protect her pack, Layla agrees to marry Lucian in her place. Asher still believes Layla is his fiancée. Layla and Lucian, along with Asher and Vivian, hold their wedding ceremonies simultaneously. Just as Layla is about to leave, Asher realizes Vivian tricked him. In a frenzy, he grabs Layla, who's about to leave forever.
6a21e90ced9cf53ee8067221.title: Not the Bride He Wanted

6a223050fd137dd5ef0e3675.synopsis: Three hundred years ago, Evelyn, the Supreme Witch, sealed the Demon King Lucifer in the underworld and reincarnated as Ivy, an orphan with feeble spiritual power. Seventeen years later, Lucifer’s minions infiltrated Silver Thorn Academy, plotting to awaken the Demon King through a dark magic circle. After enrolling in the academy, Ivy formed fateful bonds with Kane, the Alpha Werewolf, Sebastian, the Vampire Patriarch, and Victor, the Demon Hunter Mentor — the three chosen guardians of the demon core. Lucifer set a trap to kill Ivy before her power awakened, but it instead triggered her dormant supreme abilities. Heirs of the three great clans joined forces to fight the Demon King, and Ivy, regaining her full power, banished Lucifer back to the abyss once more.
6a223050fd137dd5ef0e3675.title: Bound to My Three Fated High Lords

6a22350b86a8394e370207ff.synopsis: Back from seclusion, cultivator Leonard stuns the internet—joining his live-streamer great-granddaughter to show off real magic!
6a22350b86a8394e370207ff.title: Immortal Grandpa Goes Viral!

6a22459a0dedebeb5d012d5e.synopsis: Selene, the noble Lycan Princess, loved the East Coast Alpha Caleb for eighteen years, only to be betrayed, drained of her blood, and brutally murdered by him and his Omega lover, Elara, in her past life. Miraculously reborn on the night of the Blood Moon Altar, Selene refuses to make the same mistake. Instead of Caleb, she chooses Kael, an Alpha bound by a dark witch's curse. Forced to endure Caleb's arrogant humiliations and cruelties under the temporary effects of a secrecy potion, Selene patiently bides her time. With Kael ultimately breaking his curse to become an unmatched ancient Lycan, will Selene successfully rewrite her tragic fate, expose the traitors, and claim her throne as the ultimate Lycan Queen?
6a22459a0dedebeb5d012d5e.title: Too Late, My Rejected Mate

6a226f7cb7ec41a1eb0c12d9.synopsis: Gavin Wright spent three years funding his girlfriend Mandy Parker. On their wedding day, Mandy, now at the elite Sewell Group, tests him by demanding a massive bride price and publicly insulting him. Fed up, Gavin Wright cancels the wedding. Little does she know, he is the Sewell Group CEO's long-lost child. The next day, Mandy is shocked to find he is now the Sewell Group's general manager, her direct boss.
6a226f7cb7ec41a1eb0c12d9.title: My Ex Is My Boss

6a2270e74a210587e3084099.synopsis: In the Frostmark Empire, locked in eternal winter, only a marriage between a princess of pure royal blood and the Abyss Dragon can bring back the warmth of the sun. Princess Diana grew up happy alongside her three brothers — until Lorelei arrived. Using a stolen Dragon's scale, Lorelei seized all of Diana's love and standing. Deceived, the three brothers cast Diana aside — even offering her as a sacrifice to slay the dragon. Only after the dragon took Diana away did the truth emerge. By then, it was too late.
6a2270e74a210587e3084099.title: My Brothers Begged, But I'm the Dragon's Queen

6a227fc49876923c780bc5be.synopsis: Destroy My Silver Wolf Bloodline? I Marry the Top Alpha Instead is a thrilling, dark werewolf romance about ultimate revenge and transformation. Natalie, heir to the powerful Warwick silver wolf bloodline, carries the gift to call upon moonlight and protect her pack. She devotes six years to Alpha Liam, only to face brutal betrayal on the eve of their wedding. Zoe, Liam’s deputy, deliberately shaves off her sacred silver hair—the symbol of her legacy—and drugs her to weaken her power. Liam knows everything but chooses to condone, trampling her love and dignity. In despair, Natalie awakens her long-buried True Mate bond, summoning Nicholas, the most supreme Alpha. Nicholas has waited patiently for years and rises to defend her with overwhelming power. He punishes the betrayers through clan and alliance authority, helping Natalie regain her strength and pride. Finally, she breaks free from the toxic love and marries Nicholas, rising from a humiliated fiancée to the revered Luna of the Lycan Clan. It is a dark epic of blood, loyalty, and true love, celebrating a glorious rebirth from ruin.
6a227fc49876923c780bc5be.title: Destroy My Silver Wolf Bloodline？I'll Marry a Top Alpha Then

6a22e72411f10a40420fc6b0.synopsis: For three years, Emily is treated like a free watchdog by her toxic husband, Liam, and his parasitic family, who always leave her behind during their lavish vacations. This year, the moment they jet off to the Maldives, Emily quietly sells her pre-marital home and files for divorce. When the family returns to find themselves locked out and homeless, Emily delivers the ultimate blow by exposing Liam's secret affair to his entire social and professional circle. Left with absolutely nothing, the toxic family faces total ruin while Emily embraces her wealthy new life of independence.
6a22e72411f10a40420fc6b0.title: I Divorced His Whole Family

6a263b274874fbaac20cc344.synopsis: At the academy’s grand Midwinter Banquet, Arthur is publicly stripped of his title, humiliated by the wife he spent five years protecting, and replaced by her returning first love.​ To everyone else, he is nothing more than a useless man living off Silverleaf Academy. No one knows the truth—that Arthur once sealed away his godlike power to save the continent, and the academy itself has only survived because of him.​ So when his wife throws him out with nothing left to lose, Arthur finally ends the contract that bound him to humanity.​ And the moment he walks away, the entire kingdom begins to collapse. And the moment he walks away, the entire kingdom begins to collapse.
6a263b274874fbaac20cc344.title: The Return of the Supreme One

6a263b28706a5510d90428b2.synopsis: Elena died on the temple floor with her unborn child still inside her—murdered by the husband she trusted and the woman she once called sister. But when she opens her eyes again, she’s back at the moment everything began: the public accusation that destroyed her brother and doomed her entire family. This time, Elena refuses to beg for mercy. As gods descend, lies unravel, and deadly secrets surface beneath the eyes of Olympus, Elena is prepared to burn every scheme to the ground before history repeats itself. Because in this life, the House of Hercules will not fall quietly.
6a263b28706a5510d90428b2.title: The Rose of Heracles

6a263b2a930aa5480d0868c6.synopsis: The night the zombie horde attacked, Sarah’s husband abandoned the entire settlement to take his childhood sweetheart to a mountaintop fireworks show. Sarah knew exactly what fireworks would attract in a world overrun by the dead. Desperate to stop them, she pointed a gun at the woman he loved—and paid for it with her life. But when Sarah opens her eyes again, she’s back at the beginning of the nightmare. This time, she’ll do anything to save the people trapped inside the doomed shelter… even if it means becoming the villain in everyone’s eyes. Because once the fireworks light up the sky, everyone dies.
6a263b2a930aa5480d0868c6.title: Doomsday Fireworks Show

6a2773bfd288f56fbd03afab.synopsis: Emperor Sebastian has spent years searching for his beloved Sylvia and their son, Elliot, to no avail. He is completely unaware that his beloved and his child have been enslaved and tormented by his subordinates, at one of his own estates. Sebastian follows a trail of clues that lead him to the estate where they’re being held. Piece by piece, he uncovers evidence of his partner and son’s whereabouts. Just as things reach a dangerous climax for his beloved, Sebastian arrives in time to save both her and their child—and delivers justice to the villains responsible.
6a2773bfd288f56fbd03afab.title: Find You: The Emperor's Lost Heir

6a277806e726ac6d5a05854a.synopsis: To reclaim the vast fortune left behind by her grandfather, Viscountess Melris takes a desperate gamble at a masquerade ball. She seduces a mysterious silver-haired, red-eyed attendant in hopes of bearing his child — a child she plans to use as leverage to secure her inheritance. What she does not realize is that the man she has entangled herself with is none other than Eric, a ruthless and unhinged grand general who takes pleasure in killing. Now, caught in his relentless pursuit, Melris must deceive the world, outwit her scoundrel husband, and eliminate the scheming maidservant — all while struggling to survive the dangerous game she has set in motion.
6a277806e726ac6d5a05854a.title: One Night Stand with the Empire's General

6a27878030454ed055071e62.synopsis: To protect her beloved boyfriend Noah, Amelia accidentally causes her father’s “death.” In order to safeguard their shared dream of a musical future, she hides her pregnancy, pretends to cheat, breaks up with Noah, and turns herself in—serving seven years in prison. Upon release, Amelia discovers their daughter Lisa has leukemia, and only umbilical cord blood can save her. With no other choice, she approaches Noah-now a global music star, and reconnects with him physically, hiding the truth behind her return. Noah has never stopped loving her, but the heartbreak of Amelia‘s sudden betrayal still lingers. As they’re drawn back into each other’s orbit, love and pain collide. Just when the truth begins to surface, her “dead” father suddenly reappears...
6a27878030454ed055071e62.title: The Encore of Us

6a2787e99a16b83b9c05c634.synopsis: Serena Miller had just handed her company over to Ethan Moore — and the moment he got it, he tried to run her down with a car so he could marry Carol. Ethan was the son of the Miller family's servant. Serena loved him, pitied his poor background, and treated him like family. He enjoyed everything she gave him — but for his own desires, he killed her mother, drained her of everything, and then ran her over with a car… Only on her deathbed did she learn that William Dupont, the man she had rejected as an arranged marriage match, had loved her all along. Reborn, Serena decides to cherish William and make Ethan pay for every drop of blood. She plays along with Ethan's act, letting him walk step by step toward his own destruction — without ever realizing it…
6a2787e99a16b83b9c05c634.title: Reborn to Find I Am the Mogul's Lost Love

6a2789320be4f6029e0b5585.synopsis: To save her sick boyfriend Daniel, Emily marries wealthy James in exchange for money—and lies to Daniel that she left him for greed. Three years later, Daniel returns as a billionaire. He deliberately gets close to Emily, manipulates James into making her his personal assistant, and seduces her into an affair of lust and moral destruction.
6a2789320be4f6029e0b5585.title: I'll Steal You Back

6a278a4469fc2d01e80892a0.synopsis: She's his mystery bride. He's looking for her master. When a rival tears them apart, she walks away—but comes back to save everything. Her food cures his hunger. Her love cures his soul.
6a278a4469fc2d01e80892a0.title: Taming a Fussy Billionaire: My Chef Bride

6a28d7fbc02b070e9301f2cd.synopsis: Five young models go to an Airbnb in the woods for a full moon that comes once every five hundred years. What starts off as the perfect girl's trip quickly becomes a nightmare as a pack of ancient werewolves are awoken by the new moon.
6a28d7fbc02b070e9301f2cd.title: Models vs. Werewolves

6a2a2fcc333de051d600928c.synopsis: Ordered by his master, Gideon Locke leaves the mountain for an arranged marriage, only to be rejected by the Bancroft family. He strips them of the luck his master bestowed and enters the city. With unmatched medical and martial skills, Gideon conquers the urban world, wins over Vicky Carter, and reaches the pinnacle of success!
6a2a2fcc333de051d600928c.title: The Hidden Master

6a2a4f2e18aec6c3cd02f4ae.synopsis: Eryndor never knew he was born with the ultimate power. Even his fiancee Vera wanted to call off their engagement because she thought he was a loser. When his enemies challenged him, he finally learned the truth. He was never ordinary. He was invincible all along.
6a2a4f2e18aec6c3cd02f4ae.title: Veiled Immortal Bonds

6a2a4fbbb59b00607908c005.synopsis: Hurt by his cheating girlfriend with a jade seal, he wakes up as an ancient emperor! Using modern knowledge, he gained Empress Cynthia's favor and rose to legendary status!
6a2a4fbbb59b00607908c005.title: Modern Emperor Who Speaks English

6a2a4fc0b59b00607908c014.synopsis: MeLanie watches her parents die, framed by her own uncle. She escapes, gets hunted, and falls off a cliff. A mysterious master saves her. She begs for power to take revenge. He gives her... a set of health exercises. But this "gentle workout" hides an immortal cultivation method. And MeLanie? She's the rarest divine body in ten thousand years.
6a2a4fc0b59b00607908c014.title: You Call This a Health Cultivation

6a2a7562c7ac12edf401e6ca.synopsis: Darius Martino, heir to the Golden Star Group, is left paralyzed and unconscious after a mysterious accident. While everyone abandons him, his fiancée Elina Winata stays by his side despite hardship and humiliation. When Darius finally awakens, he reveals his true identity, reclaims his power, crushes his enemies, and protects the woman whose unwavering love gave him the strength to rise again.
6a2a7562c7ac12edf401e6ca.title: The Young Master's Comeback

6a2a850ab9caa598450a9b94.synopsis: Ten years ago, the Heller family was murdered, but Jace survived. Now a top mercenary undercover as a heiress's bodyguard, he returns to hunt his enemies. He boards a flight to a private island. But the plane is full of his past tormentors: the ex-fiancée who humiliated him, relatives who left him for dead, and his abusive boss. Everyone he despises is on this very flight...
6a2a850ab9caa598450a9b94.title: Cursed Island: Survive Me

6a2b00f6fb5ac0e51f0b87c9.synopsis: The York family, the most powerful, wealthy family in the nation, is rumored to have gone bankrupt. Even though the rumors aren't true, word spreads, and the Yorks watch as their allied families turn on them. The Wilson and Meyer families turn from trusted kin into violent, abusive monsters, hell-bent on destroying the Yorks. At back-to-back events, a wedding and a 70th birthday party, the Yorks face a deluge of abuse and humiliation from the Wilsons and Meyers, respectively, putting the survival of their family name to the ultimate test. Can the Yorks overcome the doubters, abusers, and haters? Will they clear their name, and reestablish their rightful standing as the most powerful family in all the land?
6a2b00f6fb5ac0e51f0b87c9.title: We Never Said We Went Bankrupt!

6a2b043eb06e7104e409f8ae.synopsis: In Don't Toy with My Heart, Mr. Billionaire movie, adult toy designer Holly is forced to sign a contract marriage with arms dealer Derek after her company’s cash flow collapses. What begins as a simple exchange of interests spirals out of control as they move in together and face escalating crises. Derek is cold, dominant, and in total control, yet he begins to waver in the face of Holly’s resilience and kindness. Holly appears soft on the surface, but she grows stronger with every scheme, betrayal, and wound, learning to fight back. Caught between desire and genuine emotion, they move from using each other to saving each other, confirming their feelings through danger and misunderstanding, and ultimately breaking the contract to choose real love.
6a2b043eb06e7104e409f8ae.title: Don't Toy with My Heart, Mr. Billionaire

6a2b0693f7fda4bb29086262.synopsis: After Quinn gives herself a makeover to get back at her neighbor and bully Cam, she becomes the subject of a schoolwide bet for her virginity. With every guy (and even some of the girls) chasing after Quinn, but how far will she go until she realizes the one guy sabotaging her every attempt is the only one who actually wants her?
6a2b0693f7fda4bb29086262.title: Virginity Pact

6a2b076bbe129b998d0fa894.synopsis: In Fiancée's Betrayal Dante's Inferno movie, Dante Bosch returns home after 3 years in the Marine Raiders on a top secret mission, only to discover not only is his fiancée Lilith pregnant with his brother Virgil's baby, but Virgil has also spent all his money. To add insult to injury, his parents take Virgil's side. After suffering betrayals and humiliations, Dante exposes Virgil's lies with a video at his wedding.
6a2b076bbe129b998d0fa894.title: Fiancée's Betrayal, Dante's Inferno

6a2b68ac6fff4c90380cdae9.synopsis: The star superhero Bryan left his gravely injured secret wife Rachel to die in an explosion for better publicity. After sacrificing her career for their hidden marriage for 5 years, a devastated Rachel underwent agonizing genetic experiments in Vought’s Aurora Project. Reinvented as the first female superhero Lumina, she erased her former identity completely. All Bryan had left was her death certificate, doomed to gaze up at the woman he threw away.
6a2b68ac6fff4c90380cdae9.title: You'll Regret Cheating on a Superhero

6a2b7473a9c3d9ed110eef59.synopsis: Commander Z, the most powerful superhero in the world, hid his identity to live the life of a normal teenager. But as people around him take his kindness for weakness, he is done hiding in the shadows.
6a2b7473a9c3d9ed110eef59.title: Superboy vs. Alien

6a2ba015f891a4426a0746b5.synopsis: Yvonne is murdered by her jealous sister right as she's giving birth. She wakes up one year in the past, the day they picked their husbands! Fiona remembers the "future" and chooses Oliver, who was Yvonne's husband. Yvonne picks Fiona's past/future wheelchair-bound husband, Ethan. What no one knows, is that Ethan is secretly the richest man in the world!
6a2ba015f891a4426a0746b5.title: The Billionaire Groom Exchange

6a2bab24089fbc1d5e0b2b04.synopsis: Roger, chairman of the trillion-dollar group WestDream, wantsto do something special for his single mother and introduce his fiancée Vivian to her, so he brings his mother Susan, who works at a small-town restaurant, to the city to celebrate her birthday. However, Vivian’s cousin Lisa, unaware of Susan’s true identity, mistakes Susan for a thief and humiliates her. Later, Susan is again targeted by her future daughter-in-law Vivian, who treats Susan as a fraud and humiliates her. Susan tries again and again to defend herself, but no one listens.After suffering repeated humiliation, she is finally rescued by Roger. Only then does everyone realize that the humble Susan really is Roger’s mother. But by then, it is too late for regret. Roger resolves to punish the villains who bullied his mother and help her regain her dignity.
6a2bab24089fbc1d5e0b2b04.title: The Extraordinary Mother of a Billionaire

6a2bc46eb4f65096b30939f1.synopsis: Elena, the biological daughter of the wealthy Delaney family, was framed by her adopted sister Sarah in a car accident. Wrongfully accused of drunk driving, she was sentenced to ten years in prison. Nobody believed her. Famous sculptor Leo helped her take a new identity. Flora grew into a renowned sculptor. When she returned, Sarah accused her of being an ex-con and plagiarizing artworks. Flora fought back, exposing Sarah's lies. Sarah was the bastard daughter of Elena's dad. Sarah got punished. Flora cut ties with the cold family and started a new life with her lover Marc.
6a2bc46eb4f65096b30939f1.title: The Real Heiress Reclaims Her Place

6a2bc4beabbb476487016d69.synopsis: Top assassin Maya takes a high-priced contract to kill the powerful elite Cassian in order to treat her seriously ill sister, but the mission fails unexpectedly and her identity is fully exposed. Cassian hides a dual identity as Finn, the frail and gentle second young master of the Hayes Group. Saved by a young Maya ten years ago, he orchestrated the assassination attempt on purpose to draw her close and protect her. After the failure, Maya goes undercover in the Hayes family. She gradually falls for Finn, yet uncovers his true identity and finds that the family’s ruler, Victoria, is the source of all their grievances and conspiracies. In the end, the two join forces to expose the truth, settle their past feuds, and stay together.
6a2bc4beabbb476487016d69.title: My Weak Fiancé Is Actually a Kingpin

6a2d0d4d5a0c848ba1085567.synopsis: Tana is the LAST fire dragon alive—and she's hiding that secret in a cage where the losers DIE. Every night Tana heals Cedric, the wolf king locked beside her, never knowing he's her fated mate. But the second Cedric marks her and finds out she's no wolf, he LEAVES her—pregnant and alone. Now Tana is raising Cedric's secret daughter in the city… while Cedric tears apart every mountain looking for the mate he threw away.
6a2d0d4d5a0c848ba1085567.title: The Arena

6a2e0900ec19a7a7cd0a890a.synopsis: This is a 15-minute European-American suspense tragedy short film, which tells a shocking secret that took place in the wealthy Hayes family in Boston, USA: Many years ago, Eleanor, the mistress of the family, designed to kidnap and kill her adopted daughter Olivia, in order to let her own biological daughter Sophia inherit the entire family property, and framed all the crimes to an outsider. Years later, an accidental fire brought clues of this old case back to light. Conner, the police officer in charge of the investigation, peeled off the truth layer by layer along the clues, and finally uncovered the ugly crime that this wealthy family had covered up for more than 20 years, allowing the deceased to be vindicated, and the perpetrators got what they deserved. The story revolves around identity opposition, human desire, truth and redemption, revealing the darkness and cruelty behind the glamour of a wealthy family in a depressing suspense atmosphere.
6a2e0900ec19a7a7cd0a890a.title: Stolen Bloodline

6a2e095089d26e5ee702ae80.synopsis: This is a short story blending the wildness of primitive tribes with the fantastical fate of dragon clans. Set in a primitive dragon clan tribe with a muted, low-saturation color palette, the story revolves around the revenge plan of Luke, the half-blood dragon protagonist. The main storyline is interwoven with the core conflict of the female lead welcoming a new life through childbirth. Amidst the dark and oppressive power struggles within the tribe, the arrival of the new life breaks the shackles of the original fate, echoing the core theme of new life emerging from darkness. The overall style is gloomy and profound, filled with the hidden vibe of primitive wilderness and the fateful tension of the ancient dragon clan. Through a unified muted and low-saturation visual tone, it finally delivers the story's core: all colors are reborn after darkness.
6a2e095089d26e5ee702ae80.title: On the Day of the Broken Engagement, I Married a Half-Blood Dragon

6a2e09e603f9106cb603937d.synopsis: This is a female-oriented revenge short drama with a rebirth & counterattack theme. With her past-life memories, the heroine Chloe is reborn. She avoids the marriage-robbing trap set by her sister Lily, gives up the false shortcut of becoming a mafia godmother, and chooses to accept the upright wealthy businessman Jayce who is in financial crisis. Relying on her experience in managing underground industries from her previous life, she helps Jayce turn the tables and reach the top. In the end, the evildoers get what they deserve, and Chloe becomes the ultimate ruler of both the legal and underworld worlds on the East Coast.
6a2e09e603f9106cb603937d.title: The road not taken

6a2e09e8be1ac1ee080c34da.synopsis: Arina is about to marry the love of her life, Nathan, but runs away at the wedding after learning just a minute prior that she has a terminal illness. She goes far away to Switzerland to seek treatment. Four years later, as Arina prepares to undergo euthanasia, she learns that Nathan has come to Switzerland and decides to see him one last time. However, Nathan arrives to meet her accompanied by his pregnant wife.
6a2e09e8be1ac1ee080c34da.title: She Is Where the Stars End

6a2f6da22a43b076a8064492.synopsis: A modern man is reborn as a puppet emperor destined for a brutal death—starved in a dungeon, then torn apart by horses. But this time, he's not playing by the old rules. With a hidden "King's System" awakening, he starts a ruthless war against the power-hungry empress dowager. He crushes eunuchs, tames the harem, humiliates scholars, defeats foreign invaders, and expands the empire. From broken pawn to the greatest conqueror the world has ever seen.
6a2f6da22a43b076a8064492.title: Time-Traveled Emperor No More a Puppet

6a2f96b73b31512fab0f5e9e.synopsis: Ordered by his master, Gideon Locke leaves the mountain for an arranged marriage, only to be rejected by the Bancroft family. He strips them of the luck his master bestowed and enters the city. With unmatched medical and martial skills, Gideon conquers the urban world, wins over Vicky Carter, and reaches the pinnacle of success!
6a2f96b73b31512fab0f5e9e.title: The Hidden Master

6a2f96f02a43b076a80644bf.synopsis: Ten years ago, the Heller family was murdered, but Jace survived. Now a top mercenary undercover as a heiress's bodyguard, he returns to hunt his enemies. He boards a flight to a private island. But the plane is full of his past tormentors: the ex-fiancée who humiliated him, relatives who left him for dead, and his abusive boss. Everyone he despises is on this very flight...
6a2f96f02a43b076a80644bf.title: Cursed Island: Survive Me

6a2ff069eb903aaa11032782.synopsis: After five years of marriage, Nicholas discovered that his wife lsabelle had long found a new lover. He decided to erase all traces of himself and disappear forever—never to see those who betrayed him again.
6a2ff069eb903aaa11032782.title: Say Goodbye to My Cheating Wife

6a2ff111892ba8194d06c91c.synopsis: Genius girl Daisy once took the fall for her adopted sister, only to be imprisoned, robbed of her achievements, and killed after her release. Reborn, she refuses to be the scapegoat, exposes the truth, cuts ties with the Gu family, and vows their downfall. She then rebuilds her life through a radio show and music career, rising to fame—before finally exposing the Gu family’s theft and hypocrisy at a public banquet.
6a2ff111892ba8194d06c91c.title: The Scapegoat's Revenge

6a2ff113892ba8194d06c922.synopsis: Harrison accidentally discovered a miniature kingdom inside the freezer of his ancestral home. The simple tools he casually used had ten-thousand-fold effects in that tiny world. So Harrison shuttled back and forth between the freezer and the real world, using modern technology to help the miniature kingdom overcome crisis after crisis—bringing enormous shock to that little world.
6a2ff113892ba8194d06c922.title: The Freezer's Tiny Kingdom

6a2ff11a892ba8194d06c934.synopsis: The true daughter of a royal manor was switched at birth and sold into a brothel. Sixteen years later, she returns — not to reclaim her family, but to take back everything that belongs to her. With sharp wit and ruthless resolve, she tears apart her enemies, restores her honor, and ultimately wins both power and love. A satisfying revenge drama.
6a2ff11a892ba8194d06c934.title: The Return of Brothel Heiress

6a2ff28e832bcd870e0c0526.synopsis: A celestial being with the power of a nine-tailed spirit fox is reborn as a mortal baby. To regain immortality, she must earn good karma through good deeds. Labeled a “demon child” by her father, she is unexpectedly understood by her mother, who can hear her thoughts. Together, they uncover the father’s betrayal and the mistress’s schemes, breaking free from abuse. In the end, the mother escapes, and the child rises as a blessed star through accumulated karma.
6a2ff28e832bcd870e0c0526.title: A Baby's Adventure and A Wife's Awakening

6a30e14dad1d799df4050b7c.synopsis: This is a satisfying revenge short drama with a rebirth theme, set in a wealthy family feud. The story opens with full-throttle conflict: heroine Lindsay, having been reborn, is only three days postpartum after a cesarean section when her ex-husband Cole breaks into the maternity center ward at midnight with his mistress Natalie. Joined by bribed staff, they attempt to forcibly take her child away. Unlike her weak and submissive self in the previous life, Lindsay now holds clear logic and a tough attitude. She stays sharp-witted throughout the ward confrontation, pressing forward with consecutive questions and forcing her opponents into a corner. She exposes the mistress's hypocritical "innocent" disguise on the spot, calls out the maternity center supervisor's biased favoritism, and confronts the powerful oppression of her wealthy ex-husband head-on. Every word strikes hard, with non-stop satisfying plot twists, perfectly shaping a contrasting heroine who is "physically weak but has an unbreakable spirit". It tells a revenge story of the heroine turning the tables against the odds, protecting her child and taking down the unfaithful man and his mistress.
6a30e14dad1d799df4050b7c.title: I Called the Police This Time

6a30e1d6396ceee7940b8a27.synopsis: In her past life, she was framed by her so-called "best friend" — the entire school believed she was the mistress of a professor, with fake intimate photos and explicit chat records as "irrefutable evidence." She couldn't defend herself until the moment she died, when she finally learned the truth: it was all a scheme by the fake friend and the predatory professor, designed to destroy her reputation and cost her a graduate school recommendation. Reborn, she chose revenge — by streaming everything live online, exposing her former friend's true colors to the world.
6a30e1d6396ceee7940b8a27.title: She Framed Me, I Went Live

6a31012dcaac24b17b08aa4f.synopsis: Elijah Greene is lead programmer at Gray Tech, the top tech company in the world. After he's unfairly sacked on Christmas Eve by the CEO's daughter, Samantha Gray, he's recruited by Ava Cross, a high-ranking employee at Gray Tech competitor Eagle Tech and also Elijah's ex-girlfriend. When Ava's attempts to hire Elijah are met with resistance by Elijah's resentful relatives and the evil, power-hungry Henderson family, Elijah and Ava join forces with the CEOs of Gray Tech and Eagle Tech to start their own company and take their rightful positions atop the tech industry.
6a31012dcaac24b17b08aa4f.title: How the Tech Genius Stole Back Christmas (updating)

6a31012f0a4db3ff73065e0f.synopsis: On mating night, Charlie is claimed by the Alpha and his Beta. By morning, she's publicly declared "unsatisfactory" and replaced. But when she discovers she can hear their private mind-link—and their chosen mate can't—the question becomes: if she was never meant for them, why is she the only one who feels the bond?
6a31012f0a4db3ff73065e0f.title: Mated to the Alpha and His Beta

6a31186c5bb161b53600a5e8.synopsis: Vivian, as the true Alpha Princess, decides to hide her identity and transfer schools after her awakened wolf powers spiral out of control. However, on the first day of school, she encounters a fake princess who is impersonating her identity. The fake princess constantly uses false privileges to bully Vivian, even attempting to steal her fiancé, Seth. In the end, Vivian successfully exposes the fake princess in front of everyone, ensuring that she receives the punishment she deserves.
6a31186c5bb161b53600a5e8.title: The True Alpha Princess

6a3269a9443351427f006ee7.synopsis: Nick Wilson wakes up 12 years in the future, married to his nemesis, father to a daughter he neglects, and a bankrupt CEO despised by all. After exposing the gold-digger who ruined him and reclaiming his stolen empire, he's now a devoted husband and fierce father. With old friends by his side, he rebuilds his business, crushes his enemies, and rewrites his disastrous fate — it's never too late to win at love and life.
6a3269a9443351427f006ee7.title: No More Mr. Wrong Guy

6a326e13ff13a4191b0a9f7d.synopsis: As the CEO of a billion-dollar empire, Arthur Sterling chose to live as a homeless ascetic during a ten-year mourning period for his late mother. Over this decade, he sponsored two impoverished students. He never expected one of them, Valerie Thorne, to be so obsessed with wealth and status. Despising his homeless appearance, she publicly humiliated him at her graduation banquet to curry favor with the elites. Only Clara Hayes, the other sponsored student, stepped up to defend him. Seeing Valerie Thorne's true colors, Arthur Sterling was deeply disappointed but incredibly grateful for Clara Hayes's loyalty. After reclaiming his position as CEO, he returned to put the ungrateful backstabber, Valerie Thorne, in her place, ensuring she paid the price she deserved.
6a326e13ff13a4191b0a9f7d.title: The Homeless Sponsor Is Actually a CEO

6a32d64da3959ea0d306be2f.synopsis: In Death Touch movie, Ivy was raised in a lab because her touch can kill — an ability she doesn’t understand and can’t control. Now, she’s been sent to a military high school to become the government’s greatest weapon. Xaden, the elite soldier forced to train her, hates that she’s replacing him. But as they grow closer, the one thing Ivy wants most—to be touched—might kill the only person who’s ever cared about her.
6a32d64da3959ea0d306be2f.title: Death Touch

6a33069240a92351870a1179.synopsis: Based on the novel by Monica Murphy. At an elite prep school ruled by legacy and power, Whit Lancaster is untouchable—dangerous, ruthless, and irresistibly magnetic. Then, a quiet outsider crashes into his path, and is faced with a dark bargain: Let him destroy her in private… or risk being ruined in public. In a game of power, desire, and secrets—who will break first?
6a33069240a92351870a1179.title: Things I Wanted to Say

6a33101c56c0faf2ce013299.synopsis: Grace, a high school princess and Colt, her family's groundskeeper, are deeply in love. However, when Colt learns he has only months to live, he decides he'll do anything to push her away -- to help her let him go. Admist the misunderstandings and heartbreaks, will Grace find out the truth in time, or will she lose the only boy she's loved to the cruel fate without having a chance to say goodbye?
6a33101c56c0faf2ce013299.title: Teach Me How to Say Goodbye

6a33149d4dd31b5f0506cc09.synopsis: In the King of War Tech movie, Wesley Creed, the King of War Tech, hides his identity in order to keep his dead squadmates' research alive, only to be treated like dirt. 3 years later, he's ready to reclaim his identity.
6a33149d4dd31b5f0506cc09.title: King of War Tech

6a331cd1d5cb2422d00af359.synopsis: In My X-Ray Vision Sees Right Through You movie, after his girlfriend dumps him, Eric, a luxury brand CEO with X-ray vision, uses his powers and confidence to bring down arrogant global influencer bullies, all while winning the heart of his high school's most popular girl.
6a331cd1d5cb2422d00af359.title: My X-Ray Vision Sees Right Through You

6a3321d8db2a78841b024cd9.synopsis: Based on the novel by Sarah Brianne. Elle's life is turned upside down when Nero, the untouchable bad boy, swoops in to save her from her school bully. One smile from him makes every girl swoon, Elle couldn't believe he wants her. Gazing into his eyes, she wonders if this notorious bad boy could be trusted... How was she to know that she was just a part of Nero's mission, as the heir to a Mafia Empire? As for Nero, he has somehow fallen head over heels for this girl who has no idea the danger she was in.
6a3321d8db2a78841b024cd9.title: Nero: Made Men

6a33501937b5748859084caf.synopsis: Aurora Hale was born an S-Class heiress — until the man she loved locked a poisoned collar around her neck, drained her power for seven years, then watched her family die and left her nailed to a wall. But death isn't the end. Aurora wakes up the night before the collar ever goes on, and this time she'll expose his lies. She'll tear off his mask, reclaim her crown, and rise as the Voltage Queen, while everyone who betrayed her watches their world burn.
6a33501937b5748859084caf.title: The Return of the Voltage Queen

6a3354ee297612d9e5048f39.synopsis: Nick Wilson wakes up 12 years in the future, married to his nemesis, father to a daughter he neglects, and a bankrupt CEO despised by all. After exposing the gold-digger who ruined him and reclaiming his stolen empire, he's now a devoted husband and fierce father. With old friends by his side, he rebuilds his business, crushes his enemies, and rewrites his disastrous fate — it's never too late to win at love and life.
6a3354ee297612d9e5048f39.title: No More Mr. Wrong Guy

6a338e275fc1c89a8f035c19.synopsis: Her stepmother sold her off for a dowry—but sent her to the wrong address. She ended up in a drugged lawyer's bed, fled in anger, and never looked back. Nine months later, she walks into his firm for a divorce lawyer. He's been searching for her ever since.
6a338e275fc1c89a8f035c19.title: The Lawyer She Slept With

6a338ee015d842418b016159.synopsis: Vivian Hayes, CEO of Phoenix Group, finally reunites with her long-lost twin sister, Quinn Sinclair, only to find she has endured years of abuse in her marriage. Stepping up to protect her, Vivian helps Quinn divorce her toxic husband and win custody of her daughter. With her sister's support, Quinn finally finds hope for a brighter future.
6a338ee015d842418b016159.title: Destined Twins

6a338f592bdafa728a074526.synopsis: In his past life, a man died from overwork. Reborn as a college junior, he gained an investment system — the higher his investment rating, the greater the returns. He invested in a female classmate who, ten years later, would transform completely and climb into the wealth rankings. After his rebirth, he invested in her and looked after her at every turn. Gradually, she fell in love with him.
6a338f592bdafa728a074526.title: I Invested in Her Future

6a338f5a2bdafa728a074529.synopsis: A general's daughter fights in war for her country. Returning in glory, she is betrayed by the emperor and her own cousin—her entire family destroyed. She survives and returns to the palace under a new identity, using forbidden charms to seduce the emperor, outsmart her enemies, and uncover deadly secrets. But a forbidden bond with a fool prince from the enemy kingdom complicates everything.
6a338f5a2bdafa728a074529.title: The Beauty's Trap

6a33d66edcc59097cc09327a.synopsis: My Pureblood husband won't touch me. He sleeps in my stepsister's wing. So I bought a wrecked half-blind mongrel Orc on a curb for five grand. By dawn, his bond mark was on my throat. By morning, three Highborn uncles were at my door. Turns out the "low-grade" Orc I just bought is the lost heir to an eight-hundred-million-dollar Drennan estate. And every relative in that house paid to disfigure his face when he was eight. They're about to find out what I do to people who hurt what's mine.
6a33d66edcc59097cc09327a.title: The Scarred Orc Who Bit Me First

6a38959bc4ca3d9ad205c4da.synopsis: Scarlett disappears after a one-night stand with wealthy heir Landon while she is on the run. Later, entrusted by her mentor, she returns as his grandson’s fiancée to help him become a qualified heir. What she never expected was that the man she is supposed to manage is actually Landon. Landon does not recognize that his fiancée is the mysterious woman from that unforgettable night. Instead, because he resents his grandmother’s arrangement, he treats Scarlett with hostility. In this life together under a mistaken identity, their relationship is caught between rejection and attraction, constantly pulling them closer while they struggle against each other.
6a38959bc4ca3d9ad205c4da.title: Don’t Mess with My Lethal Fiancée

6a3895a2df2f4387670975fa.synopsis: Ava is finally discharged from the mental institute after years of treatment, thanks to her therapy dog Luna. She is determined to live a happy, normal life in the suburbs and buy a new house for her new beginning, but her neighbors won't stop harrassing her. Ava keeps a tight grip over herself with her therapy dog's help, staying calm and collected in the face of constant harassment. Her neighbors won't stop, even threatening to kill Luna! Ava starts to slip, fighting back against her neighbors... After all, with an insanity plea, she can do whatever she wants in revenge...
6a3895a2df2f4387670975fa.title: You Might Be Bad, but I'm Worse

6a38974ee61df0783f0d075e.synopsis: Mia, a money-driven straight-A student, strikes a deal with Chase—the star quarterback of the school team who’s failing calculus and facing a competition ban—to get revenge on her cheating ex-boyfriend. She will tutor him to pull up his grades, while he pretends to be her boyfriend. Mia lays down strict ground rules: every physical touch comes with an extra charge. As they spend endless days studying together and putting on a fake couple act, undeniable chemistry blooms between them. Chase willingly pays extra for every intimate crossing of their boundaries, and Mia sees past his flashy, cocky exterior to the broken loneliness hidden deep inside him. Their contractual performance slowly blossoms into genuine affection, until their agreement is maliciously leaked, putting their budding love to the ultimate test.
6a38974ee61df0783f0d075e.title: Tutor for the Quarterback

6a390a35f7ae1d26f00331c5.synopsis: Elena, the daughter of the Lord of Yalkreon, ventures out in search of sacred tree sap to save her mother from a deadly ice curse. Along the way, she unexpectedly rescues Hades, King of the Underworld, who immediately decides to make her his queen. But Elena is betrayed by her fiancé, then forcibly sold as a sacrifice to the Lord of the Frostlands by her cruel stepmother and greedy father. Just as all hope is lost during the sacrificial ceremony, Hades descends in overwhelming force, punishes everyone who has wronged her, and takes her back to the Underworld under his protection.
6a390a35f7ae1d26f00331c5.title: Chained by Hades, the Underworld King

6a39e60d9206d01df60805df.synopsis: Given a second chance at life, orphan sisters Ivy and Poppy return to the day of their adoption. Remembering her tragic past, Poppy maliciously chooses the impoverished Jones family, believing playing the "poor girl" is the secret to winning the wealthy Lockwood heir's heart. Forced into the toxic Lockwood household, Ivy refuses to be a victim again. While Poppy relies on deception and manipulation to steal the life she covets, Ivy focuses on true independence, standing up to her bullies, and forging her own path. Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell is a gripping tale of resilience, self-reliance, and breaking toxic cycles.
6a39e60d9206d01df60805df.title: Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell

6a3a76742e8c28bfcc06a974.synopsis: When Veya and the hypocritical woman who brazenly interfered in her marriage were both poisoned, her husband and five-year-old son unhesitatingly gave the only antidote to the mistress. Reborn with the memory of her desperate and tragic death, Veya decided to sever this rotten marriage and launch a ruthless counterattack against the usurper and her betraying family.
6a3a76742e8c28bfcc06a974.title: No One Choose Me

6a3bad90b4b6b0605300f8cf.synopsis: Betrayed, drained, and slain by the Crown Princess in his past life, now, Cillian is reborn — and seizes the Crown Princess's Nether Power. Dismissed as a broken prince, he secretly wields the Omni Cauldron. Fifteen acupoints unlocked. Divine Seed condensed. His enemies fall before they understand. This life, he doesn't seek revenge — he seeks ashes. The dynasty will burn. The throne awaits. And beyond it, his true destiny.
6a3bad90b4b6b0605300f8cf.title: Reborn: I'm the Devourer

6a3d1836ade141bc9d0a7026.synopsis: Best friends Ella and Leah married the Harper brothers, firefighter Charles and doctor Noah. On their third anniversary, Charles’s first love locks Ella inside a burning room. When Ella begs Charles for help, he brushes her off to find his ex's cat. Leah rushes in to rescue Ella and calls Noah to save Ella and her baby, but is met with mockery. Heartbroken and betrayed after years of miserable marriages, the best friends decide to file for divorce from the Harper brothers together.
6a3d1836ade141bc9d0a7026.title: Brides in Smoke

6a3d730b0112aac7e20ddfff.synopsis: After Carl Oliver, The American Sniper and King of Guns, heroically dies saving a little boy named Spencer from a car explosion, his spirit is magically transferred into Spencer's 9 year old body. Now Carl, while inside the body of a 9 year old boy, must save his new family's gun range from unscrupulous relatives, evil rivals, and even deranged killers.
6a3d730b0112aac7e20ddfff.title: American Sniper: The Kid of Guns

6a3d9547091cd749a8093d65.synopsis: In Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten movie, Genius hacker Abby was the Governor's adoptive daughter, enduring years of abuse to help him seize power. Yet, right before her 18th birthday, her adoptive father sells her to a lecherous businessman for $5 million. In despair, she uses DNA matching to find her biological father—America's top tycoon, Dominic Mancini. Back in the lap of luxury, Abby not only inherits trillions but also has three elite adopted brothers, each a titan in his own right, to protect her. At her grand coming-of-age ceremony, Abby makes a magnificent return as the sole heir, publicly unmasking her adoptive family's cruelty and making those who once bullied her pay dearly. Reborn from the ashes, she will begin her brilliant life at the pinnacle of power.
6a3d9547091cd749a8093d65.title: Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten

6a3d980baaf954b86307ecc4.synopsis: In Rise of the Caged King movie, once a business elite, Silas is framed for murder by his rival Chase and his own wife Marina. Sentenced to 60 years, Silas endures brutal humiliation from prison bullies until he meets Grayson, a legendary mafia godfather in hiding. Grayson trains him in lethal combat and helps reduce his sentence in exchange for a future favor of revenge. Meanwhile, young Ella suffers Marina’s abuse while secretly discovering the truth: her mother’s affair and her father’s innocence. Three years later, Silas is released. He crashes Marina’s engagement party like a ghost from the past, ready to strike. Armed with a father’s love, he begins his war to reclaim his life and rescue his daughter from hell.
6a3d980baaf954b86307ecc4.title: Rise of the Caged King

6a3d99936928d9c1f409ed59.synopsis: After years of torment and abuse from her mafia family, Francesca Adolfi is given a second chance at life when she's sent back to age fourteen, the day she was brought back to her birth father. But this time, she's not going to make the same mistakes. This time, she chooses to ally herself with the Adolfi's disgraced eldest son, Enzo, and help him retake his place as heir. And by saving him, maybe Francesca can save herself too.
6a3d99936928d9c1f409ed59.title: Mafia Princess Returns

6a3ddc7b6c8a0267ae0408ca.synopsis: Aria risked her life to enter the brutal War Academy for her boyfriend, only to find him in the arms of another woman. Devastated and betrayed, a moment of reckless anger leads her into a dangerous encounter with Blaze Blackwood—the ruthless Alpha King and her academy's Chief Proctor. Unbeknownst to Aria, Blaze is also her cheating ex's formidable father. After a passionate and accidental night together, Aria is horrified to discover she is pregnant. Trapped in an elite academy where she is mocked as a "Wolfless Omega," Aria must survive deadly trials, jealous rivals, and the terrifying presence of the Alpha King who refuses to let her go. Will she succumb to the powerful pull between them, or will her hidden secrets and their forbidden connection destroy them both?
6a3ddc7b6c8a0267ae0408ca.title: Knocked Up by My Ex's Alpha Daddy

6a3e50f72620b17637021bb8.synopsis: Hyper-calculated top 10 tennis pro Adrian Vale believes absolute control is always possible—until he meets Luca Reyes, a wildly unpredictable rookie who plays purely on volatile instinct. Viewing Luca as an anomaly to be "solved," Adrian aggressively leverages his wealth and influence to bring the chaotic newcomer under his wing. Fiercely rebellious, Luca initially rejects him. However, mounting financial ruin and family troubles force Luca to accept the help, igniting an intense psychological tug-of-war that will push both men to their absolute breaking point.
6a3e50f72620b17637021bb8.title: Match Point

6a3f6334d0f8b4f17e00e2a2.synopsis: After his mother’s death, billionaire heir Vincent became reckless, cold, and impossible to control. But everything snaps when his father Arthur brings home a mysterious woman who looks exactly like Vincent’s late mother — and even gives her his mother’s priceless jewels. Convinced Evelyn is a manipulative gold digger, Vincent sets out to expose her. But inside an abandoned greenhouse wrapped in vines, he uncovers her darkest secret… and a dangerous attraction neither of them can resist.
6a3f6334d0f8b4f17e00e2a2.title: Tempted by My Step Son

6a436a53dd3183e90b0a24fd.synopsis: To win dignity for his people, commoner Clint awakens the Kung Fu Boost System —one day of training gifts him one year's power. Defying all odds, he rises from a nobody to the ultimate backbone of kung fu!
6a436a53dd3183e90b0a24fd.title: Rise of the Kung Fu King

6a43729bfd4df5cb34078482.synopsis: At Asgard Academy, underdog Elena is relentlessly bullied for her pathetically weak magic. Ice-cold, stoic Professor Cassius notices her for one thing. Her scent feels hauntingly familiar, and it inexplicably awakens his long-sealed curse mark. He offers her private tutoring as cover, helping her rein in her wildly unstable magic. Until he makes the shocking discovery...
6a43729bfd4df5cb34078482.title: The Professor’s Forbidden Dragon Prey

6a4387feb66c41e77c0b918d.synopsis: College student Luke Hayes gains a new superpower weekly. His first, a life countdown, helps him save Ashley Sinclair from suicide. Luke uses his shifting powers to crush the mastermind, winning both success and love.
6a4387feb66c41e77c0b918d.title: I Gain New Superpowers Every Week

6a438c92310497e68508c01d.synopsis: Six years ago, top lawyer Madeline met wealthy heir Nicholas at a masquerade ball and later gave birth to a clever daughter Isla. Her half-sister Vivienne stole keepsakes to pretend to be Nicholas's lover, coveting wealth and status. Later, Madeline worked at Nicholas's group and reunited with him. Romance bloomed between them amid constant workplace schemes and threats. Clues including a rare hereditary disease and identical birthmarks revealed the truth. Eventually, Vivienne's fraud was exposed. All misunderstandings were cleared up. Madeline and Nicholas chose each other, and the three lived a happy life together.
6a438c92310497e68508c01d.title: Wrong Heir, Right Her

6a447059145090621d0deffa.synopsis: Leo made Maisie the queen of Wall Street, only to be pushed off a roof by Maisie and Brad at his wedding to Maisie. When Leo opens his eyes again, he finds himself reborn in his college years. Living this life over, Leo swears to live only for himself, no more "Maisie's simp." He even finds someone new, the young heiress of the Hale family.
6a447059145090621d0deffa.title: The Simp Claps Back

6a447d9cf05c392bdd0adf8c.synopsis: I reborn the day I picked my beast mate, right after my jealous sister Lyra snatched the B-rank snake Voss I once married in my past life. She framed me to be exiled into deadly wilds, but I saved a wounded white lion no clan dared accept. Everyone mocks him rankless trash, until I bear two S-rank lion cubs. The priest uncovers his hidden S-rank blood, brands me the reborn Sacred Daughter. Lyra's fake saint dream crumbles with weak snake cubs, yet she screams I stole her glory. Who will pay for all her bloody betrayals?
6a447d9cf05c392bdd0adf8c.title: My S Rank Beast Mate

6a4491f1f5e3d358340e1e02.synopsis: Sunny star quarterback Seth hides a love-starved heart behind his perfect facade. When violent ex-linebacker "Mad Dog" Matthew transfers into his team and becomes his forced roommate, their explosive fights bleed into charged, unbearable tension. Seth falls hard, until he spots his rival Ethan's birthday carved into Matthew’s necklace, convinced he's just a stand-in...
6a4491f1f5e3d358340e1e02.title: Blitzed by My Rival's Obsession

6a44c5b20d88d645ea03d86c.synopsis: Seraphina and I both died once. In my last life, she stole my face, pretended to be the Oracle, and was exposed by the king. Then she poisoned me in the dungeon, screaming that I had stolen her fate. When we were reborn, she changed her plan. In front of the royal proclamation, she pointed at me and sent me to the palace, certain the fake Oracle would be executed. But I was never fake. I was the true Oracle, and this time, I would make the king kneel before the future she tried to steal.
6a44c5b20d88d645ea03d86c.title: The Sister Who Stole My Fate

6a45c77e2fdd0135260e2dea.synopsis: Alex Carter is humiliated when his girlfriend Eva dumps him on a livestream for Brandon, a flashy rich boy with a Lamborghini. But at his lowest moment, a mysterious system binds itself to Leah, his sharp-tongued roommate and luxury real estate agent. Every emotional reaction she has because of Alex triggers huge rewards. With Leah by his side, Alex buys a McLaren, luxury properties, rare gems, a nightclub and casino shares. As Eva regrets leaving too soon and Brandon's fake wealth collapses, Alex rises from broke delivery driver to capital power player.
6a45c77e2fdd0135260e2dea.title: The Day You Dumped Me, I Became a Millionaire

6a45ca9165c2edd565082039.synopsis: I called 911 because I accidentally handcuffed myself to my bed. I expected a locksmith. Instead, my ex-boyfriend kicked down my door—with three firefighters behind him. He thinks another man tied me up and abandoned me. Then I blurt out, "No, I didn't use protection." Now he's furious, jealous, and refusing to believe the truth. My biggest embarrassment just became his biggest misunderstanding... and neither of us is ready for what comes next.
6a45ca9165c2edd565082039.title: My Hot Firefighter Ex-Boyfriend

6a45ccbcd0d3ada53d0ec66d.synopsis: On the night before her eighteenth birthday, Mara Scott is searched in public, stripped of her ID, and locked inside an abandoned gym by the boy she once loved. They think they’re silencing her—but Mara has already lived this night once before. In her previous life, she tried to stop them from attending a party, only to be framed for a horrific crime, murdered, and forced to watch her parents die in a fire. Reborn with a second chance, Mara says nothing. Instead, she secretly records everything and lets the night unfold. This time, when the sun rises, the truth will be impossible to bury—and everyone who betrayed her will face the consequences.
6a45ccbcd0d3ada53d0ec66d.title: You Never Saw Me

6a45ccbe1a807de4160b433b.synopsis: Ava Lin’s Manhattan wedding turns into a nightmare when a voice from three years in the future warns her not to marry Ryan Hall. Her groom has secretly registered a marriage with her best friend, Mia Chen, who is already pregnant with his child. In the original timeline, Ava was framed as unstable, stripped of her career and trust, and forced into psychiatric evaluation. This time, she refuses to break down for their cameras. Guided by her future self, Ava gathers marriage records, recordings, legal proof, and the hidden safeguards left by her parents. As Ryan, Mia, and the powerful Hall family try to silence her and seize control of her inheritance, Ava turns the fake wedding into a public reckoning, exposes their fraud, freezes the Hall Group’s IPO, and finally saves herself from the future that once destroyed her.
6a45ccbe1a807de4160b433b.title: Don't say I do

6a45cd5d6a8c4720d70d7bf9.synopsis: Aria Vale spent three years pretending to be the perfect housewife for Damon Crawford, the man who thought he built his Wall Street empire alone. Then he brought home a mistress and demanded an open marriage. Aria smiled and said yes. One call later, New York’s richest men were at her feet, ruthless Kade Ashford claimed her in public, and every hidden Vale dollar vanished from Damon’s company. By the time he learned his “boring wife” was the heiress funding him, bankruptcy, divorce, and lifelong regret were already waiting.
6a45cd5d6a8c4720d70d7bf9.title: The Housewife He Threw Away Is a Billionaire

6a45d01328354989cc0a6e09.synopsis: Murdered by her family, billionaire Kay Fuller is reborn as a nobody actress, Karina. She once paid $30 million for a sham marriage to Wilbur. Devastated by her death, Wilbur discovers Karina's true identity and vows to win her back. As Karina, she destroys scumbags, takes down her enemies, and rises to stardom. Clearing up past misunderstandings, Wilbur and Kay finally confess their love.
6a45d01328354989cc0a6e09.title: Love Found Her After She Died

6a469b12d3f5c65f7f095b8a.synopsis: To Jason, Tessa was only a disposable practice run for the girl he actually wanted. After the blood on the sheets became a public trophy and her dignity a ghost, young Tessa finally stops trying to mend the shards. She is done with her first love. She is leaving him behind for a future that doesn't taste like salt and shame. But at the edge of the wreckage stands the one person who shouldn’t be there: another boy with no intention of letting her go alone.
6a469b12d3f5c65f7f095b8a.title: You've Been Replaced, First Love

6a471408082122dc360d635c.synopsis: Stella was LA royalty until her father's fraud charge ended in suicide, and her fiancé left. She spite-seduced his uncle, billionaire Nicholas. Her mother's stroke sent her back; he put her to work at his bar. Contract became closeness, closeness became taboo love, and a pregnancy raised the stakes. His probe into her father's death exposed a plot aimed at the Archer empire.
6a471408082122dc360d635c.title: Your Uncle Is Obsessed with Me

6a475fdf9f947b4b4a08677a.synopsis: Jennifer, a celebrated Best Actress, was killed in a fire at an awards ceremony in her past life — a plot masterminded by her scumbag boyfriend Aidan and her backstabbing best friend Beatrice. Reborn on the very night she was supposed to elope with Aidan, she resolutely dumps the worthless man and boldly pursues Cassian, a paranoid and domineering CEO. She gives both the sanctimonious hypocrite and the scumbag a taste of their own medicine, dishing out ruthless retribution. Furthermore, during a life-or-death showdown aboard a luxury cruise ship, her shocking secret lineage — granddaughter of a powerful mafia kingpin — is unveiled. Ultimately, she and her beloved share a fully reciprocated, deeply devoted love, and their story culminates in a warm, perfect proposal.
6a475fdf9f947b4b4a08677a.title: Second Chance With My Mr.CEO

6a4a1e217879c28b1103d650.synopsis: Reborn on the Empire’s Matching Day, S-Class Guide Veda refuses to repeat her tragic fate. In her past life, she sacrificed five years of her power for Dane, only to be abandoned to die for another woman. This time, she rejects their 90% match and chooses Ryker, the Empire’s feared SSS-Class commander with a perfect 100% bond. As their legendary connection awakens, Veda exposes Dane and Vera’s betrayal while helping Ryker conquer his madness. When Dane remembers his past life, it’s already too late. Bound forever, Veda and Ryker rewrite destiny, and find the love they were always meant to share.
6a4a1e217879c28b1103d650.title: Fated to the Feral Lion

6a4a1e227879c28b1103d653.synopsis: Mara Quinn agrees when her amnesiac Alpha husband asks for divorce. Rowan Hale has forgotten their marriage, but not his body's reaction to her: one collision at the clerk's office and he wants to court her "properly, with marriage as the goal." Mara tries a gentle cat orc, yet only Rowan can make her burn. During rut, the strongest Apex commander cuffs himself and gives her the key, proving he can stop when she says stop. When his memories return, the truth hits: he chose Mara before, and without memories, chose her again.
6a4a1e227879c28b1103d653.title: Dumped by My Amnesiac Wolf Alpha

6a4bde37cdb434b20e085b0a.synopsis: Clara fakes amnesia to test her boyfriend—only to catch him cheating and watch him toss her aside for his best friend, Ethan. Big mistake. For the ultimate payback, Clara starts fake-dating Ethan to drive her ex insane with jealousy. But what happens when Ethan’s fake kisses start to feel dangerously real?
6a4bde37cdb434b20e085b0a.title: Faking It with My Ex's Best Friend

6a4c5d39cc86de7d8509ed0a.synopsis: Maeve is a defective Omega with no Wolf Spirit, a slum scavenger who once trusted her toxic friend Faye, swallowed wolfsbane, lost her unborn child, and died in flames set by Knox’s noble first love, Blair. Reborn on the night Alpha King Knox seeks her as the cure to his dark curse, Maeve hears the fierce little voice of her unborn telepathic pup and finally makes the smart choice: accept the Moonstones, the black card, and her place inside the Pack House. With her pup warning her of every trap, Maeve trains, wins the Queen Mother’s heart, exposes Faye and Blair, proves her child is pureblood, and rises from rejected Omega to Luna Queen.
6a4c5d39cc86de7d8509ed0a.title: My Telepathic Pup Made Me Luna

6a4c5d3bdf67096a3205139c.synopsis: My scholar husband Edmund sold me for 300 bucks to hunter Rowan, a cruel fate every village woman feared. I waited for brutal mistreatment, but he brought wild flowers, stewed chicken and swore to give me time. My greedy in-laws sneaked in at night, beat me and stole his rare white pheasants, ruining Edmund’s exam future. Broken-handed, drunk and drowning, he begged for forgiveness at our grand wedding. Yet I held Rowan’s hand—this contracted wife finally earned a real, warm marriage of my own.
6a4c5d3bdf67096a3205139c.title: Trapped by the Hunter

6a4c5d3dc2d6e00a6300278b.synopsis: Ava Hart once used her family fortune and connections to build Ethan Black’s empire, only to be betrayed on their wedding anniversary when he drugs her, steals her assets, and sends her to the underground Black Rose auction as revenge for humiliating his lover, Serena. Bound onstage and priced piece by piece before powerful criminals, Ava secretly activates the emergency chip hidden in her wedding ring, unlocking the Hart family’s protection clause and a $20 billion trust. When Adrian Cross, the man she once left behind, storms the island to save her, Ava refuses to simply escape. She buys out the entire auction, gathers every record, destroys Ethan’s company, dismantles the Black Rose exchange, and sends both Ethan and Serena to prison. Years later, Ava stands as a powerful investor in her own right, no longer anyone’s wife, prize, or property.
6a4c5d3dc2d6e00a6300278b.title: My Husband Auctioned Me Off

6a4c5f016de432c9700fa3e9.synopsis: Scorned by her husband, Kate drowns her sorrows in a bar—and wakes up next to a gorgeous escort named Felix. She pays him off. He won't let it go. When he shows up at her door, she offers a deal: "How much?" But Felix isn't just any gigolo—he's a billionaire duke in disguise. Soon she's riding private jets, dripping in jewels, and watching her cheating ex get publicly destroyed. Then comes the pregnancy—and her ex's desperate plea for forgiveness. Now Kate must choose: the gilded cage of marriage, or the wild, impossible truth of a love she never saw coming. Too bad Felix isn't giving her a choice. The ultimate showdown between two worlds is about to begin.
