Tormented by his own pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha, and older brother's best friend, Dalton. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.
6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.title: Fated to His Brother's Alpha

6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.synopsis: “It’s just a formality.” Reynolds threw those words in Eliot’s face on their wedding day, leaving him behind to greet his comrade. Four years of lies, another Alpha’s scent on Reynolds’ skin.Eliot didn’t cry. He ripped off his ring, threw it at Reynolds’ feet, and walked into the hall across.Vaughn had been waiting there for four years. White roses. Starlight lamps. A ring he’d kept since they were kids. He spent four years climbing four ranks just to rewrite the law that locked Omegas out of the mech bay. He never told Eliot. He just pried the door open and waited.
6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.title: The Alpha Commander’s Long-Awaited Omega

6a6849207434a5b9ed0f8048.synopsis: Lyric, an Alpha’s scarred and wolf-less daughter, was betrayed by her mate and exiled after a one-night stand with a powerful stranger. Five years in the human world cured her face and awakened a forbidden gift: she is a "Siphon," able to absorb any disease. Forced back by family debt, Lyric enters a contract marriage with the ruthless King Jaris—only to realize he was her one-night stranger. Misled by his scheming "wife" Marta into believing Lyric betrayed him, Jaris is cruel by day, yet so obsessed with her body that he drugs her by night for secret intimacy, leaving Lyric believing it’s all a vivid dream. But the secrets run deeper: Lyric’s presumed-dead twins are alive, stolen by Marta to claim the throne. And from the shadows, Jaris’s exiled brother Caden is returning with a blood-drinking army to burn it all down.
6a6849207434a5b9ed0f8048.title: The Rise of the Ugly Luna

6a6849227434a5b9ed0f804b.synopsis: Eileen Carter was once a gifted dancer and heiress, but after her family collapsed, she gave up everything to secretly support Theo through law school. Years later, he repays her with humiliation, betrayal, a fake mistress, and a divorce agreement. When his cruelty costs Eileen her stage and nearly her life, she stops explaining, stops waiting, and starts rebuilding. With Noah by her side, she exposes every lie, protects girls like her, and proves that even a broken dancer can still command the spotlight.
6a6849227434a5b9ed0f804b.title: Dance of the Broken

6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.synopsis: At Waverly University, the ice rink is split in two: on one side, the hockey team trains with brutal intensity; on the other, the figure skating team glides through elegant routines. Abby Williams is the golden girl of the ballet-on-ice program — obedient, disciplined, and desperate to land the lead role of the Black Swan in the Winter Showcase. There's just one problem: she has no idea how to be "bad." Enter Tristan Beaumont, the university's most notorious playboy and captain of the hockey team — reckless, magnetic, and hiding a devastating secret behind his bad-boy reputation. When Abby asks him to teach her how to unleash her dark side, neither of them expects what happens next: a forbidden attraction neither can control. Standing between them is Taylor Beaumont, Tristan's younger brother — Abby's skating partner, her best friend, and the "good" Beaumont everyone expects her to choose. As rumors, sabotage, and a jealous rival threaten to destroy everything Abby has worked for, she must decide who she really wants — and who she's willing to fight for. Torn between two brothers, a forbidden romance, and the role of a lifetime, Abby will learn that becoming the Black Swan means learning to stop following the rules — and start listening to her heart.
6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.title: Offside with the Hockey Star

6a695cfbe05b3907da0c851a.synopsis: Framed for destroying his family, Grace endures five years as a servant in her own husband's home—despised, replaced, punished for refusing to lie. No one knows she's dying, and carrying his child. By the time James reads her letter, it's too late.
6a695cfbe05b3907da0c851a.title: I Left Him a Letter, Not a Goodbye

6a6961979c32db374502042c.synopsis: Reborn as a serpent outcast, Aurelia is sent to a frozen wasteland as a sacrifice. After a mysterious encounter, she returns with a shocking secret that turns the entire kingdom upside down.
6a6961979c32db374502042c.title: The Serpent Queen's Rebirth

6a6964532c99fcb36e0f17bb.synopsis: The heir of a wealthy family, Lucas, voluntarily went to prison to overthrow his half brother. His fiancée abandoned him and went to live with his half brother. After being released from prison, he concealed his wealthy identity and entered into a contractual marriage with the orphaned girl, Ava. Gradually, true feelings developed between them. Ava discovered that she was the long-lost heiress of a rich family. When her old enemies came after her, Lucas revealed his true identity and embarked on a desperate revenge to help her.
6a6964532c99fcb36e0f17bb.title: The Double Life of My Ex-Con Husband

6a6971a0e0753757f40f04d0.synopsis: Betrayed by his fiancée, a poor farmer storms into Steelhaven to uncover the truth. After saving a tycoon’s daughter and facing humiliation, he vows to start over. With nothing but courage, he rises from a laborer to a billionaire legend.
6a6971a0e0753757f40f04d0.title: Rise of a Tycoon

6a6971a2d8c89204f10212bb.synopsis: Mother's mysterious death, stepmother's deadly conspiracy, hateful brother... Thomas decides to pose as a wastrel to fool everyone. But his father hires Harper, a bodyguard known as the God of Slaughter, to protect him. Now, who'll outsmart whom?
6a6971a2d8c89204f10212bb.title: The Wastrel & The Assassin

6a6975bf5d8851c89d0fcc8d.synopsis: Sophie grew up in an orphanage and was adopted by the wealthy Johnson family at the age of six. She spent twelve happy years under the love of her three elder brothers and adoptive parents. However, when her adoptive parents' biological daughter, Camille, returned, Sophie fell from being the cherished gem to a misunderstood and hurt outsider. Camille maneuvered step by step, constantly framing Sophie, while the family chose to listen selectively, and the repeated coldness and hurt left her disheartened. Sophie decided to become the first volunteer for her elder brother's 'Sleep Project,' which had been planned for five years, repaying her adoptive parents’ kindness through a life experiment. On her eighteenth birthday, she severed all ties with her family, entered the sleep chamber alone, and donated her corneas to her blind second brother. When she awoke after thirty years of slumber, her family had grown old, but she could no longer remember them—leaving only that misplaced familial affection, etched as an eternal regret through the river of time.
6a6975bf5d8851c89d0fcc8d.title: My Freeze. Their Tears. No Forgiveness

6a697704372818095101b114.synopsis: Mother's mysterious death, stepmother's deadly conspiracy, hateful brother... Thomas decides to pose as a wastrel to fool everyone. But his father hires Harper, a bodyguard known as the God of Slaughter, to protect him. Now, who'll outsmart whom?
6a697704372818095101b114.title: The Wastrel & The Assassin

6a69770603f1d48a7a07723e.synopsis: Betrayed by his fiancée, a poor farmer storms into Steelhaven to uncover the truth. After saving a tycoon’s daughter and facing humiliation, he vows to start over. With nothing but courage, he rises from a laborer to a billionaire legend.
6a69770603f1d48a7a07723e.title: Rise of a Tycoon

6a69928e1c117e13980f9f41.synopsis: After three years of fighting on the northern front, legendary dragon rider Kalen Gerard returns home, ready to marry the woman he has loved for years. Instead, he finds his castle occupied, his fiancée pregnant with another man's child, and his family legacy stolen by a shameless usurper. Branded a worthless nobody, Kalen is ordered to give up his title, his home, and even raise his fiancée's illegitimate child. But no one knows the truth—he is the kingdom's greatest war hero, the man who slew the Black Dragon and saved humanity.
6a69928e1c117e13980f9f41.title: The Betrayed Demi-God Reclaims Everything

6a69994b1e93a53dfc0ca73e.synopsis: Clara takes the fall for her family's favored adopted daughter, and spends years behind bars. The day she walks free, she makes a devastating discovery. Every song, script and business plans she's ever created has been stolen by her own family. They've disowned her completely. No more begging for love. No more playing nice. With her raw, buried talent, she’s fighting back to reclaim everything. And they will pay.
6a69994b1e93a53dfc0ca73e.title: Rising from theAshes, I Cut All Blood Ties

6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.synopsis: Bankrupt heiress Isolde signs a three-year mistress contract with Savien Thorne, heir to the Thorn Group, just to cover her mother’s life-saving medical bills. The second the contract ends, she’s ready to walk away for good. Until she finds out she’s pregnant. His arranged fiancée learns the secret, and torments her at every turn. Worse — she’s never been anything but a double for the other woman. She moves out and cuts all ties. But he’s not letting her get away.
6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.title: His Caged Love

6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.synopsis: Ethan Cole, a top-tier aviation legend in his previous life, dies as a national aviation legend. He is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. Only this time, he knows the truth: Flight 8236 is going to crash, and everyone on board will die. At 9,000 meters above sea level, fire begins to burn along the wings. The fuselage cracks open into freezing air. As panic spreads across the cabin, Ethan realizes he is the only one who understands what is coming. Trapped in a child’s body, he must stop the disaster and save his father—the man he loves most—before it is too late.
6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.title: The Eight-Year-Old Captain

6a69bbba1893284da90e5a36.synopsis: Joelle believed her husband wanted nothing more than to get rid of her. He demanded divorce again and again, flaunted a pregnant mistress, and even drugged her before sending her back to the ex she once loved. Only after her tragic death did she learn the truth. There was never another woman. Every betrayal was a lie, every cruel word a performance, because Sutton was dying of terminal cancer and wanted her to hate him before he was gone. Reborn on the day he asked for their ninety-ninth divorce, Joelle refuses to let the man who loved her more than his own life sacrifice everything again. This time, she's determined to rewrite their ending before it's too late.
6a69bbba1893284da90e5a36.title: 99 Divorces, Then My Husband Died for Me

6a69bbbb1893284da90e5a39.synopsis: Chloe freezes to death after giving her last food to the husband and son she thinks are trapped in a deadly blizzard. But as her soul leaves the storage room, she sees the truth: there was no disaster, only a cruel punishment staged by her husband, brother, son, and the fake heiress they all protected. While they feast upstairs and call her a liar, Chloe's body becomes the evidence that exposes every betrayal and drags the whole family into ruin.
6a69bbbb1893284da90e5a39.title: Frozen by the Man She Loved

6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.synopsis: A gifted contract mage, Layla, spent her past life collecting ninety-nine sacred cores to help her contracted beast, the Sacred Whale Neil, take human form—only to have Neil pierce her heart and push her into the Bloodtide Trench the moment he transformed. Reborn on the day of the contract ceremony, Layla abandons the Sacred Whale and chooses a dying little spirit snake instead. Neil, now in human form, teams up with her sister Evelyn to humiliate her, but the little snake turns out to be Poseidon, the Sea Emperor. As past betrayals and old wounds resurface, Neil kneels in regret—too late. Only Poseidon stands by her side. This time, Layla will never waste herself on the unworthy again, and finally learns to live for herself.
6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.title: After the Sacred Whale Betrayed Me, I Contracted Poseidon

6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.synopsis: To discover who truly loves them, wealthy couple Hannah and her husband fake bankruptcy, with him pretending to be paralyzed after a stroke. Their test exposes the truth: their biological son Thomas and his wife refuse to help and turn them away, while adopted son Theo and his wife give up everything to save him. After learning the truth, Hannah and her husband leave their $50 million fortune to Theo. Thomas loses everything and finally realizes that true family is built on love, not blood.
6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.title: The Billionaire Parents' Final Test

6a6adc4372e65640410ab2a3.synopsis: I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence.I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence. Everyone here wields real power — vampires, werewolves, dragon clan, witches — while I survive on street performer tricks and sleight of hand. If I'm exposed, what awaits me is worse than death. But I had to come: my sister died here. The academy called it an "accident." I know better — her killer is somewhere on these grounds. I kept my head down, stayed invisible. It wasn't enough. The blood heir, the wolf clan's little prince… the most powerful men in this academy are closing in on me one by one, marking me, declaring in front of everyone: "You're mine." Are they falling for me — or have they already uncovered my secret?
6a6adc4372e65640410ab2a3.title: Fake Witch Claimed by Two Heirs

6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.synopsis: No mate, no wolf, and raising a pup alone, Ella never expected one act of kindness to tie her fate to Alpha Torin, who is cursed to never touch a woman. When she becomes the wet nurse to his newborn heir, Ella is pulled into a deadly game of jealousy and betrayal inside the Alpha's keep.
6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.title: Thirsty for the Wet Nurse

6a6b01dc39f964ed56043895.synopsis: Three years ago, rising star Danny lost everything after being betrayed by the two people he trusted most. Everyone believed he was gone for good. Now he's back with a new identity and a carefully planned revenge. His target? The ex-lover who destroyed his life and the best friend who helped cover it up. But things take an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with Allen, the younger brother of the man he hates most. What starts as a dangerous game soon becomes something neither of them can control. As old secrets resurface and feelings grow stronger, Danny must decide, finish his revenge, or risk everything for the one person he never meant to love.
6a6b01dc39f964ed56043895.title: Revenge in My Ex's Brother's Bed

6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.synopsis: After surviving a month of kidnapping and torture, Claire returns home with severe PTSD, only to be misunderstood and humiliated by her brother Maxwell and her family. As her trauma becomes impossible to ignore, Maxwell begins to doubt his judgment — but when Claire gives up on ten years of love and walks away, he finally realizes the truth was never what he believed.
6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.title: Once Love Is Lost, It Never Returns

6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.synopsis: I lied about my age and ghosted my clingy online boyfriend half a year ago. Staying at my best friend’s house for break, I froze—her cold, CEO older brother Rhys was exactly the man I dumped online. He recognized me just by my voice and kept testing me nonstop. Later at a bar, he chugged eight drinks to shield me from a creep guy who drugged me. Trapped in his car, he recited every fake detail I told him online, staring at me: “Did you ever regret leaving me?”
6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.title: The Cold CEO Who Spoiled Me Online

6a6ff241989753f010020609.synopsis: Born with super strength, Dorin hid her martial arts talent since women were barred from martial arts. When Sky City and the Mann family were in danger, only Dorin could fight for them. Tricked into destroying her powers to save her kin, she watched them perish. Saved and healed by a master, Dorin returns for revenge.
6a6ff241989753f010020609.title: The Forbidden Fist

6a6ff2460c2b5e76730af127.synopsis: Natalie uncovers a shocking betrayal after her mother is bullied at the plaza. The mastermind's backer turns out to be her own husband. Facing family, lies, and betrayal, Natalie vows to expose the truth and make them pay.
6a6ff2460c2b5e76730af127.title: Nobody Hurts My Mother

6a6ff71e2cf525542e0730f1.synopsis: Head over heels for Preston, the Principal's son, Mia has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with the rich heiress Vivian Walden, Mia hatches a grand escape plan with Preston's opportunistic mother. Will Preston capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Sebastian, the mysterious royal boy from London get Mia's love?
6a6ff71e2cf525542e0730f1.title: My Royal Rebound

6a7002bdf1b7555be101d640.synopsis: Nia, an ordinary 18-year-old, goes viral overnight after posting a video exposing injustice at her school — only to be maliciously re-edited and mobbed online by a top Beverly Hills influencer dynasty. As hidden-camera footage, deepfakes and long-buried dirt surface one piece at a time, she discovers that her school, a PR firm and a wealthy family are jointly weaving an enormous campaign of public deception. To protect her family and find the truth, Nia joins forces with Jax, a rich-kid documentary director, to fight back — only to find that everyone is hiding something, herself included. When the truth can only be told to the world on a live stream, she must decide: stay silent, or bet everything and expose everyone for who they really are.
6a7002bdf1b7555be101d640.title: DRAMA IN HD

6a7002db07b37ca2420bcffe.synopsis: Sebastian Vale, founder and CEO of Vale Tech, was once the son of mafia boss Carmine Rossi. Twenty-five years ago, to escape his family's criminal destiny, he broke with his father, changed his name, built a world-leading technology company from nothing and developed an AI system powerful enough to change the world. But just as the company nears a major breakthrough, Sebastian walks in on his wife and co-founder Claire in a compromising moment with his close friend and COO, Marco, and his marriage collapses. At the same time, the AI system he built spins out of control: power grids, hospitals, transport and aviation fail one after another across the globe, plunging the world into an unprecedented crisis — and every finger points at him. Just as the board prepares to remove him and the world casts him as the villain, the mafia father who vanished twenty-five years ago suddenly reappears and reveals a long-buried truth: it was not his father who betrayed the family, but his mother. And the man who engineered the entire conspiracy to seize control of the company is Sebastian's half-brother — Marco. To take the life he believes should have been his, Marco exploits a bloodline loophole to breach the AI system, steals the company's assets, kidnaps Claire and sets out to destroy Sebastian's business, family and faith entirely. Facing a global crisis, a brother's revenge and old family blood debts, Sebastian must confront his mafia heritage, fight alongside his father to rescue his wife and stop the AI catastrophe, and make a final choice between revenge and justice. Yet just when everything seems settled, the mother who disappeared twenty-five years ago appears at the wedding and reveals an even bigger secret behind it all, leaving Sebastian once again at the crossroads of his family's fate. The true war of the mafia family has only just begun.
6a7002db07b37ca2420bcffe.title: Mafia Son: Unbroken By Betrayal

6a70066482066d772d0cdba1.synopsis: Seventeen‑year‑old Stella moves into a wealthy coastal mansion after her mother remarries, where she meets Vincent, her cold, sharp‑tongued step‑brother. Behind his elite heir image, Vincent dominates the competitive surfing circle—possessive and starved for love. They clash fiercely at first, but living under the same roof, quiet curiosity grows into a silent, undeniable bond. He teases her openly, yet fiercely protects her—and she slowly falls for his exclusive affection. When betrayal leaves Stella shattered, Vincent is the only one who stays. At a surfing competition, he's injured by rivals. Stella steps in and wins to protect his honor. He later risks everything to shield her. Breaking every rule as nominal step‑siblings, they begin a forbidden romance—distant in public, intensely intimate in private.
6a70066482066d772d0cdba1.title: Forbidden Love: Brother’s Cage

6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.synopsis: In I’m Pregnant It’s Not Yours movie, husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.
6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.title: I’m Pregnant, It’s Not Yours

6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.synopsis: Evelyn, a senior purser at Atlantic Airways, is reborn with intact memories of her previous life. Drawing on her foreknowledge, she sees through the deadly murder plot hatched by her husband and her trusted best friend. At an altitude of 30,000 feet, she turns the tide against all odds and saves the heir to the Sterling family. After being wrongfully framed and later fully exonerated, she secures the patronage of the Sterling family and is parachuted into the airline’s corporate headquarters. Leveraging her elite risk management expertise, she dismantles the conspiracies of her long-standing career arch-rivals, and ultimately ascends to the absolute pinnacle of power in the aviation industry.
6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.title: Reborn: A Flight Attendant Counterattack

6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.synopsis: For ten years, janitor Maya scrimps and saves while raising her daughter Lily almost entirely on her own—only to discover that her husband, Adrian, is actually a multimillionaire who has lavished all his love and affection on his first love and her son. Completely heartbroken, Maya leaves with Lily. She is later revealed to be the daughter of a fallen war hero, and after reclaiming her true identity, she becomes the long-lost beloved heiress of the powerful Harrington family. When Adrian loses his business, his family, and the wife and daughter he took for granted, he falls to his knees and begs for forgiveness. Lily gives him only one final answer: “Daddy, we’re done.”
6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.title: Daddy We're Done

6a701ec0e75af274da07241f.synopsis: Once the strongest rope guide of the Sacred Mountain, Evelyn was framed after an avalanche by the beloved Saintess Celeste, who claimed Evelyn cut the rescue rope and left her crippled. Her fiancé, Duke Adrian, believed the lie. For three years, Evelyn knelt on frozen steps to pay for her brother Noah’s medicine and keep the orphanage alive. On the final step, Adrian orders her to kneel and lick Celeste’s boots. Then a black raven arrives with Noah’s death notice. With nothing left to lose, Evelyn tears up the atonement contract and drags the Saintess’s perfect lie into the light.
6a701ec0e75af274da07241f.title: He Made Me Kneel Before the Fake Saintess

6a701ec2e75af274da072422.synopsis: After losing her sight saving Darion, Elara believes eight years of love will end in marriage. But when her vision returns, she discovers he is using her blindness to cheat with Cassia and planning to skip their wedding while another man stands in for him. Instead of breaking down at the altar, Elara exposes him before every noble, summons the man who loved her in silence, and turns her stolen wedding into Darion’s public ruin.
6a701ec2e75af274da072422.title: Marrying the Dragon Lord He Mocked

6a702ff9bfebe859c8010184.synopsis: Olivia, an art student harboring a secret crush on a star hockey player, accidentally stumbles upon the shocking truth: Liam, the campus playboy, is secretly an anonymous adult content creator. To keep his secret safe, the two enter into a dangerous "fake dating" pact. As they navigate endless teasing, power struggles, and joint battles against campus bullying and malicious schemes, their pretend romance begins to blur into real passion. However, just as they finally face their true feelings for each other, a deadly blackmail scheme threatens to destroy everything Liam holds dear...
6a702ff9bfebe859c8010184.title: Puck Perfect: My Sex Education Tutor

6a7047879dbba6268204e157.synopsis: Sera, the scorned Siren princess of Atlantis, is forced by fate to serve Ares ninety-nine times for an old rescue. The war god thinks she is a shameless worshipper, making her dance on bleeding feet, crawl before Aphrodite, and nearly drown for a false crime. But every humiliation cracks the contract. When Sera finally repays the debt, she returns to the deep sea as royalty. Only then does Ares learn she was his true savior, his obsession, and the princess he can never own again.
6a7047879dbba6268204e157.title: 99 Cracks：The Scorned Siren’s Final Goodbye

6a7047889dbba6268204e15a.synopsis: Isabella believed Salvatore was the man who saved her. He killed her abusive father, built a mafia empire for her, and swore there would be no divorce, only death. Then she uncovered 1,800 photos of another woman. When the mistress stole everything she had bled to protect, Isabella fought back with blood instead. But exposing his betrayal uncovers an even crueler truth. The child she lost, the family they dreamed of, and the marriage she died to protect were all destroyed by the man she loved most.
6a7047889dbba6268204e15a.title: The Mafia Wife's Revenge

6a70478a9dbba6268204e15d.synopsis: Her family threw Nova to the zombies, calling her a useless waste. They didn't know their powers all came from her. Within five hundred meters of Nova, they were heroes. Without her, they were nothing. Left to die, Nova's ability awakened. She took back everything she gave. Now her family stands defenseless in a sea of zombies, watching Nova walk through the horde untouched.She made all zombies kneel. They wanted a sacrifice. However. it was late.
6a70478a9dbba6268204e15d.title: They Fed Me to the Zombies, Not Knowing I Was Their Power

6a70478c9dbba6268204e160.synopsis: Vince buried his past with Dante, the mob heir who vanished five years ago. When Dante returns, he's still reckless, still devastating, still determined to win Vince back. But Leo, the fragile younger brother Vince saved, wants him too. Caught between two brothers, Vince must decide if the man who broke him once is worth the risk again.
6a70478c9dbba6268204e160.title: Forbidden Night with the Mafia Heir

6a70478d9dbba6268204e163.synopsis: Emma spent years protecting Ethan, a supposedly mute werewolf, only to hear him speak when he chose to save her sister from a deadly fire. Reborn on the day their father bought the twin wolf guards, Emma refuses to repeat her mistake. She gives both brothers to Sophia, enters the family empire, and builds the power she was once denied. But when betrayal turns into kidnapping and murder, Emma fakes her death and joins forces with Mason Astor, the ruthless Alpha King and her family’s greatest rival. This time, the abandoned heiress won’t beg to be chosen—she’ll destroy everyone who chose against her.
6a70478d9dbba6268204e163.title: He Chose My Sister, So I Chose His King

6a70478f9dbba6268204e166.synopsis: Willow celebrates a positive pregnancy test until she overhears a monstrous truth: her Alpha husband, Adrian, has never touched her. Every time she trusted him, his Beta took his place behind her blindfold, while Adrian built a lie to brand her unfaithful and crown his mistress Luna. Betrayed, pregnant, and trapped in a pack that calls her wolfless and ugly, Willow plans her escape. But under the full moon, her birthmark vanishes, a legendary white wolf awakens, and the men who used her begin hunting the woman they can no longer recognize.
6a70478f9dbba6268204e166.title: The Alpha Lost His Ugly Luna

6a7047929dbba6268204e16c.synopsis: When billionaire Reid Vale finally wires his six-year-old daughter’s surgery deposit, Annie is already dead. His private finance team marks the payment as a loan. While Annie begged for approval, Reid spent $200,000 on another woman’s daughter and called his own child a liar. But Sloane has the death certificate, the school footage, and every cruel financial record. One upload turns a powerful CEO into the father who let his daughter die.
6a7047929dbba6268204e16c.title: He Called His Dying Daughter a Liar

6a7143c1abc1c458e804435b.synopsis: Amber Ryder, a rugged horse breeder, is forced to sell her most dangerous stallion to billionaire polo heir, Henry Harding to keep her father's ranch afloat. Amber doubts if Henry has the grit to tame this wild stallion, but as they train the difficult horse, they realize the real fight isn't the horse... it's each other. Will these two horse-lovers rein in their desires… or let the flames of passion burn brighter?
6a7143c1abc1c458e804435b.title: Reins of Desire

6a71471f953620e7ca06019b.synopsis: Eileen Quinn only wanted to live quietly after leaving the underground gambling world behind. But when her fiancé, her best friend, and a professional cardsharp trap her father in a deadly casino scheme, they think her innocence will hand them the Quinn Trust. With her father’s hand, her mother’s sapphire brooch, and her fortune on the table, Eileen plays the fool until the final card reveals who has truly been controlling the game.
6a71471f953620e7ca06019b.title: A Deadly Gamble

6a71485d12c3962c010749f4.synopsis: Evie is returned to House Ashborne as the true heiress, only to be blamed for every misfortune. Her family worships Chloe, the fake heiress, as their lucky star, never knowing Chloe has been stealing Evie’s blessing all along. To repay a blood debt, they send Evie to the cursed Ravenhold Castle as a sacrifice. But the feared Dark Countess refuses to kill her. When Evie saves the Countess with a hidden underworld power, Ravenhold begins to prosper while House Ashborne collapses. Now Chloe, the Church, and the Queen all want Evie’s stolen luck back.
6a71485d12c3962c010749f4.title: The Dark Duchess’s Lucky Star

6a71485f3064175e0c0b72a0.synopsis: On the eve of their bonding ceremony, Ivy discovers that Lucien, the Alpha she has loved for five years, has crossed the line with his childhood sweetheart. Instead of confronting him, she secretly moves her assets, stages her disappearance, and exposes their affair during the ceremony—leaving the betrayers trapped in regret while she begins a new life under a new identity.
6a71485f3064175e0c0b72a0.title: The Groom’s Inferno

6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.synopsis: Kaelen Ashfell bought me at the Mate Auction for a fortune. Three years later, after I gave him three hatchlings, his first love came back, and he crossed my name out of his Bond Ledger like I was property to return. He handed me and our babies to his brother Roran, then let his first love tear apart my den, my garden, and even hurt our child. Kael thought regret could bring me back. But the mate he discarded was about to learn what it felt like to be protected by someone else.
6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.title: The Auctioned Mate

6a714984282e82f7430d5aa3.synopsis: Kai, an orphan turned soldier, led Valerano's fleet to defeat the Kyte Empire. Recognized as King Eddy's long-lost second prince, he returned to find his wife Sara and daughter Diana enslaved by his in-laws. He crowned Diana a Countess, crushed a Kyte invasion with his Underwater Fleet, and exposed the traitors. After Eddy's death, Kai faced his brother Jake's treachery, summoned the Airship Fleet to obliterate the Kyte army, and was crowned king. Sara became queen, Diana princess.
6a714984282e82f7430d5aa3.title: Crowned: The Son-in-Law's Return

6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.synopsis: In The Atlantic Bride movie, in 1911, amid New York’s Gilded Age, Evelyn Hart, a rural English schoolteacher, voyages across the ocean for love, only to suffer betrayal at the hands of her fiancé Thomas. On the ocean liner, she comes to the rescue of Julian Kane, a mysterious wounded man, and agrees to a marriage of convenience with him when left with nowhere to turn. Little does she know he is the heir to the Kane family empire, commanding railways, shipping and steel. What begins as a reclusive tycoon hiding his true identity blossoms into a tender romance. As workplace clashes and taunts from her old rival mount, affection grows between them, while the truth of his identity slowly surfaces amid the unfolding drama.
6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.title: The Atlantic Bride

6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.synopsis: When James loses his daughter Amy and his legs on the same day, he stops believing in magic. Little does he know, Amy is now Mia, a fortune-telling prodigy come to save James from his fatal bad karma.
6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.title: Little Miss Fortune

6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.synopsis: Sawyer is a quarterback prodigy, but his mom Marnie always ignores him in favor of his adopted brother, Ben, even when Ben frames Sawyer, steals his MVP title, and ruins his future. Heartbroken, Sawyer vows to make his mom realize just how much she hurt him and how much she's lost.
6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.title: The Son Rises Alone

6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.synopsis: After claiming her fifth World Culinary Championship, the legendary Chef Sage goes undercover as a homeless beggar to find a partner with genuine character. Ignored by the masses and ruthlessly mocked by her ex, she encounters Jasper, a kind-hearted man who offers her his food. Desperate to save his family's failing restaurant from a vicious corporate takeover, Jasper hires Sage to play his wealthy fake fiancée. As rival factions push the Vance family to the brink with a high-stakes "Culinary Death Match," all hope seems lost. But when cornered, the beggar bride sheds her disguise. With a flash of her blade and her signature blue flame, she turns the tables against world-class chefs, exposing her true identity and sparking a legendary romance.
6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.title: My Homeless Bride Is a Culinary Legend

6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.synopsis: Caleb Shaw calls BDSM a cure for his dead marriage, then chains his wife Mara to a tree for his mistress. When Mara says the safe word, he leaves with the key. By sunrise, Nina’s hired men find her. But Caleb never knew what Mara buried for this marriage. She was not just his wife. She was the woman who once owned the West Side docks. Now the collar, the blood, and the betrayal will drag every Shaw secret into the light.
6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.title: My Safe Word Was Revenge

6a72d8ae387822c92105c1fb.synopsis: I'm Elena, reborn the day I drowned. Last life, I dragged Nathaniel into disability and was forced to be his brother’s substitute bride. This time I swam hard to save Rosa, and Nathaniel dumped our engagement first. Yet he still accused me of copying Rosa, who’s actually copying my style. Later I found Julian also reborn—he’s loved me for years. Nathaniel chased me crazily to make up his sins. But when I’m about to marry Julian, Rosa breaks their engagement and reveals a shocking truth that crushes Nathaniel completely.
6a72d8ae387822c92105c1fb.title: My Reborn Fiancé Begs for My Love

6a72d8b011baf61cd80e5fb3.synopsis: After ten years of devotion, Evelyn is betrayed by Lucian, the holy white dragon she saved and raised, when he rescues her charming sister Vivian from a deadly flood and leaves Evelyn to die. Reborn on the day she first found two dragon hatchlings, Evelyn refuses to be anyone’s sacrifice again. But Lucian remembers the past too, and Vivian is determined to steal every blessing meant for her sister. As academy dreams, stolen grace, and ancient dragon secrets collide, Evelyn discovers the truth of her bloodline: she is not a powerless human girl, but the Abyss Dragon Queen.
6a72d8b011baf61cd80e5fb3.title: I Raised Him. He Let Me Drown.

6a72d8b2f2d34be5d20118cb.synopsis: Samantha Hughes waited a whole year for AURA’s final farewell concert, only to find her childhood sweetheart Logan kissing Sierra outside the venue after giving away Sam’s VIP ticket. When Logan keeps choosing Sierra, exposes Sam’s family trauma, and later abandons her during a fire, Sam finally sees the boy she loved is gone. She withdraws from Berkeley, moves to New York, rebuilds her life with her mother, and refuses every attempt Logan makes to drag her back. Even when Sierra tries to ruin her reputation and Logan begs for another chance, Sam chooses peace, dignity, and a new love who actually stays.
6a72d8b2f2d34be5d20118cb.title: Scorched Heart

6a72d8b5becaa7e3c600345e.synopsis: On her eighteenth birthday, the Beta’s daughter loses everything. First, her childhood sweetheart, the Alpha heir, and her best friend are revealed to be fated mates. Then, a brutal attack leaves her pack in ruins and both her parents dead. Determined to leave it all behind, she goes to say goodbye to the Alpha heir, only to catch him in bed with her traitorous best friend. That is the final blow. Turning her back on the pack, she becomes a rogue. But exile changes everything. On the road, an extraordinary power awakens within her, revealing a shocking royal heritage. No longer a helpless wolf, she must now destroy a ruthless human trafficking ring and save the entire werewolf race. And along the dangerous path to reclaiming her throne, she will finally find her fated mate.
6a72d8b5becaa7e3c600345e.title: Emerald Eyed Luna

6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.synopsis: In Abandoned Pawn Unrivaled Dragon King movie, Owen — discarded heir of the Hull family, the one and only disciple of the master of the Dragon Knight Sanctum. He awakens the Ten Dragon God Marks and forges a soul-deep bond with Akura, bearer of the ancient Golden Dragon bloodline. Betrayed by his own family, stripped of his name, and tormented by the very Sanctum that should have been his home — when the buried truth finally breaks free, the outcast of old rises in the full wrath of a Dragon God and grinds every last humiliation to dust. From that moment on, the young dragonlord sets forth across the land with his dragon at his side, and the entire continent shudders as the sky itself begins to change.
6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.title: Abandoned Pawn, Unrivaled Dragon King

6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.synopsis: Five years ago, Elena Hartwell broke up with her college boyfriend Killian Thorne to protect him from her ruthless uncle Victor—making him believe she was a gold-digger. Heartbroken, Killian returned to his family's trillion-dollar empire, while Elena was framed by Victor and imprisoned, where she gave birth to their daughter Luna. Now, brave 4-year-old Luna tracks down Killian at his corporate headquarters, shocking everyone by calling him "Daddy." After a DNA test confirms the truth, Killian learns of Elena's wrongful conviction and the sacrifices she made. With his power and resources, he sets out to free Elena, protect Luna from Victor's schemes, and win back the woman he never stopped loving.
6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.title: Mommy's Little Savior

6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.synopsis: In Bound by the Past movie, 8 years after Dante took a bullet for Valentina, a mafia war rages between Chicago and Las Vegas. With a world of bloodshed knocking on their door, they must decide how to protect their daughter, and their marriage.
6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.title: Bound by the Past

6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.synopsis: After a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Nora Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Drake, her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she's responsible for his family's death. For three years, Drake torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Nora shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears. Years later, she returns not as Nora Reed, but as Nadia Moon, heiress to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power. Her mission is clear, protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Drake at all costs.
6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.title: Crowned in Silver Blood

6a740377759fd85b61000861.synopsis: Chris, a low-level Omega werewolf, is brutally murdered during her pregnancy by her mate Alex and former friend Janet. Reborn one year prior to their bonding ceremony, she decisively rejects the scumbag in public and severs their bond, triggering her hidden bloodline as the "True Luna" (Mother of all Werewolves). Guided by a mysterious vision, she must find her true love within a month to fully awaken and survive. Taken in by Leon, the powerful Alpha of the Fire Moon Pack, Chris faces continuous framing by the villains. Ultimately, through numerous trials, she and Leon firmly choose each other, leading to her complete awakening.They cast the evil duo into the dungeon and live happily ever after.
6a740377759fd85b61000861.title: True Luna：On My Terms

6a74042be5a067bb2804d31a.synopsis: When Mimics invade Azure, college student Julian Blake is trapped in a dorm surrounded by enemies until he unlocks the Safehouse System. While others hide in fear, he turns a flimsy dorm into an unbreakable fortress. He builds a team, wins over Mimic leaders, and challenges the Principal, a Lord-level Mimic who wants to assimilate the whole campus. Julian breaks the rules, seizes control, and builds a new order. The counterattack begins.
6a74042be5a067bb2804d31a.title: The Mimic Playground

6a741db7bf22b9d5b80c238e.synopsis: Lucas Carter is the charismatic captain of his college hockey team. After a concussion leaves him with temporary amnesia, his life begins to unravel. He forgets his complicated rivalry with transfer student Albert Clay, making him the perfect target for Albert’s carefully constructed lie: Albert claims they have secretly been lovers all along. As Lucas struggles to separate truth from deception, he still believes he is straight, yet finds himself irresistibly drawn to Albert. Torn between his girlfriend Jessica, his fading memories, and feelings he can no longer deny, Lucas embarks on a journey to uncover who he truly is. Along the way, he is forced to confront his identity, his buried emotions, and the truth behind Albert’s betrayal.
6a741db7bf22b9d5b80c238e.title: Off the Ice

6a743ac77ef51a4855018515.synopsis: At Oak Valley High, soccer star Damian and football captain Zane are bitter rivals. A surprise kiss during training ignites Zane's relentless pursuit—he's had a crush on Damian for years. But when Damian finds a slip marked "D.K." in Zane's ring box, he assumes Zane is chasing Daisy, the cheer captain. Their tension simmers: teasing, a princess carry, flowers by the sea, hiding from each other. A genuine kiss in drama class and Zane shielding him in an alley slowly break Damian's walls. At the school dance, a misunderstanding forces Damian to flee by graduating early. Everything comes to a head at the championship game. Zane climbs into the stands, confesses publicly—and reveals D.K. stands for Damian himself. Their love finally comes true.
6a743ac77ef51a4855018515.title: His Athlete Boyfriend

6a7456d6a4740b6805050945.synopsis: Elite doc Christine catches mafia boss Damon's eye—her eggs are top-tier, and he wants his heir. She hates his guts: same mob that drove her mom to suicide. She rushes a wedding to escape, but Damon crashes the ceremony and snatches her. Locked in his penthouse, he comes at her hard every night; she fights back twice as hard. But slowly she sees past the ice—when someone drugs her, Damon burns it all down to save her. That twisted, obsessed devotion cracks her open. Christine drops the grudge. They end up together, damaged but locked in.
6a7456d6a4740b6805050945.title: The Mob Boss Demands Her Perfect Genes

6a7536d7d20c60c600016a49.synopsis: Centuries after the extinction of human civilization — perhaps even longer — Earth no longer belongs to humankind. The once-thriving cities have crumbled into ruins, skyscrapers swallowed by yellow sand, steel forests reduced to derelict remnants where mechanical life now roosts. Football stadiums, subway tunnels, factories, city squares — the relics of human civilization still lie scattered across the world like the last embers left behind after a great fire, silently bearing witness to an era that no one remembers anymore. The world now belongs to the machines. They think, they communicate, they build organizations. They know friendship, faith, hatred, and dreams. Yet the vast majority of them have no idea what "humans" ever were — let alone why they themselves came into existence. The world has entered a new epoch of mechanical civilization. And this age would later be known as:After the Embers
6a7536d7d20c60c600016a49.title: After the Embers(updating)

6a753b06b9632278d60f78c9.synopsis: Held under the tyrannical rule of the Holy Church, magic is branded heresy across the North. Elena, a gifted healer and illegitimate daughter, is betrayed by her half-sister Veronica and fiancé Grayson. They rip out her magic core and sentence her to the stake. At death’s door, she bargains with the Ash Goddess for destructive ash magic—yet every spell erases fragments of her soul. Reborn seven days before her arrest, she allies with disgraced knight Marcus. The vengeful Ash Witch will overthrow her betrayers and ignite rebellion against the oppressive Holy Church.
6a753b06b9632278d60f78c9.title: Covenant of the Witch

6a754311338f32d80c0fc293.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Emily is hunted down by her relatives over her massive inheritance. She flees to her family’s rural farm for shelter, only to accidentally discover that their fireplace connects to a dragon‑ruled otherworld. She keeps sending modern supplies to this realm, aiding Kael, the metal dragon lord, in protecting his people and homeland. To the dragons, she becomes the "Dragon God". From firewood and medicine to modern weaponry, she reshapes the dragon‑race war step by step — and rewrites her own destiny.
6a754311338f32d80c0fc293.title: My Fireplace Ships to Dragon Realm

6a7588a197becf6700086632.synopsis: Cora’s husband helps his dead best friend’s widow get pregnant, then defends her at every turn, calling it kindness while his own marriage collapses. When his loyalty turns violent and costs Cora her unborn child, she stops begging and starts collecting proof. Armed with Sienna’s recorded confession, Cora forces a brutal divorce, walks away with what she is owed, and watches the woman who stole her husband trap the Vance family in the scandal they created.
6a7588a197becf6700086632.title: She Used My Husband's Sperm

6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.synopsis: On a snowy Thanksgiving, young healer Rita lives with her ungrateful uncle William and his cruel family. They exploit her powers, sabotage her feast, and secretly hire a thug to drive her away. Hunted and alone, she is rescued by mafia godfather Richard Genovese and his wife. Discovering their kindness and lack of an heir, they adopt her. On the journey, Rita's powers save them from crises, alarming Richard's rival. At the manor, she heals Richard's dying father, Arthur, and finds a lost heirloom. Her courage and abilities win the family's trust. Rita becomes a true Genovese, protecting her new family with everything she has.
6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.title: The Godfather's Guardian Angel

6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.synopsis: When Naomi accidentally summons Thanatos, the God of Death, a desperate kiss awakens his heart after ten thousand years. Revealed as his destined Bride of Death, Naomi is the only one who can break his curse, while the immortal reaper discovers that even a god can fall in love.
6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.title: My Marriage with the God of Death

6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.synopsis: In Altarboy movie, after getting kicked out for being gay, 18-year-old Theo is dumped at a Catholic church to be "cured" — and finds his new priest is young, hot... and a huge jerk who makes Theo his personal altar boy. What starts as a game of temptation becomes a slow-burn obsession neither can pray away, but as the game turns real, both Theo and Alexander risk losing everything to a love neither of them is supposed to want.
6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.title: Altarboy

6a792d0968014e86ca0a0a79.synopsis: After three years away, Grant returns home with a brooch for his sister Ella—only to witness her fall to her death from the top of Vanguard Tech. In her final moments, Ella reveals that Kane orchestrated her downfall, stole her company, and drove her to her death. Grant gives himself three days to exact revenge. At a merger celebration, he unleashes his lethal skills—while his in-laws, the Richards, and other relatives continue to mock and belittle him, unaware that he has just been sworn in as the new FBI Director. As he protects his wife Laura and systematically dismantles Kane's conspiracy, Grant hunts down every last perpetrator—and reclaims the company his sister built with her own blood and tears.
6a792d0968014e86ca0a0a79.title: A Soldier's Revenge

6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.synopsis: In My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit movie, seeking a fresh start after years of managing crises, Grace takes on a new job, only to be swept into a fake marriage by her enigmatic boss, Mason. As their pretend arrangement blurs into undeniable passion, Grace falls deeper into his spell. But Mason is playing a far more dangerous game—and he has no intention of ever letting her go.
6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.title: My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit

6a792e8f6760fac43a08230d.synopsis: Everyone accuses Faye of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Adam Stone! (And win his heart too)
6a792e8f6760fac43a08230d.title: The Hobo Goddess and Her Billion-Dollar Contract

6a792f892dee9a176102157c.synopsis: In Shattered Vows movie, princess Venessa lived a sheltered life—until her sister was murdered. Stripped of her innocence in a single night, she must confront a devastating betrayal: her husband and best friend just helped the killer escape justice. The pampered princess is gone. Now she's coming for every last one of them, to take back the justice they owe her sister.
6a792f892dee9a176102157c.title: Loved Me Most, Betrayed Me Worst

6a79352e6aee1ef8c50dd878.synopsis: Wren buried her Ducati, her guitar, and her soul to marry Ethan, who repaid her by telling her to be more like Chloe. That night, she walked out and into the arms of Julian Ashford—billionaire heir and motorsport royalty. He didn't want her small; he wanted her flying. As Julian helped her reclaim every piece of herself, Ethan watched his empire crumble, realizing too late he'd traded a diamond for dust. Wren learned real love doesn't ask you to slow down—it keeps pace.
6a79352e6aee1ef8c50dd878.title: Goodbye, Ex-husband I'm Racing with a Billonaire

6a79353382908a419d018d21.synopsis: Emma spent years protecting Ethan, a supposedly mute werewolf, only to hear him speak when he chose to save her sister from a deadly fire. Reborn on the day their father bought the twin wolf guards, Emma refuses to repeat her mistake. She gives both brothers to Sophia, enters the family empire, and builds the power she was once denied. But when betrayal turns into kidnapping and murder, Emma fakes her death and joins forces with Mason Astor, the ruthless Alpha King and her family’s greatest rival. This time, the abandoned heiress won’t beg to be chosen—she’ll destroy everyone who chose against her.
6a79353382908a419d018d21.title: My Wolf Guard Chose My Sister, So I Chose the Alpha King

6a79353639273200140302fe.synopsis: Vivienne and Adrian are moments away from adopting a sweet little girl when Vivienne notices a pea-sized birthmark on the child's hand. She immediately refuses to sign and demands a divorce. Adrian kneels. His family calls her cruel, barren, and heartless. Even the child begs her not to leave. No one understands why Vivienne would destroy a loving marriage over such a tiny mark, and she refuses to explain. Not until Vivienne unveils three reports at a live press conference does the truth behind that tiny birthmark finally begin to surface.
6a79353639273200140302fe.title: A Birthmark Exposed My Husband’s Secret

6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.synopsis: I’m Seraphina, ocean princess. In my last life, I loved shark lord Kael, yet he held me down while his lover Lira stabbed my heart with venom crystal. Reborn on my mate-picking day, I shocked everyone by choosing Rhys, the playful dragon eel playboy. Kael seethed, ignored me when assassins poisoned me, and knelt begging me to ditch Rhys later. But Lira’s fake fragility hides deadly malice—she just pushed me into deadly undertow. Can Rhys reach me before I drown?
6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.title: I Chose The Playboy Eel To Abandon My Shark Lover

6a79353f9620ad2c7704348f.synopsis: For three years, Elena endured a marriage where every affair ended the same way—her husband handed her another man as compensation. When his pregnant mistress demanded a wedding, he expected another fake divorce and another obedient return. Instead, Elena accepted the young man he chose, signed the papers, and walked away for good. By the time Damian uncovered the truth behind the betrayal that destroyed their marriage, she was already standing at another altar. This time, the bride never looked back.
6a79353f9620ad2c7704348f.title: My Husband Gifted Me His Rival

6a793547b52e318bd5041bcb.synopsis: Three years ago, Lyla Silverthorn was framed by her adopted sister Mira, abandoned by her parents, and betrayed by Caleb Cross, the Alpha who once loved her. Her moon core was carved out, her voice burned away by silver poison, and her name reduced to the black-market number R-17. When Caleb buys her at auction for $200,000, he has no idea he has found his lost Luna. As the Moon Crown awakens and exposes every lie, Lyla refuses their late remorse and cuts the soul-bond chain to claim her freedom.
6a793547b52e318bd5041bcb.title: The Alpha Bought His Lost Luna

6a79354ae13d167ced00947f.synopsis: For three hundred years, Olympus worshipped the wrong goddess. Lena, a judgment envoy from the Court of Hades, has lived under the shame of a stolen name: her grandmother Aletheia was betrayed, stripped of her True Name, and erased from divine history. When the thief’s granddaughter Athenais is about to ascend as a new goddess, Lena publicly tears apart her ascension scroll and demands a Trial of True Name. But exposing one stolen godhood means challenging the God of Law, the false Goddess of Art, and the entire divine order built on their lie.
6a79354ae13d167ced00947f.title: They Stole My Grandmother’s Godhood

6a7937d142b947c10103143a.synopsis: Erotica writer Ivy accidentally stumbles upon the secret between campus heartthrob Noah and a female teacher. After secretly filming the encounter, she becomes his target and is soon pushed into the role of leader of the school-wide "Anti-Noah Alliance." Forced to be paired as mentor and student for Ivy League applications, the two go from hostility to tentative probing, caught in a constant tug-of-war involving lies, power, and collective hysteria. When a campus crisis puts a baseball bat in her hands, the swing she takes hits not only the truth—but herself as well.
6a7937d142b947c10103143a.title: Dangerous Persona

6a799b227ca81994420fb772.synopsis: Victoria, the secret head of a powerful aristocratic family, rejects an arranged marriage for her longtime boyfriend, Julian. On her way to see him, she saves billionaire CEO Alexander Blackwood from an accident, unknowingly awakening his wolf-spirit mark that identifies her as his destined mate. Victoria rejects Alexander's sudden proposal and heads to Julian's promotion party—a position she secretly secured for him. However, Julian publicly humiliates her, offering her a buyout check so he can marry Chloe, the daughter of a Blackwood executive, to secure his status. When Victoria reveals she is the true mastermind behind his success, Julian and the elite guests mock her as a delusional beggar. Just as security corners Victoria to throw her out, Alexander violently crashes the party...
6a799b227ca81994420fb772.title: The Destined One

6a79a5ea47342654bf008f37.synopsis: Trash dog’s epic counterattack! Inheriting Anubis’s legacy, he evolves by devouring everything! Tortures villains, protects his master, fights the world-destroying serpent, and finally breaks through to SSS rank as Anubis, becoming a god in one battle!
6a79a5ea47342654bf008f37.title: Devour to the God of Death from a Stray Dog

6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.synopsis: Cain Hunter, heir to the almighty Godfather, is back! He'll fight past mind-controlling schemers and threats haunting the shadows, whatever it takes to pass the ten trials his grandfather has set for him. But what if it all comes at a cost? What if it means losing the love of his life, Annalise?
6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.title: Super Godfather 2: My Ex Dumped the Wrong Man

6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.synopsis: Five years ago, Tiffany experienced the unexpected betrayal by her fiancé and her best friend in The Alpha and His Nanny Luna. Heavily pregnant and helpless, Tiffany begged for her life as they poisoned her and left her for dead. She thought her life was over. Miraculously, she survived the attack, but her baby was no longer by her side. She spent the next few years tirelessly looking for her daughter. Her efforts were fruitless as every lead she stumbled upon meant nothing. Desperate for better results, she took a job as a nanny at the Silvermoon Pack, where the mighty Alpha Asher Sterling tasked her with taking care of his daughter, Maya. Tiffany accepted the terms, treating Maya like her own and feeling a strange connection to Asher. Little by little, the truth resurfaced. Maya was Tiffany’s long-lost daughter, and Asher was the man from that night years ago. Fate brought them back together to make up for the time they had lost. But their story was far from over. As their love deepened, old enemies rose and deadly secrets began to unravel, leaving Tiffany and Asher with only one way to survive—remain devoted to each other or risk losing the family they had fought hard to claim. Characters Tiffany Croft Tiffany Croft is the central character of The Alpha and His Nanny Luna. She’s a wolfless omega whose life revolves around proving her worth to the people who never appreciated her. Thankfully, her need for validation begins to fade when Asher loves her for who she is, and her self-doubt eventually turns into conviction. Asher Sterling Asher Sterling is the ruthless, untouchable alpha of the Silvermoon Pack. He’s one of the most powerful authority figures, and yet he’s more than capable of love. He proves that by passionately fulfilling his role as a father and giving Tiffany the world she deserves. Maya Sterling Maya Sterling is Tiffany and Asher’s bubbly daughter. From the moment she sees Tiffany, she already feels connected to her. That never changes, even as people question their bond.
6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.title: The Alpha and His Nanny Luna

6a7a81d232f8351021093876.synopsis: Two years ago, a car accident left me blind. My sense of sight finally returned to me one day... and the very first thing I saw... was my wife cheating on me.
6a7a81d232f8351021093876.title: Blind No Longer: My Wife's Betrayal

6a7ab985618cb1757a07e666.synopsis: "Lorde, the Daughter of the Sea‑God, was betrayed by her husband Demos and her handmaiden Chloris, who cast her off the cliffs of Mount Olympus. As she lay dying, she finally learned that Helios, the deposed Sun‑God, had always loved her deeply — and he traded his divine status for her rebirth. Returned to the age of eighteen, Lorde rejects her old betrothal to seek out Helios, only to face forced marriage imposed by Zeus once more. The two join forces to hatch a plot, reclaim the Sun‑God’s staff, expose the truth behind the murder in their past life, and make the wrongdoers pay for their crimes. In the end, they hold their wedding on the island of Rhodes and embrace a new beginning."
6a7ab985618cb1757a07e666.title: Daughter of Poseidon Forsakes you

6a7ade3bcccb5af57d0f0ddc.synopsis: Lord Julian Thornfield burns Adeline’s village, turns her into a vampire, and forces her to become his dead wife’s replacement. Even his daughter, Eve, calls her “Mama.” When Adeline tries to die, Eve’s strange power hurls them a hundred years into the past. There, Julian is not a cruel lord yet. He is a scarred human slave in a circus cage, whipped as a monster. Adeline only wants to hand Eve back and escape, but the child’s broken heart ties her to them both. Then the caged man asks who she is, and Adeline answers, “I’m your future wife.”
6a7ade3bcccb5af57d0f0ddc.title: I Was My Vampire Husband's Dead Wife

6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.synopsis: Once a straight A freshman, Emma Lucas lost everything when Adrian Cole filmed her in bed and let her nudes spread across campus. He said her brother owed his sister a life, then made Emma pay for it. Three years later, Emma strips to keep Ryan alive, only to find Adrian in the VIP booth, paying men to humiliate her. “How did you get this cheap?” But when her family shatters and the truth about Lily resurfaces, Adrian’s revenge starts looking like the cruelest mistake of his life.
6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.title: My First Love Pays to Watch Me Strip

6a7ade4881a82adc940aeaf3.synopsis: Pregnant Ava is pushed by her mother-in-law Marlene to terminate her pregnancy after Logan is declared dead. A voice from her unborn child leads her to Logan alive, injured, and trapped under a psychologist's memory manipulation. Together, Ava and Logan expose forged authorizations, stolen benefits, and a military cover-up before fighting their way back to their family.
6a7ade4881a82adc940aeaf3.title: Mom, don't sign! Dad is not dead!

6a7ade4b6dd79807440adcb9.synopsis: Born with the sealed bloodline of Hades, Lia Thorne is raised as the lost daughter of the wealthy Lancaster family. But when her return exposes their crimes and shatters their "lucky" adopted daughter Ava's perfect life, Lia is branded a curse. On her twelfth birthday, her parents drug her and leave her at Black Rose Manor, the most feared mafia estate in Black Bay. They expect her to die. Instead, mafia queen Veronica Knight and executioner Damian Wolf protect her as their little princess. As enemies close in, Lia's hidden power awakens, turning every betrayal into deadly karma.
6a7ade4b6dd79807440adcb9.title: Hades' Mafia Princess

6a7ae421b439ccf70a081b47.synopsis: Betrayed by her boyfriend. Hunted down by her father. Forced to mate with a ruthless Alpha King. Cora thought her life was over until she escaped and accidentally marked a dangerous, magnetic stranger. Left with no choice, she accepted a fake mating proposal from that stranger, totally unaware that her "contract mate" is the very Alpha King she’s desperately trying to escape...
6a7ae421b439ccf70a081b47.title: Caught! The Ruthless Alpha's Runaway Luna

6a7b163cc628342bd2004993.synopsis: Princess Serena of Atlantis with golden‑tailed fins was murdered in her past life by her adopted younger sister together with her fiancé. Reborn with burning hatred, she saw through their schemes. To escape the deadly trap, she dived into the abyss and united with Nereus, the sealed ancient Sea God, conceiving nine primeval divine eggs. On the grand birthing ceremony, she exposed the villains' plots. Joining forces with Nereus, she crushed her foes, abolished the hierarchical system separating humans and merfolk, and ascended as the Tidal Sea Queen to rule the deep ocean alongside the Sea God.
6a7b163cc628342bd2004993.title: Ruler of the Ancient Seas

6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.synopsis: In The Rockstar's Secret movie, Juniper is hopelessly, recklessly in love with Tristan—the dark, intoxicating rockstar who rules their campus. The catch? He’s her protective older brother Carter’s best friend, and as far as Tristan is concerned, Juniper is nothing more than an invisible little sister. Until the night the lights go out. Trapped in the pitch-black darkness, a wild, uninhibited flame ignites between them—a night of unforgettable passion with a mysterious girl whose face Tristan never saw. All he has to trace his secret lover is a delicate butterfly bracelet left behind, and the vivid memory of a butterfly birthmark. He is obsessively hunting for the stranger who shattered his world, unaware that the girl he craves is sitting right across his kitchen table. But if Tristan discovers Juniper was the woman in the dark, and if Carter finds out his best friend touched his sister, the fallout could destroy them all. Can a love born in the shadows survive the brutal light of truth?
6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.title: The Rockstar's Secret

6a7bd0f9c6914781b809601a.synopsis: A month before the most important piano competition of her life, gifted heiress Evelyn Sterling is kidnapped—and her hands are shattered on her fiancé’s orders. He plans to replace her with her adopted sister, steal her inheritance, and erase her from New York’s music world. Betrayed by everyone she called family, Evelyn undergoes a dangerous surgery and returns to the stage with bleeding fingers. Her impossible perfect score ignites a ruthless war of forged drug tests, stolen identities, and deadly revenge. They broke her hands to silence her, but Evelyn is ready to reclaim her music, her name, and everything they stole.
6a7bd0f9c6914781b809601a.title: He Shattered My Hands for My Sister

6a7bd13ab51889316001fc6b.synopsis: Sean Carter gave up his powerful family name to live as an ordinary DoD civilian analyst, hoping his wife Morgan Hayes loved him for who he was. But when he caught Evan Brooks assaulting her, Morgan protected Evan’s military future by giving false testimony and sending Sean into three years of punishment in Alaska. The day Sean returns, Morgan brings him straight to her wedding with Evan, humiliating him in front of everyone who thinks he is powerless. But Sean has one secret left: he is the son of General William Carter. When the truth comes out, Morgan and Evan finally learn that the man they destroyed is the one who can bring them down.
6a7bd13ab51889316001fc6b.title: Married to the Enemy

6a7bd1857cc82d300f0bf04a.synopsis: I'm Elena, reborn the day I drowned. Last life, I dragged Nathaniel into disability and was forced to be his brother’s substitute bride. This time I swam hard to save Rosa, and Nathaniel dumped our engagement first. Yet he still accused me of copying Rosa, who’s actually copying my style. Later I found Julian also reborn—he’s loved me for years. Nathaniel chased me crazily to make up his sins. But when I’m about to marry Julian, Rosa breaks their engagement and reveals a shocking truth that crushes Nathaniel completely.
6a7bd1857cc82d300f0bf04a.title: Reborn to Escape My Cruel Fiancé

6a7be5ecdb59ed908700633c.synopsis: Beggar Killian, secretly the Crown Prince of the Dragon Clan, saved Eva during his tribulation. Eva's family demanded she choose between Killian and her home; she chose him. Moved by her loyalty, Killian crowns her, sealing their bond.
6a7be5ecdb59ed908700633c.title: Found A Homeless Dragon Husband

6a7c09eedc4e3cb2b80e4055.synopsis: Princess Isabella of Valen has spent years studying medicine and developing a remedy for the plague. She returns to the capital quietly, hoping to offer it as a birthday gift to her father, King Arthur, who is about to remarry. Arthur's fiancée, Margaret, resents the princess for staying away and delaying the wedding. While riding through the capital, Margaret lets her carriage tear through the streets and nearly runs down commoners. Isabella stops her, only to be publicly humiliated and beaten by Margaret and her daughter, who accuse her of being a witch. The corrupt, fawning captain of the city guard helps them. Margaret burns the portrait of Isabella's mother and the precious herbs Isabella needs for her medicine, then orders her tied to a stake and burned alive. Just in time, King Arthur learns the truth and arrives with his guards in a fury.
6a7c09eedc4e3cb2b80e4055.title: The Gold-Digging Queen's Guillotine

6a7c3216c1fb13520e051bed.synopsis: The Witcher clan was massacred by the Vampire High Table. Silas, the sole surviving bloodline heir, ventured forth alone. He successfully assassinated one of the Elders before fleeing gravely wounded—only to inadvertently take Aion, a half-blood noble, hostage. Seeking to overthrow the corrupt rule of the Elder Council, Aion forcibly turned Silas at the brink of death via the Embrace, chaining him to his side as a pawn for vengeance. Within this fragile, uneasy alliance, the two men evolved from mutual suspicion to forging a bond forged in life-and-death peril, and an unspoken, forbidden affection bloomed between them. To save the dying Silas, Aion dared to cast a forbidden ritual to share their life force, permanently weaving their fates into one.
6a7c3216c1fb13520e051bed.title: Hunter's Prey

6a7c48e5b4c56e59bc06ed9a.synopsis: Elena is drugged by her stepfather and, at a masked ball, has a night with Vincent—a powerful heir who can't touch any woman due to childhood trauma. She gives birth to Leo, but Frank sends the baby to an orphanage. Vincent recognizes his tie at the scene, adopts Leo, and brings him home. Desperate to reclaim her child, Elena applies as a wet nurse at Cunningham Manor, reuniting with Vincent—neither recognizes the other. Leo only drinks Elena's milk. Vincent discovers Elena is the only woman he can touch without repulsion, and gradually falls for her. Frank's schemes and Lina's sabotage are repeatedly thwarted by Vincent. Elena learns her child has been "adopted" by the Clintons, but discovers the child isn't hers—the orphanage director was deceiving her. Vincent produces the tie: Leo is her son, and Vincent is the masked man from that night. Vincent confronts his father Charles, exposing the abuse that drove his mother to suicide. Charles concedes, accepting Elena. The family of three reunites in a grand wedding.
6a7c48e5b4c56e59bc06ed9a.title: Mafia's Desire for the Wet Nurse

6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.synopsis: Based on the novel by bestselling author Cora Reilly. 21 year old Giulia Rizzo suddenly finds herself engaged to the ruthless crimelord Cassio Moretti against her will. Rumor has it he's responsible for the bloody, untimely death of his wife, whom Giulia is not only replacing as a wife, but as the mother of their two young children. Will rebellious Giulia manage to make a life for herself alongside Cassio, or will his refusal to let her into his heart create yet another broken marriage?
6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.title: Sweet Temptation

6a7d23d4c59b8cef5f036fc9.synopsis: Marina is a mermaid who will turn to foam in thirty days without true love's kiss. She tore her tail apart for Damien. Day twenty-seven—no kiss. Damien kissed another woman in front of her. He gave her soul-scale to Vanessa as a necklace, and her heart-pearl—her only way home—as an anklet. Marina took everything back. On opening night, she emptied every case of his stolen jewels. She reclaimed the tide-bracelet, the soul-scale, and finally the life she stole from death for him. Damien dissolved into white foam, swept away by the tide. And Eli—who gave up his voice to find her—used his returned voice to whisper: "Welcome home."
6a7d23d4c59b8cef5f036fc9.title: My Boyfriend Doesn't Know I'm a Mermaid

6a7d2695c110da6695071109.synopsis: Kaelen, a fallen noble, is betrayed by his beloved and exiled by humanity—only to awaken the Abyssal Demon Lord's supreme bloodline in the lightless abyss. He rises with a cursed serpent-woman by his side, vowing to tear down the hypocritical gods and divide the sun among all races. In this world, light is a weapon of the powerful. Human nobles drain their own kind's blood to fuel "divine sanction" and oppress dissenters. The demons and beast tribes are the true victims—starved of sunlight and hunted. The protagonist's struggle is a war against class oppression. When the magic altar is destroyed, an energy tsunami shatters the barrier confining the beast tribes. Tens of thousands of starving warriors surge into human territory—igniting a colossal war that engulfs humans, demons, beasts, and gods. Kaelen must unite enemies, break the gods' monopoly on light, and reshape the world.
6a7d2695c110da6695071109.title: Abyssal Throne：The Godslayer

6a7d29c9eef07d221a00cda9.synopsis: In her past life, Willow Warner sacrificed herself by marrying the Wolf King Ralph to save her sister Mia, only to die frozen in the northern wasteland. Reborn on her wedding day, Willow swaps places with Mia and enters the dangerous Peacock Valley. With her honey badger powers, fearless spirit, and unmatched strength, she defeats enemies, reforms the clan, protects the realm, and rises from a doomed bride to the unstoppable Queen of Beasts.
6a7d29c9eef07d221a00cda9.title: The Bride Who Could Not Be Tamed

6a7d2bcab1873733e20616ba.synopsis: Reborn after her family’s betrayal, Claire refuses to sacrifice herself for Violet again. With Adrian’s support, she exposes Violet’s schemes and pursues her esports dream. Despite her brothers’ remorse, Claire chooses freedom and a new life.
6a7d2bcab1873733e20616ba.title: KO, The MVP Heiress is Back

6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.synopsis: In 1849, the American West, poor dockworker William is betrayed by his lover and his boss, losing everything and becoming a slave laborer in a gold mine. On the brink of death, he awakens a mysterious "Golden Eye" that allows him to see through anything and uncover hidden treasures. From a powerless nobody to a legendary mining tycoon, William uses his extraordinary vision and intelligence to defeat the elites who once crushed him!
6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.title: King of Gold

6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by mutant beasts, Kane is humanity's one and only War God — yet he hides his identity, secretly gifting seventeen top military honors to his girlfriend Sena. On her promotion day, she coldly dumps him as a "worthless nobody soldier." Meanwhile, City Lord Eve, forced into a political marriage by the corrupt government, proposes a fake marriage to Kane — never suspecting who he truly is. As elites humiliate him and scheme against her, the War God finally rises. Revenge, romance, and absolute power collide.
6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.title: Wasteland Sovereign

6a7d3aae10a933d3cb0c4cbe.synopsis: Maddox, a gifted diver haunted by the trauma of a past accident, makes his comeback. On the night of his return, he mistakes Teo, a younger fellow athlete, for someone else and spends the night with him. The next morning, he discovers Teo is none other than his new synchro springboard partner. What follows is a journey from awkward hostility to budding affection. Tormented by public expectations and lingering trauma, Maddox struggles repeatedly with his feelings. Their rival Tyler secretly films their intimate moments and uses the footage to blackmail them. In the end, Maddox conquers his inner demons. He and Teo claim the championship at the grand finals. Standing on the winner’s podium, they publicly confirm their relationship, achieving fulfilment both in their sporting careers and their love.
6a7d3aae10a933d3cb0c4cbe.title: Never Fall Alone

6a7d84d946113b47740e69e6.synopsis: Reborn before her tragic fate unfolds, Elena falls victim to betrayal in her past life at the hands of her sister Veronica and her fiancé Grayson. They swap her golden‑dragon egg, leaving her to die under false accusations. In this new life, she resolutely turns to the imprisoned Dragon Lord Nidhogg to conceive a child for self‑preservation and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with nine offspring. On the day of her labor, the villains strike again with slander. Nidhogg appears majestically to shield his mate. He exposes Veronica’s true identity as a wyvern and crushes all her foes. Elena rises to become the Divine Mother. She embarks on a sweet‑romance life alongside the Dragon Lord, and her nine dragon‑born children shake the Three Realms.
6a7d84d946113b47740e69e6.title: Doting Snake Lord

6a7daee9a884ec41830ad386.synopsis: "You're lying." That's what my husband said when I begged him to save me. Six months pregnant, I was kidnapped, beaten, and left to lose our baby—while he chose his mistress over me again and again. So I gave him exactly what he deserved: my death. Now he thinks he buried his wife and daughter. But I'm still alive... and this time, I'll bury everything he loves.
6a7daee9a884ec41830ad386.title: I Faked My Death To Ruin My Mafia Husband

6a7e002a0b1fda126b0dd463.synopsis: Armand Procacci and Talia Wynzel go head-to-head in a Random Song and Dance Challenge, a fast-paced challenge where each round, they press a button to randomly determine a song they must sing or a dance move they must recreate. If they successfully complete the challenge, they stay dry. If they fail, they get splashed with water!
6a7e002a0b1fda126b0dd463.title: ReelTalk EP 87-Random Song and Dance Challenge with Armand and Talia

6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.synopsis: On her first day at Maple Elite Academy, transfer student Emma Parker does the unthinkable — she picks a fight with The Big Four, the untouchable heirs who rule the school. Tyrannical Rowan Calloway wants to break her. Golden-boy August Langford wants to protect her. But behind their masks, nothing is what it seems. The closer they get, the harder they fall — for the girl who was never meant to belong in their world. Enemies… or childhood friends? When it comes to Rowan and August, the answer is never simple. Who will she choose?
6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.title: Taming My Bullies 1-3

6a7ecdc9c34b99d5370d4c80.synopsis: Eleanor marries Tristan to save her bankrupt family, but he mistakes desperation for greed and treats their marriage as a purchase. After cutting off her income and using his mistress to humiliate her, he sends the weakened Eleanor into a deadly snowstorm to retrieve a necklace. She survives, exposes the truth in court, wins her freedom, and creates a fund ensuring that no other woman will ever lose a child for want of fourteen copper coins.
6a7ecdc9c34b99d5370d4c80.title: Silent Snow Falls, No Looking Back

6a7f30edf644260e4c06e96a.synopsis: Axel is a ghost, a Russian operative buried deep inside the underground fighting circuit, sent to infiltrate the empire of Dante, the most feared mafia don on the continent. His ticket in? A brutal cage match where he publicly defies the don, then holds back the killing blow. The bait works. Dante brings him home. But the mansion is a cage of its own. When Axel gets caught cracking the don's safe, his only alibi is a forged love letter, a lie that accidentally ignites Dante's twisted obsession. When assassins strike, Axel sees his moment. He steps in front of the bullet meant for Dante. Bleeds for him. Nearly dies for him. The reward? The don's absolute trust, and an S-level pass to every secret in the empire.
