6a8f9944ad5076b92e00c1b7.synopsis: In I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad movie, killed by Ethan, Vivienne is reborn five years prior. She chooses Richard, Ethan's father and the clan's strongest Alpha. A fated red thread proves them true mates. Carrying his five pups, she passes the Spirit Stele trial, earns divine blessing, and strips Ethan of his title. Ethan takes forbidden drugs, becomes a monster, and kidnaps her. As she falls into the sea, the Ice Lotus awakens the pups' power, lifting them on a golden lotus. Richard slays Ethan, and they wed amid a moonlit flower sea.
6a8f9944ad5076b92e00c1b7.title: I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad

6a8f9c5571f9039e440f4c2a.synopsis: At their mate-selection ceremony, Grant rejects Mara in front of both tribes and gives her place to her crying younger sister. He swears it is only temporary. He has forgotten one thing: Mara turns twenty-two in three days. Under tribal law, an unmated woman loses her right to choose, and Mara has already been assigned to the dying Dragon King. Grant expects her father to stop it. Mara accepts the decree. Three days later, as Grant comes to bond with Brenna, one hundred dragon guards arrive at the Hale gates to escort Mara away as their future queen.
6a8f9c5571f9039e440f4c2a.title: Sister Stole My Mate, I Got the Dragon King

6a8fb0fa833289c5ca079ae2.synopsis: In Atlantis, only godblood mermaids are allowed to live. Mudbloods are crushed at birth. I, Princess Rosalie, am a mudblood. My mother used dark magic to hide it. But on the day I gave birth, my husband Xavier discovered the truth, and I died by his hand. Now I'm reborn. I reject Xavier and choose to marry a mute slave instead. They all laugh. They say I've lost my mind. But they don't know the truth. He's not just a slave. He's Pure Godblood. The rarest, most powerful bloodline in Atlantis."
6a8fb0fa833289c5ca079ae2.title: From Mudblood to Atlantis' Owner

6a8fce5a72320f50d207cd12.synopsis: Former beauty queen Wendy thought marrying into the Carter family was her fairy-tale ending, only to discover it was a living nightmare. Her husband Jonathan sees her only as his "No. 113 collectible" and is secretly having an affair with her sister-in-law, Chloe. Betrayed and belittled, Wendy refuses to suffer in silence. Armed with an IVF pregnancy and a strategically swapped piece of underwear, she ignites a path of calculated revenge. Teaming up with Sean, her husband's scorned illegitimate brother, she exposes Jonathan's litany of sins at the climax of the family's farewell banquet. Just when everyone believes she is only fighting for a divorce, Wendy reveals her true fangs—she demands not just her freedom, but for the entire Carter dynasty to pay for their arrogance.
6a8fce5a72320f50d207cd12.title: The Day of Betrayal, I Took Everything

6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.synopsis: Laila, a destitute widow, is forced off a cliff by the tyrannical Governor Barrow—only to fall into the sacred dragon realm. There, she spends one fateful night with King Kael, a dragon sovereign bound by a deadly curse that burns any woman he touches. Ten months later, she gives birth to a royal dragon egg. Hunted by Barrow, she desperately entrusts the egg to the dragon clan. When the temple issues a decree seeking one who can hatch the egg, Laila tears down the royal notice and steps forward. Despite scorn and humiliation from the nobles, she reunites with Kael. In the end, it is her unconditional mother's love that awakens the dying egg—and a penniless commoner becomes the mother of the dragon clan's sole heir.
6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.title: Pregnant with the Dragon Lord's Last Heir

6a8fef34c22ec2dd5308633a.synopsis: A modern medical student transmigrated into the body of Theresa, the obese queen of the Kingdom of Bolun in the Middle Ages. The original owner had been publicly humiliated at the blessing ceremony and then strangled to death by the white lotus Lia. After being reborn, the female lead was determined to take revenge. Banished to the desolate cold palace, she relied on a cross-time device to purchase modern supplies online and lose weight scientifically, stunning the palace by shedding fifty kilograms in a single month. Coincidentally, the old king fell gravely ill with abdominal pain, and she saved him with modern surgery, firmly establishing her position. Thereafter, facing successive provocations from Lia, the queen dowager, the biased king, and treasonous nobles, she brought out modern high-tech gadgets such as air conditioners, sports cars, and firearms, crushing foreign enemies in a martial arts competition between the two kingdoms, exposing everyone's treason and conspiracies, and severely punishing the villains. In the end, she let go of palace romance, accompanied the old king on a road trip across various countries, and found freedom.
6a8fef34c22ec2dd5308633a.title: The Counterattack of the Fat Wife Queen

6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.synopsis: Shivon has spent her life dreaming of escaping her cruel family and earning a place at the Royal Academy. But after one reckless night with the mysterious Duke Alaric Blackmoor, she discovers she’s carrying the one thing everyone believed impossible—his child. Alaric was thought incapable of producing an heir, because a wolf can only conceive with his fated mate. Now, as Shivon’s family tries to sell her to the ruthless Lord Greyfang, Alaric will stop at nothing to find the woman who may be his one true mate—and protect the impossible heir growing inside her.
6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.title: Knocked Up by the Wolf Duke

6a900050fd9273c14e0f4526.synopsis: Sharon, an ordinary art student, publicly confessed her love to wealthy young master Ryan at his birthday party, only to be humiliated ruthlessly. Her years of humble devotion turned into a laughingstock, leaving her heartbroken and determined to start a new life. On the night she planned to move out, a man who looked exactly like Ryan blocked her way. He was Ryan from three years in the future, traveling back filled with remorse. In his past life, he lost Sharon, watched her art school admission spot be stolen by Ryan’s younger sister Lena, her talent buried, and she was eventually driven to commit suicide. Having returned to make amends, he revealed the truth to Sharon and guarded her as she pursued her art dream. The arrogant present-day Ryan and scheming Lena kept sabotaging her at every turn. Future Ryan foiled their plots time and again and exposed their true colors. In the end, Sharon rediscovered her talent, rose to the pinnacle of the art world, and gradually opened her heart to this belated love that crossed time and space.
6a900050fd9273c14e0f4526.title: Too Late to Love Me—So He Went Back in Time

6a9001d1d85aa8495c0398a3.synopsis: Ethan Voss, heir to the ultra‑wealthy Voss conglomerate, fell in love with Clara, an ordinary girl, under a concealed identity. He was left comatose after a car accident and vanished for six years. Clara held fast on her own, gave birth to their daughter, and scraped by on odd‑job work. Upon regaining consciousness, Ethan made behind‑the‑scenes arrangements to make amends to his beloved. He threw a lavish top‑tier wedding to humiliate his snobbish relatives, finally revealed his true identity, and walked hand‑in‑hand with Clara toward a happy ending.
6a9001d1d85aa8495c0398a3.title: The Billion-Dollar Heir's Six-Year Secret Bride

6a900bc7e259af77060af16c.synopsis: Reborn as an Immortal Venerable, Tristan returns to rewrite fate itself. After crushing a deadly illusion and rebuilding his clan, he learns a shocking truth: his mother never died of illness. Behind her death stands a powerful family in the imperial capital. As he heads to Southshire, old mysteries resurface—and this time, nothing will stop him.
6a900bc7e259af77060af16c.title: I Am the Immortal Lord Season 2

6a90158f7da62716800586d3.synopsis: When Bridget’s childhood best friend, Trevor, pins her down on stage so the campus Queen Bee can chop off her waist-length hair for a cruel "prank," eighteen years of loyalty vanish in a single snip. Refusing to be a punchline, Bridget instantly withdraws from university, walks away from their toxic bond, and takes control of her own destiny. While Trevor’s life spirals out of control, Bridget rebuilds herself from the ashes, trading a humiliating public joke for a near-perfect SAT score and a triumphant path to Columbia University.
6a90158f7da62716800586d3.title: The Cut That Freed Me

6a90159bf687ef8b8704e933.synopsis: "You're lying." That's what my husband said when I begged him to save me. Six months pregnant, I was kidnapped, beaten, and left to lose our baby—while he chose his mistress over me again and again. So I gave him exactly what he deserved: my death. Now he thinks he buried his wife and daughter. But I'm still alive... and this time, I'll bury everything he loves.
6a90159bf687ef8b8704e933.title: MY MAFIA HUSBAND HAS TWO WIVES

6a9034ce5284d484dd043333.synopsis: For centuries, Pale Wraith has been trapped in a graveyard, visible only to a girl named Gianna. Gianna feeds the lonely spirit for years, and they form a deep bond until she marries and disappears. Pale Wraith waits, only to see Gianna's children return to bury their mother. Refusing to let her story end, Pale Wraith takes over Gianna's body, avenges her death, raises her children, and transforms the lives of women throughout the village, earning the name Lady Pale Wraith.
6a9034ce5284d484dd043333.title: Lady Pale Wraith

6a90e77f3400f6ce3b0fad07.synopsis: Framed by the deceitful adopted daughter Eleanor, Matilda suffered three years of unbearable torment in a dark monastery. Returning home with deep scars and a branded heart, she found only cold violence from her cruel father and blind brother. Cutting all tied blood bonds, Matilda chooses to marry Killian—a seemingly wild, disgraced prince. But behind his reckless guise lies an unwavering loyalty. When her past burns open and long-buried secrets unravel, the vicious imposter is unmasked, and her family is crushed by brutal regret. Matilda steps out of the ashes, no longer a victim, but a queen.
6a90e77f3400f6ce3b0fad07.title: The Branded Witch is the Prince's Bride

6a90ea2c3140b63d0f073a2c.synopsis: Sabrina wakes from a crash to find her husband cheating with her best friend. To steal her $5 billion trust, he "gives" her to his Mafia uncle, Silas. She fakes amnesia and uses Silas's power to destroy them both—exposing fake pregnancy, stealing deals, sending her husband to prison. When she tries to leave, Silas corners her: "You took ten years to reach me. Now you want to run?" He waited in the shadows for a decade—and finally turns her from a bargaining chip into his bride.
6a90ea2c3140b63d0f073a2c.title: The Mafia's Stolen Bride

6a90ebe987b0c61f9007735c.synopsis: Elara, an 18-year-old painter, wakes up ten years in the future as her 28-year-old self, discovering she is married to a billionaire and has a 4-year-old son. Facing an impending divorce and a fate of dying on the streets within a year, she must repair her relationship with her husband Soren in just one month. At the same time, she has to deal with Damian, a fake lover who has long been posing as a wealthy man and draining her finances, as well as her ruthless stepmother-in-law, who is scheming to seize the family fortune. Amid the chaotic and dramatic life of the wealthy elite, Elara relies on her 18-year-old wit and straightforwardness to gradually uncover the truth behind her parents' death and make her husband fall in love with her all over again—with this "new" soul.
6a90ebe987b0c61f9007735c.title: Transmigrated as a Billionaire's Wife

6a90edce12fd232313065336.synopsis: Scarlett, a kind‑hearted and resilient delivery rider, enters a flash marriage with Ethan, the CEO of Imperial Group who is disguised as a poor young man, in order to hold onto her late mother’s keepsakes. As they live together after marriage, feelings gradually blossom between them. Behind the scenes, Ethan helps her resolve workplace crises. When his true identity as a corporate president comes to light, his former fiancée teams up with their bitter rival to set her up. Amid life‑threatening danger, Scarlett recognizes her true feelings, and the two finally rebuild their trust hand‑in‑hand.
6a90edce12fd232313065336.title: The Secret Billionaire's Unexpected Bride

6a90ef7b26e6d777480a5e84.synopsis: In a world where elite vampire clans hold supreme power and vast wealth, ordinary girl Raina is saved by noble Justin, falls deeply in love with him and becomes his fiancée. When his ex-girlfriend Ellie returns, she repeatedly frames Raina. Justin always sides with Ellie and even demands Raina give up her hard-earned clan training spot. Heartbroken by his cold betrayal, Raina finally chooses to leave forever...
6a90ef7b26e6d777480a5e84.title: Goodbye Fiancé I Choose the Vampire King

6a90f6d101e2de15180ff0be.synopsis: My mate crushed our newborn son in black fire, then ripped my heart from my chest. Death should have been the end—until I woke up years earlier at the royal Choosing. This time, I refuse to marry the prince who murdered us. Instead, I choose the kingdom's weakest prince... and the moment he touches me, fate explodes between us. "Did you really think I'd fall for it twice?" my killer sneers—because he remembers our past life too. But he's about to learn he threw away the true queen... and handed me the throne.
6a90f6d101e2de15180ff0be.title: Rejected Bride, Reborn Dragon Queen

6a9102ace5c9db03f30c43ef.synopsis: Beast King Elden bears a lethal lightning curse—any living thing he touches burns to cinders. Human girl Vera is the only one who can endure his touch. To break the curse, he forces her into marriage by holding her mother hostage. Vera resents him, but glimpses his sincere heart: he heals her, shields her, and crumbles when she prays for him barefoot through brambles. The curse can be broken by consummation—but Vera would die from the backlash. Elden makes an antidote, but the villainess Lia swaps it for poison. On their wedding night, the curse lifts—but Vera collapses, never to wake. Elden mourns her for six years at her grave. But Vera is alive, raising twin children with golden beast ears in the human slums. One snowy day, her daughter clings to a passing man's leg—"Daddy." Elden finds his lost family. But Vera cannot forgive his deception, and an old enemy's father has raised a poison bow, vowing blood revenge.
6a9102ace5c9db03f30c43ef.title: Bound to the Ruthless Beast

6a9123fa3fc3c5a93a04b399.synopsis: Leo has always been one rank behind Jaxon, the star quarterback who takes everything Leo wants, including his crush, the hottest girl on campus. What Leo doesn't know is that Jaxon is secretly in love with him. So Jaxon tanks an exam on purpose, then makes Leo an offer — Tutor me to keep my captaincy, and I'll teach you how to win your dream girl. Studying calculus by day, dating lessons by night — and one plan Leo never accounted for, falling for his romance coach, his biggest rival.
6a9123fa3fc3c5a93a04b399.title: Romance Lessons with My Quarterback

6a912471533d191e1d0a5726.synopsis: Brynna’s fiancé, Sterling, crashes their wedding with his wealthy mistress, Celina. In front of everyone, they set fire to the wedding dress designs she spent months creating and viciously humiliate her elderly mother. Enraged by their cruelty, her mother suffers a fatal heart attack and dies on the spot. Overnight, Brynna loses her fiancé, her career, and the only family she has left. Heartbroken, she leaves the country. Five years later, Brynna makes a stunning return to the fashion world with her daughter, Mia, and her mysterious “contract husband,” Kane. At a major fashion exhibition, Sterling claims Mia is his daughter. He and Celina publicly slap Brynna and try to snatch the child from her. Just when Brynna is about to lose everything again, Kane steps forward to protect them and reveals his true identity.He is one of Europe’s most powerful financial tycoons. In front of the entire crowd, he declares Brynna his legal wife and Mia his biological daughter. Sterling’s exhibition privileges are immediately revoked.Everyone thinks Brynna has finally turned the tables.But the real revenge has only just begun. And when the dust finally settles, what will become of the contract marriage that has lasted five years?
6a912471533d191e1d0a5726.title: My Kids Ruin My Ex's Fancy Life

6a912552e51337cc6f014800.synopsis: After Alpha Luke killed her parents, Freya enters his estate with one goal: revenge. But she catches the attention of Leander, Luke’s carefree son everyone considers a worthless playboy. He seems careless and arrogant, but Freya soon discovers the darkness hidden beneath his charming mask. As enemies become allies and secrets begin to unravel, Freya is pulled into a dangerous game of revenge, power, and forbidden attraction. On the eve of her mate ceremony with Luke, when Freya is about to become his Luna, she discovers that Leander is her true fated mate.
6a912552e51337cc6f014800.title: Married His Father,Now My Mat Call Me Stepmother

6a91653d7b441cad410e390c.synopsis: In The Mafia Boss's Contract Bride movie, Elena signed the divorce papers, penniless, wandering through the rain with her suitcase. A "Wanted: Stepmother" flyer on a deli bulletin board caught her attention. She followed the address, only to find that her employer turned out to be the Marchetti family, the most powerful mafia dynasty on the East Coast.
6a91653d7b441cad410e390c.title: The Mafia Boss's Contract Bride

6a916cb6a07eb2f5bb00297a.synopsis: Billion-dollar conglomerate founder Sarah returns home, keeping her wealth hidden, hoping only for a quiet wedding. Unexpectedly, Hailey, her son's fiancée, humiliates her relentlessly to seize her wedding venue — completely unaware that the victim before her is none other than her fiancé's own mother! Hailey resorts to extreme violence. She shoots Sarah and has her bound and drowned in a resort pool to silence her. Miraculously surviving, Sarah refuses her son's protection. Disguised as a waitress, she infiltrates the engagement gala. Before the city's elite and assembled media, witnesses and irrefutable evidence come to light, exposing Hailey’s full conspiracy: fake-pregnancy fraud, embezzlement, and attempted murder. The villain is publicly ruined. Sarah makes her triumphant return, reclaiming everything that belongs to her!
6a916cb6a07eb2f5bb00297a.title: Fake Angel's Final Fall

6a94d78854bf92589202afac.synopsis: Molly Hart runs a street food truck called Big Molly’s Hot Dogs with her adoptive parents. People love to joke about the name—and about Molly herself—but she never lets it get to her. If anything, she turns it into part of the brand. Meanwhile, Adrian Blackwood, heir to the Blackwood empire, has gone days without being able to eat. The best doctors, private chefs, and nutritionists money can buy have all failed to help him. Then Charles brings one of Molly’s hot dogs back to the estate. What was meant to be a simple meal unexpectedly catches Adrian’s attention. For the first time in days, he willingly takes a bite—and his condition immediately begins to improve. The moment Adrian learns the hot dog came from a food-truck girl named Molly Hart, he sets out to find her. Neither of them expects that a relationship beginning with food, money, and a very unusual arrangement will eventually turn into something neither can walk away from: real dependence, real desire, and real love.
6a94d78854bf92589202afac.title: Big Molly The Billionaire's Only Cure

6a94da44281fc60a7909373a.synopsis: Eva, a cold-blooded assassin, accidentally triggers a deadly curse after killing the man chosen as her soulmate. Her only chance of survival is Leo—a clumsy Cupid apprentice who has failed his divine exam for ten thousand years. Bound by an invisible life thread, they must stay within three meters of each other or die. With only seven days left, the mismatched pair is forced to run from a powerful assassin organization while uncovering a conspiracy that has been manipulating love itself. Eva has never trusted anyone. But when Leo repeatedly risks his life to save hers, she must decide whether love is her greatest weakness—or her only way out.
6a94da44281fc60a7909373a.title: Clumsy Cupid

6a94dc4c834d8e48b901d179.synopsis: The Ph.D. candidate Thea personally taught a lone male dragon courtship calls and the Flame Dance to complete her thesis. The dragon immediately performed the move in front of her after learning it. The mentor's phone call tore open the truth. The courtship ritual involves abducting the mate into the nest and locking them until egg-laying. It's too late now—the claws tear open the roof, and he transforms into a human form to take her away. She dreamed back twelve years in a fever. She had fallen from a cable car and was rescued by a young ancient dragon. After the relationship was established, she imprisoned him in reverse. She opened the cage door and knelt to propose.
6a94dc4c834d8e48b901d179.title: I Taught Him to Court a Mate — He Chose Me

6a94dd9bda8c8b6cd704fe18.synopsis: In You Can't Stop My Super X-Ray Vision movie, after his girlfriend dumps him, Michael, a luxury brand CEO with X-ray vision, uses his powers and confidence to bring down arrogant global influencer bullies, all while winning the heart of his high school's most popular girl.
6a94dd9bda8c8b6cd704fe18.title: You Can't Stop My Super X-Ray Vision

6a94ddb411f2b8c133009eea.synopsis: Ever since my Omega sister saved me from wolfsbane poisoning, she used that life debt to control every detail of my existence—including my wedding. She picked the flowers, designed the theme, and even tried on wedding dresses with my groom while he smiled in delight. Every time I voiced my outrage, they weaponized the past to silence me: "She saved your life! Why are you always acting like the villain?" If they want the wedding so badly, they can keep each other. I discarded my ring and returned to my royal pack, took my throne as Alpha Queen.
6a94ddb411f2b8c133009eea.title: From Puppet Bride to Alpha Queen

6a94de31327cf4d1930976d9.synopsis: Lena has been secretly married to Isaac for a year in Shh Don’t Let Him Find Out. She accepts the secrecy and still remembers the sweet words he whispers in her ear about how much he loves her. Lena is certain that nobody could ever replace her in his heart. What she doesn’t realize is that she is nothing more than a pawn. Isaac married her to satisfy a family rule and qualify for his inheritance. Lena’s false sense of peace shatters when Isaac’s debt leaves her at the mercy of loan sharks. Once she understands what he has done, she faces them by herself. The ordeal leaves her struggling to regain her balance, but someone steps in to protect her. That man is CEO Jack Kane, a billionaire who also rules the West Coast mafia. Jack looks at Lena with an obsessive hunger he makes little effort to hide. He is also her father-in-law. As his hands begin to wander, Lena finds herself giving in to the attraction between them. Getting closer to Jack also gives her a chance to plot her revenge against her soon-to-be ex-husband, Isaac. Characters Lena Lena is the main female character in Shh Don’t Let Him Find Out. She doesn’t realize that her cowardly husband has been using their marriage for his own benefit. The truth finally becomes clear after Isaac’s actions put her in danger and she meets Jack. Jack Kane Jack Kane is the main male character and Isaac’s father. He knows exactly how cowardly and despicable his son can be. Jack loves Lena and wants to protect her from the trouble Isaac has caused. Isaac Kane Isaac Kane is the main male villain who leaves Lena burdened with his debt. He has no problem draining other people’s money for his own benefit. When carrying out his plans, he sometimes works with his mistress, Bella. Bella Bella is the female villain, and she is every bit as shallow and manipulative as Isaac. She envies Lena’s success in the port project and sometimes helps Isaac carry out his plans.
6a94de31327cf4d1930976d9.title: Shh, Don't Let Him Find Out

6a94df7b94243530c408228d.synopsis: On the day Beatrice catches her husband of eight years cheating, she quietly hands him divorce papers he signs without realizing — starting a thirty-day countdown to freedom. As she dismantles the Belmont family's schemes one by one, she is pulled into the orbit of Damian Crowley, her ex-husband's most feared cousin and the mysterious head of the NobleQuest Group. Revenge, a slow-burning romance, and a long-buried secret about a fire and her own origins begin to surface.
6a94df7b94243530c408228d.title: Obsessed by My Ex's Boss

6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.synopsis: On the continent of Vester, Iso—Supreme Ruler of the Hidden Dragon Dominion—goes into hiding under a humble identity to investigate his mother Saintess Esara's murder. Disguised as an ordinary man, he takes residence in Silvermoon Castle and, honoring an old betrothal, becomes the fiancé of Sera, heiress to the saintess lineage. Sera, however, is obsessed with the legendary Dragon Lord—a mythical figure she has worshipped from afar—and feels only disappointment toward her unremarkable-looking betrothed. She frequently mocks and belittles him, unaware of his true identity. Cardinal Taren of the Orthodox Church, coveting the saintess's power, secretly hires eight renowned Dragon Slayers and rallies noble conspirators to ambush and assassinate Sera time and again. Each time, Iso secretly intervenes, wielding his silver-dragon might to save her. At Dragon Ridge Altar, he finally reveals his true form as the Dragon Lord—yet Sera fails to recognize him. The perils continue: a tavern trap, a royal council coup, and a siege by dark Dragon Slayers—all quietly thwarted by Iso from the shadows. At the climactic final banquet, the Church launches its all-out assault. Iso summons a thousand dragons before the entire assembly, shattering the enemy's ranks. Only then does Sera realize that the "ordinary" fiancé who stood by her all along is the Dragon Lord she so longed to meet. Together, they join forces to counter the Church's conspiracy and uncover the truth behind the past.
6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.title: Secret Dragon

6a94e01145098107520f9f20.synopsis: Dr. Miles Hill is flying with a life-saving kidney for the Zeller family when Jane and her mother sabotage the delivery, destroying the precious organ. Without the transplant, the Zeller patriarch loses his only chance at survival. Jane had dreamed of marrying into the wealthy Zeller family, but her scheme backfires, shattering her hopes of wealth and status overnight.
6a94e01145098107520f9f20.title: Her Dream of Marrying Rich Turned Deadly

6a94e555fcfb758a6d08267d.synopsis: At her son’s seventh birthday charity gala, Elena Moore is humiliated on a live broadcast when her little boy crosses out her face in the family photo and declares another woman his real mother. Her powerful husband, Derek Harrington, demands she apologize instead of protecting her. But Elena refuses to break. She announces a divorce and launches an audit into the Harrington Children’s Medical Fund. Soon, she uncovers a chilling “Mom Exit Plan”: staged videos, a fake psychiatric evaluation, and a plan to erase her from her child’s life forever. This time, Elena fights back.
6a94e555fcfb758a6d08267d.title: My Son Crossed Me Out for His New Mom

6a94e906802350a8530a156c.synopsis: Annie, a human, fell in love with Fenrir, the wolf king, and bore twin half-blood children. Yet they were brutally exiled due to blood prejudice and Mara’s malicious schemes. Five years later, the twins’ werewolf blood awakens unexpectedly, dragging the whole family back into power struggles and deadly hunts. Following the clues, Fenrir uncovers the truth of the past. While protecting his wife and daughters, he exacts revenge on the real mastermind behind all the crimes.
6a94e906802350a8530a156c.title: The Alpha King's Half-Blood Twins

6a94ebefe7c41896010967cf.synopsis: Heroine Stella, betrayed on her crowning night, hosts dragon prince Silas's soul in her heart. From enemies to symbiosis, she embraces dragonhood, escapes to Ash Mountains with elf prince Logan, and battles Grant's void-army. Completing a blood ritual, she becomes a dragon knight, unites three races, defeats the void god, reunites with family, and evolves from avenger to guardian.
6a94ebefe7c41896010967cf.title: Marked by Him I Became the Dragon Clan's Forbidden Toy

6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.synopsis: After his father dies saving the world, he is branded a traitor and his entire clan is destroyed. Ryan vanishes into exile, training in secret for fourteen years. Now Ryan returns to expose the dark mage's conspiracy, clear his father's name.
6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.title: Vindication: Blood of the Archmage

6a94edde525a0f0b05072178.synopsis: Duncan, once a renowned master chef, is transported to another world and reduced to a lowly kitchen hand at the Marquis of Farhaven's estate. When a grand banquet is nearly ruined, he saves it with leftover ingredients and catches the Marchioness's eye. After earning a chance to cook, he faces sabotage from powerful food merchants. Undeterred, Duncan turns humble lotus root, cabbage, and crab into exquisite dishes, wins the Golden Key, earns his freedom, and opens a restaurant of his own.
6a94edde525a0f0b05072178.title: Cooking My Way Out of Servitude

6a94efb998f9dd536609d392.synopsis: Natalie, the dragon-slaying heroine, abdicated her throne to protect her adopted daughter Lily. Unable to bear being torn apart from the child, she returned Lily to her birth mother Iris. Unbeknownst to her, it was a cruel scheme devised to harvest Lily’s heart. Upon learning that Lily was imprisoned, tortured and hanging by a thread, Natalie reclaims her crown. She storms the castle with the full might of a queen, exposes all the lies, resolves to rescue her daughter and make everyone who harmed her pay dearly.
6a94efb998f9dd536609d392.title: Release the queen's daughter

6a94f0cc46d3fb23b6034c95.synopsis: He's the strongest Alpha alive—cursed so that anyone who touches him burns to ash. She's a wolfless mage apprentice who fell from the sky straight into his arms… and didn't burn. Desperate to find her fated mate, Aria takes a job as Kael's personal maid, unaware the cold, dangerous Alpha is already falling for her. But a dark prophecy looms: their child will carry a curse far deadlier than his—and bearing it could cost Aria her life. When rivals attack and Aria's life hangs by a thread, Kael will face the deadliest mountain in the world to save her. Because some fates aren't written—they're fought for.
6a94f0cc46d3fb23b6034c95.title: Cursed Alpha’s Fated Luna

6a94f45a2e175c3d910e7135.synopsis: In the underground arenas of a wasteland metropolis, Ryker, an F-rank underdog, risks his life in brutal bare-knuckle fights to save his sister, Lena, from a fatal genetic disease. Driven to the brink, he swallows an ominous Insect King egg offered by the Black Market King, unleashing a terrifying power within himself. Armed with this monstrous ability, Ryker defies class prejudice and claws his way up the ranks, only to find himself steadily mutating into something inhuman. As the dark truth comes to light, he discovers that his sister's illness and his parents' deaths are tied to a sinister imperial conspiracy disguised as human-insect hybridization. With war and a relentless swarm engulfing the city, can Ryker—on the verge of complete metamorphosis—cling to his fading humanity and save the only family he has left?
6a94f45a2e175c3d910e7135.title: I Swallowed the Zerg Overmind's Egg

6a94fac21102a673db08d5e8.synopsis: A broke young woman agrees to be a stranger's wife for ninety days to save her brother from prison — only to learn her "husband" is the billionaire who has spent seventeen years searching for the girl who once saved his life.
6a94fac21102a673db08d5e8.title: Oops! My Fake Husband Got Me Pregnant!

6a9513ea94b7be68f406102f.synopsis: After a one‑night stand, Shirley is horrified to discover her lover Sophia is her stepsister. Terrified, she tries to keep her distance, yet Sophia pursues her relentlessly with bold advances, and they are nearly caught by their blended‑family parents. Overwhelmed by intense attraction, Shirley yields and embarks on a thrilling, forbidden secret romance with her. Professor Sophia grows increasingly reckless, even flirting openly with Shirley at the freshman speech event. Envious Amy sets Shirley up and spreads lies to drive them apart. Heartbroken, Shirley breaks up with Sophia. Abducted by hitmen Amy hired, Shirley learns Sophia is secretly the underworld kingpin. They reconcile. Just as Shirley plucks up courage to go public with their relationship, Sophia’s first love Vivian returns home. Rejected suitor Klein exposes their affair to their families. Amid fierce opposition, Sophia lets go of old grudges. Standing firm in their love, the two finally break free from social prejudices and stay together.
6a9513ea94b7be68f406102f.title: Sinking With My Step‑sister

6a951a615fd77720d3076393.synopsis: After a painful rebirth, Eleanor, once a devoted wife and mother, finds her family's affection reserved for Lydia, her husband William's true love. Betrayed by William's bigamy and her children's cruelty, she abandons them, secretly applying to Harvard. As she builds a new life in science, William and the children, now suffering under Lydia's abuse, realize their loss. They beg for forgiveness, but Eleanor, hardened by their betrayal, coldly rejects them. Choosing her own path, she leaves them behind to embrace a future of independence and self-worth.
6a951a615fd77720d3076393.title: After I Took Back My Love

6a951b15f5e222776e05b7ec.synopsis: A firefighter sets his own home ablaze for his mistress’s drill, trapping his three-year-old daughter inside. The mother watches via security cam, but he dismisses her pleas, calls the child illegitimate, and prioritizes the assessment. As flames consume the nursery, the daughter’s ghost emerges—still apologizing for being “bad.” Only when charred remains, a melted necklace, and final recordings surface does he break down. But forgiveness never comes. The daughter’s last words: “Daddy didn’t love me.” He is arrested; she fades into ash, finally free.
6a951b15f5e222776e05b7ec.title: Firefighter Husband Burned His Daughter, Driven to Desperate Regret

6a951e521102a673db08d5ef.synopsis: Evelyn was once the beloved human daughter of four mighty Norse god-kings. But when the false saintess Freya framed her, the fathers who raised her chose to believe a liar. They stripped her blessing, tortured her soul, stole her blood, and forced her to beg for death. Only after Evelyn truly dies do they discover the truth: Freya was the monster all along, and Evelyn's real mother has been trapped beneath the World Tree. Now the gods want their daughter back. But the little girl they destroyed no longer wants to return.
6a951e521102a673db08d5ef.title: Daughter of the Four Norse God-Kings

6a951fac6e99d6bfe505e0dc.synopsis: In Tempted by my bad boy stepbrother movie, Olivia has secretly loved her stepbrother Jacob for years — but ever since their parents' wedding, he's treated her like a stranger. He races motorcycles and lives on the edge; she's the golden girl who never breaks a rule. When one reckless night forces them together, buried feelings start clawing their way to the surface. Some lines were never meant to be crossed.
6a951fac6e99d6bfe505e0dc.title: Tempted by My Bad Boy Stepbrother

6a9528b29e1ac8de2d01d8e4.synopsis: Cassius, a former top-tier bodyguard, retired to the countryside. After his family was persecuted by criminal forces, he wielded the Valerius family's supreme black card to settle scores with all his enemies. Standing side by side with Celine, the family head who admired him, he protected his loved ones and dismantled a transnational criminal network.
6a9528b29e1ac8de2d01d8e4.title: Black Card The Reckoning

6a954112ffb159a50b0e241a.synopsis: To save his dying daughter, he knelt in the rain begging his ex-wife, only to be pushed into the mud. Left for dead, he was run over by a luxury car—but at that very moment, his royal dragon blood awakened! With golden eyes and giant wings, he became the last living dragon on earth. To escape an arranged marriage, the cold female CEO offered him a contract marriage and saved his daughter. He hid his identity as her assistant, mocked by his ex-wife as a worthless toy boy. Until the night of the elite gala— The city's richest tycoons and the war general knelt before him, shouting: "Welcome back, Your Highness!" His ex-wife spat blood in pure regret. But when the enemies who slaughtered his clan thirty years ago kidnapped his daughter, they crossed the line. Touch the dragon's scale, and prepare to die! No more hiding—his wings blocked the sky, bringing down divine wrath in the storm to crush them all. He saved his child, conquered the cold CEO's heart, and claimed his throne as the only king of this world!
6a954112ffb159a50b0e241a.title: My Hidden Dragon Awakened

6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.synopsis: Four years ago, healer Seraphina saved cursed Infernal Legion commander Drake and gave birth to twins. Unaware of his identity, she was exiled by her family and raised the children alone. Years later, the wounded Drake is found by the kids and brought home. He falls for Seraphina at first sight and proposes firmly. Amid stepmother's persecution, brother's power grab and dark magic crisis, they uncover the truth of their past. Finally Drake inherits the Lord of the North, and the family of four lives happily together.
6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.title: The Inferno Warlord's Secret Healer Bride

6a962bb32b4cbe2329008357.synopsis: Enslaved by the Alpha who slaughtered her family, Lyra is forced to the altar until his son Asher kills him and claims her. Their fated bond ignites, but Asher hides her and takes political Luna Selene to shield her. Selene's jealousy explodes into brutal torture, forcing his cruelty to mask his devotion. When Selene and brother Garrick's coup erupts into war, Lyra reveals she is a lost Alpha's daughter and helps crush it, killing Garrick herself. Selene is exiled, and Lyra is crowned his equal.
6a962bb32b4cbe2329008357.title: The Alpha's Forbidden Mate

6a9631352b4cbe232900835a.synopsis: In my past life, my husband's niece drowned my newborn. To protect their precious heiress, the mafia family told me to let it go. When I refused, my own husband murdered me. Now, I’ve been reborn on the morning it all happened. This time, I secretly send my son to my father, the most powerful Mafia Godfather in the city. But when I return to the party, another baby still ends up in the pool. Predictably, my husband and his family rush to destroy the body to cover it up. Now there's just one question: whose child did their golden girl really kill?
6a9631352b4cbe232900835a.title: A Mother's Vengeance

6a963ba8fda5294962054f78.synopsis: Tessa is pushed off a building by her adopted sister Chloe. She wakes up at fifteen, reliving her life. This time, she refuses to fight for her family's love. Chloe manipulates everyone, framing Tessa for cheating. Tessa calmly proves Chloe's guilt using surveillance footage. Chloe is expelled. Tessa earns straight A's and a Yale scholarship. Her family apologizes, but she remains distant. She leaves for Yale alone, determined to live for herself.
6a963ba8fda5294962054f78.title: I Watched Them Love Her

6a963bbc7308ebfe9309c899.synopsis: Serena Vale died with Adrian's silver knife in her chest after her sister Lila screamed, "Serena stole my Luna mark." Reborn at the Moon Den, Serena refuses to bleed for Lila again. The mark chooses her in front of the pack, and when her former betrothed steps forward, she makes the choice that shatters Blackwood: "I choose Rowan Blackwood." Rowan is Adrian's cursed uncle, poisoned into a living corpse, but his wolf still answers her. When he wakes and asks who dared touch his Luna, Serena's second life turns from survival into war.
6a963bbc7308ebfe9309c899.title: Reborn as the Cursed Alpha's Luna

6a96459a9521102b6f0c2bf8.synopsis: Delaney is the youngest daughter most beloved by the Dragon God, but she falls in love with a human named Dylan. As a test, the Dragon God seals Delaney’s divine powers for three years. During those three years, Delaney, a female CEO, helps Dylan’s company grow into a household-name corporation. To protect Dylan’s pride, she supports him quietly from behind the scenes. In the third year of their marriage, Delaney gives birth to a dragon egg that needs to be hatched, but Dylan becomes involved with Daphne, his secretary who is secretly his mistress. At an auction, Delaney crosses paths with Daphne and the two clash. The dragon egg, on the verge of hatching, becomes the target of Daphne’s jealous rage…
6a96459a9521102b6f0c2bf8.title: She Smashed My Dragon Baby, I Smashed Her Life

6a9666af470904d5580f098e.synopsis: For ten years, Evelyn helped Stephen rise from fallen prince to emperor, protecting him and bearing his two children. She thought their love would last forever until he married her sister. Heartbroken, Evelyn activated her system and returned to the modern world. Only after she vanished did Stephen and their children realize what they'd lost, crossing a thousand years to beg her back. But Evelyn is done being anyone's consort or mother. This time, she chooses herself.
6a9666af470904d5580f098e.title: Your Consort Is Back in the Modern World

6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.synopsis: GT endurance driver Kai Mercer is pushed into a reserve role after refusing his sponsor’s sexual advances, while struggling with his father’s debts and his mother’s illness. Through an anonymous platform, Kai develops an intimate relationship with a mysterious man named Nox, unaware that Nox is actually Adrian Cross, his new team owner and a four-time World Endurance Champion. As Kai falls for both identities, Adrian’s secret creates a dangerous conflict of trust and power. When the truth is exposed, Kai walks away. After kidnappings, threats, professional investigations, and an ethics hearing, the two eventually rebuild their relationship, while Kai earns his place as a professional works driver.
6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.title: Below the Red Line

6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.synopsis: Desperate to pay for her sick mother’s treatment, restaurant waitress Anna is betrayed by her biological father, Richard, and sent into a deadly trap controlled by an East Side crime boss. Using her combat skills and intelligence, she survives, defeats Victor, and escapes with crucial evidence. With the help of Leo, an undercover operative and Thomas’s son, Anna rises through Los Angeles’ criminal underworld, taking control of casinos and territory. But she soon discovers that her entire rise has been part of Thomas’s larger power game. Together, Anna and Leo expose the money-laundering operation and bring down Thomas and Richard.
6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.title: Blood Rose Crushing the Cartel

6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.synopsis: Odysseus is the secret demigod son of Apollo, bound by a deathbed vow to give his queen, Antigone, a hundred chances to earn his trust — and never seize her throne. He turns white-haired overnight saving her kingdom from a monster, only to catch her in another man's arms. Stripped of power, tortured, framed, betrayed again and again — every wrong she commits burns away one more chance. When the hundredth chance runs out, his true power awakens. He returns for vengeance, spear blazing with divine fire — but victory comes at the ultimate price: his own existence.
6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.title: Demigod Under Oath

6a9786141e7b557da205265b.synopsis: Bullied university student Elena saves her mysterious professor, Lucien, from a deadly poison. Their fateful encounter leaves Elena pregnant with sextuplets—six baby dragons! Just as her abusive family and cruel classmates attempt to burn her alive for carrying "monsters," Lucien descends as a Black-and-Gold Dragon King to claim her as his Queen. However, Elena's rare ability to bear dragon heirs makes her the ultimate prize for the wicked Frost Dragon, Kael. Caught in a deadly war, can Elena awaken her true power and protect her family?
6a9786141e7b557da205265b.title: Pregnant with the Dragon King's Sextuplets

6a978afb992e4c583d089fdb.synopsis: Tim Harper is secretly Titan, but at school he's a bullied new kid. His powers keep nearly slipping out, and Sarah suspects his double life. Their bond grows through a talent show and a scholarship contest run by billionaire Blackwell, secretly Tim's mentor. Confessing his secret costs Tim his powers. Mayor Hunter and Jax frame him at a gala, and a blast nearly kills everyone. Powerless, Tim risks his life anyway, regains his powers, and flies off with Sarah as the villains are arrested.
6a978afb992e4c583d089fdb.title: World's Strongest Loser!

6a97933e4755502ce50b4a6b.synopsis: Elf Princess Helena dies tragically when her husband and "daughter" let a crused rabbit drain her rare golden blood. In her final moments, she uncovers the sickening truth: the rabbit is his cursed mistress, and the girl she raised is an evil spirit possessing her true daughter’s body. Reborn on the exact day the beast arrives, Helena plays the oblivious, fragile wife—while secretly plotting a savage retribution to destroy the traitors and reclaim her child's soul.
6a97933e4755502ce50b4a6b.title: My Blood-Sucking Familiar Is My Husband’s Lover

6a97bb7b5edcbfc5b9067696.synopsis: Though blind, Lyra has an incredible gift: she can understand the language of spirit beasts. Then she starts bonding with adorable spirit pets and gathers a group of steadfast companions. Using her kindness and wit, she calms the beast tides!
6a97bb7b5edcbfc5b9067696.title: I Calm the Beast Tides With Spirit‑Words

6a97c252a24f1db6960c76d2.synopsis: Cast out penniless by the Zellers with just $280 and a family pickling jar, Charles hits rock bottom in Frostpond. Desperate, he turns wild cress into a signature tangy sensation, going from local joke to go-to hot pot supplier. Targeted by rivals with smear campaigns, knockoffs, and sabotaged water lines, he refuses to cut corners. Through radical transparency and a village co-op, he turns a desperate hustle into a thriving empire, a comeback built on grit, craft, and pure integrity.
6a97c252a24f1db6960c76d2.title: His Pickled Empire

6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.synopsis: Born a commoner, Eleanor has spent years quietly protecting her husband, Duke Adrian, and his kingdom. Yet he has always mistaken her loyalty for ambition, believing she married him only for status and power. After being publicly humiliated and heartlessly cast aside by the man she loves, Eleanor finally gives up on their marriage and walks away. Only after she leaves does Adrian discover that the mysterious masked warrior who repeatedly saved his life was Eleanor all along. What he still does not know is that she is also the long-lost heir to a powerful empire. When Eleanor reclaims her identity and the power that rightfully belongs to her, Adrian finally realizes what he has lost. Meanwhile, an ambitious regent launches a coup, plunging the entire kingdom into crisis. With both his former wife and his realm in danger, Adrian is willing to sacrifice everything to protect Eleanor. But this time, he is no longer fighting to win back her love—only for the chance to earn her forgiveness.
6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.title: The Duchess They Cast Away

6a97fcd41810d9e05a02c5a5.synopsis: Nia is a 300-pound Omega mocked by the entire pack as a disgusting fat wolf. When Alpha Zayne chooses her as his Luna, she believes she has finally been loved. She poisons herself, bleeds for him, tears her own fur to keep him warm, and carries his child. Then she overhears the truth: Zayne only used her as a womb and plans to kill her after the baby is born. Betrayed, abused, and forced through unbearable trials, Nia awakens as a legendary White Wolf. Now she returns under a new name, not for love, but to save the child Zayne killed. The Alpha finally falls in love with her beauty, but the woman who once loved him has already died.
6a97fcd41810d9e05a02c5a5.title: After the 330-Pound Fat Wolf Left, the Alpha Went Crazy with Regret

6a97fe91ae5bf68c3c0ed5e7.synopsis: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her best friend at a college party, Vera accidentally falls into a pool and wakes up in Ancient Egypt. Branded an outsider and hunted for her mysterious origins, she's rescued by Prince Amon, who discovers she carries the blood of an ancient god. As a power-hungry queen plots to use Vera's divine bloodline to seize the throne, Vera and Amon are drawn into a deadly game of palace intrigue, betrayal, and forbidden love. Just when Vera finally finds a way back home, the person she trusts most is killed. Choosing revenge over escape, she embraces the godlike power within her—but the truth behind her bloodline could destroy everything Ancient Egypt was built on.
6a97fe91ae5bf68c3c0ed5e7.title: Bound to the Pharaoh

6a98068fa11efb8684067d36.synopsis: To pay off her father’s debts, Diana Banning unexpectedly shares an intimate night with billionaire CEO Ethan Vance and ends up marrying him out of guilt and obligation. She is determined to fulfill her dream of being a designer, yet she winds up with an overly clingy, jealous husband.An ex-boyfriend, a young female rival chasing Ethan Vance, and an imposter pretending to be the CEO’s wife keep stirring up trouble. Ethan Vance fakes illness to hold her close while fiercely standing up for her against anyone who dares to hurt her. A hilarious, heart-fluttering tug-of-war filled with love and jealousy kicks off!
6a98068fa11efb8684067d36.title: Moonlit Wilds, A Secret Yearning

6a980ef9a68d1a06280ed24a.synopsis: Fifteen years ago, Princess Serafina of the White Dragon Clan shattered her dragon crystal to save three dying alien youths—Kael the wolf, Dorian the merman, and Soren the vampire. She lost three‑quarters of her power in exchange for their vow of eternal marriage. On the night of her father's funeral, she caught them cheating with her stepmother Lilith in the mourning hall. Heart‑turned‑ash, she tore up the tri‑clan contract on the spot. Her ex‑fiancés, who had risen on her power, felt their strength crumble as the dragon crystal shards inside them backfired. They begged. She walked away. Now Serafina is on a path to recover her complete dragon crystal and reclaim the Dragon Clan's throne. And a mysterious man who never owed her anything, yet would burn himself for her, is stepping out of the shadows.
6a980ef9a68d1a06280ed24a.title: Dragon Girl's New Choice: All 3 Fiancés, Get Lost

6a98116575e068605f0b3cf7.synopsis: Aria, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car, a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private high school. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Damon, the werewolf heir, and Levi, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities. One as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love? Aria later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything.
6a98116575e068605f0b3cf7.title: Bound by Crimson and Silver

6a9813f417879200f002d8ca.synopsis: Falsely condemned to bear only lowly mongrels, Moonwolf she‑wolf Aurora is viciously harmed by her husband and clan leader Tristan. Reborn on the day of the political marriage, she hears the hateful prophecy again and watches Tristan wed her sister to produce a noble Silverwolf. On a full‑moon night, Aurora slips into Moonillusion Bar and surrenders herself to the trapped, heat‑stricken ancient wolf god Fenrir for a child. Their fiery night frees Fenrir from his thousand‑year bonds. He shocks everyone by claiming the pregnant Aurora as his bride. She delivers a supreme wolf king. Her powerful bloodline erases every disgrace. The traitor and her scheming sister kneel in defeat. Aurora changes her fate and gains unmatched glory.
6a9813f417879200f002d8ca.title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King

6a981593d34037288f0fc899.synopsis: When a zombie outbreak hits, Mia saves someone—only to be attacked in return. Just when she’s about to die, Damian, the Zombie King who’s secretly loved her for years, comes to her rescue. Things get even crazier when Damian takes her home and his zombie parents already call her their daughter-in-law. Then Mia learns the cure may lie in Damian’s genes! Now she has one crazy plan: win over the Zombie King, have his baby, and save the world！
6a981593d34037288f0fc899.title: Walker Love Tale

6a981a168259296cb909cc7d.synopsis: At Cascadia Reptile Research Institute, Noah Hayes is assigned to Avery, the largest and most bad-tempered white python in the facility. Avery refuses food, scares away every snake Noah cares for, bites only him, and keeps wrapping around him like a jealous lover. Noah thinks the snake hates him, until a breeding-season check reveals the ridiculous truth: Avery has been courting him all along. When Avery starts leaving “gifts,” guarding him from other snakes, and appearing in Noah’s dreams as a beautiful silver-haired man, Noah realizes his troublesome white snake may want far more than care. He wants Noah.
6a981a168259296cb909cc7d.title: My Black Python Wants My Eggs

6a981efcfbf28c4f110062c3.synopsis: Selena is the real biological daughter of the Grant family but is framed and alienated by her adopted sister Kelly, neglected by her three elder brothers. In her past life, she stayed loyal and cared for them even after the family fell apart, only to die tragically in a car accident. Reborn, she vows to stay away from the cold Grants and live for herself. Unexpectedly, her three brothers also return with full memories and endless regret. They dote on her fiercely and crush every scheme from Kelly. Hardened Selena slowly melts under their desperate love, getting the family devotion she was denied in her last life.
6a981efcfbf28c4f110062c3.title: My Three Brothers Finally Chose Me

6a98202ff5b9b83c45081220.synopsis: Emma, the wife of the founder of a Paris‑based fashion brand, endured long‑term humiliation and betrayal from her husband Maxime, her best friend Camille and her sister‑in‑law Valerie because of her weight. She was even pushed off a terrace and locked in a cold storage room to die. On the brink of death, she was rescued by her biological grandfather Henri, who had been searching for her for years. She learned that she was the sole heir to the Villard fashion empire. With the companionship of her childhood sweetheart Lorenzo, Emma rebuilt herself over seven months. She made a glamorous comeback under the identity of Adele Villard and carefully laid out schemes to take revenge on those who had betrayed her. In the end, she exposed their crimes, took over the empire, and embarked on a brand‑new life.
6a98202ff5b9b83c45081220.title: Revenge Is a Size Zero

6a98d56ee2c86a26c0043d17.synopsis: In her past life, Sloane was betrayed and killed by her fiancé, Liam, and her stepsister, Gemma, who stole her family fortune. Reborn on her engagement night, she calls off the wedding and marries Tristan Hawth, Liam's ailing uncle. Together, they uncover the massive secret plot crafted by Jonathan and Valerie. After gathering evidence against their enemies, Sloane and Tristan fall in love and have a real wedding, starting their new life together.
6a98d56ee2c86a26c0043d17.title: Reborn: My New Groom Is My Fiancé's Uncle

6a98d9755972ce3f4d0efdb8.synopsis: Silas was the world's greatest magician—a masked vigilante called the "King of Magic." When an assassin's bullet meant for him killed his mentor, Silas vowed to vanish and protect the man's daughter, Lyra. Now hiding as a janitor at Lyra's failing theater, he silently guards her and her little girl. But her vicious ex, her greedy uncle, and a parade of elite magicians descend to seize everything—forcing her into deadly magic duels where losing means death. One by one, Silas steps from the shadows. Whispers spread: could this lowly janitor be the missing King of Magic himself?
6a98d9755972ce3f4d0efdb8.title: American Magician: The Last Encore

6a98ee249190c115d90278b7.synopsis: Beneath New York City, a secret werewolf society exists alongside the human world. At the request of a close friend, pureblood Alpha Marcus Vance fabricates a $50,000 debt to force young illustrator Felix Carter to stay by his side—supposedly for his own “protection.”Cold, obsessively clean, and seemingly immune to desire, Marcus soon finds his defenses crumbling under the pressures of living together...
6a98ee249190c115d90278b7.title: My Wolf Roommate is a Fool

6a98faf36b47f6c32e069f44.synopsis: A broke small-town perfumer agrees to a $50,000 marriage of convenience—only to discover her "nobody" husband is the werewolf king who married her for the scent that calms his beast.
6a98faf36b47f6c32e069f44.title: Boss, Your Wolf Secret Is Out!

6a98fc7809dda853590ac775.synopsis: After their fates are reset, two sisters embark on completely different life journeys. Letting go of past pains, the younger sister chooses to stand side by side with a duke misunderstood by the whole world. Step by step, she uncovers the truth of manipulated destinies with courage and wisdom, breaking the invisible chains that trap countless people. In the end, everyone breaks free from prearranged lives and learns to take responsibility for their own choices.
6a98fc7809dda853590ac775.title: Ashes and Thorns

6a98fe18f74722e51507e385.synopsis: After ten years of sacrificing her career and inheritance for Julian, Sophie discovers he has kept a mistress, fathered a child, and moved millions while planning to divorce her with almost nothing. Instead of confronting him too soon, she gathers evidence, returns to Whitmore Materials Group as its heiress, exposes his betrayal at a family gala, wins the divorce battle, and takes back the company she helped build—leaving Julian with nothing.
6a98fe18f74722e51507e385.title: Divorced, She Reclaimed Her Empire

6a9922c5f1680179d201b6fb.synopsis: A thousand years after humanity’s extinction, vampires and werewolves rule the world together. Knox, a vampire baron, and Aurora, a werewolf hunter, are both sworn enemies and secret lovers. To help Aurora win the Festival of the Twin Moons and save his mother, Knox binds their lives together with a forbidden spell—but conceals the truth that every wound inflicted on Aurora will be transferred to him. After losing loved ones and becoming targets of both races, they publicly turn against each other while secretly investigating the conflict. Together, they uncover a conspiracy orchestrated by their rulers, who have spent a thousand years provoking war to preserve an ancient curse. On the night of the final trial, Aurora gives up his only chance to become human and uses the Heart of the Twin Moons to save Knox. In doing so, their forbidden love breaks the curse and gives human civilization a chance to rise again.
6a9922c5f1680179d201b6fb.title: The Second Breath

6a99555185913218590748f3.synopsis: Orphaned Caine spent ten years of his life prioritizing his five mates in Rejecting My Five Female Mates. They were his foster father’s beloved daughters—spoiled, cherished, and fearless in their own ways. They became the anchor of his existence, and for so long, he thought one of them would become his fated mate. Everything changed when Seth, a notorious rogue, came onto the scene. Blinded by Seth’s lies, the five female mates turned against Caine, relentlessly humiliating him and constantly challenging his honor as the next-in-line alpha of the pack. Their treatment of Caine eventually became more than he could bear. Rather than stay and endure another humiliation, he left the pack and looked elsewhere for a future. His search took him to a foreign pack, where a marriage alliance brought him together with Princess Sylvia. He didn’t expect to fall for her so quickly, but he did. Caine thought leaving would put the worst behind him, but his life with Sylvia soon ran into trouble. One problem followed another, testing a relationship that had only just begun. Still, they refused to turn against each other and managed to get through it. For a brief moment, their future finally looked secure. That was until his five female mates crashed their wedding, demanding to settle the score and begging him to take them back. Would Caine accept their apology, or would it be the last time they ever brought up the past? Characters Caine Caine is the central character of Rejecting My Five Female Mates. He’s resilient, compassionate, and humble, always acting out of honor and always determined to fight for the truth. Enduring the hardships eventually pays off when he discovers a place where no one can doubt him again. Princess Sylvia Princess Sylvia is the reigning princess of the Silvermoon Pack. She’s mature, morally upright, and perceptive, exactly the kind of traits that match Caine’s personality. No wonder fate brought them together and allowed them to live happily ever after. Seth Seth is the notorious rogue who lies his way into the five female mates’ hearts. He creates stories to attack Caine’s character, believing they would be enough to get everything Caine has. His schemes fall through when Caine exposes him and he is punished for his sins.
6a99555185913218590748f3.title: Rejecting My Five Female Mates

6a995a16870e7f35ae062fc3.synopsis: At eighteen, Riley was the girl three powerful Alphas fought over—her fiancé Chase, her childhood friend Mark, her stepbrother Ethan. They shattered their blood bond with her, chained her as a "blood bag," and drained her veins to heal a sweet-faced Omega named Chloe. Everyone saw her as a wolf‑less freak. Then the Blood Moon rose. The Moon Spirit, sleeping for ten thousand years, awakened inside her—revealing Riley as the true Lycan Queen, the one who reigns above every Alpha. When her silver hair blazed to life, the whole hall knelt. She turned away. "None of you. I choose no one." She married Alex Reed, the cursed Lycan King who'd worn a silver muzzle for ten years—a beast who'd endure a thousand needles through his heart before hurting her. She purged his curse. He burned her enemies to ash. When the three men who betrayed her crawled back begging, their Blood Moon wedding became her breathtaking reckoning. From a discarded girl to a goddess ruling beside her King—this time, they kneel and look up at her.
6a995a16870e7f35ae062fc3.title: Rejected by Three Alphas, Claimed by the Lycan King

6a99ded16d3e99d8c804e117.synopsis: Jesse Morales and Grandma Dana couldn’t keep it together while reading Bound by Love and Sweet Temptation. Watch their funniest outtakes!
6a99ded16d3e99d8c804e117.title: ReelTalk EP 89-Bound By Blooper

6a9a22922dffdf54e50ba5a5.synopsis: In Accidentally His The Dragon King Won't Let Go movie, on a Blood Moon night, a drunken human girl steps into a cabin where the Dragon King lies in heat. After a steamy night with him, her belly suddenly swells, terrifying her into fleeing and leaving the loyal Dragon King to believe she has abandoned him. Days later, fate brings them together again, only for him to discover that she remembers nothing about him! But wait... is she secretly raising a child with horns all by herself?
6a9a22922dffdf54e50ba5a5.title: Accidentally His: The Dragon King Won't Let Go

6a9a2a1759516005be053227.synopsis: Alice is swept into the undersea world of Atlantis and becomes the mute, wicked supporting character everyone despises: the disgraced princess whose four merman husbands are ready to kill her. A healing pearl regrows her tongue, and the newly activated system sends her on missions to recover her beautiful voice and rebuild her spirit power. Through singing and other spirit-based purification skills, Alice eases the ocean corruption driving her husbands berserk and slowly turns their resentment into trust, affection, and fierce devotion. Soon, Gunnar the shark warrior, Will the irresistible merman, Vincent the sharp-tentacled octopus, and Albert the venomous jellyfish mage - four stunning, chiseled merman husbands - are all competing to protect and spoil her. When a two-faced rival tries to take everything Alice has reclaimed, she gives her enemy a satisfying reality check, turns the tables, and rises from Atlantis’s most unwanted woman to its most adored.
6a9a2a1759516005be053227.title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands

6a9a62c047b73c93ed010ce8.synopsis: Mira is the long-lost biological daughter of the Hale family of Ashen City. Yet after returning home, she repeatedly gives way to their adopted daughter, Lia—surrendering her room, her place as a dragon rider, and even half of her mother’s inheritance. Before the wedding, Draegoth—the bonded dragon Garrick personally tamed and the only keepsake Mira has left from her mother—is trained to obey Lia alone and nearly kills Mira. Realizing that Garrick, her fiancé of eight years, has always seen her as nothing more than a gullible woman, Mira walks barefoot across burning coals, breaks off their engagement, and turns to marry Theron, the Lord of the North, who has waited eight years for her. When Garrick, Lia, and Mira’s brother Cael arrive at the magnificent Northern wedding and discover that Mira is the bride, they are overwhelmed with regret—but it is already too late. In the end, Mira is surrounded by the love she deserves, and her mother’s dragon finally returns to her side.
6a9a62c047b73c93ed010ce8.title: Goodbye My Ex, I'm Marrying the Dragon Prince FINAL

6a9a62f26495d8525209847f.synopsis: Kind-hearted Isabella always believed that being useful meant being loved. On the night she planned to propose to her boyfriend, she catches him cheating with her boss. Heartbroken and drunk, she stumbles into the hotel room of Owen—her company's cold, wealthy CEO, who's been drugged in a business trap. One night leaves her pregnant, binding two strangers in a marriage of convenience. What starts as distrust slowly becomes real. But when Owen's glamorous ex Lisa returns, she fuels Isabella's insecurities, convincing her she'll never truly have his heart. After a devastating accident, Owen believes their baby has died—while Isabella disappears with their son. Five years later, a stronger Isabella returns. Owen discovers the truth: she kept his child from him. Forced back into each other's lives, they must face old wounds, buried feelings, and Lisa's schemes—before they can finally choose love and become the family they were always meant to be.
6a9a62f26495d8525209847f.title: One night with my billionaire CEO

6a9a67a8ed1505d7280fda7a.synopsis: Kane, once the Empire’s youngest war god, was framed by his closest ally and exiled to a junkyard planet as a lowly outcast. To clear his name of treason, he pilots the ancient mecha Primarch and infiltrates the Empire’s top mecha academy, where he plays the underdog while uncovering a massive conspiracy. When an army of Void Beasts descends, he is forced to join forces with his former enemies—only to discover that Primarch’s core holds his mother’s Star Core bloodline. In the end, Kane chooses to protect the common people as a knight, rejects the lure of power, and soars across the stars with the princess. This is a fiery mecha epic of betrayal, redemption, revenge, and guardianship.
6a9a67a8ed1505d7280fda7a.title: Primarch Genesis

6a9a76ca38999d12c103c839.synopsis: In the ancient Greek era, when gods ruled the heavens and the earth, a single pure love — steadfast for five long years — stood against the prejudice and malice of the entire world, weaving a tale of redemption between god and mortal. Elena, a fallen noble girl, endured mockery and family pressure without flinching. For five years, she held on — never wavering, never abandoning Aether, a man with a broken mind. Her family, eager to climb the social ladder, forced her into marriage with Drakon, an ambitious temple priest. On the eve of the wedding, the two bid each other a painful farewell — only to be cruelly ambushed by Drakon. Aether was mortally wounded, teetering on the brink of death. In that desperate hour, Aether awakened the primordial origin of the Chaos God — a power sealed for ten thousand years. The supreme divine force that once towered above all the heavens surged back to life. The once-submissive mortal transformed into a ruthless sovereign of the divine realm. To protect the one he loved, he defied the odds, overturned their fate, and rewrote their destiny with his own hands.
6a9a76ca38999d12c103c839.title: The God They Called a Fool

6a9a9f24146dc32fdc02e4c9.synopsis: Diana, the Wolf Queen, grew tired of war and bloodshed. She disguised herself as a simple healer in the woods. To give her daughter Katherine a normal life, she sent her to the Conroy pack. Little did she know, it was a living nightmare. The Conroy pack treated Katherine like a worthless slave—humiliated, abused, beaten, and nearly raped, simply because she had no power. When Diana discovered the truth, her motherly fury was unleashed. As the dark secrets of the Conroy pack’s betrayal of Lord Julius Redblood came to light, it was no longer possible to hide. The Wolf Queen had to strike back, defeat her enemies, and reclaim her crown.
6a9a9f24146dc32fdc02e4c9.title: The Wolf Queen Strikes Back

6a9aa0e1879a1f7da603a46b.synopsis: Abe Tatum is a transmigrator and a Great Emperor. But all he wants is a peaceful life and hides his true strength at the Azure Cloud Peak. Too bad his system forces him to take in three misfits——a reincarnated Empress, a troublemaker, and a girl with massive bad luck. He wants to keep a low profile, but keeps getting dragged into conspiracies, revenge, and heavenly karmic backlash. When his home and disciples face absolute peril, Abe Tatum is forced to drop his act.
6a9aa0e1879a1f7da603a46b.title: My Strongest Master Likes Acting Weak

6a9ab541307b23911801c401.synopsis: After she supports him through law school, Vicente dumps her. His reason? He found a rich girl to marry! Heartbroken, Abril marries a stranger... only to discover he is the billionaire CEO Cristóbal Noriega!
6a9ab541307b23911801c401.title: Flash Marriage to the Wild Billionaire

6a9ad210a71c71f5b40153b9.synopsis: For years, the Federation’s top mech pilot has lived incognito. He lifted his wife’s family to the heights of power, only to be met with divorce papers and public humiliation.When he steps into the award ceremony hall in his true identity and draws the Tyrant’s Sword, everyone falls to their knees. Only then do they realize the “worthless man” she discarded is the god they all look up to.
6a9ad210a71c71f5b40153b9.title: Abandoned Husband, Titan Lord

6a9b046ef7be38ef68007d67.synopsis: Ten years ago Layla's parents died pulling Elias Cole out of a burning building. She watched it happen, and the trauma took all five of her senses. Sight came back. Hearing and speech never did. Elias learned sign language for her and made her a promise: he'd be her eyes, her ears, her voice, and show her the whole world. The Coles raised her. The whole school knew whose girl she was. Then a transfer student named Molly turns the school into a game, and in the boys' bathroom Layla's hearing comes back — just in time to learn that Elias has been on the other side of that game for a long time. She says nothing. She lets them keep talking, keep escalating, keep filming, while a recorder collects every voice, every insult, every line about a cripple who can't call for help. She takes the beatings, the wastewater tank, the broken ribs, and she keeps the file. Molly is going to hear her own voice played back to her. And when Elias finally turns around and starts breaking things to make it up to her, Layla will already be on a plane, with an uncle who has been waiting ten years for her call, learning to say her first word out loud.
6a9b046ef7be38ef68007d67.title: All the Words I Never Said

6a9e1564668ea4a80b077b17.synopsis: Evelyn is the Godfather Damian Moretti’s secret wife, carrying his only heir. Hidden away for her safety, she is mistaken for a discarded mistress by Bianca, who brutally humiliates her and kills her unborn child. When Damian discovers the truth, he gives Evelyn the power to punish everyone involved. One month later, the gentle wife returns as the true Lady Moretti, and no one who wronged her will escape.
6a9e1564668ea4a80b077b17.title: The Godfather’s Hidden Wife

6a9e210d6851b4c2d303c2cb.synopsis: When nine-year-old Samara Brenner, the last heir of the legendary White Wolf bloodline, witnesses her family slaughtered, she escapes and spends the next nine years hiding under a false identity, pretending to be a weak Omega while preparing for revenge. Her plan unravels when she discovers her fated mate is Roman Hartwell, the Alpha she has believed was complicit in her family's massacre. As hatred turns into reluctant trust, Samara uncovers a devastating truth: Roman has spent years searching for her and hunting the real mastermind behind the betrayal. Together, they must expose a conspiracy that reaches deep into their own families, reclaim her pack, and decide whether love is stronger than vengeance.
6a9e210d6851b4c2d303c2cb.title: Mated to My Sworn Enemy

6a9e332e7eb2800e7e0b27c9.synopsis: Ethan, the cursed Alpha of Silver Moon, needs a Luna who can survive bearing his heir. Hope, a poor outland Omega, enters the mate selection to save her pack — and accidentally awakens ancient wolf power. Forced into a bond, Ethan rejects her at first. But when Hope risks her life for him, hate turns into obsession. Now they must break the Luna curse before their mate bond kills her.
6a9e332e7eb2800e7e0b27c9.title: The Heirless Alpha's Miracle Omega

6a9e50f2f0b3ac02d102ff76.synopsis: He is the only Omega in the entire military camp, crushing every Alpha with perfect scores just to join the legendary team Raven and stand beside his idol, Ares Thorn. But on the day he earns his place, the man waiting for him is not Ares. It is Logan Frost, an ace sniper and the legal husband assigned to him by the matching system, kneeling before him with roses in his hands. Before Ethan can refuse, Ares steps out from behind Logan, grips Ethan's chin in front of everyone, and says, "He is mine." His idol claims him. His husband proposes. On the same day. As the countdown to his forced match closes in and enemy fire surrounds them, Ethan realizes he never wanted only to stand beside Ares. He wants far more than that. He does not want to become anyone's Omega. He wants to become Raven.
6a9e50f2f0b3ac02d102ff76.title: The Omega's Command

6a9e5e483e3e3774520ffddd.synopsis: Careless father leaves toddler in a hot car unattended. Will her mother be able to find her and save her in time?
6a9e5e483e3e3774520ffddd.title: Daddy Left His Baby to Die

6a9e7a740bc0a33f1e000e25.synopsis: Ares is a decorated special‑forces war hero who retires after his closest comrade dies in battle—haunted by trauma, bound by a promise. That promise: protect his fallen brother's wife and daughter. They fall victim to a loan scam, trapped in crippling debt and terrorized by local thugs. Ares steps in with brutal efficiency—only to discover the thugs are small fish. Behind them: a sprawling criminal web of corrupt cops, dirty officials, and military moles. They smear his name, set traps, and try to bury him. He doesn't break. He gathers his loyal comrades, fights from the ground up, dismantles the syndicate, purges the corruption, and clears his name. In the end, he honors his promise, avenges the innocent, and bring
6a9e7a740bc0a33f1e000e25.title: A Promise to My Fallen Brother

6a9e7d70e751b89e350f2a6a.synopsis: Hart has everything: a loving husband, brilliant children, and a quiet life as the wife of Adrian Hart, founder and CEO of HartX Technologies. Her only wound is the family she never knew. When a DNA test confirms that she is the long-lost daughter of the Whitmore family, Serena returns home before Christmas hoping for answers, not inheritance. Instead, she finds a family obsessed with reputation and a false heiress, Sylvia Bellamy, determined to protect the life stolen for her forty years ago. Serena's daughter Ava, a Stanford-bound teen prodigy, is humiliated; Serena's husband is mistaken for a laborer; and every act of patience is repaid with suspicion. As Sylvia's schemes escalate from theft accusations to public slander, Serena's true status as Mrs. Hart becomes the weapon no one saw coming. The story promises a mature heroine's emotional awakening, high-society humiliation, and the ultimate choice between blood relatives and the family that truly chose her.
6a9e7d70e751b89e350f2a6a.title: The Heiress Returns at Forty

6a9e9e77afd46d4b1b0fcc75.synopsis: Mafia Godfather Vito Moretti loses his life while rescuing abused teen Leo Grayson, and his soul awakens inside the high‑schooler’s injured body. Once a weak, mistreated outcast, Leo is now inhabited by the sharp, domineering don. He stands up to his cold‑blooded biological family the Graysons and cruel school bullies including Chris and Brad. Balancing secret mafia duties with ordinary campus life, he chases his long‑held dream of getting into an Ivy‑League university. He goes through kidnapping incidents and dangerous showdowns. In the end, he scores a perfect mark on the SAT, defeats his vicious rival Chris, and builds a sweet bond with kind‑hearted school beauty Ella.
6a9e9e77afd46d4b1b0fcc75.title: The Godfather’s SAT Guide

6a9f7829742cadec7602d145.synopsis: On a blood moon night, Lilith, daughter of Count Dracula, was born. Her power was too great—the crystal ball went dark. Her father declared her "worthless" and tried to kill her. Her mother Ileana threw her into the abyss to save her, losing her magic and youth, and was banished. In the abyss, Lilith was adopted by Cain, leader of the "impure bloodline." Eighteen years later, she awakened the bloodline power of the "Moon Goddess." She returned to the surface, saved her withered mother, and was imprisoned by Mirela, the Count's fake daughter. When werewolves attacked, Lilith turned the tide with raw combat power—but because she refused to reveal her true power, she was again dismissed as "worthless." Ileana risked her life to seek help from Cain. In the final battle, Lilith unleashed the power of the blood moon, revealed her true origins, deposed her father, banished the impostors, and was crowned Countess. She abolished the old order of blood purity, restored her mother's youth, and brought the exiled home.
6a9f7829742cadec7602d145.title: Return,Goddess of the Moon

6a9fa251f8c2c567f70eeab6.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Queen Amelia gave birth to a daughter—but the temple flame went dark. High Priest Mordred forged an oracle, branding the infant a "bloodless curse." King Carl ordered her execution. Amelia tore out her Titan blood, forced it into her baby's mouth, and threw her into the River Styx. She was chained to a pillar and drained for twenty years. The baby was rescued by Ryan, Lord of Tartarus, and raised as Zoe—trained as a top assassin. She returned to Obsidian disguised as a blood slave, freed her mother, and uncovered the truth.
