Tiffany and Mordred activated the "Ten Thousand Blood Purgatory Array." Zoe's sealing ring shattered, awakening her Titan Primordial Queen power. She exposed the forged oracle. Tiffany fused with the ancient evil god, but Zoe tore it apart. Ryan fell protecting her—his soul shattered. Zoe ventured to the Titan Temple, awakened the Titan Heart, split it in two—one half healed her mother, the other restored Ryan. She was crowned Supreme Queen, forging an eternal alliance. The "bloodless freak" became the guardian of all beings.
6a9fa251f8c2c567f70eeab6.title: The Ichorless Thrall Is The Primordial Queen!

6a9fa3ff72bf93a3100ed278.synopsis: Kallydia, head priestess of the Temple of Philotia, is exploited by her mother—forced to seduce the Sun God Helios for gold coins. An enchanted incense leads to a night with him. She flees at dawn, leaving only a silver armband engraved with her name. Helios had grown fond of her—but after a misunderstanding, he believes she's just a social climber who toys with men. Enraged, he cuts all contact. Kallydia discovers she's pregnant. Alone, she guards the faint golden light in her womb through public humiliation and family oppression. The God of War and Goddess of Wisdom arrive, revealing the truth: the gentle maidservant they remember is the "bad woman" Helios spoke of. By the time Helios reaches her, Kallydia has been tortured bloody and cast into a pit of serpents. With her last breath, she begs the gods to protect her child.
6a9fa3ff72bf93a3100ed278.title: The Sun God’s Beloved

6a9fa78372bf93a3100ed27c.synopsis: Damon Blackwood, the ruthless mafia don who has never touched a woman at thirty, mistakes innocent college student Lily for an escort during a rainstorm. After one brutal night, he casts her out with a priceless watch. One month later, Lily discovers she is pregnant with twins—but her drug-addicted brother's debts force her parents to sell her to a dealer. Seven months later, she collapses in Damon's own bar, and the Patek Philippe on her wrist reveals the truth: she is the virgin he destroyed. When Damon learns his own heirs are dying inside her, the beast becomes a prisoner of love. He brings her to his estate, quits whiskey and cigars, buys out entire department stores, and crashes through windows to protect her from bullies. From a blood-soaked underworld to a sunlit chapel, this is the story of a soulless killer who learns to kneel, and a broken girl who learns she is worth more than diamonds.
6a9fa78372bf93a3100ed27c.title: The mob boss spoils his pregnant wife

6a9fda0b3a120fb80d0eb58d.synopsis: ER nurse Emma returns home for her younger sister Sophie’s lavish wedding, only to discover a terrifying truth: every night at 11:54 p.m., Sophie is thrust into a deadly crisis—and whenever Emma dies trying to save her, she wakes up again at 8:07 the same morning. Trapped in an endless time loop, Emma uses each reset to search for the killer and uncover the truth. But the deeper she digs, the more she realizes that Sophie’s death is tied to a medical secret buried twelve years ago—and a dark conspiracy hidden within their own family. Even crueler is what happens between Emma and Noah. She remembers every moment they shared, every promise, and every time they fell in love. But with each reset, Noah forgets her completely. And somehow, every single time, he chooses to trust her—and fall for her all over again.
6a9fda0b3a120fb80d0eb58d.title: My Sister Dies at Her Wedding Every Day

6aa016f0dec67ee5640992c5.synopsis: Joanne Yates, the badass female Chief Instructor of the Navy SEALs, was betrayed and murdered in a classified nuclear trap engineered by her clout-chasing ex-boyfriend, Brandon. But death couldn't hold her. She wakes up reborn in a dark, abusive terrorist bunker, trapped inside the frail body of a 14-year-old angelic girl. An innocent face, but a bloodthirsty war god's soul! With pure muscle memory and tactical supremacy, she silent-kills her captors, pulling off impossible blind shots that leave Brandon’s reinforcement unit trembling in shock. From the ashes of the Middle East to the corrupt elite circles of North America, she adopts a new identity, secures the ultimate protection of an Alpha warlord family, and signs a dangerous pact with a seductive arms billionaire. Watch her crush her toxic ex's dignity and ignite a tactical nuclear strike against the Deep State itself!
6aa016f0dec67ee5640992c5.title: Reborn: The Angelic War God with a Barbie Face

6aa0b83410e6e406410874a7.synopsis: As emergency physician Naomi rushed to resuscitate a patient, lines of comments scrolled across her vision, warning her that the patient was already dead. It revealed that entering the ER meant taking the fall for the hospital director’s daughter, ultimately dooming Naomi and her family to a brutal death at the hands of the patient’s relatives. Desperate to avoid the trap, she tried everything to steer clear of the ER. Yet, the director still framed her using fabricated footage and forged signatures. Guided by the comments, Naomi exposed two fatal flaws: a birthmark on the imposter’s neck and a missing dot in the forged signature. The truth finally exploded. The director was stabbed to death by the enraged family, and his daughter was left facing execution.
6aa0b83410e6e406410874a7.title: Escaping the ER Death Trap via Scrolling comments

6aa0bd39fc29657998080be1.synopsis: After the sudden death of her father, Charlotte is cruelly abused by her succubus stepmother and two stepsisters. At an elven banquet, the Orc Queen arrives to choose a new bride with a magical goblin. After being secretly framed by her stepsister, Charlotte is chosen by the goblin and taken back to the orc castle as a “bargaining chip.” She is ordered to choose between two orc princes and marry one of them at her 18th birthday ceremony. At Saint Elaine’s Supernatural Academy, Charlotte meets two orc princes with completely opposite personalities: Vesper, an aloof, restrained snake prince with dark hair, and Claude, a charismatic, sunshine-bright lion prince with golden hair. As her stepsisters Skyler and Blair relentlessly torment her at school and the lecherous hyena Logan repeatedly schemes against her, the two princes transform into fiercely protective mates. They publicly declare Charlotte as theirs in front of the entire school, and time and again, they unleash their full beast forms—the Golden Berserker Lion and the Black-Armored Giant Serpent—to rescue her from danger. As they spend more time together and their intertwined fates pull them deeper into one another’s lives, Charlotte finds herself torn between the possessive, jealous Vesper and the gentle, devoted Claude. Caught between their overwhelming affection, she gradually falls hopelessly in love with both. On the eve of her coming-of-age ceremony, she even takes the final step with Vesper inadvertently awakening the rare and supreme bloodline of the “Holy Elf,” an ancient elven lineage of unparalleled power.
6aa0bd39fc29657998080be1.title: The Elf Bride’s Impossible Choice

6aa0bec5daf44451500e0686.synopsis: As a child, Elian was condemned by her father Marcus for being a magicless waste; her mother Selene burned her life force to save her and cast her off a cliff, where she was adopted by Kaelen. Twenty years later, she awakened the Golden Dragon bloodline, returned home to find her mother, exposed the truth, stripped Leora of power, exiled Marcus, and became Queen of Ashridge. Leora made a deal with dark sorcerer Morgaine, sparking war and taking Kaelen hostage. Elian awakened Dragon God power, defeated the dark magic, saved her parents, and was ultimately crowned Sovereign of the continent.
6aa0bec5daf44451500e0686.title: Abandoned Dragon, Ascendant Queen

6aa0bec90b22d50efa081ac4.synopsis: Will O'Connell, the city's most powerful mafia boss, dies saving an overweight, bullied teenager, Cayden, only to awaken in the boy's body. Forced back into high school, Will quickly clashes with campus bully Dane. After enduring a brutal public beating, he shocks everyone by knocking Dane down with a single punch. With help from his trusted confidant Vinny, Will secretly regains control of the O'Connell family while posing as his own illegitimate son. Using mafia resources, he transforms Cayden's body, returns to school in spectacular fashion, humiliates Dane, defeats a vindictive teacher with his academic brilliance, and survives an assassination attempt.
6aa0bec90b22d50efa081ac4.title: Bully Me? I Run the Mob!

6aa0c32f740c3351330796a2.synopsis: Layla Hale, a fallen heiress, scrapes by working at a small‑town bakery with her twin sons, who can shift into wolf cubs. She endures harassment from her lecherous boss and constant hunger, until her best friend signs her up for the Voss Group Jewelry Competition. She returns to New York and wins the championship through her own talent. Yet barely after lifting the trophy, she is framed by her malicious adopted sister Maggie, who had wronged her in the past. Layla is forced down onto a chair at City Hall and made to take Maggie’s place in marrying the notorious CEO of Voss Group — a man rumored to be hideously ugly, brutal and perverse. When the door swings open, however, the man who steps forward is none other than the one who marked her five years ago — the biological father of her two wolf‑cub sons. What she does not know is that the man she has spent five years running from has spent those same five years searching for her. — Fled with my kids for five years, only for my toxic sister to force‑marry me to the Wolf King CEO — who happens to be my boys’ real father.
6aa0c32f740c3351330796a2.title: The Alpha King Is My Baby’s Daddy!

6aa0c794f0a554f6be08413a.synopsis: Thirty‑two‑year‑old Alice has a middle‑class marriage that others envy. Her husband Richard is a senior bank executive who provides abundant material comforts, yet their marriage is frigid. Plagued by Richard’s physical issues, their relationship is little more than a hollow formality, leaving Alice trapped inside a gilded cage. Richard’s younger brother Noah comes to spend the summer, and their old romance resurfaces. They had been lovers before Alice’s marriage. Back then, Alice’s father fell seriously ill. Richard forced Alice into marriage by offering to cover her father’s medical expenses, and the two were torn apart.
6aa0c794f0a554f6be08413a.title: The Forbidden Desire

6aa0cc0c8ee9b4536c0e27de.synopsis: Exploited and sold off by her adoptive family, reborn genius Scout uses DNA matching to reunite with her biological father—Dominic Moretti, America’s supreme Mafia don. Backed by three elite brothers, she debuts as the sole Moretti heiress at her coming-of-age gala, exposes her abusers, and claims her place at the top.
6aa0cc0c8ee9b4536c0e27de.title: My Second Life as a Billionaire Heiress

6aa0d8974cfd2f8e44057b76.synopsis: Adopted daughter Olivia is betrayed by her own brother, her fiancé and her family. Her wedding is stolen, and she is exiled to the border for eight years. Over those eight years, she evolves into a top‑tier intelligence strategist and protects eight heirs from major powerful families. Her old enemies track her down and force her to abandon the children. Conflicts erupt on all fronts, and Olivia is pushed to the brink of danger. When Don MacRae arrives with armed reinforcements, layers of lies are exposed one after another. All parties return to the East Coast Committee for a public trial, and the betrayers receive their due punishment. Olivia cuts off her toxic bond with her birth family and gradually climbs to the apex of power within the East Coast Committee. The eight children she once protected become her most loyal backing.
6aa0d8974cfd2f8e44057b76.title: The Godmother Returns

6aa0e4992d54042dab0172a6.synopsis: On her 7th anniversary, pregnant Amelia finds husband Trevor dining with another woman. She leaves Boston, files for divorce using a prenup clause he wrote, and reclaims her hidden identity as Dr. Amelia Voss—co‑founder of Longmoor Labs and creator of VESL. As she rebuilds her career and custody of daughter Adi, Trevor’s world crumbles. With support from her grandmother, loyal colleagues, and quiet suitor Hugh, Amelia wins sole custody, 75% assets, and a new life. Trevor loses everything—too late, he finally sees who she truly is.
6aa0e4992d54042dab0172a6.title: I Flew Home Pregnant Only To See His Secret

6aa13ab21e573e2b84067787.synopsis: Overworked and dropped dead, Earth girl Lira transmigrates into an interstellar beast world as the infamous vicious Ice-Dragon female. The original host—manipulated by the Third Princess—abused beastmen and sold her own brother, earning the hatred of four top-tier Alpha beastmen. Lira awakens a Purification System—and her inner thoughts are broadcasted to all four men. She uses her power to heal frenzied beastmen and reveals conspiracies with her unfiltered monologues. Slowly, the four Alphas shift from loathing to obsession, fighting for her affection. A shocking conspiracy surfaces: the Queen forged the Ice-Dragon bloodline and imprisoned Lira's parents. With the strength of her four partners, Lira ascends to divinity, crushes the royal conspiracy, and becomes the sole Holy Maiden—reunited with her brother and her lovers in peace.
6aa13ab21e573e2b84067787.title: Ice Dragon’s Thoughts Drive Her Husbands Obsessed

6aa14b83871c17602008654b.synopsis: My family never remembered my birthday. Ethan’s meant a steakhouse booked a month ahead; Chloe’s meant Six Flags and Mom’s Instagram carousel: “Happy birthday to our little princess.” Mine is July 19th, mid-summer—always ignored. On my eighteenth, I woke early, put on makeup, and waited on the couch. Mom passed with Chloe’s dance bag: “Heat your own lunch. I’m taking her to intensive.” Dad left with Ethan to play ball. By noon I was alone. I texted the family chat: “I’m eighteen today! 🎉” Silence. At seven they came home—Ethan’s ribs, Chloe’s mac and cheese. No cake. No candles. No song. Nothing missing, to them. Everyone got a birthday except me. I was eighteen now. I could finally choose where to go.
6aa14b83871c17602008654b.title: You Ignored My Birthday So I Erased Myself From The Family

6aa20de315d359602001a835.synopsis: Mason Todd, once the Culinary King, lost everything after refusing to endorse Damon Holt's gutter-oil brand and was saved by Tessa Ford, owner of Crossroads Bistro. Though stripped of his sense of taste, Mason rebuilt his skills in humble kitchens and entered the Culinary King Championship to protect Tessa and her restaurant. Facing sabotage from Holt and Gavin Cole, he fought his way to the final and reclaimed his crown with a simple bowl of soy sauce fried rice.
6aa20de315d359602001a835.title: Rise of the Culinary King

6aa213ce7d560fa0290979b7.synopsis: Henry, a culinary genius with ancestral imperial-chef recipes, spent eight years building the high-end Starlight Feast for his childhood friend Jasper—only to be betrayed. Jasper coveted the recipes, shortchanged him, and humiliated him publicly. With his mother gravely ill, Henry turned to a street stall, but Jasper’s men smashed it and injured his best friend Cole. At his lowest, Iloen, owner of the rival restaurant Voss, offered help—covering his mother’s surgery and inviting him to run her failing restaurant. Bound by cuisine and business, they fought Jasper’s attacks: supply cuts, chef sabotage, and online smears. Henry’s mother gave him a ticket to a cruise culinary exchange. On board, Jasper kidnapped Henry’s sister, forcing a deadly wager: loser loses wrist tendons. Through two rounds, Henry exposed every scheme, bringing the villains to justice. A month later, Voss thrived, his mother recovered, and Henry found family, friendship, and mutual love with Iloen.
6aa213ce7d560fa0290979b7.title: The Royal Chef’s Comeback

6aa214827f10f7350d061957.synopsis: Ethan Carter, a brilliant algorithm prodigy, gave up his career to secretly marry into the Lin family and support his wife Evelyn Lin's dream. For ten years, he was treated as the family's "free housekeeper" and "human ATM" — until he caught her cheating with Damian Rivers, who also fathered a secret child with her. The decade of silence ends. Ethan Carter files for divorce and strikes back: recovering transferred assets, reclaiming pre-marital property, and leveraging his hidden identity — the creator of "Pangu," the core algorithm keeping Evelyn Lin's company alive — to plunge her empire into crisis. Meanwhile, Charlotte Shaw, president of Charlotte Group and his longtime "rival," confesses she has secretly loved him for ten years. Under her pursuit,Ethan Carter heals, severs his past, and embraces a new life.
6aa214827f10f7350d061957.title: Divorced, Betrayed, and Claimed by Her Rival

6aa217a1550d0f52260da399.synopsis: Seven years after she ran, Yukino comes home to find her father in prison and the family company in the hands of her stepbrother—the man she once loved. He forces her into an engagement to finish his revenge. What he doesn't know: the daughter she's hidden overseas for six years is his.
6aa217a1550d0f52260da399.title: Engaged to My Enemy

6aa2199faf0e20bdc4094519.synopsis: Five years ago, gifted surgeon Elara Voss fled a suffocating marriage while secretly carrying her husband’s unborn daughter. Now, one drunken mistake lands her back in bed with her cold, billionaire ex‑husband, Damian Sterling. Determined to protect their five‑year‑old daughter, Elara insists the child isn’t his and proposes a strictly physical arrangement: Tuesdays only, no publicity, no interference, and no entanglement. What she doesn’t know is that Damian has loved her for five full years and waited for her all along; he simply never knew how to express his feelings. As old desire reignites, their daughter’s identity and the carefully staged fake‑infidelity hoax that destroyed their marriage begins to surface. Can two people who never learned to understand each other’s love give their marriage a second chance once the truth comes to light?
6aa2199faf0e20bdc4094519.title: My Possessive Ex-Husband

6aa221dcce316629590e2bed.synopsis: Clara, a young widow, shares one night with a stranger in the castle rose garden—not knowing he’s Crown Prince Gabriel. Pregnant, she leaves her baby and a golden ring on the castle steps to save him from a tyrant. She becomes a wet nurse at the castle, nursing the little prince who refuses all others—without knowing he’s her son, and the cold prince is her one-night stranger. When the truth surfaces, Gabriel crowns her queen.
6aa221dcce316629590e2bed.title: Claimed by the Prince：the Forbidden Wet Nurse

6aa24b86d6c23093cf06e859.synopsis: After three years of hidden trial in a homeless camp, Vince Astor is crowned America's Godfather, heir to $20.9 billion. He keeps the secret when Helen Stark, the CEO he saved two years ago, proposes to him on the street. Still dressed as a bum, he follows her home and swallows her family's scorn as they force her to marry Philip West. His power then surfaces layer by layer. A bank president kneels, a $1 billion bid lands, an underboss kisses his ring. Helen chooses him anyway, for who he is.
6aa24b86d6c23093cf06e859.title: Step Back! That Homeless Man Is Not to be Messed with

6aa26bc1c177163e200be667.synopsis: Vivian Tyler, the world's top billionaire and sole heiress of the Tyler family, willingly builds her penniless husband, Julian, into a business tycoon. This devotion lasts until his mistress, Bianca, publicly trashes Vivian at a grand opening party—even launching a viral live stream to relentlessly humiliate her, fully exposing the bitter betrayal. Facing the heartless scumbag Julian, a completely disillusioned Vivian no longer hides her true identity. She exposes Julian and Bianca’s hypocrisy and personally destroys the very business empire she built from scratch.
6aa26bc1c177163e200be667.title: The Hidden Heiress Strikes Back

6aa26e69c628a25e9a00dfe9.synopsis: When a ruthless billionaire matriarch returns from a three-year covert mission to cure her daughter's illness, she discovers her husband and their former nanny have stolen her empire and left her daughter brain-damaged from abuse—forcing her to unleash her cold-blooded wrath to reclaim her crown.
6aa26e69c628a25e9a00dfe9.title: Don't Harm the Heiress，Her Mom Is the Sable Queen

6aa270443a1ab55d480d6487.synopsis: Emma was abandoned by her biological parents. To save her adoptive mother, she spent two years as the substitute lover of Chris, a ruthless CEO. She groveled in the dust, while her twin sister Mia basked in all the glory — a renowned designer, the eldest daughter of the Foster family, and engaged to a ridiculously wealthy fiancé who worshipped the ground she walked on. Emma thought she would forever remain Mia's shadow — until Mia "accidentally" died. She believed her miserable fate would finally come to an end. But to her shock, the man she had loved for years kicked her aside without hesitation for a "resurrected" Mia. The moment her heart died, she turned around and joined a rival company. At the design competition, she made a stunning finale appearance wearing a custom haute couture gown of her own creation — forcing everyone who had ever trampled on her to kneel and watch her coronation.
6aa270443a1ab55d480d6487.title: The Stand In

6aa27c0a6fdfcd61ca0a985d.synopsis: Evelyn is the sole Alpha heir of the Silvermoon Pack, but a poison secretly administered to her since childhood has kept her wolf spirit from fully awakening. In her past life, she trusted Adrian, surrendered her wealth and power to him, and was ultimately betrayed and killed by Adrian and Serena. Only in her final moments did she learn that Lucien, the Lycan Crown Prince, was the man who truly loved her. Given a second chance by the Moon Goddess, Evelyn returns ten years into the past and refuses to remain powerless. She takes back her resources and birthright, exposes the impostors who betrayed her, and, with Lucien's help, removes the poison suppressing her wolf spirit. As her legendary White Wolf bloodline awakens and her enemies fall one by one, Evelyn discovers that Lucien is not only the hidden Lycan Crown Prince—he is also her fated mate.
6aa27c0a6fdfcd61ca0a985d.title: The Wolf King Bowed for Me

6aa27cbefff49e7f1307ea4c.synopsis: An ordinary salesman meets a rich heiress dodging an arranged marriage — and one fake relationship gets way too real... When Lydia Kensington finds hidden treasures in Logan Ashford's home, his "cousin" Vanessa Hale drops the bomb: he's the heir to Crown City's richest family. After trials and growing feelings, Lydia and Logan choose each other, and the Ashfords prepare a lavish bride price for a happy new life.
6aa27cbefff49e7f1307ea4c.title: My Heiress Wife Won't Let Go

6aa35d260fac88c4d20cb597.synopsis: Evelyn, burned alive in her wedding gown by husband Edward and best friend Iris—who stole her fortune and her parents' lives—is reborn at Edward's proposal. This time, eyes wide open, she turns their trap against them. With bridal veils, spices, letters, and curses, she delivers each torment until they burn in their own regrets.
6aa35d260fac88c4d20cb597.title: Ashes of Vengeance: The Wedding Reborn

6aa35dfd4d5aaf051600f537.synopsis: Laura, sold to a violent old man, escapes into a cave and bonds with silver dragon duke Kyle—becoming pregnant with his heir. They marry for the child, then fall in love. Despite rival schemes and assassination attempts, Laura discovers runemaster talent, gives birth to twins, founds an academy, and stands equal beside Kyle.
6aa35dfd4d5aaf051600f537.title: Becoming the Heirless Dragon King's Fated Mate

6aa3618b8b03e71fd0047437.synopsis: Enduring six years of humiliation as a contract wife, Belle received nothing but her husband Nicholas's indifference, her rival's scheming, and even the betrayal of her own son. When she finally walked away battered and broken, the mysterious billionaire Sebastian stepped in with unwavering protection—only to reveal that this marriage had been nothing but a transaction all along. True love, after all, is never something you beg for. When the truth finally comes to light, who will be her ultimate destination?
6aa3618b8b03e71fd0047437.title: The Contract Wife’s Vengeance

6aa361dabb9c46cea20e79f9.synopsis: I was dying from a difficult childbirth, yet my husband stayed outside the delivery room of his subordinate’s widow. I signed the divorce papers and left without hesitation. He was filled with deep regret and ended up abandoned by everyone around him.
6aa361dabb9c46cea20e79f9.title: I Signed My Divorce Papers on the Operating Table

6aa362809c3d2a806c09b7b5.synopsis: Cross Corleone, the feared head of the Corleone crime syndicate. Stricken with amnesia after a sniper ambush during a drug crackdown, he lives incognito as a lowly kitchen helper for five years. A devastating betrayal restores his memory. He uncovers an imposter misusing his identity and the ruthless Columbo clan exploiting his reputation to seize power. With loyal underboss Daisy and heiress Selena Hayes, he reclaims his throne, exposes the deception, and crowns Selena his only Mrs. Corleone.
6aa362809c3d2a806c09b7b5.title: The Godfather with Amnesia

6aa363575c614c71b500c008.synopsis: After completing her final trial, Elena, the High Priestess of the Hidden Order, learned that fragments of her soul were missing and that she needed to go to the Sterling and Forrester families—where her biological parents were—to retrieve them. The two families were on the verge of a marriage alliance, and she seized the opportunity to return. But she soon discovered that both families were riddled with schemes and intrigue, and there were villains coveting the power of the Hidden Order and the wealth of the Forrester family. While fighting against these conspiracies, Elena searched for her missing soul fragments, ultimately uncovering the truth, protecting her identity and the one she loved, and completing her self-redemption and the closing of her fate.
6aa363575c614c71b500c008.title: The true heiress returning is the grand priestess of fat

6aa37a12b55dd4a1cf053ff6.synopsis: Sophia suffered domestic abuse at the hands of her father, Antony, since a very young age. As an adult, Sophia encountered a paranoid and abusive partner, Gordon, who eventually pushed her off a cliff. Miraculously, Sophia survived and was rescued by Alpha Bernard, who had recently lost his partner. After being rescued, Sophia decided to move forward despite the doubts and pushbacks. Antony and Gordern, in an attempt to cover up their crimes, had since been planning to take Sophie out. Fate intertwined, Sophia and Bernard became partners. With Bernard's love and encouragement, Sophia not only overcame her inner fears, but also discovered her powerful abilities as the white wolf. With Bernard's assistance, she defeated Antony and Gordern, and ultimately became the queen.
6aa37a12b55dd4a1cf053ff6.title: My fated Alpha: Rejected and Reclaimed

6aa37cede917b4216b027db0.synopsis: Eighteen years ago, a deliberate baby swap entangled the fates of Fiona, CEO of the Blackwood Group, and her assistant, Allison. Eighteen years later, at the coming-of-age ceremony, Allison publicly exposes the "truth," intending to reclaim her daughter and swallow the entire corporation. However, the real game has only just begun—Fiona has long known everything. With her biological daughter raised in abuse, and the man beside her in bed revealing his fangs, in this chess game of revenge revolving around bloodline and greed—who will walk away unscathed?
6aa37cede917b4216b027db0.title: The Price of Blood

6aa37dba78a4f8b71e0fab25.synopsis: Reborn from a tragic death, Merit, the eldest daughter of a W’ab priest, relives theNile Inundation Festival where noble maidens choose their fated husbands. In herpast life, she boosted her husband’s career only to be murdered by her jealousyounger sister Nefti, who has also been reborn and aims to seize the powerful officerHemte for status.When Merit casts the sacred scarab, it lands on Kaji, the real Pharaoh Amenemhiding under a beggar alias to test noble ladies’ true characters. Defying familyhumiliation and public mockery, Merit marries the seemingly destitute Kaji. Living ina shabby hut, she practices superb folk medicine and wins Kaji’s deep-seatedaffection.Consumed by envy, Nefti frames Merit and tortures her in prison. At thelife-or-death moment, Kaji reveals his royal identity and punishes the villains.Surviving war, plague and the admiration of the Hittite emperor, Merit guards thekingdom with wisdom and mercy. She finally ascends as Queen, gaining sincere,mutual love with Kaji.
6aa37dba78a4f8b71e0fab25.title: Crown of the Nile: My Beggar Husband is the Pharaoh

6aa39542cfad6e0f1e036697.synopsis: I'm Elena. Ten years I built his company with him. The day we went public, I walked in on himwith his pregnant secretary.He forced a divorce that night—cashed out my shares, gave me the house, the money. Hethought I was crying over him. He didn't know I was crying because the fraud evidence washitting the regulators the next morning.I took the money. I signed. I walked away.Let him and his empire burn together.This time, I'm not betting on anyone. Because I'm holding all the cards.
6aa39542cfad6e0f1e036697.title: Divorced and Billionaire

6aa3983abe67c2f3dc0c9699.synopsis: After five years of sacrificing her career for fiancé Luca, Bianca watches him turn their wedding into a celebration for her manipulative sister. She walks away, takes back her work, and rebuilds her life as acclaimed photographer B-09. When Luca tries to destroy her new career, Bianca fights back with the truth—exposing his fraud, her family’s lies, and proving she was never the shadow behind his success.
6aa3983abe67c2f3dc0c9699.title: He Swapped My Wedding For My Sister

6aa39e12f4ae9dbd480c9e1f.synopsis: She can't stand her boss, and he'd rather tease her than tell her how he feels. When he's sent away to turn around a failing restaurant, he insists she come along. What she doesn't know? Her biggest workplace rival is also the man she's fallen for online.
6aa39e12f4ae9dbd480c9e1f.title: My Worst Boss Is My Online Crush

6aa3a8de4c3ae91aba01e787.synopsis: Eleanor Vance spent sixteen years protecting Leo Carter, only for him to turn her into the school's laughingstock to impress Savannah. She vanishes to California, where a new school, real friends, and a gentle captain help her become someone the old Eleanor never dared to be. When Leo finally tracks her down, his apology comes too late—she has already built a new life with no room for him.
6aa3a8de4c3ae91aba01e787.title: Bullied Girl

6aa3b5bdd5aadad2080fbafd.synopsis: In Dragonblood Alpha movie, abandoned as an infant for lacking a "wolf spirit," Kyle is raised by three Legendary Beasts in the Beast Forest. Eighteen years later, he has not only grown into a fierce fighter but also awakened the hidden power of a dragon within him. Seeking his parents, Kyle rescues Freya, the Princess of the Silvermoon Pack, and follows her to the Crimson Flame City. There, he discovers that Elina, a disgraced slave tormented by the pack's hypocritical Alpha, Alaric, is actually his birth mother. Just as they reunite, the Thunderclaw Pack launches a devastating invasion. While Alaric and the cowardly heir Kent surrender and betray Freya to save themselves, Kyle steps forward, unleashing his dragon-wolf bloodline to crush the invaders. However, a darker conspiracy emerges: the Thunderclaw Pack has allied with the Liches, an evil undead race bent on destroying the world. Facing the terrifying Lich King and an endless army of ghouls, Kyle is empowered by Freya's holy light and the united strength of every werewolf worldwide. Transforming into a colossal silver wolf, Kyle defeats the Lich King and saves the realm. In the end, his father, the ancient dragon Vodar, awakens from his slumber, reuniting their family. Kyle claims his rightful place as the new Alpha of the Crimson Flame Pack and finds true love with Freya.
6aa3b5bdd5aadad2080fbafd.title: Dragonblood Alpha

6aa3b82c32eca1e150047623.synopsis: Three years ago, Chloe won the national clinical skills championship but chose frontline medicine over fame. When she saves a billionaire's wife and her baby, a rival doctor steals the credit, and a corrupt director fires Chloe. After the truth is exposed, Chloe returns to save the patient and brings her betrayers to justice. Vindicated at last, she leads a national emergency-care initiative and earns the country's highest medical honor.
6aa3b82c32eca1e150047623.title: I'm the Doctor You Never Should Have Fired

6aa3c77fb7434a33740b5e5a.synopsis: Exhausted by the endless corporate grind of Wall Street, elite executive Lauren quits her job and sinks her life savings into an abandoned, 200-acre farm in the remote mountains of Montana. Seeking a peaceful escape, she unexpectedly awakens a "Druid" superpower—the ability to hear and communicate with wild animals. Using smart management strategies and gourmet food, Lauren recruits an incredible crew of wildlife employees: porcupines as automated farm equipment, a massive black bear as a bulldozer, hydro-engineer beavers, and a pack of wild grey wolves acting as her ultimate security team. With their help, the barren wasteland transforms into a luxurious ecological estate. However, when her farm's ultra-premium products go viral on TikTok, they attract the greed of her ex-fiancé Chad and corrupt local tycoon Miller. Facing cyber-smears, power grid sabotage, and a brutal night raid by heavily armed poachers, Lauren leads her multi-species army in an epic counterattack, crushing the capitalist threats with the raw power of nature and rising as the undisputed queen of her "Montana Druid Empire".
6aa3c77fb7434a33740b5e5a.title: Wall Street to Wilderness: The Montana Druid

6aa3da026ad2b895d6070ebf.synopsis: Leo Banks got a special physique and X-ray eyes. After leaving his sect, he runs into his fiancée and tries to save her, only to be mistaken for a creep. To prove himself, Leo now has to dominate the city and live a carefree life.
6aa3da026ad2b895d6070ebf.title: My X-Ray Eyes Rule the City

6aa41b758d6e213b0101ffa5.synopsis: At Adrian Shaw’s company, everyone knew her simply as "Georgia Hale"—a manager who had worked by his side for eight years and his secret girlfriend. No one knew that "Hale" was merely her middle name; her real name was Georgia Hale Harrison, the sole heiress and Vice President of the Harrison Group. When she humbled herself for the first time in her life to beg her father, Richard Harrison, to approve the crucial thirty-million-dollar contract Adrian had been desperately chasing for months, Adrian repaid her by publicly announcing his marriage to an intern, Chloe Vance. Georgia withheld the deal, resigned, severed ties with Adrian, and agreed to marry Julian Prescott—the heir to the Prescott family who had waited twelve years for her. At the grand signing ceremony, her father appeared in person to reveal her true name and identity; she terminated the contract on the spot and exposed Chloe’s betrayal. As Adrian’s company collapsed and he spiraled into regret, Georgia’s life soared—cherished by Julian and welcomed back into the fold of her family, she finally lived life on her own terms, no longer anyone’s secret.
6aa41b758d6e213b0101ffa5.title: How I Bankrupted My Cheating Ex

6aa752ea136f31b62908c889.synopsis: Maya, a studious girl, agrees to help her crush Connor prank Harper. But Connor ties her up with zip ties and covers her in fake blood. Harper, terrified, beats her with a steel chair, breaking 17 bones. Maya survives after three months in ICU but is disfigured. She rejects settlements, testifies in court, and gets Harper jailed and Connor imprisoned. She moves away, rebuilds her life, and studies psychology and law. Connor spirals into madness. Maya moves on, scarred but unbroken.
6aa752ea136f31b62908c889.title: Prank Gone Wrong

6aa753499f31a8ba4c0a3fcc.synopsis: Claire, divorced and broke, becomes caregiver for Poppy, a traumatized girl. She wins Poppy's trust and marries Adrian Mercer to secure custody. Her ex-husband Daniel harasses her, but Adrian defends her. Claire and Adrian grow close, and she learns Poppy is Adrian's adopted niece. They have a child and legally adopt Poppy. Daniel loses everything. Claire finds true family and love.
6aa753499f31a8ba4c0a3fcc.title: Let the Past Rest

6aa753ad83b3abf3980648be.synopsis: Five years ago, Evelyn, from the slums, was chosen by Adrian, a wealthy young man from New York, to be a surrogate mother to give birth to Chloe. However, after the child's birth, she was stripped of her maternal status and forced to remain at Blackwood Estate as a live-in nanny. For five years, she silently memorized Chloe's every habit, ailment, and fear, only to be repeatedly humiliated, forced to kneel, confined, and even distanced from her daughter by the nominal wife, Lillian. Chloe, however, instinctively relied on Evelyn, the one who truly cared for her, clinging to her through repeated crises of illness, fear, and abandonment.
6aa753ad83b3abf3980648be.title: The Slum Girl Who Became a Billionaire's Wife

6aa753efe13e65890e083ebb.synopsis: In AGENT BADBOY movie, top FBI agent Buddy looks exactly like Barton, the deceased patriarch of the Logut mafia family. He goes undercover as Barton to expose the family’s arms smuggling. Inside, he survives power grabs from Luca, probes from Barton’s stepmother Susanna, and uses their shared crescent birthmark to avoid exposure. He falls for Barton’s wife Elise, wins over bodyguard Haruko, and secures the San Francisco docks. With evidence in hand, he and FBI Deputy Director Helena plan a final raid—but FBI Director Burke is the mafia’s deepest mole. He and the Raine family spring a trap; Helena is shot. In the battle, Buddy kills Burke and Carlos. Dying, Burke reveals Buddy and Barton are twin brothers—stolen as infants and groomed to be a mafia mole inside the FBI. Torn between two bloodlines, Buddy stands with Elise, Susanna, and Haruko—as Helena, presumed dead, twitches her fingers. Cliffhanger.
6aa753efe13e65890e083ebb.title: Agent Badboy

6aa756337b3ea9ca6e0e382e.synopsis: Joe, self-made CEO of Vera Robotics, pioneered companion robots. In his past life, his wife Vanessa and her lover Dan conspired to murder him brutally, staged an accident, and stole his company.Reborn on the day of his companion robot launch, Joe initiates his revenge. Using the guise of testing robots, he mercilessly torments Dan, who is disguised as a machine. At the press conference, he meticulously manipulates Vanessa into signing divorce papers voluntarily, then publicly exposes Dan hiding inside a robot shell, shattering Vanessa's innocent facade. His scheme leaves the traitors ruined—family broken, company lost—while Joe reclaims his empire and relists it successfully.
6aa756337b3ea9ca6e0e382e.title: The Robot She Cheated With

6aa75787742a9765a10bfc80.synopsis: On the same day, two best friends gave birth. Ellen, drowning in poverty, secretly swapped her newborn with her billionaire best friend’s baby, desperate to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she never expected: her friend saw everything and silently switched the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Ellen’s scheme is finally about to pay off, the truth explodes in her face: the daughter she’s tormented and belittled all along… is her own blood.
6aa75787742a9765a10bfc80.title: She Swapped the Wrong Baby

6aa760d814afee28720ae8f7.synopsis: Betrayed by her stepsister Sera and fiancé Henri, Elara is pushed off a cliff on her wedding day. She drags Sera down with her—and both are reborn. On the eve of the Flower-Bond Ceremony, Elara tosses her bouquet. Sera shoves her; the bouquet lands among commoners, caught by a disguised man—Cassian, CEO of the British East India Company, hiding from an arranged marriage. Mocked for marrying a “penniless commoner,” Elara fiercely defends him. He falls for her on the spot. Meanwhile, his mother learns the truth and heads for the venue.
6aa760d814afee28720ae8f7.title: One Wrong Toss, I Married the Richest Man

6aa76218b3be27359003c45c.synopsis: As a fake‑born heiress, Ivy was betrothed to three elite beastmen: Lucian the fox, Kieran the tiger, and Caelen the serpent. After stumbling across their group chat, Ivy mistakenly believed they disliked her and favored her sister Lia. At her birthday banquet, she publicly gave the three beastmen to Lia and fled abroad to become a renowned pianist. Four years later, Ivy returns home, only to be tracked down by the trio. Those hurtful messages turned out to be their scheme against one another, each plotting to have her exclusively. As misunderstandings clear and Lia keeps making trouble, the beastmen fiercely defend Ivy. After her solo recital, Ivy faces her true feelings, accepts their affection and lives for herself.
6aa76218b3be27359003c45c.title: Rejected by My Shifter Mates, So I Walked Away

6aa762ef7437581d78018d97.synopsis: Abandoned by her family, Eva is reborn on the day of the bloodline trial. In her past life, her stepsister Vivian framed her, and she died in a vampire castle as a pawn. This time, she sees through her family’s fake love and the vampires’ schemes, choosing wounded werewolf Alistair—secretly the supreme Lycan King. Poisoned by the Ice-Fire Divine Poison and betrayed by his closest subordinate, he hides as a lowly wolf slave. Vivian steals the vampire marriage contract and torments Eva, while her cold parents treat her as a bargaining chip. Even cast out and mocked by nobles, Eva stands by Alistair. At the Blood Moon Ceremony, Vivian forces her barefoot across silver thorns and sacred fire to kill her. Alistair arrives with his wolf legion, reveals his true identity, and avenges every insult. Together they uncover the vampire Progenitor’s plot to seize the Blackstone Divine Essence inside Eva. Eva enters the Void Sacred Spring alone, endures heavenly thunder as a mortal, absorbs the forbidden essence, and cures Alistair. They defeat the Progenitor, overthrow the old order, and punish all traitors. Eva ascends the twin thrones as Wolf Queen beside her Lycan King, bound by eternal love.
6aa762ef7437581d78018d97.title: My Lycan Lord

6aa764892d395f6ee40b75d1.synopsis: Sean, sole heir to the Kelton Group, hid his identity for love. He became a stay-at-home husband and helped his wife Vivian rise. On the night she became vice-president, she and her male best friend Lucas framed Sean for Lucas's drunk-driving hit-and-run. He served a year in prison. Vivian never visited—she moved in with Lucas and let their son Jason call Lucas "dad." Released, Sean gave her one last chance. He returned home and caught them in bed. Vivian slapped him, called him a jobless deadbeat ex-con, and even Jason humiliated him. He signed the divorce and returned to the Kelton Group. His billionaire father Winston backed him, assigning childhood friend Mia—president of Nossa Group—to assist him. At the Nossa welcome banquet, Vivian and Lucas mistook Sean for a beggar, smashed his Patek Philippe, and ordered guards to drag him out. Mia revealed his true identity: heir and chairman of the Kelton Group. Lucas and Vivian turned on each other, were dragged out, and stripped of everything. With Mia by his side, Sean reclaimed his power and completed his revenge.
6aa764892d395f6ee40b75d1.title: Betrayed by My Wife, I Return for Revenge

6aa765af8d7e92f91a030faf.synopsis: Retired underworld king Roman is hiding as a rideshare driver. Until the Graysons' cruelty at his daughter's engagement forces him to summon his three powerful sworn brothers—crushing his enemies and revealing his true empire.
6aa765af8d7e92f91a030faf.title: Daddy's Done Pretending

6aa7937c010dc7b364022699.synopsis: Pyrrhos is the hammer-hand at Hermon's Forge — a nobody they call Emberless, because he can't feel forge fire the way a real smith should. He's spent a thousand nights making the runeblades that kill dragons and hydras across the continent. On Assessment Day, he watches the guild crown his senior brother Deryk for a masterpiece called Firstlight: Pyrrhos's design, his three years of work, his signature scraped off the plans. When he demands his wages and walks, his master upends a sack on the anvil — ten rusted scraps. Then, in the dying furnace behind him, a thread of pure gold flame rises on its own. Ten scraps is his starting stake. With a girl carrying a broken family sword, a landlord's back room, and a wartime order no one else will fill, he builds a forge out of nothing and starts scraping the paint off the guild's fake runes one blade at a time. But the fire in his hands isn't luck. It answers to a bloodline that traces back to Hephaestus himself, to a father who burned with his workshop rather than surrender the plans for the Godslayer, and to an order of ashes still hunting the seven fragments he scattered. Delphi has a name waiting for him. He'd rather earn one.
6aa7937c010dc7b364022699.title: GODFORGED: TEN SCRAPS OF IRON

6aa793819e09c929dd03bef8.synopsis: In The Alpha's Broken Mate movie, my entire family forced me to take the blame for my adopted sister, and my Alpha told me, "Seven years will pass in no time". While I was in prison for her, losing the child in my womb, my Alpha mate was holding her in his arms and saying, "I love you". After I was released, I severed our soul bond with my own hands and left for the war zone. Later, filled with regret, he clutched my boots and cried, "My Luna". I touched my heavily pregnant belly and said, "Sorry, but I'm already carrying your older brother's child".
6aa793819e09c929dd03bef8.title: The Alpha's Broken Mate

6aa7a6696a19b24c4c0d6384.synopsis: "On her wedding day, Megan’s fiancé Mark vanishes without a trace. After four years of investigation, the police still turn up no leads whatsoever. Consumed by her relentless obsession, Megan is taken by her best friend Jennifer to a hidden underground store that sells so-called hyper-realistic ""shared boyfriend"" companion robots. She is horrified to discover that ""Robot No. 07"" is none other than Mark, missing for four years. He is kept subdued with drugs and electric shocks, disguised as merchandise to be exploited for profit. To save her beloved, Megan swallows her humiliation and feigns compliance, secretly gathering evidence. Step by step, she uncovers the shocking truth: her best friend, driven by hatred born from scorned love, was the one who ""donated"" Mark to the store owner. In the final showdown, Megan collaborates with the police from the inside to raid and shut down the illegal operation. The two lean on each other through the long aftermath of trauma, moving steadily toward healing and a new beginning."
6aa7a6696a19b24c4c0d6384.title: Shared Boyfriend

6aa7a817352596cfcd03ec5b.synopsis: Chloe thought she was just an ordinary wife until her husband Noah and her sister Mia betrayed her. But they underestimated her—she is no victim. She is a queen, and revenge is a dish best served cold. After discovering their affair, Chloe devises a systematic plan to strip Noah of everything—his wealth, his company, and his dignity. With the help of her fiercely loyal right-hand man, Liam, she infiltrates the boardroom, exposes their schemes on a public stage, and dismantles Mia’s fragile facade piece by piece. What begins as a twisted love triangle soon reveals a deeper conspiracy: the truth behind Chloe's father’s mysterious death. From securing control of a billion-dollar corporation to unearthing long-buried secrets, Chloe's quest for justice turns into a sweeping power play. In the end, she rises as the undisputed queen of the empire, with her most dangerous yet loyal ally standing beside her—not as a servant, but as her equal. Revenge is just the beginning. This is a story of betrayal, power, and absolute redemption.
6aa7a817352596cfcd03ec5b.title: Surrender to the Night

6aa7be510277dd3ed1059830.synopsis: Mia is a 19-year-old college freshman who's beautiful but broke. Her father tells her to sell herself. Her mother offers her a job at a bar. With tuition overdue and no way out, she accepts an offer from her African professor, Kofi: $5,000 a month for companionship. But Kofi has other plans. He injects her with drugs, ties her up, and films everything. He doesn't stop there. He uses the videos to blackmail her into delivering packages—drugs, money, things she doesn't want to know about. Just when she thinks she's alone, Nina, the quiet girl in her dorm, steps in. Nina saves her from Kofi in a dark parking lot. She holds Mia through withdrawal. She becomes the only person Mia trusts. Until Mia finds messages on Nina's phone. Messages that prove Nina wasn't just helping her. She was positioning herself. She was waiting for Mia to fall so she could be the one to catch her—and own her.
6aa7be510277dd3ed1059830.title: The Freshman’s Secret

6aa7c50450460871b005c79c.synopsis: Avalyn, a lone girl raised by wolves in the northern wilderness, is brought back by her birth father Duke Snow only to get trapped in royal conspiracies. After her father is murdered, she bides her time and devises schemes. With her courage and beast-taming skills, she slays her enemies, quells barbarian uprisings and earns widespread renown across the kingdom. Eventually, she uncovers her true identity as the lost heir of the Sacred Court of All Beasts, returns to the divine realm, executes the usurper, and ascends the Throne of All Beasts.
6aa7c50450460871b005c79c.title: Wolf of the North

6aa7c58723b93c5a45037516.synopsis: Cecilia, Crown Princess of Etheria, rescues a disfigured “deserter” named Amos from a death pit and makes him her personal guard. Three years later, King Helios of Nord storms her capital—and reveals he is Amos. Having used her to steal every military secret, he destroys her kingdom, burns her ancestral tombs, and enslaves her. To buy time for her brother Edmund to strike Nord’s rear, Cecilia endures public humiliation, torture, and repeated abuse, until she takes a fake-death potion left by Edmund and escapes. Edmund captures Nord’s capital, trades Helios’s mother for Cecilia’s “corpse,” and secretly revives her. Years later, Edmund dies, naming Cecilia regent for his young son. Helios, learning she is alive, begs for reconciliation, then threatens to massacre civilians when refused. Cecilia declares war and leads the army herself. After three years, she stands before Nord’s capital, shoots Helios twice but spares his life, then orders the assault. That night, Helios dons his old disguise mask and burns himself alive in the palace. Cecilia annexes Nord, abolishes slavery, standardizes weights and measures, establishes a people’s council, and unites both kingdoms into a new realm—Eternal. She never marries, devoting her life to her people. Upon her death, she is honored as the “Mother of the Eternal Realm.” Her bronze statue still stands in the capital square, gazing into the distance, a silent witness to the peace she won with blood and sacrifice.
6aa7c58723b93c5a45037516.title: Fallen Princess to Queen

6aa7d18a729361e7e207336d.synopsis: After Serena, the wealthy heiress of Renwick Bay, uncovers her fiancé Jake’s betrayal, she is framed and embroiled in an unexpected entanglement with Marcus, a ruthless mafia godfather. To save her wrongfully accused father, she struggles to survive amid Marcus’s overpowering dominance and vengeful schemes. Weathering successive blows of betrayal and family ruin, she rises from the ashes of despair. In the end, Serena and Marcus resolve the long-standing feud and misunderstanding between their families, walking hand in hand into a grand wedding.
6aa7d18a729361e7e207336d.title: Hale Heiress Strikes Back

6aa8087087fabbce6b0b13a9.synopsis: In the early 1980s, Ellie is forced to marry John, a scarred logging foreman, in her sister's place. Expecting a hot-tempered brute, she finds a rugged husband who adores her and a fierce mother-in-law who always has her back. Blessed with uncanny luck, Ellie discovers rare mushrooms and century-old ginseng in the mountains, turning the family's fortunes around. Soon, the once-pitied bride becomes the forest camp's richest woman, while fighting off greedy relatives and her shameless sister.
6aa8087087fabbce6b0b13a9.title: I Married a Lumberjack and Struck It Rich

6aa80929eca954405107a0f4.synopsis: Born with the ability to understand animal language, Nora Seth was abandoned as a child and raised by Elder Tatum. When her grandmother falls gravely ill, Nora returns to reunite with her family. Yet her stepmother and her daughter constantly try to sabotage Nora. But with her beast-taming skills, she beats them all. Then comes her arranged fiancé... Vicious stepmom and stepsister, a company to save, and a fiancé to deal with, can she handle them all?
6aa80929eca954405107a0f4.title: Beasts at My Command, I Tamed a Kingdom

6aa82ca6fef73defe803d847.synopsis: Ever wonder what The Big Four really get up to after wrap? We kept the cameras rolling as they took a dip and dove into some heated sports debates.
6aa82ca6fef73defe803d847.title: ReelTalk EP 88-Bro Knows Ball

6aa83403a82a0a84ed0093e5.synopsis: Cool down from the steamy scenes with the Lyonesse Trilogy’s favorite throuple! Salt Kiss, Honey Cut, and Bitter Burn stars Nico Tortorella, Jake Lively, and Katelynn Rose whip up homemade ice cream while answering some seriously hot questions.
6aa83403a82a0a84ed0093e5.title: ReelTalk EP 91-Ice Cream & Hot Questions with the Lyonesse Trilogy Cast

6aa8a3355bc79b35270882d6.synopsis: In The Dragon Queen's Gambit movie, Dragon Queen Evelyn discovers her consort Cyril and handmaid Cecilia, both serpent-shifters, swapped her newborn with their son. She secretly raises her daughter Ann into a northern empire queen. After twenty years of silent endurance, Evelyn abdicates and is exiled. When Ann marries the impostor prince, the trap springs: identity reveal, economic ruin, and the arrival of Millennium Dragon Aurelius as Ann's true father. The betrayers lose everything while Evelyn reunites with her family.
6aa8a3355bc79b35270882d6.title: The Dragon Queen's Gambit

6aa8a5d7f08dff1bf80a3bda.synopsis: Abandoned at her tenth wedding—and insultingly replaced by a K-9 dog—Brigid Hayes marries powerful billionaire Marco Romano on the spot. Ignorant of her new status, her toxic ex-fiancé and his scheming assistant physically attack and frame her. Marco swiftly retaliates, uncovering their official corruption and bringing them to complete public and legal ruin. As her tormentors crumble, Brigid discovers Marco's devotion stems from a deep, shared past.
6aa8a5d7f08dff1bf80a3bda.title: Tenth Wedding, New Groom

6aa8a632ced94a7b9009c98c.synopsis: Five years ago, Luna, a girl from the slums, was forced by Alan, her wealthy mother-in-law, to jump off a building. She later gave birth to their son Neo alone. Five years on, Neo was diagnosed with leukemia and urgently needed a bone marrow transplant. Luna crossed paths again with Ken, her former boyfriend, who had become a chief orthopedic surgeon. To protect her son, Luna concealed the truth about their relationship and signed an agreement with Ken. However, trapped in a series of plots hatched by Alan and Tina, Ken’s fiancée, she suffered a miscarriage and fled to France. After uncovering the whole truth, Ken had his mother committed to a psychiatric hospital and sent Tina to prison. Eventually, he tracked down Luna, and the family of three was reunited.
6aa8a632ced94a7b9009c98c.title: Bound by Secrets: Her Billionaire Doctor

6aa8da2fbf58aac6cb0b70cd.synopsis: Ethan once had the life everyone dreamed of. After being adopted by a poor couple, he rose from humble beginnings through his own hard work and became a legend admired by many. While his most trusted brother, Cole, was adopted into a wealthy family,but still failed to achieve the success he desired. Cole was consumed by jealousy, believing that Ethan had taken everything that was meant to be his. Their bitter rivalry eventually led them both to a tragic end. As Ethan loses consciousness in the freezing river, fate gives the two brothers a second chance. They wake up and find themselves back on the day they were adopted. This time, Ethan is determined not to repeat the mistakes of the past or allow himself to be controlled by his brother again. Cole, meanwhile, is determined to reclaim what he believes was always his. Given the chance to rewrite their destinies, the two brothers set out on completely different paths. But the past they share, the grudges left unresolved, and the battle for the family legacy force them to stand at another crossroads of fate. With the same life beginning again, what choices will they make? And this time, who will truly control their own future? A battle over wealth, glory, and the choices that define a life has only just begins...
6aa8da2fbf58aac6cb0b70cd.title: My Brother Thought He Won

6aa8dad9632d51a1f901d837.synopsis: Elara thought the worst thing that could happen was getting pregnant by a dangerous stranger. She was wrong. Because the man hunting her down is Silas Thorne, New York's most feared mafia don. And he isn't just the father of her baby. He's her boyfriend's father. Now Silas wants her under his roof, his son wants her back, and the Thorne family is one secret away from tearing itself apart. Elara only made one mistake that night. But in this family, one mistake can start a war.
6aa8dad9632d51a1f901d837.title: Pregnant by My Ex's Father

6aa8dd440365004aed09970e.synopsis: Serena marries the mafia boss Dante Santoro. Their marriage begins purely out of interests, with no love involved. After Serena discovers she is pregnant with quadruplets, she suddenly receives a divorce text offering one hundred million on condition that she signs papers and leaves Dante. Instead of breaking down or weeping, she calmly signs the documents and vanishes overnight. When Dante returns, he finds out the divorce message and papers are all forged by his childhood friend Vivienne. He realizes he has long been in love with Serena. He makes a public sincere apology and spares no effort to win her back. Serena refuses to forgive him easily...
6aa8dd440365004aed09970e.title: Quads, Mafia Divorce ——I Took the Money and Ran

6aa902759f0e8f89050c71b9.synopsis: In her past life, Liriel, Princess of the Moon Elves, loved her betrothed, the paladin Kaelen. When the Abyss crisis struck, he abandoned her to save Elara. Liriel was mortally wounded, her golden hair withered. Reborn at the betrothal temple, she watched Elara claim the golden oath meant for Kaelen. Heartbroken, Liriel signed the black oath of Azriel, the cursed Goblin Lord. Elara burned her relics, framed her, and killed her spirit bird, Snow. Kaelen publicly flogged Liriel, and her father moved to strip her title. Near death, Liriel was saved by Azriel, whose thousand-year curse her moonlight power had long eased. They forged a protection pact. Cold to all, Azriel cherished only her. When the Elf coalition and Elara attacked, he sacrificed his demon core and bound their lives forever. Together they exposed Elara’s plots. Elara was disfigured; Kaelen was doomed to regret. Liriel rose as Queen of the Abyss, loved eternally by Azriel.
6aa902759f0e8f89050c71b9.title: Bride of the Goblin Lord

6aa911ac6f6588b4d906af45.synopsis: Betrayed and killed by her jealous sister, noble Aloryn is reborn. She casts a silver token into the sea to choose her husband, and Poseidon, disguised as a fisherman, claims it. Despite mockery, Aloryn marries him. Her sister and the arrogant prince torment her, forcing her to walk over burning embers. Enraged, Poseidon reveals his divine identity and punishes the villains. Poseidon’s mother Rhea subjects Aloryn to cruel trials. Through kindness and self‑sacrifice, Aloryn gains Rhea’s approval. She becomes Queen of the Seven Seas, bound to Poseidon forever.
6aa911ac6f6588b4d906af45.title: Married to a Fisherman, But He Is Poseidon

6aa92d318ac4232b930dfeb7.synopsis: Six-winged Archangel Seraphina spent a thousand loveless years married to Heavenly Commander Michael, who loved her sister, Lyra. When Lyra died and Lucifer waged war on Heaven, Michael died begging Seraphina to let him go in the next life. Heartbroken, she burned her divine power to rewind time. Reborn at the altar, she severed all ties, took Lyra’s place in an ancient pact to marry Lucifer, and gave Michael his freedom. Michael, unaware, wounded her with cruel accusations. After Lyra’s deceit, Seraphina quietly left. On his wedding day, Michael lifted the veil expecting his “true love”—and found Lyra. Realizing Seraphina had sacrificed herself for him, he raced to the Demon Abyss in regret. There, Lucifer proved no monster, but a refined protector. He used his last drop of Angelic Grace to heal her and defended her against his own dark legion. They fell deeply in love, and he abandoned his vengeance for her. When Michael invaded the Abyss to “rescue” her, Seraphina coldly rejected him. In the end, she burned her divinity again to save Lucifer, purifying his dark core. Together they found redemption beyond Light and Darkness.
6aa92d318ac4232b930dfeb7.title: Bound to the Fallen: A Seraph's Rebirth

6aa9f3cd0cf84de170032bc9.synopsis: Grayson, hidden ruler of the Five Nation Syndicate, poses as a gardener. His wife Vanessa leaves him for being poor and falls for Ivan — his most dangerous subordinate plotting to seize the vault. Grayson infiltrates his own summit, proving his identity through golden keys and escalating confrontations. Outgunned, he flees with waitress Sarah and discovers she, not Vanessa, once saved his life. He turns Ivan's heist into a trap, ambushes the traitors in the vault, and crowns Sarah as queen.
6aa9f3cd0cf84de170032bc9.title: Five Keys, One Hidden King

6aa9f4450efc92eabb076257.synopsis: Kit vanishes at age seven in a robot attack, raised by kidnapper Voltage as "Ash." Later, Ash infiltrates his family's tryouts, framed by brother Spark, Voltage's son. His birthmark nearly surfaces, Aura's intuition circles, and their father doubts him, until Spark burns the mark away. When Voltage publicly claims Ash, the family erupts into war. Ash proves his bloodline and helps them escape. He regains his memory at the crater, reclaims the name Kit Unbreakable, Spark's betrayal unresolved.
6aa9f4450efc92eabb076257.title: The Unbreakables: Super Son Returns

6aa9f4fe836e550fa6010f87.synopsis: Orphan Eileen saved Hatton Academy's headmaster and was adopted, growing up with three Alpha childhood sweethearts. Chloe framed her with forged notes; the three men refused to believe her, torturing her with hockey pucks, dragging her behind a horse, and hanging her from a flagpole. Her heart died, and she chose Bruno, a fallen Alpha. When the truth came out, the three regretted deeply and gave up their Alpha blood to save her—but she never looked back, bonding with Bruno and marrying him.
6aa9f4fe836e550fa6010f87.title: After My Three Alpha Childhood Sweethearts Abandoned Me, They Regretted It

6aaa008f38bdf5f65a0af22b.synopsis: Amelia lived in a novel world. Her human mother had transmigrated here, completed a system-assigned mission to conquer four beastmen (a phoenix, a rabbit, a wolf, and a snake), and given birth to her. After her mother returned to the real world, Amelia was raised and fiercely spoiled by her four fathers Later, they brought home another girl named Brielle, who constantly framed Amelia for abusing her. Blinded by the lies, the Dads locked Amelia up and tortured her, which tragically went too far and killed her. After her death, her mother contacted her through the system and brought her soul back to the real world. Eventually, Brielle’s lies were exposed and she was beaten to death by the furious four dads. The quartet were subsequently stripped of everything and sentenced to life imprisonment. Meanwhile, Amelia lived a peaceful and happy life with her mother in the real world.
6aaa008f38bdf5f65a0af22b.title: My Four Beast Daddies' Regret

6aaa0f8e6b8e83505f0b9260.synopsis: Once a legendary finance mogul, Eli Stone walked away from the industry years ago to live under the radar. After adopting his son, Caleb Stone, Eli settles into a laid-back life as a security guard. But his peaceful days are turned upside down when he unexpectedly rescues Reed Hayes. Forced into a fake relationship, the two soon find real feelings blossoming between them, and Eli's long-dormant heart finally begins to beat again.
6aaa0f8e6b8e83505f0b9260.title: Your Boss Becomes Your Stepmom

6aaa11db6f352adbdf0772d6.synopsis: Lainey is humiliated by her fiancé Leo at City Hall, who marries pregnant Rosalie for power. She flees to New York, marries Don Falcone Marcus, and becomes his cherished wife and mother of their son. Five years later, back in Chicago, Leo and Rosalie mock her, steal her bracelet, and slap her. At Marcus’s gala, they attack her again. Their son Gable cries out for Mommy—exposing Lainey’s identity. Marcus arrives, enraged. Rosalie stabs Lainey, then dies. Leo is captured. Lainey discovers Marcus secretly loved her for years. They reconcile deeply.
6aaa11db6f352adbdf0772d6.title: The Don's Fatal Tenderness

6aaa1547ad8b86eca7057727.synopsis: Medieval Europe was ravaged by calamities; monsters and plagues had brought kingdoms totheir knees. Six desperate kings journeyed to the Dragon's Gorge to forge a secret pact withLunara, the one and only True Dragon. In exchange for six of her ventral scales to stave offthe apocalypse, the six kingdoms pledged the souls of all their royal bloodlines to the dragonfor eternity upon their death. Lunara honored the pact, surrendering her scales anddamaging her core. She fell into a deep slumber atop a mountain of gold in the gorge.Decades later, she awoke to utter betrayal. The six kingdoms reneged on the soul contract,used the dragon scales to conquer and expand their territories, and allied with the Church torewrite history, branding the oath-keeping True Dragon as a world-ending menace. Sir Cyrus,a royal knight ordered to hunt her down, saw through the hypocrisy of men, abandoned hisfaith, and became her loyal guardian. He vows to help her reclaim the scales, enforce thecontract, and reset the rules of the world.
6aaa1547ad8b86eca7057727.title: Awakened Dragon Oath

6aaa3dd87b1c44ab070000bc.synopsis: Noble heiress Luna lost her memory after falling off a cliff, completely forgetting Evan, the heir to the empire’s overlord, whom she had humbly pursued for five years. After awakening, she cut off all affection, agreed to a family-arranged marriage, and coldly struck back at the provocations from Evan and the two-faced “white moonlight” woman. After a drowning incident in which Evan left her to die, Luna made a dignified farewell to the past at a banquet. Meanwhile, Evan, long accustomed to being favored, gradually lost control amid Luna’s coldness and headed toward an irredeemable wife-chasing crematorium.
6aaa3dd87b1c44ab070000bc.title: I moved on, and he fell apart

6aaa3e4b39f2eeea4f0221fb.synopsis: "Sophia, the secret chairwoman of a Wall Street conglomerate, lets her husband Richard run the firm. Jealous secretary Chloe mistakes the pregnant Sophia for a mistress. Aided by corrupt directors, Chloe attacks her and tries to terminate her baby. Richard rescues Sophia. Sophia exposes Chloe’s crimes of espionage and bombing, and crushes her corporate ally with a clever financial trap. Chloe ends up insane in prison. Richard recovers from severe wounds. Sophia holds onto her empire, and the couple have a new baby."
6aaa3e4b39f2eeea4f0221fb.title: Pregnant Yet Mistaken for a Mistress

6aaa3ef79254462ce808d599.synopsis: On the night of a full moon, the Werewolf King Cain loses control and has a sexual encounter with a human girl named Jenny; she subsequently leaves, unaware that she is carrying the Wolf King's heir. She struggles to protect her pregnancy while enduring abuse from her cold-hearted father, cruel stepmother, and greedy younger brother, eventually giving birth prematurely to a half-breed son, Sammy. To cover exorbitant medical bills, she works odd jobs by day and sells alcohol in nightclubs by night, suffering endless humiliation. Amidst this desperate situation, she reunites with the child's father, Cain. Together, they mature through power struggles and family conspiracies, safeguarding a love that transcends the boundaries between their species.
6aaa3ef79254462ce808d599.title: Marked by the Wolf King, I Return With My Fierce Cub

6aaa3f867b1c44ab070000c0.synopsis: Real estate mogul James destroyed his own daughter Sophia’s life to please Charlotte and her daughter. Only after losing his company and dying beside Sophia in a fire did he finally see the woman he loved for who she truly was. But when James opens his eyes again, he finds himself back on the night that changed everything—Charlotte’s daughter’s dog is trapped on one side, while his own daughter is crying for help inside the burning mansion. Who will he choose this time? And what happens when the man Charlotte once controlled finally decides to fight back?
6aaa3f867b1c44ab070000c0.title: A Father's Redemption

6aaa412a5ffd78135c023c4e.synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, Alicia, the Saintess of Order, is secretly drugged by her elder sister Lina and catches her fiancé, the Sun God Apollo, in an affair with Lina. The two turn the accusation against Alicia, framing her for an illicit relationship with a guard. Humiliated before the gods, Alicia has her engagement annulled and her divinity stripped away before being cast into the Abyss as a sacrifice. At the brink of death, the dormant royal blood of Lilith awakens within her, transforming her into a succubus. She falls into a cavern where Lucifer, the Demon King, has been sealed for a thousand years. Through an unexpected twist of fate, Alicia forms a soul-seal bond with him and breaks his ancient imprisonment. When Alicia awakens, she is no longer the obedient and innocent saintess others once controlled, but a reborn queen empowered by seductive royal blood and a burning desire for revenge. She strikes a bargain with Lucifer and follows him to the Demon Palace, where she is scorned and challenged by its maids and the elders of the Abyss. Faced with humiliation and attack, Alicia reveals the ancestral mark of Lilith’s royal blood. Its overwhelming power forces the nobles of the Abyss to kneel before her. From that moment on, Alicia joins forces with Lucifer to wage war against the Divine Court, expose the hypocrisy of Lina and Apollo, and make everyone who betrayed her pay the ultimate price.
6aaa412a5ffd78135c023c4e.title: Married to the Demon King, the Sun God Begs for My Return

6aaa457647b731f35c0cb459.synopsis: Twenty years ago, Victoria Stone murdered her fiancé Charles in a candlelit bedroom, stole the golden heir ring, and seized control of the Stone empire as his ruthless "widow." For two decades, she has ruled with beauty, cunning, and a razor-sharp PR machine, treating her three daughters as pawns and turning every scandal into ratings gold for the family's reality TV show.
6aaa457647b731f35c0cb459.title: The Heir Game

6aaa57320abf12301005e94e.synopsis: Typhon attacks Olympus and is sealed beneath Mount Etna, but the seal weakens every 600 years. As the Age of Gods ends, Hades lacks power to reinforce it. The Prophecy Stone reveals that a divine heir—born of Hades and a mortal woman with witch blood and different-colored eyes—can permanently strengthen the seal. In the mortal world, Saintess Layra is blamed for volcanic disasters and nearly burned alive. Hades saves her, taking her to the Underworld. The Prophecy Stone has chosen her as his bride: she must bear his child or die. Bound by the Serpent Soul Pact, Layra resists at first, but Hades’ care and protection win her over. They consummate their marriage. Jealous Minthe, who loves Hades, torments Layra. Nyx, the Goddess of Night, imprisons her and claims Layra carries a God-Devouring Curse. Heartbroken and misled, Layra tries to escape through the Well of Reincarnation, but Hades saves her, confessing his love. They grow deeply in love, and Layra becomes pregnant. Hades weakens, avoiding her. Then Alector, the high priest who raised her, lures Layra back to the mortal world and captures her—he has discovered her witch blood and has his own plans.
6aaa57320abf12301005e94e.title: The Nether King's Bride

6aaa58e56a90084bd304022e.synopsis: Competitiveeating champion Vivian has a special gift: the more she eats, the better luck people close to her get. She devotes all her resources to boost husband Arthur’s mayoral campaign, only to face his betrayal and forced divorce. Vivian breaks away and enters an alliancemarriage with rival candidate Smith. With her supernatural gift, wit and public popularity, she crushes schemes from her exhusband and tycoons, exacts revenge and gains sincere love.
6aaa58e56a90084bd304022e.title: The Vote Queen: My Mayor Ex Can't Have Me

6aaa596c0424e9843907daea.synopsis: Actress Lily had a one‑night stand with CEO Liam five years ago and returned home raising their son Leo alone. Leo accidentally recognizes his biological father, and a DNA test confirms their blood ties. The two sign a contract for a secret marriage. As Lily struggles in show business, she faces rumors and rivals’ harassment. She also deals with the pursuit of movie star Mason and hostility from actress Lucy. Quietly resolving troubles for her, Liam gradually falls for her and chases her heart. With the clever little son playing matchmaker, this fake couple slowly develops genuine feelings for each other.
6aaa596c0424e9843907daea.title: Run, Mommy! Daddy Is Coming!

6aaa5ad912516e61c1098431.synopsis: Daniel is the invisible, bullied equipment assistant for the ice hockey team, a pitiful bottom who only gets attention and care when he becomes a sexy cam boy late at night. He has no idea that his most hated bully, the school's top alpha who despises gays, is the same person who showers him with money every night as his biggest fan. This is a story of enemies turned lovers, where a straight jock is bent out of shape by the boy he swore to hate
6aaa5ad912516e61c1098431.title: Bully at School, Sugar on Live

6aaa5ca0d8704222850a577a.synopsis: Twenty-three years ago, EVELYNN, wife of the HARTMAN pharmaceutical tycoon, swapped her biological daughter LAYLA with an orphan DANIEL at her mother’s instigation to secure her position in the wealthy family. Twenty-three years later, LAYLA works as a bartender in a bar, while DANIEL has risen to the post of R&D President of the group. The two meet and fall in love amid misunderstandings, only to face fierce sabotage from the fake heiress THYRA. As the truth of the baby swap unfolds layer by layer, blood ties and hatred intertwine. After losing her child and her adoptive mother to illness, LAYLA eventually reconciles with her birth mother EVELYNN. Together with DANIEL, she exposes the HEER family’s plot to seize control of the enterprise.
6aaa5ca0d8704222850a577a.title: The Forgotten Blood Heir

6aaa72b1239fb7032b010b89.synopsis: After canceling the condo she decorated alone, Maya leaves her fiancé Ryan—who spent five winters in Japan with his first love Hannah, gifting her custom jewelry while bringing Maya only fridge magnets. She moves to a new city, starts over, and ignores his belated apologies and list of 47 broken promises. He signs the dissolution agreement and sends back her belongings, along with one last magnet he chose himself. Maya keeps the magnet, buys her favorite flowers, and closes her eyes—no longer waiting.
6aaa72b1239fb7032b010b89.title: Five Winters With Her, Five Fridge Magnets for Me

6aaa73d81c3de108910ef9a3.synopsis: For five years, Serena built Adrian's empire, only to be branded a traitor when he protected his childhood sweetheart. Exiled, hunted, and presumed powerless, she vanishes for three years. Then she appears at a Blackwood underground auction, puts a gun to her rival's head, and claims the castle as her territory. Everyone expects her execution. Instead, the feared Vincent Blackwood steps forward and names Serena as his wife. She did not return for Adrian. She returned with evidence, an army, and a trap for everyone who destroyed her.
6aaa73d81c3de108910ef9a3.title: The Don's Abandoned Ex-Wife Strikes Back

6aab6504d2ab3aadf90598bc.synopsis: Selene Ward shattered her wolf soul at ten to save Tristan, Dark Moon's future Alpha. For eight years, she endured being called "wolfless," clinging to his promise that she would be his Luna. At his coronation, he held her down while his new girlfriend cut her hair with silver scissors, then rejected their mate bond before a thousand witnesses. Selene accepted his rejection, severed her pack bond, and walked away—with her father, Dark Moon's head warrior, beside her. No one knew that losing Tristan would awaken her dormant bloodline. At Apex Royal Academy, she meets Ryker Thorne, a "useless playboy" hiding the power of a pureblood Lycan king, and discovers a mate bond ten thousand times stronger than the one she lost. Selene rises from outcast to legendary commander as Dark Moon crumbles without her. The wolfless girl never returns. The White Wolf Queen takes her place.
6aab6504d2ab3aadf90598bc.title: The Wolfless Queen

6aaba53318dcc44dbd00634f.synopsis: Six-year-old orphan Ivy has a secret: she can see the color of people’s souls. Red means good. Pitch black means evil. When two couples visit the orphanage, her best friend Ashley ignores Ivy's warnings and insists on being adopted by the wealthy family. Ivy instead chooses a poor couple who seem stern but possess kind hearts. Just as Ivy settles into a simple and happy life, a jealous Ashley suddenly shows up, demanding they swap families...
6aaba53318dcc44dbd00634f.title: After Seeing Their Soul Colors, I Gladly Chose the Poor Family

6aabaeceb29a9b4590020ef1.synopsis: After his girlfriend sells him out to a death game, James unlocks a system that turns every coin spent on female monsters into ten thousand—and with it, he conquers monstrous bosses, crushes the elite, and seizes total dominion over the end of the world.
6aabaeceb29a9b4590020ef1.title: Spend on Her, Get 10,000X Back in the Apocalypse

6aabb1e4b185f80695072f0d.synopsis: On her wedding day, kindergarten teacher Emma was sold by her fiancé Kyle, who was tangled in gambling debts, to the border group leader Santiago. She was forced to sign a one-year contract marriage and also became the nanny for his niece Sofia, who had developed aphasia after losing her family. While adapting to the dangerous world of the group, Emma helps heal the girl, and they gradually develop genuine feelings amidst numerous crises. Facing attacks from rival Valentina, ambitious brother Nacho, and deadly enemy Emilio, Emma sheds her frailty, learns to use a gun for self-protection, and together with Santiago, crushes their enemies' schemes, breaks the contract's chains, finds true love, and builds a complete family
6aabb1e4b185f80695072f0d.title: The Cartel’s Contract Bride

6aabb8c90f0428a0f00f0531.synopsis: Cast out by the angels as worthless — no virtue, no power, no mother — Bastian is thrown into the Void to die. But the pendant his demon queen mother left him just awakened. Down in the abyss, the Seven Deadly Sins have waited fifteen years for their lost prince. The angels should have killed him when they had the chance. He's coming home — and he's bringing all seven Sins with him.
6aabb8c90f0428a0f00f0531.title: Seven Sins! I claimed them all!
