6aabc45f8f37c9b52c024b26.synopsis: William publicly rejects Lora for her younger sister Selena, who bore a dragon egg in their previous life. Both reborn, William blames Lora for failing to produce a pureblood dragon heir. His older brother Asher saves and cherishes her. Together, they fight royal schemes—while she carries Asher’s pureblood dragon heir.
6aabc45f8f37c9b52c024b26.title: Eight Heirs for the Dragon King

6aabc4d597552fb960017530.synopsis: Nine-tailed heiress Aurora gives everything to help her black fox fiancé gain human form. He repays her by killing her and stealing her power for her scheming sister. Reborn at the mate selection ceremony, Aurora gives the black fox to Brielle and chooses Cassian, the feared four-tailed white fox prince. But her enemies still want her birthright, and the elders are ready to sacrifice her. This time, Aurora sets the trap first. As Cassian crushes anyone who touches her, she discovers her ruthless new mate may know exactly how she died.
6aabc4d597552fb960017530.title: In This Life, the White Fox Prince Slays for Me

6aabe2c2ddeda4f8620cf697.synopsis: Secret heiress Ariana is the angelic voice behind her best friend's fame. When that bestie steals her boyfriend too, Ariana's childhood friend—the school heartthrob and MVP —comes back.
6aabe2c2ddeda4f8620cf697.title: Prep School Pop Star!

6aac622e968c52e4da007355.synopsis: Bound By Hatred is based on Cora Reilly’s third book in the Born In Blood Mafia Chronicles. Gianna is the Scuderi family’s little princess, but all she has ever wanted is freedom. She wants freedom from her father’s demand that she marry into the Famiglia, but she also wants to escape the bloodshed and everything her sister has been forced to endure. Gianna has already seen what kind of monsters these men can be. Her family has other plans. They force Gianna into marriage with Matteo Vitiello, a ruthless killer who wants her all to himself. Known throughout the Famiglia as the God of Blades, Matteo is also the younger brother of the man who robbed Gianna’s sister of her virginity. While Gianna remains powerless to help Aria, Luca Vitiello seems ready to claim her older sister completely. No matter how many times Gianna says no, Matteo always finds a reason to pull her back to him. In their world, they are born in blood, sworn in blood, and bound by hatred. Matteo becomes Gianna’s dangerous prison—and the one temptation she can never fully escape. He is ready to burn the world for her, but when will Gianna finally feel the same way? Characters Gianna Scuderi Gianna Scuderi is the main female character of Bound By Hatred. As Aria’s younger sister, she refuses to repeat the fate her sister suffered at the hands of the Famiglia. More than anything, Gianna wants control over her own life. Matteo Vitiello Matteo Vitiello is the main male character and Luca’s playful younger brother. His deadly skill with a blade has earned him the name God of Blades. Matteo sees Gianna as different from every other woman and refuses to let her go. Luca Vitiello Luca Vitiello is Matteo’s older brother and Aria’s new husband. He softens around Aria and Matteo, but he remains fiercely protective and ruthless. His treatment of Aria also shapes Gianna’s hatred of the Famiglia. Aria Vitiello Aria Vitiello is Gianna’s older sister and Luca’s wife. She loves Gianna despite having married into the Vitiello family. Everything Aria endures strengthens Gianna’s determination to escape the same fate.
6aac622e968c52e4da007355.title: Bound by Hatred

6aac64819e2d618b790f0dd8.synopsis: The Story of Dream On: Hollywood's biggest star, Lexington Hall, quit his acting career, desperate for a normal life, and moved to Maple Creek in the Dream On movie. After an accident and an unexpected deal to play a lead role in a school play, he ended up in farm girl & theatre nerd—Stevie's world. Their attraction was inevitable as sparks flew. The ordinary country girl began chasing her acting dreams with the biggest star in her arms as they fell deeply in love. However, their budding romance was ruined when Veronica Hall, Lexinghton's hellish mother and agent, returned as the Dream On movie plot escalated. She wanted Lexington to return to LA and threatened to take him to court & destroy not just his but also Stevie's life, her dreams, and her home. Refusing to let his mother ruin Stevie's life, he broke her heart and abandoned her. But when Lexington Hall returns with an enticing fake-dating offer, Stevie is forced to risk her heart all over again, as their pretend romance only reignites their old love. Will there be a second chance, or would Hollywood destroy their one true love? Characters: Stevie St. James Stevie St. James is the central character of the Dream On movie. She was a country girl who fell in love with the Hollywood star, Lexington Hall, and got her heart broken. Lexington Hall Lexington Hall is Stevie's love interest in Dream On. He was Hollywood's hottest and most popular movie star. Quitting acting, he moved to Maple Creek and fell in love with Stevie only to break her heart when Hollywood pulled him back. Veronica Hall Veronica Hall is the antagonist of Dream On. She was Lexington's ambitious mother and agent who used her son as a ticket to fame and luxury. As the story escalated, she became the force behind Lexington and Stevie's heartbreak. 6aac64819e2d618b790f0dd8.title: Dream On

6aac6e6d5230d8d6ca013277.synopsis: Best friends, Ella and Leah, marry into the HARPER family at the same time – Ella to the firefighter older brother, Charles, and Leah to the doctor younger brother, Noah. On the three-year anniversary of their marriage, Ella is locked inside a blazing room by Charles's first love, Megan. Ella calls Charles and begs for help, but he brushes her off, saying he's busy helping Megan find her cat. At the most crucial moment, Leah rushes in to save Ella. Leah calls Noah, begging him to come and save Ella and her baby. But she's met with mockery and criticism. Heartbroken and betrayed, the best friends, who have endured years of their horrible marriages, decide to file for divorce with the HARPER brothers together.
6aac6e6d5230d8d6ca013277.title: Homegirls Before Husbands

6aac82d6cb3883b74605b9b8.synopsis: Good-girl university student Cecily Knight has spent years pining after popular golden boy Landon King. But everything changes when she impulsively saves Jeremy Volkov: Brutal mafia heir, Landon's deadliest rival, and the one man who will stop at nothing to make Cecily his. As Landon's manipulation is slowly exposed and Jeremy's relentless pursuit awakens something dark in Cecily she never knew existed, she must choose between the boy she thought she wanted and the dangerous man she can't stop craving.
6aac82d6cb3883b74605b9b8.title: God of Wrath

6aac8371968c52e4da007358.synopsis: Nothing exciting ever happens to Ryan Collins, the average nerd next door. Until one day, her best friend (and popular football prodigy) breaks down her door hiding from his ex. One thing leads to another, and the two hook up that night. Unbenkownst to Carsen, who has to leave for NFL training the next day, Ryan's pregnant. She lets him leave without telling him--after all, she'd only ruin his life. He'll forget all about her, now that he's a famous athlete...right?
6aac8371968c52e4da007358.title: Worth the Chase

6aac8448a2dbec86c80e73d7.synopsis: Leo is devastated to find out his new roommate at reformatory school is his arch nemesis, Tyler. But when the highly inexperienced Leo falls for the Headmaster's daughter, Tyler offers to give him "sex lessons." The more Leo and Tyler lose themselves in these lessons, the harder it becomes the deny their feelings for each other. But getting caught doesn't just mean expulsion, it means prison. And Leo and Tyler can't decide if being together is worth the risk.
6aac8448a2dbec86c80e73d7.title: The School for Bad Boys: S*x Lessons

6aac9a50a5aa71b036008ada.synopsis: Desmond Finley wakes up to find he's transmigrated into a romance novel as a playboy. Betrayed on his wedding night by his fiancée and cousin, he awakens the Playboy's Comeback System. Meanwhile, Elowen Hawth is reborn on the very day of the wedding. Realizing Desmond isn't the good-for-nothing rumors claim, she decides to swap places to marry him. With a system and a reborn bride, Desmond is ready to conquer this era.
6aac9a50a5aa71b036008ada.title: Transmigrated, I Married the Reborn Bride

6aac9d1fff613013bf0bc8ef.synopsis: Seraphina Hart, the hidden heiress of the Ashford family, spent five years as Damian Sterling’s secret lover. As their agreement ends, Damian prepares to marry Isabella. Crushed, Seraphina tries to leave—but faces Damian’s coldness and Isabella’s relentless torment. At her breaking point, she returns to her family and makes a stunning comeback as CEO of an Ashford-owned corporation, ready to reclaim everything.
6aac9d1fff613013bf0bc8ef.title: Beneath the Secretary

6aacd2ad5611e2928b0c5c98.synopsis: Meara's cruel stepmother and half sister marry her off to Damian, a poor, cursed Alpha and single father to his disabled daughter, Sierra. Wolfless and trapped in the mountains, Meara struggles to survive—especially with Violet, the pack woman determined to have Damian for herself. As Violet plots to destroy her, Meara fights to protect her new family and reclaim her wolf. But Damian isn't the weak, cursed Alpha everyone believes him to be... He is the Supreme Alpha, and her fated mate.
6aacd2ad5611e2928b0c5c98.title: Married Off To The Cursed Alpha Daddy

6aacd6048765c9ffb501803d.synopsis: On her wedding day, Sabine brother Leo spills red wine on her mother's heirloom wedding dress. Her fiancé Marco then pressures her to apologize to Ava. She publicly calls off the engagement, and leaves the Ricci household to study design under Nora, an old acquaintance of her late mother. After Sabine's departure, Leo and Marco finally realize how their years of favoring Ava have hurt her. Plagued by remorse, they set out to find her. Deprived of her sources of support, Ava spirals out of control. She flees to Nora's home and takes her hostage, luring Sabine to come alone. At the critical moment, Marco, Leo and the police officers arrive. Ava is shot dead, and Nora is rescued...
6aacd6048765c9ffb501803d.title: I let her have all. They live in regret

6aacd9e3b5c952d0200aa70b.synopsis: Theo awakens as a condemned prisoner in a deadly arena, where the Last-Stand Protocol lets him trade years of his life to reflect fatal attacks back at his enemies. After killing a tiger fiend and gaining its powers, he sets out to find his missing sister, battling monsters, corrupt cultivators, and a trafficking ring along the way. But every victory costs him years. With only two years left to live, Theo enters the Metropolis of Fiends, where his mysterious bloodline has made him prey.
6aacd9e3b5c952d0200aa70b.title: I'm the Human Who Hunts Fiends

6aad007e45c728dd8c0b3bca.synopsis: Dustin Curran felt like a spare son. He was sent to his grandfather in the countryside right after his birth, while his parents raised his adopted brother by their side. When he returned home after his grandfather passed away, he was immediately cast into the Clearwind Sect, where he improved his cultivation. One day, his parents suddenly showed up and demended him to wed Linda Collins, who was terminally ill. But Dustin is no longer the spare son they dismissed. They begged him to leave the sect, only to regret it.
6aad007e45c728dd8c0b3bca.title: He's Not A Spare Son

6aad0081cdd42d3e700dcdfc.synopsis: Holding onto Ethan's marriage promise, Cynthia was his secret lover for five years. But when pregnant Kelly returned, he dumped her. Cynthia joined Reese Group, cutting ties. Ethan's late regret failed to win her back. While he and Kelly faced retribution, Cynthia found true love with Jerome.
6aad0081cdd42d3e700dcdfc.title: I Was His Secret. Now I’m His Regret.

6aad031874dc6a0a85073c6d.synopsis: Three years ago, she pushed her husband into the rain, making him hate her enough to survive. Three years later, she escapes into the Underground Blood City, only to find its ruler is him—the man she "killed" is now a vampire godfather. He traps her by his side, punishing her with hatred, binding her with a blood oath, until he discovers the truth: she never betrayed him. She left to save his life.
6aad031874dc6a0a85073c6d.title: At the Mercy of My Vampire Ex

6aad0b798f6a7e56ac09c191.synopsis: Tessa was supposed to be graduating college. Instead, she wakes up trapped inside Vampire Academy, a survival horror game where dying means never making it back to the real world. Her only advantage? A dating system that keeps ordering her straight into the arms of Nolan Grave, the deadliest vampire in the game. Kiss him. Bite him. Get into his bed. Every task keeps her alive. Every touch makes him hungrier. But when the other vampires come for her, Nolan is always the one who stops them. So what does he really want? To protect her? Or to make sure no one else gets a taste before he does?
6aad0b798f6a7e56ac09c191.title: Kiss the Vampire or Die

6aad0e71e01e8ab9e30dbdc4.synopsis: Caesar, the universe's strongest "Mechanical Man," honors a dying friend's wish by escorting Princess Shirley through deadly territory. Battling the Wild Grass Gang at every turn, he holds the line until reinforcements arrive—keeping his promise, and keeping the people he cares for safe.
6aad0e71e01e8ab9e30dbdc4.title: Space Cowboy's Royal Escort

6aad112d89bf7cfe830389ca.synopsis: Sonny, heir to a lineage of vampire hunters, accidentally awakens Victor—the Blood Lord imprisoned for 300 years—during a sacred sealing ritual on Holy Mountain. As family betrayal, past-life memories, and a conspiracy surrounding the "Holy Blood" unfold one by one, two men who were born to be mortal enemies fall in love again and join forces to overthrow a hunting order that has endured for three centuries.
6aad112d89bf7cfe830389ca.title: Bloodbound to You

6aae902a8b430d94100b20e5.synopsis: On her wedding day, Nova is publicly abandoned when her fiancé, Cole, recognizes Elara as his fated mate. Meanwhile, Alpha King Ronan is also left at the altar by Elara. The next day, Ronan arrives at Nova’s door with 108 chests of betrothal gifts and asks her to marry him. United by betrayal, Nova accepts his proposal and begins a new life as the Luna of the Draven royal family. As Cole desperately tries to win her back and Elara repeatedly schemes against her, Nova gradually discovers that Ronan did not choose her on impulse—he has secretly loved her for twenty years.
6aae902a8b430d94100b20e5.title: Rejected Luna is His Fated Mate

6aaf3a9dbe776ffafc04f5e7.synopsis: Saria, an abused village girl, is seized by Dragon King Alarik, whose touch triggers an unprecedented Mark binding them as mates. Alarik hides their bond behind a slave collar. Amid Xander's suspicion and Celeste's schemes, Saria survives a slave hunt and discovers she can bend dragon fire. Alarik reveals his death curse: one month to live. Xander exposes the Mark and attacks; Saria channels blue fire to destroy him. Their first kiss seals the bond, but Celeste offers silence at an unnamed cost.
6aaf3a9dbe776ffafc04f5e7.title: The Dragon King's Slave Mate

6aaf3aa4bdadc9280a004fa7.synopsis: Scholarship student Abbi is bullied by Felix at Camden Prep, yet poverty forces her into his home as live-in nanny. Hatred turns to desire: Felix confesses cruelty masked attraction; Abbi sees his protective side. But his abusive father Scott forbids romance on pain of dismissal. Braving blackmail, viral humiliation, and a rival's sabotage, they love in secret. Felix uses years of recorded abuse evidence to banish Scott, freeing them both. Abbi earns Oxford and Head Girl, enemies become lovers.
6aaf3aa4bdadc9280a004fa7.title: Nanny to the Boy Who Hates Me

6aaf3b3bf499ae4fe9071a07.synopsis: After being publicly rejected by her promised mate on her 18th birthday, bunny "defect" Snow finds herself at the mercy of the Falcon Kingdom that conquers her herd. Now she's trapped in the ordbit of the ruler she holds responsible for her mother's death, and losing a battle against the bond pulling her straight toward him.
6aaf3b3bf499ae4fe9071a07.title: Fated to the Cruel Falcon

6aaf3d86e270e34e33026b1b.synopsis: Pizza-shop worker Claire Bennett dies in a freak accident and wakes as Evelyn Voss, the F-rank Guide who tortured four elite Sentinels in an animated series. Adrian, Kane, Elias, and Silas all have reasons to kill her. To survive four predetermined death nodes, Claire must replace forced chips with consensual deep links, heal the men's mindscapes, and win their trust. Her attempt to change Evelyn's ending soon exposes a larger scheme: adopted sister Vivian is manufacturing Sentinel riots to mandate Voss control chips, while Silas's father Magnus wants Claire's four consciousness backups to control the Federation. Claire must save the men who hate her, expose the conspiracy she skipped in the original story, and prove that love built on choice can defeat a system built on fear.
6aaf3d86e270e34e33026b1b.title: I Woke Up as the Villainous Guide

6aaf40ddadec8186070b64eb.synopsis: Crown Princess Astrid is poisoned by her fiancé Erik and her closest confidant Silas on the eve of her coronation. Her soul bargains with the Norns, trading her human warmth for black magic and a second chance. Resurrected in the frozen north, she allies with Ragnar—the late king's illegitimate son and a savage warlord. She supplies strategy and sorcery; he supplies muscle and army. Disguised as a priestess, Astrid infiltrates the capital, using mind-reading and desire magic to drive Erik to public madness, turn Silas against himself, and make the love-obsessed Linnea raise the Mirror of Truth before the kingdom. Every spell drains her life and triggers an ice curse; only Ragnar's searing body heat can pull her back, forcing intimacy that ignites a taboo love. At the coronation, the Mirror exposes Erik and Silas's treason and murder. In the final battle, Astrid freezes herself to shatter the royal array. Ragnar cuts open his chest, pouring burning blood over her to melt the curse. They are crowned together, founding a dark empire of vengeance, fire, and an unbreakable bond.
6aaf40ddadec8186070b64eb.title: The Revenant’s Vow: Shattered Crown

6aaf466ac9a67ebbca0ba786.synopsis: Sylvia, heir to the Slin Group in Los Angeles, was abandoned by her three adopted brothers on her eighteenth coming-of-age ceremony, all because of lies spun by Mia, the housekeeper’s daughter. Overwhelmed by despair, she chanced upon Silas, a mysterious tycoon, in a bar and married him on impulse. Faced with betrayal from her adoptive brothers and Mia’s relentless schemes, Sylvia grows from a dependent girl into an independent woman. Protected by her husband Silas, she reclaims control of the group, makes the wrongdoers pay for their crimes, and ultimately gains a thriving career, true love, and reconciled family bonds.
6aaf466ac9a67ebbca0ba786.title: Jilted at the Altar, I Flash-Married a Mysterious Billionaire

6aaf4731567556b68702a229.synopsis: A broke single mother, Emma, sells her breast milk to Locke, the werewolf football captain, for one million dollars. He drinks it before games to suppress his berserk wolf bloodline. As their transaction deepens, Locke protects her from her abusive ex and jealous rivals. Emma moves into his estate, where nightly feedings blur the line between deal and desire. Locke tears up the contract, giving her freedom—but she chooses to stay. They become a family, bound not by money, but by love.
6aaf4731567556b68702a229.title: The football captain insists on drinking my breast milk

6aaf478c87526e1dea08542e.synopsis: Lena, who possesses extraordinary innate strength, saved Ryan, a framed heir to a financial conglomerate, five years ago. She left after unexpectedly giving birth to a pair of boy-and-girl twins. Five years later, to fend off forced marriage and the inheritance crisis from their families, the two enter into a contract marriage. Ryan has no idea that Lena is the savior he has been searching for for five years, nor that the twins are his biological children. They join forces to fight William, Ryan’s scheming uncle who covets the family fortune. With superior intelligence and unusual strength, the twins repeatedly help them out of dangers. After many twists and turns, the whole family is finally reunited.
6aaf478c87526e1dea08542e.title: My Twins Picked a Billionaire Dad

6aaf5144865374f888020127.synopsis: Four years ago, Elena was a 200-pound Omega girl who secretly loved Victor, the most admired Alpha at their werewolf academy. On graduation night, one room card and a cruel misunderstanding turned her first love into her deepest humiliation. She disappeared, changed her name to Lena, lost the weight, and raised their son alone. Now she's back as a team doctor for Victor's hockey team. He doesn't recognize her at first—but he can't stop watching her. Then her three-year-old son calls him “Dad.” As old bullies expose her past and the internet turns against her, Victor finally learns the truth: the woman he lost four years ago has been beside him all along.
6aaf5144865374f888020127.title: Slimmed Down, My Wolf Crush Recognized Me

6aaf52d36f4b58546800f727.synopsis: Brady, the legendary sharpshooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for longest confirmed kill then vanished from the public eye. He hid his identity, working as maintenance at a shooting range. He endures humiliation from the dismissive shooting club captain who's unaware of his true identity. The shooting range is facing a hostile takeover. In order to protect Denise, the owner, and her daughter Sophia, Brady steps up and shows his legendary shooting skills, drawing attention to his mysterious identity...
6aaf52d36f4b58546800f727.title: King of Guns

6aaf575be7862770da05312a.synopsis: One morning, Zoe wakes up with a strange new power: when she narrows her eyes, she can see the hidden stats of anything — objects, prices, and even people's secrets. Her best friend Tiffany's dazzling new boyfriend? The words above his head read: "A married man with $1 million in debt." Her own boyfriend Daniel, the sweet guy she's been splitting discount groceries with for three years? "Heir to a $150 million fortune." The catch: Daniel has no idea either. The treasure has been hiding in his late grandmother's locked room all along — antique desks, oil paintings, and gold bars buried under the floorboards. As Zoe and Daniel's life transforms overnight, Tiffany spirals from heartbreak to jealousy to sabotage, determined to take everything Zoe has — including Daniel. Turns out the hardest thing to appraise was never the antiques. It was the people.
6aaf575be7862770da05312a.title: Hidden Values

6aaf6c6449315e6453090bd9.synopsis: Caterina thought a proposal to marry the Duke's son, Felton, would save her poor family. But the night before her debut ball, her bed is pillaged by Augustus, who brands her with his crest. Dishonored overnight, Caterina heads to her debut, hoping Felton will claim her love. But her world spirals when she realizes the man who's laid claim to her is the wicked Duke, and her fiancé's father.
6aaf6c6449315e6453090bd9.title: Marked by My Duke Daddy

6aaf76be9884ddb0cc07604a.synopsis: Death chooses Leo and gives him the power to see it coming — a red number hangs over anyone with three days or less to live, counting down what they have left. He brushes it off, until a stranger with a zero over his head is killed in the street right in front of him. Then he boards a flight and finds a zero over every passenger on board. This plane is going down. He fights to stop the takeoff and the other passengers throw him off; only Anna believes him and walks off with him. The plane crashes. He was right about all of it.
6aaf76be9884ddb0cc07604a.title: I See the Death Countdown

6aaf9bcc7bfb882718056152.synopsis: Claire Hayes is left with nothing after her divorce from Preston Hollis. With nowhere else to turn, she takes a job as the contract wife of Rafael Moretti, the most feared Don in New York. His son, who refuses to speak to anyone, starts calling her Mom. Little by little, Rafael falls for her too. Preston comes crawling back—first begging, then threatening, then trying to have her killed. Too late. The woman he threw away is now Rafael's real wife and the Queen of the underworld.
6aaf9bcc7bfb882718056152.title: Divorced: Claimed by the Mafia King

6aafa0776f040c788f0e5593.synopsis: A fallen snowboarding prodigy, Kieran, now a forbearing physio, faces relentless bullying from an arrogant reigning champion Axel — unaware his nemesis has secretly obsessed over him for years. To force the ex-champ back to his peak, Axel orchestrates a high-stakes healing trap while hiding a fatal secret. Together, they conquer life and death, reclaim the summit, and achieve ultimate mutual redemption.
6aafa0776f040c788f0e5593.title: Bottom to Top, Ice on Fire

6aafa66280208b713c0e08c9.synopsis: In The Husband She Took for Granted movie, a gifted scientist gave up his career to be a stay-at-home husband and dad for his baby, only to find out his wife had an abortion to save her business partner. He finally files for divorce, and returns to science. His wife who's taken him for granted now regrets it all.
6aafa66280208b713c0e08c9.title: The Husband She Took for Granted

6aafa7fc530d47585a054f74.synopsis: The Story of The Triplets' Final Regret: In The Triplets' Final Regret movie, for ten years, Elisa Carter, a half-human and half-vampire girl loved and cared for the Lockhart triplets. She even wanted to become a full human and marry one of them. But when they brutally abandoned her for the maid's daughter—Amber, Elisa's heart was shattered, and she was stripped of her dignity. Hence, as Elisa turned eighteen, she transferred to night school and became a full vampire. She also found love with the elite and powerful vampire lord Caine Trueblood, which ultimately led to the ruin of the Lockhart triplets. Now, as the triplets return, begging for forgiveness, will Elisa Carter give them a second chance, or will she build a new life with the vampire lord? Characters: Elisa Carter Elisa Carter is the female protagonist of The Triplets' Final Regret movie. She was an orphan, a half-human and half-vampire girl who was adopted by the elite Lockhart family. But when her protectors—the Lockhart triplets—turned into her tormentors and abandoned her, she became a full vampire and moved to night school. The Lockhart Triplets Jacob, Oliver, and Nash are the elite Lockhart triplets and the male leads of The Triplets' Final Regret movie. They promised to protect Elisa forever, but when they fell for Amber's lies, they deeply hurt Elisa and abandoned her only to regret it all in the end. Caine Trueblood Caine Trueblood is Elisa Carter's love interest. He was the powerful vampire lord who commanded the elite Cross Academy. When Elisa Carter was abandoned by the Lockhart triplets, he took her under his wing and became her ultimate protector. Amber Jackson Amber Jackson is the antagonist of The Triplets' Final Regret movie. She was a maid's daughter who stole Elisa Carter's status by lies and malicious tricks. 6aafa7fc530d47585a054f74.title: The Triplets' Final Regret

6aafe6a0807f36ffca0c1225.synopsis: Elena, a wealthy merchant's daughter, spent her entire fortune to buy her husband Julian a baron title, only to endure his brutal abuse. To marry the Empire's Princess, Julian and his wicked mother conspire to frame Elena for adultery at the Holy Court and banish her to hard labor. To survive and seek revenge, Elena sets her sights on Julian's godfather—Duke Alistair, the most powerful man in the empire and Commander of the Knights Templar. Offering herself as the ultimate prize, she engages in a dangerous, taboo game of seduction with the cold-blooded Duke. Just as her mother-in-law drugs her and locks her in a room with a filthy beggar, with Julian and the Princess arriving to bust the door open and ruin her reputation, will the ruthless Godfather descend in time to save her...?
6aafe6a0807f36ffca0c1225.title: The Unchaste Charge:Plaything of My Husband's Godfather

6aaff98c9bcab205770fed07.synopsis: After three years on the front lines, Leon Bosch — a decorated war hero — finally returns home, only to walk into a nightmare. His fiancée Grace is seven months pregnant... with his own brother Jack's child. His family has carved up his property and savings, and he is even forced to serve as best man at their wedding. Refusing to stay silent, Leon exposes Jack's forged medical records at the ceremony, tearing off the family's mask of hypocrisy. But the real storm is just beginning — the truth emerges that Leon is no ordinary soldier. He is the War Master, an elite special-forces legend entrusted with a top national mission. At a military supply bidding banquet, Jack tries to climb to power with substandard weapons. Leon gambles with his own life, provoking Jack into firing a gun whose barrel explodes — exposing the defective-arms scandal on the spot. Jack's reputation crumbles as his crimes come to light. Just as Leon prepares to settle the final score with the family that betrayed him, Jack's hidden protector — Colonel Angelo — storms in. Corruption reaches the highest levels, and the former War Master must fight a new war: against the system itself. Can he turn the tables and reclaim everything they stole from him?
6aaff98c9bcab205770fed07.title: That Soldier You Betrayed Is The War Master

6ab00279b22e3e67590f8527.synopsis: The Kingdom of Silver Moon must send a princess to wed the King of the Wildlands. Two princesses, Maeve and Lila, draw lots to decide who will be married off to that barren land. Lila begs Maeve to go in her place. Then Maeve remembers her last life. She stayed — and married Asher, the general who had been her childhood sweetheart. Their marriage turned bitter, and they spent a lifetime hating each other. On the day the city fell, Asher died shielding her escape, and with his last breath he begged her to let him be with Lila. Maeve had spent a whole life and never won his heart. She threw herself from the cliff to follow him in death. Reborn, Maeve finally sees clearly: this time, she will give Asher and Lila her blessing.
6ab00279b22e3e67590f8527.title: Swapped Bride: Awakening of the True Princess

6ab090e57087873df908c6d9.synopsis: Tess is the only wolf in her pack who hasn't shifted — and if she doesn't figure it out by next week, she's out for good. Her only hope is Jaxon: her Alpha's son, her step-brother, her enemy. But the moment he's close, everything changes — her wolf stirs closer than ever, and the hatred she's clung to starts feeling like a lie. There's just one problem: pack law says a future Alpha can never take a wolfless mate.
6ab090e57087873df908c6d9.title: CLAIMED BY MY ALPHA STEPBROTHER

6ab0933d8ba05fe9750ac71c.synopsis: After his greedy girlfriend dumps him, Cole Preston awakens the LadyAid System and gains immense wealth by helping women. He rises from obscurity to become a hidden billionaire, building a vast empire and forming complicated relationships with powerful women. When his ex launches a smear campaign, Cole's allies expose her lies, leading to her arrest. With his enemies defeated, Cole reaches the pinnacle of wealth and power.
6ab0933d8ba05fe9750ac71c.title: LadyAid: From Dumped Pauper to Tycoon

6ab0966c2eac8bc8bb0d3e4d.synopsis: For Ava, Godfather Alexander’s Capone estate is the only safe place left in Hearing The Little Alpha’s Mind Saved My Life. At least, that’s what she believes as she desperately tries to stay inside. Beyond the estate, her husband has sent armed rogues after her, and every one of them is ready to tear her apart. When Ava first reaches the estate, wolf scratches cover her arms and legs, and she is bleeding badly. At first, Ava only hopes to find work as one of the maids. The job is far from easy. She is expected to tame Alexander’s cute but dangerous little pup, Leo. His raging bloodline can make him bite just about anyone—and anything—that gets too close. Something about Leo doesn’t make sense. Although he is dangerous around everyone else, he clings to Ava like a soft kitten. After she removes a nasty, sharp splinter from his mouth, she begins to discover what has really been happening to him. Through his thoughts, Leo tells Ava that his grandmother has been poisoning him. If Ava wants to earn her freedom, she must first find a way to cure the Young Master. Characters Ava Ava is the wolfless girl and main female character of Hearing The Little Alpha’s Mind Saved My Life. She possesses the unusual ability to hear Young Master Leo’s thoughts. Her connection with Leo catches Alexander’s attention and makes her the target of the Head Nanny’s jealousy. Alpha Alexander Alpha Alexander is the main male character and the feared King of the Black Werewolves. Other werewolves shiver at the sound of his name. He takes an interest in Ava after seeing how easily she can soothe Young Master Leo. Young Master Leo Young Master Leo is Alpha Alexander’s cute but dangerous little pup. His behavior is shaped by his raging bloodline and the mistreatment he suffers from his grandmother. Despite his aggression toward others, he quickly becomes attached to Ava. Head Nanny The Head Nanny is a minor villain in the series. She pretends to care for Young Master Leo while secretly conspiring with his grandmother. Ava’s growing connection with Leo also makes the Head Nanny jealous.
6ab0966c2eac8bc8bb0d3e4d.title: Hearing the Little Alpha's Mind Saved My Life

6ab0dd3efcd55b2fca0e84bd.synopsis: In Boston of 2049, after the Global Data Collapse wiped out massive digital archives, androids have woven themselves into human society. Alden Shaw, chief emotionalAI engineer at Wren Robotics, rescues prototype EL0 marked for disposal and labelled defective. He names him Elio. What begins as a technical rescue gradually blooms into a bond crossing the line between human and machine. Elio repeatedly breaks the Three Restrictions programmed into androids, developing jealousy, longing, possessiveness and selfsacrificing love. Drawn into corporate conspiracies, they uncover Gideon’s greed, Silas’ hidden agenda, and Julian’s unfinished hidden core. They are forced to confront one devastating question: is an android’s love merely code and command, or the genuine affection of a freewilled being?
6ab0dd3efcd55b2fca0e84bd.title: His Defective Robot Boyfriend

6ab0f1a2018580c9820e1475.synopsis: Five years ago, waitress Lily was framed by Vanessa. She accidentally had a one‑night stand with drugged tycoon Alexander. Afterwards, Vanessa cruelly blinded Lily, seized the keepsake and took her identity. Five years later, Lily’s biological son Leo took a job as a caddie for fake young master Ethan at the manor to raise money for his mother’s eye treatment. Within the estate, Leo endured constant bullying from Vanessa and her son, yet won the affection of the matriarch who held power in the family. During an accident, Leo saved the old lady from falling off a cliff. Vanessa shoved him off the mountainside out of malice, leaving him critically injured. Extremely rare golden‑blood type was urgently required for the rescue. Alexander rushed over to donate blood. The old lady secretly ordered a DNA test, which proved Leo was the true heir of the family. Sensing her scheme was about to be exposed, Vanessa tried to eliminate the mother and son. She framed them for theft and hired gangsters to chase them onto the rooftop of an abandoned factory with the intent to kill them. At the critical moment, Alexander and the old matriarch arrived on an armed helicopter and rescued Lily and her son.
6ab0f1a2018580c9820e1475.title: Stolen Identity: The Billionaire's True Bride

6ab0f32835b6b75a6d031850.synopsis: Chloe was tricked by her fiancé into attending a swinger party and accidentally entered the suite of his uncle Victor. After a night of indulgence, she was abandoned and humiliated by her fiancé, then forcibly possessed and imprisoned by Victor, reduced to a mere tool. After becoming pregnant, she suffered retaliation, was sold off, faked her death in a fire, and escaped. Three years later, she makes a glamorous return with her daughter. Victor embarks on a “wife-chasing crematorium,” and eventually the misunderstandings are cleared, culminating in a grand wedding and a happy ending for the family of three.
6ab0f32835b6b75a6d031850.title: The Swap Game: Claimed by His Uncle

6ab0f388752914e8e50fe57e.synopsis: Leonardo, the Ancient Dragon Lord, conceals his true identity and lives as a blacksmith in the royal city to protect his daughter Fiona. On her deathbed, his wife Sophia transforms into a dragon crystal, bidding him safeguard Fiona, whose dragon‑kind bloodline has yet to awaken. King Glen uncovers Leonardo’s real identity. Hoping to harness the dragon clan’s power, he arranges for Prince Adrian to marry Fiona, promising that Fiona will awaken her dragon inheritance at their wedding
6ab0f388752914e8e50fe57e.title: The Dragon Lord' Daughter

6ab0f9d1fa6d3a3e98004385.synopsis: My stepmother hung my son over a crocodile pit to force me to become a sacrifice for my sister. With my son’s life in her hands, I had no choice but to agree. Everyone thought I was as good as dead. But I came back alive—with a “husband” by my side. No one knew that this man was the Black Dragon himself. They sent me to the dragon as a sacrifice. So I turned the dragon into my husband. Now, it’s their turn to pay the price.
6ab0f9d1fa6d3a3e98004385.title: The Dragon King’s Secret Baby

6ab11e0af321a3292b05419b.synopsis: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty only to be betrayed and rejected by her lover Derek. It's time for Lia to get her revenge and claim her place as the Dragon Princess. But why won't anyone believe her?
6ab11e0af321a3292b05419b.title: Never Reject a Dragon Princess

6ab1dbdd57702faa710e1557.synopsis: Sophia finally marries Damien, the man she’s loved for ten years—only to have her dream marriage shattered by humiliation, betrayal, and his scheming assistant. Heartbroken, she walks away and transforms herself inside and out. Three months later, Sophia returns stunning, confident, and determined to live for herself. But just as she stops chasing Damien, her arrogant husband realizes he’s fallen for her—and now he’ll do anything to win his wife back.
6ab1dbdd57702faa710e1557.title: The Big Wife's Revenge: From Model to Queen

6ab1dc7e3d722d363b018ae7.synopsis: Cora chose a penniless beggar over the wealthy old merchant her family tried to force her to marry. What she never knew was that her new husband was Zeus—the all-powerful King of the Gods. When Frost Giants invade Mount Olympus, Zeus is forced to leave her behind. For seven long years, Cora raises their gifted twins alone while suffering relentless abuse from her cruel family. But when Cora and her children are branded as demons and sentenced to death, Zeus finally returns in a storm of thunder. As his true identity is revealed, everyone who humiliated his family will face the wrath of a god.
6ab1dc7e3d722d363b018ae7.title: Zeus Came Back for His True Love

6ab1e02e895cc75bc70e42e7.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a lavish party is underway inside a luxury estate.Alex, the estate's lowly maintenance worker, is publicly humiliated over a minor mistake by Victoria—the former president's daughter—and a group of wealthy socialites.Then the zombie outbreak begins.As the privileged guests become helpless prey, Alex discovers something impossible: the zombies will not attack him. Overnight, money, status, and power become meaningless.Armed with his survival instincts, combat skills, and a mysterious immunity, Alex rises from a humiliated worker to the leader of his own survivor base. The women who once looked down on him must now abandon their pride and trade skills, labor, and resources for the right to survive. But zombies are not the only danger in the new world.Ambitious survivors, traitors, ruthless mercenaries, and unknown forces hunting Alex's blood soon emerge. As the estate is repeatedly threatened by massive zombie hordes and brutal human conflicts, Alex becomes the one man everyone depends on.When the survivors finally set out for a rumored safe haven in Nevada, a mysterious transmission changes everything:“Possible complete antibody carrier identified.”“Capture the target alive.”The apocalypse has only just begun.
6ab1e02e895cc75bc70e42e7.title: King of the Dead

6ab1e1d70d218e897d0acbd8.synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus kills the Cyclops and is crowned King of Ithaca by Athena. Hiding his identity, he returns home to endure humiliation from his wife's family, who push her to marry the suitor Antinous. He proves himself despite his relics being destroyed, survives Antinous's frame job and kidnapping, and loses an ally to a life debt. At the coronation, he is exposed, kills Antinous with a rebounding arrow, and reclaims his throne and family.
6ab1e1d70d218e897d0acbd8.title: The Odyssey: A Warrior King's Homecoming

6ab1e304ed425041e6000c30.synopsis: Eighteen years ago, Leonardo Gambino ruled New York’s underworld. At eighteen, he took control. At thirty-three, he survived a brutal war that buried half his brothers. That night, he learned his wife was pregnant—and for the first time, he had something greater than power: a family. So he walked away. He divided his fortune, abandoned his legend, and vanished with his wife and closest friend. Under a new name, he opened a small bar in a quiet town and built an ordinary life. Eighteen years later, no one recognizes the former Godfather in the gentle bartender. To his seventeen-year-old daughter Sofia, he is just Dad—a harmless man shielding her from his dark past. Then Sofia becomes the target of vicious bullies. Terrified, she lies to protect the father she believes is only a bartender. Until Leonardo sees what they have done to her. Black cars arrive in the rain. Armed men emerge from shadows. Old soldiers bow before their Godfather. Luca stands at his side. And in the darkness, Dominic Gallo—believed dead—still lives. The Colombos think they have inherited his city. They are wrong. When the Gambino crest appears, Jack’s arrogance crumbles. When hundreds answer one call, Jacob—once Leonardo’s driver—realizes the truth: Leonardo did not disappear because he lost. He chose family over power. Now someone has hurt his daughter. Sofia watches in disbelief as her gentle father transforms. The bartender is gone. In his place stands the man who once made New York kneel. They have no idea they are touching the daughter of the Godfather. And when the man who made a city bow finally stops hiding—who will be left standing when his old name is spoken again?
6ab1e304ed425041e6000c30.title: Don's Back: No One Touches His Daughter

6ab1e3ac6e49794ab9083a4a.synopsis: In her past life, human princess Seraphina loved dragonslayer Cassian with obsessive fervor, forcing him to marry her—though his heart belonged to her younger sister. War erupted, the kingdom fell, and Cassian died pleading only to "never see her again." She perished in flames, vowing: *If given another chance, I will never cling to him again.Reborn on her wedding day, she makes a new choice—yielding Cassian to her sister and offering herself in marriage to the brutal Dragon King Vhaeros, to avert the coming war.Vhaeros intended to torture her to death as a pretext for battle, but her cold defiance on the torture stairs, her negotiations at death's door, and her kneeling to tend wounded dragon soldiers slowly melted his frozen heart.Meanwhile, Cassian realizes on the wedding day that it was Seraphina who went to the dragons—and past-life memories torment him. Awakening too late to his true love, he pursues her to the dragon realm, only to meet her icy farewell.As Seraphina and Vhaeros grow close, she uncovers the truth: the mark on his chest matches the young dragon she saved twelve years ago—at the cost of her own near-fatal wound, healed only by her mother's sacrificed life. She is the very one he has mourned for twelve years, building a shrine in her memory.Misunderstandings dissolve. Old enmity transforms into twelve years of destined redemption—two souls, reborn, finally saving each other.
6ab1e3ac6e49794ab9083a4a.title: I Married This Dragon King Instead of My Sister

6ab1e47548021082330aee9f.synopsis: Leo carries the pure bloodline of an ancient Sea God, but crippled his own legs to save his fiancée's father. On the eve of their wedding, Sophia and Arthur, the Papacy's Saint, drag him to a cliffside altar and drain his divine blood so Arthur can be baptized a Saint. Left for dead, Leo instead awakens a sleeping god-relic beneath the sea, reclaiming the Golden Trident and a body reforged in scaled armor. He returns in disguise, crushes Arthur's forged relic in the arena, and reveals his true god-form, forcing the Church to its knees. Allied with Elena, Grand Duchess of Winter, he hunts down three Sea God Hearts, exposes the Church's dark sacrifices to the Lord of the Abyss, and ultimately unleashes the wrath of the ocean to seal the rift and save the continent.
6ab1e47548021082330aee9f.title: Wrath of the Sea God

6ab1e4fdb35552a0c2028529.synopsis: In Dragonstone, the Valen bloodline guards the city. Every youth must pass the Dragonstone Resonance Trial to bond with a true dragon. Kael, the chieftain’s elder son, has no draconic resonance at all. Branded a failure, he is stripped of his succession and family crest by his father Roland, then cast out. In Dragonveil Valley, Kael meets Dramor—a dusty silver hatchling also deemed worthless. When dragon hunters ambush them, boy and dragon forge a flawless bond amid certain death. Dramor awakens molten crimson-gold fire; seven elemental runes bloom on Kael’s wrist. They vow to hide their power and reclaim everything at the Valen Grand Tournament in seven days. They train in an abandoned quarry, slaying a full-grown rock-armor grizzly. Whispers of a mysterious fire dragon knight spread. Dramor devours a monster core and matures rapidly, but exposes their trail. Pursued, they plunge into Twin Peaks Gorge—and their pact’s sacred fire becomes enormous wings, carrying them to the open sea. Disguised as a weak, non-aligned pair, they enter the clan tournament. Kael overpowers a wind dragon wielder, then defeats a lightning dragon pair with Dramor. In the final match, Dramor’s fire is drained; wounded, he shields Kael. Kael realizes he fights not just for birthright—but for his dearest companion. The second pact rune awakens, unleashing lightning and flame. Boy and dragon fuse into a new Thunderfire form.
6ab1e4fdb35552a0c2028529.title: No Dragon Chose Him—So He Chose the Dragon God

6ab1e506d70c17e43b09791f.synopsis: Five years ago, Grace saved NovaMind’s data in a server-room fire, suffering severe burns. Her parents died transporting the backup. Though she owns 51% of NovaMind, she stays out of the spotlight. Secretly married to Ethan, she hides her scars with gloves and endures his affair with assistant Sunny. Sunny and Ethan already have a daughter, Lily, and Sunny is pregnant again. They plot to seize Grace’s assets, backed by Marcellus—the true mastermind behind the fire. Grace carries a fallen flame-angel bloodline, marked by a golden symbol on her wrist. Andrew, her father’s friend and an Alpha with moon-wolf blood, has loved her for years but kept away due to family ties and age difference. He returns to protect her as she awakens her powers. Together they gather evidence, expose the conspiracy, and confront the Hale family’s traitors. At a lakeside under the full moon, they complete a ritual binding their bloodlines. United, they defeat their enemies. Grace reclaims NovaMind, engraves her father’s name on a company landmark, and steps forward with Andrew to lead their future together.
6ab1e506d70c17e43b09791f.title: Invisible Wife,Tragic Fallen Angel

6ab205093b21ae6ba206d819.synopsis: Three years ago, Marine Raine Winters died saving Captain Kane Thorne in the Middle East. His last wish: return to New York, marry my sister Isabella, and protect her forever. Kane arrives in New York—foul-mouthed, sloppy, hiding twenty-seven shrapnel wounds and twenty-plus black-ops missions. He expects to be a bodyguard for a CEO. Instead, he finds Isabella Winters, young head of Winters Group, fighting for her life. Her revolutionary anti-cancer project, “Golden Apple,” threatens the medical giant Caesar Group. Zachary Caesar wants the data, the company, and Isabella—using forced marriage, bribes, moles, assassins, snipers, and bombs. But Kane isn’t an ordinary bodyguard. He clears assassins bare-handed, bends titanium clubs, and makes the Iron Fist Gang kneel. As Isabella falls for him, so do FBI agent Erin, former mole Liana, mercenary Raven, and Wall Street queen Vivian. Victor Caesar strikes personally—Kane crushes him, Vivian bans Caesar on Wall Street, and the empire collapses. Zachary kidnaps three women, injects a neural enhancer, and demands Kane’s life. Raven defects. Kane still wins. The Caesars fall. But Isabella, Erin, Liana, Raven, and Vivian won’t let him walk away.
6ab205093b21ae6ba206d819.title: The Super Soldier of the Stunning Female CEO

6ab21030213827243c039eab.synopsis: On Tidewater Station, dockhand Cole Andrews keeps his head down, takes the abuse, and raises his daughter alone. But when a rigged debt puts fifteen-year-old Kira in the fight ring, the station starts asking who her father really is - and so does the Syndicate that has spent fifteen years hunting a dead man.
6ab21030213827243c039eab.title: Don't Wake the Dead Man

6ab214222bbdc12d830988f9.synopsis: Hunter Elias has hunted the vampire Lorian for three hundred years, convinced he is the one who killed his parents. In a fatal ambush, Elias — the ace hunter — is forced to form a desperate alliance with Lorian, the vampire noble. As they trace the conspiracy, he tears open the cruelest truth: his adoptive father Stone, the guild director whom he revered for half his life and who raised him, not only colluded with the vampire progenitor to launch the human-experiment "Project Zero," but is the true culprit who killed his father with his own hands and destroyed his family! The false upbringing was a scheme long in the making. Racial hostility, a blood feud, and forbidden love intertwine layer upon layer, as two mighty rivals join forces to break the deadlock, defy fate, take their revenge, tear apart the hypocritical mask, and guard the one redemption and the road home.
6ab214222bbdc12d830988f9.title: Bloodline Paradox: Silver and Shadows

6ab2155e9df6bcab89056d99.synopsis: Audrey, of pure wolf-god blood, was framed in her past life by her scheming foster sister Morgana and the Wolf King Silas. Her newborn divine heir was killed, and she was branded a disaster to the clan and died cruelly as a sacrifice on the altar. Upon her rebirth, Audrey returns to the bloodline ceremony, and carrying the memories of her past life, she counterattacks step by step — tearing apart her hypocritical sister and standing firm against the biased Wolf King. To prove her innocence and bear the divine heir, she ventures alone into the Forbidden Forest, where she meets Fenrir, the ancient wolf god living in seclusion. The two form a bond, and on the day of birth, Audrey delivers a black-furred divine heir bearing the supreme god-blood. When Morgana's venomous schemes strike again, Fenrir emerges to save his wife and daughter, shaking the entire clan — and together, husband and wife will take their revenge!
6ab2155e9df6bcab89056d99.title: Oh my god—I'm carrying the Wolf God's pup!

6ab21823b1f659cce405a239.synopsis: In a world ruled by shifters, humans are rare and treated as prizes to be bought and bred. Owen wakes up tied to a bed, purchased like property. Then a System binds to him: sex with woman shifters makes him stronger. Soon Owen isn't anyone's pet. He's a noble, a husband, a conqueror. But as his power rises, so do his enemies. To survive, Owen must bed more beauties, grow his harem, and claim his place at the top of a world that once caged him.
6ab21823b1f659cce405a239.title: Bedded and Buffed: Claiming My Shifter Harem

6ab23b8542c0f756180f663f.synopsis: In the noble matriarchal magic family of Valerius, baby Ella is born with the supreme Pure Gold Bloodline, destined to be queen. But her jealous aunt Morgan bribes a priest to brand her a clan-destroying curse. The cold grandmother orders a fire execution. As her parents, Duchess Octavia and Edmund, watch in despair, Bram—a “foolish” janitor despised by all—rushes into the flames and saves her with scorched hands. Ella’s supreme magic is sealed by a dark curse; her identity pendant becomes a charred lump. Six years later, powerless Ella is the lowest “magic-less trash” at the Magic Academy, surviving with her foolish adoptive father. Fate is cruel: her biological brother Julian brutally beats her; Duchess Octavia, longing for her dead daughter, smashes the dirty child against the sacred blood-testing stone. The stone flashes gold but is extinguished by the seal. Enraged, Octavia silently allows Julian to kill; Bram is severed in the spine protecting Ella. To earn one gold coin for medicine, 8-year-old Ella endures humiliation and jumps into a freezing ice lake. The icy water cleans the Star Pendant, revealing its faint blue glow. Climbing ashore, she runs into the Duchess—who stares at the pendant, stunned. When the supreme Pure Gold magic finally breaks the seal and shakes the empire, the truth will tear open the ducal family’s bloody lies. They will fall into eternal regret. And Ella, holding her foolish father’s hand, has only coldness and unforgiveness for those “blood relatives” who kneel and weep.
6ab23b8542c0f756180f663f.title: Mistaking My Daughter For Trash

6ab23bf894d95228650555cc.synopsis: Born with noble blood yet cursed with damaged magic, Elysia is cruelly betrayed by her sworn protectors—childhood friends Arthur and Leo. For the sake of a hypocritical, vicious maid named Lillian, the two brothers not only sever the Bonding Tree and break her pet's wings, but also force her to strip off her warming robe and drive her, dying, into a raging storm. In her darkest moment, Lucas, the mightiest Dragon Prince of the continent, descends like a god, rescuing her from hell with a "Sacred Marriage Contract" and taking her back to his castle for ultimate devotion. When the childhood brothers accidentally unlock a Memory Crystal and witness the maid stealing dragon eggs and pushing Elysia into the Abyss Lake, their faith collapses. They go mad, stripping the maid of her magic, kneeling in the mud, weeping blood and begging. Even at the grand wedding, they take a poisoned blade for Elysia, leaving them permanently disabled, just for a single glance. But late devotion is cheaper than weeds. Elysia turns away coldly, awakening her magic at the altar and carrying the dragon heir, kissing and being crowned with the domineering prince under the stars—leaving the blinded brothers to chew on endless regret in their wheelchairs for the rest of their
6ab23bf894d95228650555cc.title: The Forsaken Moon

6ab24803ee19872d9b02ea3d.synopsis: Will Quinn, the legendary world-class magician, is assassinated mid-publicperformance. His soul travels across time and awakens inside Noah, a bulliedten-year-old illegitimate son of the powerful Blackwood noble family. Retaining all ofhis peerless magic skills from his past life, Noah steps forward during a high-stakesmagic duel for the sacred Phantom Stage against the hostile Graves family. To unmask the masterminds behind his murder, he pretends to be Will Quinn's secret apprentice and issues a public challenge to all top-ranked magicians at theGlobal Magic Championship. The fake "God of Magic" Cassian Frost and the corrupt Council of Magicians take the bait one after another. Drawing on his intimate knowledge of magic mechanisms, Noah dismantles deadlytraps and uncovers the dark truth: the Council ordered his assassination becausethey feared his unyielding independence. He defeats the evil cabal, exposes theircrimes, and reclaims his rightful glory. He reminds the whole world that true magic belongs to everyone who still believes in miracles.
6ab24803ee19872d9b02ea3d.title: Reborn at 10 The World's Greatest Magician

6ab248c64dc48c013b069415.synopsis: "Out of Prison, I Rule Vegas" is a fast-paced urban drama set in the high-stakes world of Las Vegas casinos. Once the legendary "God of Gamblers," Victor emerges from prison to find his seven-year-old daughter Mia gravely ill and desperate for treatment money. With just ten dollars to his name, Victor returns to the casino—armed with extraordinary hearing, a razor-sharp memory, elite card-counting skills, and masterful psychological instincts. Rising from a mocked ex-con to a legendary gambler, he sends shockwaves through the city. But as stakes escalate, Victor must confront his ex-wife Sarah's distrust, Chris's schemes, a cheating casino manager, and the underground empire of Mr. X. Forced into a deadly showdown with Leo—an impostor claiming to be the heir to the "God of Gamblers"—Victor fights not for glory, but for his daughter's life. Through nonstop twists, extreme high-stakes games, shocking reveals, and ruthless revenge, Victor delivers a thrilling comeback with breakneck pacing and powerful emotion.
6ab248c64dc48c013b069415.title: Out of Prison, I Rule Vegas

6ab32cfcf20879dc290f9f99.synopsis: Luna dies after Ronan and Sophia’s betrayal costs her son his life. Given a second chance, she returns to the night the babies were switched and turns their scheme against them. Twenty years later, Sophia sacrifices her own son to protect the heir, pushing Lucas toward the truth.
6ab32cfcf20879dc290f9f99.title: The Luna Swap

6ab32d5b144ab8635400e759.synopsis: After three years of secret Alpha training, Aria Sterling returns to find her mother enslaved, her birthright stolen, and an impostor family ruling her pack. To reclaim the Sterling throne, she must break a silver curse, expose a forged bloodline, and reveal that the mighty Aether Guild answers to her.
6ab32d5b144ab8635400e759.title: Alpha Heiress Reclaims Her Pack

6ab32ed159fe702cf703f2fb.synopsis: After ending her suffocating seven-year marriage, Eleanor Sullivan starts over with her daughter. Once a math prodigy, she returns to her passion and enters the ALI Math Competition. Despite her ex-husband's doubts and outside criticism, she rises to the top in the preliminaries. With ace lawyer Jared Caldwell by her side, she finds her confidence—and a whole new life.
6ab32ed159fe702cf703f2fb.title: He Fell for the New Me

6ab33143194f80d99c01fa0b.synopsis: One year after the apocalypse broke out, Caleb, a once‑written‑off young man, and his sister Maya, who has endured hunger to survive for his sake, hide in a fragile sanctuary. Sealed inside Caleb is the Dominator Gene left to them by their parents on their deathbed — a dormant mutant power that, once unleashed, can never be re‑contained. As the sanctuary’s captain of the guard, Maya shoulders every burden, even willing to starve herself to keep her brother’s power from erupting. Yet the sanctuary is far from safe. Its administrator Vance has long colluded with the Blood‑Tribute Legion, an outside slave army backed by Red Umbrella Biotech, plotting to betray the entire haven to them. When Holt, the Blood‑Tribute’s raid commander, leads his men to slaughter the sanctuary and publicly humiliates Maya, Caleb’s slumbering power finally awakens, triggered by the harm done to his own blood. No longer the bullied weakling, he rises as the Zombie King. He can command hordes of undead to kneel from a hundred meters away, catch rocket‑propelled grenades bare‑handed, and raise the dead to fight for him. His true foes, however, are neither Holt nor Jonah Kessler, the mastermind behind Red Umbrella. The real enemy is the Emperor, the hidden ruler pulling all the strings of the Blood‑Tribute Legion. What begins as vengeance born within one sanctuary soon ignites a war for power that sweeps across the entire wasteland.
6ab33143194f80d99c01fa0b.title: Apocalypse Siege: King of the Awakened

6ab331fbf2310964420250aa.synopsis: Eleanor Sterling is the true controller of the Sterling Family Trust. Her husband, Alexander Vance, teams up with her best friend Sophia Bennett to fake amnesia, tricking her into signing divorce papers in a bid to seize her entire fortune. Having seen through their scheme long before, Eleanor completes the legal divestment of all high‑value assets prior to the divorce, leaving Vance Group as an empty shell saddled with $1.1 billion in environmental liabilities. On the very day after the divorce when Alexander and Sophia take over the company, the EPA issues an indefinite shutdown order together with massive fines. The pair fall from grace overnight. Alexander tries to sell off assets to pay the debts, only to find all his real‑estate holdings frozen. Sophia steals his remaining cash and flees to Harrison Sweet, a ruthless Wall Street tycoon, only to be cast aside by him. Consumed by despair, the two turn on each other. After being imprisoned, Alexander stages a jailbreak. He eventually takes Eleanor hostage on a rooftop but is subdued, and later dies from a gastric perforation. Eleanor reclaims her mother’s inheritance and founds Sterling Group. She redevelops the polluted Brooklyn site into a green creative district, closing the chapter on her revenge while achieving personal reinvention and embracing her authentic self.
6ab331fbf2310964420250aa.title: Her Last Laugh

6ab33273eb36cab19f067a7a.synopsis: Former top assassin “Crescent Moon” Elena Sterling retires to live a normal life. On her wedding day, she discovers her fiancé and best friend’s betrayal. Her adoptive brother Lucas drugs her and sells her to a brutal underground death-match arena. Saved by underworld godfather Dominic Rossi, who has searched for her for 15 years—ever since she saved his life in childhood—Elena signs a six-month fake fiancée contract with him. In return, Dominic helps her take revenge and uncover the truth of the Nightshade assassin camp’s fall. Cold and guarded at first, Elena gradually falls for Dominic’s silent protection. When their enemy Bianca attacks, Dominic takes a deadly poisoned bolt for her. Forged documents later separate them, misleading Elena into believing his family killed her people. After exposing the mole and clearing misunderstandings, they learn Elena is the sole survivor of the destroyed Sterling noble family, fallen to a criminal alliance’s plot. The couple defeats all enemies and regains Elena’s inheritance. Dominic abandons his power, tears up the contract, and gives Elena a real lifelong promise. They leave the violent underworld behind, start a new life abroad, and welcome their child—two broken souls finally finding true, equal love.
6ab33273eb36cab19f067a7a.title: Lethal Vows：Married to My Rival

6ab332d3c6d934532a02380c.synopsis: Kyle is an abandoned half‑dragon outcast living in a human town. After his adoptive father Arthur is killed by the lord’s guards, he flees and forms a soul‑bond with the young dragon Aurelia, gaining the Crimson Dragon Gauntlet. Along his journey, he rescues the wolf‑kin girl Luna, who can transform into Shadow Twin‑Blades; the wind‑spirit Seraphina, who can turn into a Storm Longbow; and recruits the phantom fox Vex, who takes the form of a Psionic Diadem. He founds the Dawnbreaker Army to fight against the Holy Inquisition of mankind. Marco, the Grand Inquisitor‑Knight Commander of the Inquisition, leads troops to hunt him down. At Despair Canyon, Kyle repels an army of thirty‑thousand with his four‑fold armament.
6ab332d3c6d934532a02380c.title: Dragon blood Uprising

6ab335709a52d1898e0f969e.synopsis: Brenton is the trueborn heir to the Dragon Throne. When his bastard brother, Devlin, crashes a dragon into the castle, killing the King, Brenton takes the fall to protect Devlin, but Devlin arranges for a harsher sentence for Brenton, killing him with dragonfire. However, instead of dying, Brenton is sent a few months into the past. Now that Brenton knows Devlin's true nature, he resolves to take control and get revenge.
6ab335709a52d1898e0f969e.title: Reborn to be the Dragon King

6ab33610ae7501f30b0068ac.synopsis: Human med student Elena secretly raises Kate, her half-wolf daughter, from a one-night bond with Alpha Alex. Needing rare medicine Lunarid, she finds Alex, who recognizes her by scent and bite mark. Kate is kidnapped, Alex discovers she is his daughter, and Elena moves into the pack estate. She survives Nyx's cruelty, becomes Luna, breaks Alex's curse through true love, and exposes Nyx's sabotage of a bloodline test. Mrs. Volkov accepts the family. Alex proposes, and they marry as one.
6ab33610ae7501f30b0068ac.title: Hunted by the Alpha

6ab34a843087e011030699de.synopsis: For seven years, Cecilia — a half-blood born between a powerful mage and an ordinary human — lived as nothing more than a servant in the prestigious Leon family. Married to Leon, the heir of a legendary magical bloodline, she was never treated as a wife. Instead, she was forced to brew potions, serve his family, and endure endless humiliation. Then her half-sister Lilian entered her marriage pretending to be the helpless victim. Little by little, she stole Leon’s affection — and even turned Cecilia’s own daughter against her. But everything changed the day Cecilia signed the divorce papers. The “dead egg” everyone mocked for years finally cracked open. Inside was not a worthless spirit, but Loki — the ancient Dragon Lord who had waited 600 years for her return. He gave her the legendary ring that commanded the entire dragon clan. More importantly, he gave her what she had never received before: respect, protection, and the power to choose her own destiny. Reborn as Luna Sera, a once-in-a-generation magical genius, Cecilia returns to the magical world. The people who once looked down on her are now forced to kneel before her. Only then does Leon realize the truth: The woman he abandoned was never beneath him. She was someone he could never reach. Desperate to win her back, Leon kneels and offers her the wedding ring. But Cecilia only smiles coldly. “Your love is something I no longer need.” And she walks away with Loki — the man who shares her soul, her destiny, and a bond that will last beyond life and death.
6ab34a843087e011030699de.title: Dumped by My Ex, Chosen by the Dragon King

6ab37198011591995402da38.synopsis: In School for Bad Boys movie, after being sent to Maplewood Reform School—a last stop before prison for the problem sons of wealthy families—openly gay teen Cody Calloway is NOT welcome. After all, the first rule of Maplewood is clear: any homosexual activity earns an immediate expulsion. Enter Beckett Hayes, the school's straight golden boy with a girlfriend, a dark past, and a growing obsession with Cody. Every stolen touch puts their freedom on the line…but some things are worth the risk.
6ab37198011591995402da38.title: The School for Bad Boys

6ab3852676234689d7078281.synopsis: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress* tells the story of Aurora Vance. On her third‑wedding anniversary, she is publicly abandoned and left penniless by her husband Marcus. In despair, she makes a contract‑marriage deal with wealthy heir Ryan Winslow. Meanwhile, she finds her true identity and takes back the Vance Group. They dig out the truth, bring mastermind Victor Kane to justice. After fierce struggles, the contract turns into genuine love. Aurora achieves self‑redemption and marries Ryan.
6ab3852676234689d7078281.title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress

6ab3852b3150acd59f00280f.synopsis: In her past life, she donated bone marrow to her father, but died full of resentment after being tormented by his family. Reborn right before the marrow match, she gives up on seeking his love and escapes the family. As she skyrockets to fame through her incredible acting, he finally learns the truth and is consumed by regret.
6ab3852b3150acd59f00280f.title: Daddy's Regret Comes Too Late

6ab386c65ea428ef3e0c0666.synopsis: Princess Mira of the Silver Moon Kingdom was rescued from the ruins of war by the royal family as a child and raised under their constant protection for seventeen years. However, when Serla—who claimed to be her "biological sister" —returned to the royal household, everything changed: her family began to neglect her, misunderstood her, and even repeatedly pushed her toward the abyss. On the surface, Serla appeared gentle and kind; beneath this facade, however, she was ruthless and cruel—she stole Mira's music box, her evening gown, and her room, and even framed and accused her, leaving her three elder brothers and parents utterly disillusioned with Mira. Mira endured all of this in silence, secretly entering into a covenant with the Dragon Clan—sacrificing herself in exchange for a century of peace for the kingdom—and exchanging her heart for that of her second brother, Solin, who suffered from cardiac disease. On her 18th birthday, her family expelled her from the royal palace due to Serla's lies. Without offering any defense, Mira walked alone toward the altar and was consumed by flames, vanishing into nothingness. Only when the truth was finally revealed did her family, consumed by endless remorse, forever lose the girl who truly loved them.
6ab386c65ea428ef3e0c0666.title: After I was sacrificed to the evil dragon, my brothers regretted it

6ab38779c694944c590230f4.synopsis: Emily, the biological daughter of the Foster family, returns after an eighteen-year absence to find Lily, an imposter, has taken her place. Outwardly sweet, Lily secretly works with her accomplice Jack. She forges DNA reports, spreads rumors, and plants false evidence to frame Emily, manipulating adoptive parents Richard and Catherine into turning against their real daughter. Emily is misunderstood, locked in a storage room, and nearly driven out. Refusing to surrender, Emily teams up with allies James and Tony. They uncover that private detective Victor was bribed by Lily to feed false leads. Tracking down Lily’s birth mother Diana, they expose a long-buried paid identity swap. Lily’s illegal adoption is voided. Desperate, Lily bribes Victor to tamper with Richard’s heart medication, intending to murder him and seize the fortune. The plot is exposed with witnesses and evidence. Lily breaks down and pays for eighteen years of greed. Emily clears her name, reclaims her identity, and transforms herself in the battle over who truly belongs.
6ab38779c694944c590230f4.title: The Heiress Returns Playing the Game

6ab392059db6f3a57a070ae9.synopsis: Malik Carter grew up dirt poor, training on a cracked outdoor court while his single mother worked three jobs to keep him fed—until an NBA scout secretly makes him the number one draft pick. But a month of sealed pre-draft testing leaves him unreachable, and his hometown decides the worst: that he's been arrested for prostitution. His own uncle, aunt, and cousin turn the whole church against him and his mother, stripping them of dignity, stealing from them, and even scalding her hand to punish his "lies." When the truth finally breaks, every person who spat on his family scrambles to grovel—but Malik's fight isn't over. At his own rookie celebration, the father who abandoned his pregnant mother years ago shows up flaunting a new wife and a stepson chasing the same spotlight. As the draft countdown hits zero, everyone who ever doubted, humiliated, or betrayed Malik and his mother is about to learn exactly who they were dealing with.
6ab392059db6f3a57a070ae9.title: Number One, Nobody

6ab397e13282a14d03058cf7.synopsis: In the beastkin world, Toby (a rabbit whose impending marriage was called off) is forced into an arranged marriage with Enzo (the Wolf King and adoptive father of his former fiancée) following an unexpected one-night stand. Humiliated again and again by his ex and her family, Toby is saved by Enzo through crisis after crisis, and what begins as forced dependence slowly turns into helpless devotion — sparking a dangerous, forbidden romance defined by an extreme emotional tension.
6ab397e13282a14d03058cf7.title: The Alpha's Forbidden Bunny

6ab39949ec17d073650d5236.synopsis: Maeve is neglected and abused by her parents while her sister Bianca is adored. Bianca frames her, steals her allowance, and forges a letter selling Maeve to a rogue Alpha. Maeve escapes death, is rescued by Enforcer Adler, and rebuilds her life. She testifies against Harlan Briggs, transfers to a new Pack, and earns a place at Highspire Academy. When her parents beg forgiveness, she cuts all ties. Bianca is arrested. Maeve becomes the youngest Chief Enforcer, finds her fated mate Cassian, and builds a loving family.
6ab39949ec17d073650d5236.title: The Black Wolf They Cast Aside

6ab3a84d5d7b4f9772012c7e.synopsis: Lana Samuel, the biological daughter, was banished to the countryside for 18 years over a misunderstanding about her appearance. Meanwhile, the adopted daughter, Bria Samuel, received all the family's love. When Lana returns home as the top scholar, her three brothers despise and mistreat her. But the tables turn when they realize Lana is the girl they have been searching for. Refusing to wallow in self-pity, Lana leverages her stellar grades to pursue a future in scientific research, leaving her guilt-ridden brothers in deep regrets.
6ab3a84d5d7b4f9772012c7e.title: The Comeback Heiress

6ab3b0f68eb57767b80f5732.synopsis: Claire, an ordinary waitress, happens to rescue a little girl named Ava who has been hurt. Billionaire Lucas, seeking to comfort his traumatized daughter, signs a six-month contract marriage with Claire. Entering the lavish Grant estate, Claire heals Ava and also changes the cold, distant Lucas. Facing the family's hostility, the exposure of the contract, and one conspiracy after another, the three break through the shackles of money and blood ties — proving that a true family is made of people who choose one another willingly.
6ab3b0f68eb57767b80f5732.title: The Billionaire’s Daughter Chose Me to Be Her Mommy

6ab3b1316174855ed506e6e6.synopsis: Second Chance at Life is a 25-episode female-growth and comeback drama. Avery Ross spends eighteen years as Caleb Bennett’s safety net—fixing his assignments, covering his mistakes, sacrificing her own chances, and believing it was friendship. Then, at the freshman talent show, Caleb holds her down so Bailey can cut off her hair, all to prove his loyalty to a cooler crowd. The whole auditorium laughs. He laughs loudest. That night, Avery wakes up. She withdraws from college, returns home, takes a gap year, and rebuilds her life from zero—SAT 1590, Columbia University. Meanwhile, without Avery to clean up his messes, Caleb is discarded by Bailey, expelled, and watches the Bennett family collapse. Along the way, Avery meets Lucas, an MIT-bound top student, and learns a love built on equality, respect, and mutual growth. In the end, she is no one’s sidekick and no one’s sacrifice—she is the lead of her own life.
6ab3b1316174855ed506e6e6.title: Second Chance at Life

6ab3b5adb0a5c3756705d7d1.synopsis: After being forced to stay on campus during winter break, Eric Tully and his fellow college classmates find themselves trapped by one of the worst blizzards in recorded history. With the campus completely cut off from the outside world, the students soon realize they are not alone. A mysterious stranger wearing a mask made entirely of ice has begun stalking the frozen campus, picking them off one by one. As the body count rises, Eric and the remaining students desperately search for a way to survive the night while trying to uncover the identity of the masked killer known only as The Ice Man. But when the survivors begin uncovering clues connecting the murders to a dark secret some of them have been hiding, it becomes clear that the killings may not be random. The Ice Man knows what they did, and he intends to make them pay. With the blizzard showing no signs of stopping and escape becoming impossible, Eric and his friends must confront the truth about their shared past before The Ice Man hunts them all down. To survive, they will have to determine who among them is truly his target—and why.
6ab3b5adb0a5c3756705d7d1.title: The Ice Man

6ab3ba913eb244b17d031ed1.synopsis: In Sexting My Pucking Nemesis, Ethan Miller may be a nerd, but he’s also the hockey player his teammates would rather avoid. He has never been good at respecting boundaries. Then he does the one thing his captain hates most: he publicly asks out Captain Hunter Kennedy’s younger sister, Hayley. For Hunter, few things could be more infuriating than watching the man he secretly wants chase after his sister. When he realizes Hayley plans to answer Ethan’s message, Hunter confiscates her phone. Ethan, using the username “Bad Boy,” sends Hayley a sexy text in the hope of winning her heart. What Ethan doesn’t know is that Hunter is the one answering those messages. Pretending to be Hayley, Hunter plays along with Ethan’s provocative texts and soon gets carried away. What begins as a trick turns into a private sexting relationship with Ethan—except Ethan has no idea who is really on the other side. As more people become involved, keeping the secret becomes harder. Can Hunter, Ethan’s biggest bully and hockey captain, pull him away from Hayley? Or will Ethan keep chasing the girl he thinks he wants without ever discovering who has truly captured his attention? Characters Ethan Miller Ethan Miller is a hockey player who loves learning and serves as one of the main male characters. He believes he’s straight and has his eyes on Hayley. Without realizing it, however, he ends up sexting her older brother—who also happens to be his nemesis. Hunter Kennedy Hunter Kennedy is the good-looking hockey captain and the second main male character. He is Hayley’s protective older brother and Ethan’s biggest bully. Beneath their rivalry, Hunter has had his eye on Ethan for a long time. Hayley Kennedy Hayley Kennedy is a supporting character and Ethan’s original love interest. She has a reputation for acting out of reach and is often accompanied by two other cheerleaders. Her phone unknowingly becomes the starting point of Ethan and Hunter’s secret connection. Trent Trent is the villain who considers himself Hunter’s best friend. He reacts badly when rumors and scandals involving Hunter and Ethan begin to surface. Their growing connection threatens the place Trent believes he holds in Hunter’s life.
6ab3ba913eb244b17d031ed1.title: Sexting My Pucking Nemesis

6ab3cafad3dcc6d3860bae2a.synopsis: Maya Bennett’s life disappears overnight. Her coworkers don’t recognize her, her records are gone, and another woman is already living under her name. Searching for answers leads her to SECOND LIFE, a mysterious organization tied to vanished identities and stolen lives. But the deeper she digs, the more terrifying the truth becomes: what if Maya Bennett’s life was never hers to begin with?
6ab3cafad3dcc6d3860bae2a.title: My Name Is Not Maya

6ab3cc6204c812d3fe03b9c5.synopsis: Seraphina, the hidden pureblood heir of House Vale, returns to fulfill an arranged marriage, only to be publicly humiliated and scarred with poisoned silver by her fiancé Damian and his vile foster sister.
