Unbeknownst to them, Damian’s family owes their entire empire to Seraphina’s mother, who arrives with crushing dominance. Scarring the wicked woman in return, Seraphina forces the toxic pair into an unbreakable, eternal blood oath—dooming them to torment each other until they turn to ash.
6ab3cc6204c812d3fe03b9c5.title: The Last Daughter of House Vale

6ab3cc6bccf5221f6c029385.synopsis: On the day Taylor's Columbia acceptance arrives, she secretly flies to New York to surprise her boyfriend Ethan and best friend Lexi. Instead, she overhears them confess: to grant Lexi's birthday wish, they secretly altered Taylor's application, making her miss the deadline and lose her spot. They've been dating behind her back for a year. Ethan promises Lexi he'll stay hers until fall, then return to being Taylor's boyfriend. Taylor stands outside, holding cupcakes and sunflowers, realizing her entire life was built on their betrayal.
6ab3cc6bccf5221f6c029385.title: Forward, Without Him

6ab3ceb983ec64ca37028217.synopsis: Four years ago, to defend their homeland, Michael, the Lycan King, and his wife Rebecca decided to sacrifice themselves. Princess Selena, their only daughter, overwhelmed by grief, she chose to honor her late parents' final wish. She didn't take the throne, stripped herself of her wolf soul, sealed her Lycan lineage, and became an Omega. Four years later, Selena married Damon, the Alpha of the Blue Moon Pack—the weakest of the four wolf packs. After the wedding, she quietly took care of her husband's family and even carried Damon's child. Yet she was still betrayed by Damon. Then Selena met Kael, the Alpha of the strongest pack. Finally, Selena decided she would no longer tolerate it...
6ab3ceb983ec64ca37028217.title: The Rejected Lycan Queen Returns

6ab3d9467005444d100a9527.synopsis: Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?
6ab3d9467005444d100a9527.title: The Alpha Who Let His Luna Die

6ab48511b7e3bc54940add55.synopsis: Blind Ayla is "sold" by her fiancé to Ronan, the Wolf King of the North. After one night of passion, she is framed by a witch and exiled from the wolf territory. She struggles to survive alone with the Wolf King's child. A year later, her daughter Lumi unexpectedly reunites with Ronan. Facing the witch's pursuit, her fiancé's betrayal, and Ronan's probing, Ayla hides her true identity and secretly plots her revenge. Meanwhile, as Ronan investigates the truth, he gradually realizes he has long been caught in an emotional vortex for Ayla—and willingly becomes the weapon of her vengeance. Curses intertwine with true love, setting off a bittersweet romance that defies race and destiny.
6ab48511b7e3bc54940add55.title: The Alpha's Secret Pup

6ab485169b5ef8f06d0efba5.synopsis: Race car driver Jack Riley is betrayed by his team and plunged off a cliff. As he lies dying, he awakens Lightning, an alien Defender scout who has been dormant on Earth for eighty years. Jack and his new alien partner return to the racing circuit, but soon find themselves caught in a galactic plot as the Ironvore Legion, led by Frostfang, hunts for the Ultimate Core—a device of infinite energy. With the help of heiress Rose Cavendish and his ragtag teammates from the Anvil Racing Team, Jack and Lightning transform from isolated outcasts to leaders of a united Defender force on Earth. Their final battle rages across deserts, cities, and a massive mothership. When the human government decides to surrender, Jack and his allies prove with unwavering trust and courage that Earth’s salvation depends not on alien technology alone, but on the strength of human hearts.
6ab485169b5ef8f06d0efba5.title: Star Core Rush

6ab486022577b7634d091c77.synopsis: Kalen, a blacksmith of the Northern Realm raised by the legendary warrior Silas, bears the long-dormant Golden-Eyed bloodline — power enough to shake the entire continent. Silas entrusts him with half a vampire fang relic, sending him south to House Ashborn to honor an ancient betrothal. Along the way, Kalen saves Lila, the family’s youngest daughter, and is pulled into a war between the Four Great Vampire Clans, the Vampire Senate, and the Orc Tribes. Kalen soon learns he is the Ashborns’ long-lost eldest son, abandoned at birth twenty years prior. To protect his mother and kin, he unleashes his Golden-Eyes against formidable foes Klausen and Vaughn, and journeys into the hidden realm aided by Silas, Lila, and the huntress Ella. He ultimately inherits the legacy of the Progenitor Cain, defeats the Orc King and Blood Moon Wolf Lord, and secures his family and new home with the power of his Golden-Eyes.
6ab486022577b7634d091c77.title: The Golden-Eyed Vampire Prince

6ab48e7290a90172fe09635f.synopsis: The Story of Roaming the World Untamed: Vanished at age five, Rian, the prodigy of Maple Kingdom returned years later. But he was no longer the celebrated son of Duke Aldric. Instead, he was humiliated, treated like trash, and cast aside by his family. However, Rian was no ordinary. Secretly raised by the holy dragon, he had achieved the impossible forbidden dragon spell. He was the realm's last dragon speaker in the Roaming the World Untamed movie. After years of hiding his dragon magic, Rian finally stepped up when the ugly monsters, the half orcs threatened the kingdom & demanded Princess Isabel's hand in marriage. Entering the princess tournament, Rian unleashed his ultimate glory as he defeated the half-orcs one by one. But the stakes only went higher when Rian next faced Starspeaker Aether & the Undead Legion's General. Could the disgraced son beat the odds, expose his family's abuse and win the princess’s heart while claiming the ultimate title as the dragon speaker? Characters: Rian Calder Rian Calder was the protagonist of the Roaming the World Untamed movie. He was raised by Aurelian, his birth mother, Elena’s true friend and Holy Dragon. Treated like trash & abused by his family, Rian suffered deeply for years until he claimed his title as the realm's last dragon speaker. Princess Isabel Princess Isabel was Rian Calder’s love interest and female lead of the Roaming the World Untamed movie. When Rian defeated the half orcs who threatened the Maple Kingdom, Isabel became his future bride and ultimate ally. Duke Aldric Calder Aldric Calder was Rian's cruel and ambitious father, driven by status. He subjected Rian to years of abuse until Rian exposed the Calder family and unleashed his dragon magic. Reynard Calder Reynard Calder was Rian's half-brother and favored son of Duke Aldric in the Roaming the World Untamed movie. He was a noble knight who was defeated by the Half orcs.
6ab48e7290a90172fe09635f.title: Roaming the World Untamed

6ab48e78dc6fd7ef4a06596e.synopsis: Vanessa built an empire, paid off her husband’s debts, and funded his family’s lavish lifestyle. She's ready to enjoy the family vacation - until she finds out her husband gave away her first-class ticket to his ex-girlfriend! Finally, she realizes she's been nothing but a walking ATM to him. Now, she's done letting him bleed her dry, and she's going to take back everything she ever gave him!
6ab48e78dc6fd7ef4a06596e.title: Out of Your League: The Billionaire Wife's Revenge

6ab48e7fb0cc5b02e504728a.synopsis: Olivia Onyx is the top cadet at Blackspire War Academy, but behind her perfect reputation, her family is broke and her grandfather lies in a mysterious coma. Desperate to pay for his treatment, Olivia takes a secret night job that could cost her everything. Then her arrogant rival, Valor Riven, discovers the truth. Rich, powerful, and impossible to ignore, Valor offers Olivia enough money to save her grandfather if she secretly works as his maid. She agrees, unaware he’s hiding something bigger: their matching fate marks mean Olivia is his soulmate, and Valor already knows it. By day, they compete at the academy. By night, rivalry turns into dangerous attraction. As Olivia gets closer to Valor, jealous enemies target her, secrets about her grandfather surface, and someone inside Blackspire will do anything to keep the truth buried.
6ab48e7fb0cc5b02e504728a.title: The Dragon Heir’s Secret Maid

6ab48e82a0c9ed1a400db21a.synopsis: Jonathan's the richest man in the world, but he won't let his loving wife and adorable son know. Convinced that everyone's only after him for the money, he puts them to the test for ten long years, letting them collect scraps for money as he signs million dollar deals. Ten years later, they've passed the test. They've proven they love Jonathan, even if he's penniless. Now one last question remains: after everything he's put them through, does Jonathan deserve them? And when his son died because of him, will his "test" be the final straw?
6ab48e82a0c9ed1a400db21a.title: I Buried Our Son While You Played Poor

6ab48f611261e140c00d2b72.synopsis: Billionaire heiress Ella visits a nail salon, but greedy owner Daniel and jealous tech Sarah turn a tipping dispute into violence. Bodyguard Mark saves her, and Ella retaliates by buying the street. Corrupt police grovel when they learn her fiancé Christian is secretly billionaire Mr. Cashman. At his proposal gala, Sarah frames her again, but Christian's drones reveal Ella's true identity as an heiress. Once married, Ella abolishes tipping nationwide while her tormentors end up scrubbing toilets.
6ab48f611261e140c00d2b72.title: Don't Mess with the Billionaire Heiress

6ab48f64d0f771c12b0add3f.synopsis: Waitress Amy Winters marries the feared Dragon King to secure her grandfather's lifesaving surgery. Inside his hostile palace, she discovers a dangerous bond, a royal conspiracy, and a power awakening in her blood. As enemies close in, Amy must decide whether Solus is her captor—or the only man protecting her right to choose.
6ab48f64d0f771c12b0add3f.title: The Dragon King's Virgin Bride

6ab48fd9f9e19a102105c0af.synopsis: The kingdom’s greatest warrior returns home after five years of war and glory, only to find his wife has decided to divorce him, and hold a contest to find a mate that can protect her. Little does he realize the true reason for her betrayal… the safety of their five year old daughter.
6ab48fd9f9e19a102105c0af.title: THE HUSBAND SHE DISCARDED IS THE WINTER DRAGON

6ab4951019f6b3d4f506c81f.synopsis: They called me a useless fat orange cat. They stole my magic fruit, burned my home, and chained me over a potion fire. “Cut out her heart!” Vanessa ordered. She never knew I was the daughter of the White Tiger King, or that my weak body hid the First Tiger Heart. When my father and warlord brother arrived, the whole guild fell to its knees. But Vanessa’s trap stole their power and fed it into me. I had failed to shift for three hundred years. Now my first human form might be strong enough to destroy them all.
6ab4951019f6b3d4f506c81f.title: The Weakest Orange Cat Is the Strongest Golden Tiger

6ab4957a73eff4c1e00f242b.synopsis: Paige, a struggling aspiring musician, dreams of getting into the Royal Academy of Music, but the application fees are impossible. At the homecoming party, she plans to confess to her crush Vera—but in her nervous rush, she knocks on the wrong door and finds Talia, the star cheerleading captain, just after discovering her boyfriend Derek's infidelity. Talia proposes a fake-girlfriend contract: Paige pretends to date her until the National Cheerleading Championship. In return, Talia helps Paige join the music club and raise funds. They face campus gossip and Derek's vicious retaliation, and their fake romance slowly turns real. Derek spreads lies. Talia's controlling mother uses money and media to tear them apart. A severe ankle injury threatens Talia's cheer career. Misunderstandings pull them apart. With support from friends and her brother, Paige accepts herself, exposes Derek, and passes her academy audition with her original song "Cheer for My Heart." She rushes to the championship and confesses publicly. Defying class prejudice, the two girls bravely choose their future together.
6ab4957a73eff4c1e00f242b.title: Wrong Door Right Girl

6ab49bcd5e33558cc10381df.synopsis: A slightly curvy yet effortlessly elegant heiress marries beneath her station and secretly supports her husband for three years. When she brings her expedition-worn mother—the world’s richest woman—to the grand opening of his new fashion boutique, his mistress publicly body-shames and brutally assaults them. Finally revealing her true identity, the heiress summons three waiting business titans and an army of black-suited bodyguards, crushes her cheating husband’s fashion empire, and delivers the ultimate comeback—a ruthless reckoning of revenge and humiliation.
6ab49bcd5e33558cc10381df.title: Bullied by my Husband's Mistress，I am the Hidden XXL-Billionaire Heiress

6ab49d3661f3258f2d05a8db.synopsis: A thousand years ago, dragons saved the elves from orcs—but demanded a virgin princess for every new Dragon King. Lora, the elven king’s illegitimate daughter, is blackmailed by her stepmother into taking Princess Bella’s place as the dragon bride. But Prince Draven isn’t the tyrant of legend. He offers a deal: give him an heir, and he’ll free her mother and grant her freedom. Day by day, Draven falls for Lora’s gentle heart. She opens to him and willingly carries his child. Then the orcs return, and Draven is gravely wounded. Bella arrives, playing the “true princess,” poisoning Draven’s trust in Lora. Heartsick and misunderstood, Lora walks away—only to be kidnapped by orcs as leverage. Draven risks everything to save her, drives back the orcs, and exposes Bella’s schemes. In the end, the bastard bride becomes the Dragon King’s one true queen.
6ab49d3661f3258f2d05a8db.title: Forced to Bear the Dragon’s Heir

6ab49dec4a24f137390e16aa.synopsis: The Kingdom of Eloria has strict social classes, and nobles hold all power. Viscount Moore has two daughters. The elder sister Lirayn spends half her life working nonstop to lift the fallen noble Vorian to the top of power. Her stepsister Elysia marries Kyran, the heir of Duke Hale, and suffers endless bad treatment. After Kyran's family loses its wealth, she envies her sister's good life and kills Lirayn. When Lirayn is dying, the old gift left by her mom activates, sending both of them back to the day before their weddings. Elysia fears all the power fights among nobles, so she insists on swapping brides with Lirayn. After marriage, her mother-in-law bullies her, and her husband Vorian ignores her. In the end, Vorian's ugly side comes out, he goes to jail and loses all his fame. Lirayn marries Kyran instead, and Duke and Hale treat and trust her with all their hearts. After Lirayn marries Kyran, he only favors Saelin who pretends to be weak, and misunderstands Lirayn again and again. Lirayn exposes Saelin's fake kindness many times. When Kyran finally realizes his mistakes and begs her humbly, she says no firmly. She only wants power to control her own life.
6ab49dec4a24f137390e16aa.title: Fatal Vow Swap, I Rule the Castle

6ab49f52f7f5f54f640d4863.synopsis: A year ago, plus-size Gemma was bullied until scarred stranger Cole saved her. After a glow-up, she returns as a top physical therapist—secretly the Vance Media heiress—and reunites with Cole, now an isolated boxer. Facing Triss and Sinna’s schemes, she fights back with brains and money, while Cole buys the club to protect her. At the gala, both reveal their billionaire-heir identities, crush their enemies, and kiss above the city.
6ab49f52f7f5f54f640d4863.title: The Billionaire Boxer Fell for the Plus-Size Heiress

6ab4b8dd7a80758e5208e006.synopsis: Legendary chief test pilot Evelyn Carter is reborn as nine-year-old Mia after a stage accident. Aboard Flight SC6654, when the left engine explodes and both pilots are incapacitated, she uses her past-life flight and engineering expertise to stabilize the aircraft, avoid a mid-air collision, survive a thunderstorm, and ditch in Lake Michigan, saving everyone on board. After landing, she exposes Ethan and Linda’s attempt to steal her credit at the recognition ceremony, receives Skycrest’s official honor, and joins its youth aviation engineering program—pursuing a new dream: not only to fly, but to make aircraft safer and bring more people home.
6ab4b8dd7a80758e5208e006.title: Rebirth in the Sky

6ab4b960b1ed19fd1408979c.synopsis: Emma Sinclair, hidden heiress of Sinclair Real Estate, followed her father’s orders to live modestly—used car, budget clothes, treated as a poor student. She trusted her roommate Bella, a vain cheerleader who secretly hacked her phone and drained ten million dollars. When Emma discovered the truth, Bella pushed her off a Dubai hotel rooftop. Jason, the basketball star Emma loved, had already publicly slapped her, calling her a fraud. Emma died abandoned. Reborn to the day Bella proposed the Dubai trip, Emma plans revenge. She “loses” her phone, replaces it with an old Nokia, and lures Bella into spending over five million dollars on non-refundable luxury items. At payment, Bella is exposed, unable to cover the bill. Jason sells his sneakers and maxes credit cards to help her. Followers desert. Only Ashley apologizes. Then tycoon Victor Sterling reveals Emma as the Sinclair heiress. Bella is arrested for fraud; Jason loses everything. Emma’s revenge makes every betrayer taste the fall.
6ab4b960b1ed19fd1408979c.title: The Ten-Million Dollar Trap

6ab4b9cdc4ba90cc8d07abda.synopsis: Seven-year-old genius Daisy concealed her identity as the heir to a top-tier wealthy family. While secretly manipulating the stock market and controlling a large conglomerate, she quietly supported her ordinary father, Richard. At bidding conferences, at school, and at class reunions, she repeatedly humiliated the rich kids who looked down on Richard, step by step helping her father get to know Lila, a woman of quality. In the end, she publicly revealed her hidden identity as the wealthiest person in the shadows, shaking up the entire Los Angeles business world.
6ab4b9cdc4ba90cc8d07abda.title: Daddy, We’re Secret Billionaires

6ab4bb3600201a59b408e65f.synopsis: Cross Group Chairman Adrian secretly returns to surprise his wife Rebecca, but Vice President Ryan mistakes him for her “boy toy.” Humiliated, beaten, and framed, Adrian endures until he reveals his identity. Ryan is jailed, and the couple reunite, expecting a child.
6ab4bb3600201a59b408e65f.title: Boy Toy I'm Your Boss

6ab4c2f1a5e1bbcdc20dfe49.synopsis: Resident John unexpectedly gains miraculous supernatural powers to see internal injuries in patients. He uncovers multiple hidden critical conditions and saves countless dying patients. However, his extraordinary diagnostic skills draw suspicion and investigation from his peers. Racing against death in the emergency department, he carefully hides his supernatural secret, while danger creeps closer to him.
6ab4c2f1a5e1bbcdc20dfe49.title: Clinic Miracle

6ab4caad55d7dfdf17051310.synopsis: Five years ago, she took her sister's place in a one-night entanglement with a powerful CEO and was forced to leave the country. Five years later, she returns with a genius baby, only to discover that the all-powerful man is the child's father.
6ab4caad55d7dfdf17051310.title: The CEO's Genius Baby

6ab4ebf6f128bf3d7c0812fb.synopsis: "Pure-blooded Silver Moon wolf Seraphina was betrayed by her lover Kane and her stepsister Stella, framed for infidelity, forced to bear a mongrel pup, and burned alive. Reborn on the day of the mating ceremony, she discovers that Kane has also returned with memories of their past life. Determined to change her fate, Seraphina refuses to become his Luna again and enters the forbidden land, where she finds Nike, the true Alpha imprisoned by Kane, and forms an alliance with him for revenge. But Kane and Stella retaliate by using pack law to force her into a humiliating marriage with the outcast Rhett. Just as Seraphina is about to be humiliated, a terrifying pressure sweeps across the square……"
6ab4ebf6f128bf3d7c0812fb.title: The Pure-Blooded Wolf Queen’s Vengeful Fury

6ab4ee4d8ee3a23f97044324.synopsis: Max is a college junior with zero dating experience and eight rejected confessions to his name. One drunken night, he wished he could be a beautiful girl. He woke up as one. Now his roommate Toby is red-faced in the feminine hygiene aisle buying the wrong product, his buddy Elliot is timing his bathroom breaks with a stopwatch, and his dream girl Ivy — who never gave him the time of day — is linking arms with him and wiping rice off his face. Turns out she always noticed him. She just couldn't say yes when he confessed in front of the entire cafeteria. Every. Single. Time. Life as "Maxie" is a crash course in high heels, period cramps, and the terrifyingly efficient girls' gossip network — until Kai, Elliot's cold-eyed half-brother, moves in and starts noticing that this pretty new girl fights like a jiu-jitsu black belt and bites her lip in the exact same spot as a boy who's been "missing" for weeks.
6ab4ee4d8ee3a23f97044324.title: Dude, I'm a Girl Now

6ab4ef01b13ef3d23e0f74c2.synopsis: Samantha's childhood friend Logan betrays her, giving her VIP ticket to her idol's final concert to another girl, Sierra. Samantha cuts him off, switches to NYU, and rebuilds her life. Logan keeps harassing her, while Sierra vandalizes her home and spreads lies. Samantha refuses to forgive Logan, despite his pleas. She grows close to Ethan, a fellow fan who helps her stop Logan's harassment. Logan attacks Ethan in jealousy. Samantha chooses Ethan, finally finding love and peace with her mother by her side.
6ab4ef01b13ef3d23e0f74c2.title: The Girl He Lost in the Flames

6ab4ef3d73f5cdd44e0ba279.synopsis: After His Number Disappeared, a 38‑episode modern urban fantasy romance short drama. The heroine Mia has a special ability to see numbers above people’s heads showing how many times they will meet. Since childhood, she saw the huge number above her childhood friend Henry and believed they were soul‑mates, even making boyfriend‑rules for him. The moment Henry showed her a photo of his roommate Liam, the huge number transferred to Liam. Mia let go of her obsession and fell for Liam, who had secretly loved her. Henry tried desperately to win her back after losing her yet could not change fate. Henry moved overseas due to family misfortune, and Mia finally stayed with the sincere Liam.
6ab4ef3d73f5cdd44e0ba279.title: After His Number Disappeared

6ab4ef79e39a830ab3083d12.synopsis: For seven years, Coralie loved Malachi with no title, no ring, no place in his world. Then his first love returned—and he proposed. Not for love. For a prenup that would pour his fortune into another woman's hands. That night, her grandmother's last wish shattered, and so did Coralie's patience. She left New York with nothing but dignity. When he finally learned what love looked like, she had already stopped needing his.
6ab4ef79e39a830ab3083d12.title: Saved My Life, No More Love

6ab4f2fe9369192e17015ae0.synopsis: Eight years after losing the love of her life, elite mercenary Evelyn Cross walks away from the battlefield to raise her young daughter and run a small shop. But when the ruthless Sterling Group comes after her family, Evelyn must fight back—and uncover the truth buried for eight years.
6ab4f2fe9369192e17015ae0.title: The Mercenary Mom Is Back

6ab54091922f71fc8b0b3d97.synopsis: After being betrayed and executed by her husband, King Charles, Queen Bea miraculously wakes up three years earlier on her wedding day. Armed with memories of her past life, Bea refuses to repeat her mistakes and sets out to change her fate. But as Charles schemes to reclaim her and her fortune, Bea grows closer to his overlooked younger brother, Prince Paul... and realizes she may have chosen the wrong King in her first life.
6ab54091922f71fc8b0b3d97.title: The Beheaded Queen's Rebirth to Dethrone the King

6ab541f9a0570f0b720682e7.synopsis: Elara, the only human in the Red Dragon Castle, has survived for three years on Dragon Lord Agni's breath. But after giving him everything, she's cast aside for another woman. Left to die in the Abyss, Elara is rescued by the legendary Ancient Black Dragon King, Caius — only to discover she's the one mate he's been waiting for all along.
6ab541f9a0570f0b720682e7.title: The Dragon Lord's Regret

6ab542adc0469ddbb30a7c59.synopsis: Buried alive by her stepmother, Mafia Princess Lucia returns as Viper—her killer's bodyguard—to destroy them all. Her first love and knight falls for her again, as her stepbrother joins her side.
6ab542adc0469ddbb30a7c59.title: The Dead Mafia Princess Will Make Them All Pay

6ab6069d7d9f411584084db5.synopsis: Bullied scholarship student Ella escapes into a romance with her perfect AI boyfriend—until he mysteriously comes to life as the billionaire heir at her elite prep school. When her ruthless rival steals Ella's identity and claims to be the girl he's been searching for, Ella must risk everything to win back the boy who was always meant to be hers.
6ab6069d7d9f411584084db5.title: My AI Boyfriend Came to Life!

6ab6084357304459cf0cfcc5.synopsis: Humiliated, divorced and broke, orphan Nina applies to be the step-mom for hire of Mafia Don Leon Marconi, wins little Gio over with a Spider-Man doll, and signs a marriage contract. His tenderness eases her depression, and when he names her his wife at a gala, Easton's family collapses. Drug-addled Easton kidnaps Nina and Gio; Leon drives him off, they marry for real, and Gio proves to be his sister's son. Carmen's revenge fails as Nina gives birth to Dahlia, and Easton dies by his own bomb.
6ab6084357304459cf0cfcc5.title: Divorced, I Married the Mafioso

6ab608475f377946a2054b85.synopsis: Ethan, a rejected walk-on, sexts a stranger he thinks is his crush, not knowing it's rival captain Caleb, who hijacked the account on a bet. Caleb finds Ethan's birthmark and blackmails him, but the game turns to real feelings: he shields Ethan from bullying and fakes dating him to dodge an arranged marriage. A duel, a public coming out, a scheming fiancée, and a jealous rival test them before Ethan chooses Caleb, who gives up his family's future for hockey and love.
6ab608475f377946a2054b85.title: My Rival Got My Thirst Trap by Mistake

6ab60a5d383eb0da93077d05.synopsis: Luke Peterson is a seventeen-year-old outcast surviving a violent home and relentless school bullying in Chicago's South Side. When a mysterious representative of the Peterson Group — a global financial empire — reveals Luke is the founder's only legitimate heir, Luke receives the family's ancient signet ring, unlocking five abilities: invisibility, magnetic force, time suspension, X-ray vision, and spirit summoning. What follows is a methodical, deeply satisfying reversal. Every humiliation Luke has endured becomes the setup for a public reckoning — engineered with precision, executed with style.
6ab60a5d383eb0da93077d05.title: Revenge of the Superpowered Nerd

6ab60ad679098aca75062427.synopsis: 7-year-old Wolf Princess, Ruby Zephyr is cursed, and slowly freezing the heart of her sister, Talia. Talia would rather die than leave Ruby, so Ruby runs away, giving up her wolf, and all memory of who she is to save her sister. 11 years later, Alpha Queen Talia is determined to reunite with her long lost sister. She travels to Crystal Valley High, and finds a brilliant and kind student with her sister's violet eyes. As her suspicions grow, Talia sees Ruby mistreated by her peers and must intervene, jogging Ruby's memory and unlocking her Ice Wolf. When Ruby's bullies finally realize they've been abusing the Alpha Queen and her sister, the lost Ice Wolf Queen, they'll FREEZE with regret.
6ab60ad679098aca75062427.title: Fire & Ice: Return of the Alpha Queen's Sister

6ab717e529656d2f070af407.synopsis: Ex-special forces trucker Kieran lives by one rule: never touch the cargo. When his comrade Lucas hires him to transport Audrey across a zombie wasteland, Kieran expects routine. But Audrey dismantles his defenses with fierce vulnerability. As hordes and raiders batter them, his detachment crumbles. Lucas betrays them, Claire joins as a rival for his heart, and the love triangle ignites at Southridge, forcing all three to confront desire, betrayal, and survival.
6ab717e529656d2f070af407.title: Never Touch the Cargo

6ab8a43a2cdfd334da0580eb.synopsis: In Dear Brother Your Regret Came Too Late, Stephanie Sims has spent all 16 years of her life carrying her family’s blame. Her mother, whom her father loved dearly, died while giving birth to her. From that day forward, Stephanie’s father neglects her and holds her responsible for the loss. The only person who shows Stephanie any warmth is her brother, Alexander “Alex” Sims. Whenever their father ignores her, Alex pats her on the back and reassures her that she is loved. Everything changes when their cousin, Abigail Dawn, moves into the family home. Before long, even Alex begins siding with their father. Together, they spoil Abigail, whom they call Abby, while treating Stephanie as though she no longer belongs. At their cruelest, they even wish Stephanie had died instead of her mother. Their wish comes true in the worst possible way when Stephanie is diagnosed with cancer. On their father’s birthday, Alex even catches a glimpse of her diagnosis report. Still, he doesn’t understand what Stephanie has been facing until after she dies. His regret comes too late. The accusations he throws at Stephanie’s friends—and his own mistreatment of her—soon begin to turn against him. Characters Stephanie Sims Stephanie Sims is the suffering main female character and Alexander’s real sister. Her family labels her as her mother’s murderer simply because her mother died giving birth to her. Even after she becomes seriously ill, Stephanie is left to struggle alone. Alexander “Alex” Sims Alexander “Alex” Sims is the main male character and Stephanie’s brother. He once comforts Stephanie when their father neglects her, but his attitude changes after Abby moves into their home. By siding with Abby and misunderstanding his sister, Alex sets himself up for a lifetime of regret. Abigail “Abby” Dawn Abigail “Abby” Dawn is the manipulative and jealous main villain. Although she fails three classes, she finds a way into the Ivy League by exploiting Alex. Her arrival also drives a deeper wedge between Stephanie and her family. Rowan Rowan is the punk-looking girl who gives Stephanie her tattoo. She is also Stephanie’s best friend and biggest supporter when her own family turns against her.
6ab8a43a2cdfd334da0580eb.title: Dear Brother, Your Regret Came Too Late

6ab8feee15fa455e9c062f17.synopsis: Blackstone City stands against the Central Beast Forest, where a Frenzied Beast Tide erupts every hundred years—and if the city falls, everyone dies. Ian White, sole heir of the White family, lost his parents eight years ago and was raised by his uncle, Mawson. Before her death, Ian’s mother sealed away his gift as a legendary Beast Speaker—a seal set to break on his eighteenth birthday. His father left the family estate in the hands of the Beast Tamers’ Association, likewise locked until Ian comes of age. With fifteen days left before the seal lifts, the Dark Guild and his uncle Mawson are deliberately amplifying the beast tide—aiming to seize the Beast Forest’s mining rights and the White fortune. Ian meant to wait it out. But as defenses collapse, he is forced to act in secret—using his gift to command wild beasts and quietly turn back the tide, again and again. Thain, a Saint-level beast tamer, begins to suspect him. Against all opposition, he names Ian to lead the defense. In the end, Ian claims the Beast King’s Medallion his mother left behind, awakens his full power, summons all beasts to drive back the tide—and exposes his uncle and the Dark Guild before the entire city. He inherits the family legacy and rises as the city-state’s new Beast King.
6ab8feee15fa455e9c062f17.title: Beast Whisperer

6ab9c22a20b8ff5a830ffba7.synopsis: Celestia, the goddess, was drugged and betrayed by her stepsister Mortis. She spent one fateful night with Dragon King Azriel and later gave birth to a pair of dragon-god twins. Coveting the Dragon Queen’s throne, Mortis stole their baby daughter Joey, raised her as her own, and plotted to execute Celestia. Fleeing to the barren wasteland, Celestia lived in anonymity for five years with her son Aion. Born with an incomplete divine core, Aion could only survive with his biological father’s essence. To save her son, Celestia returns to the divine realm. There she unexpectedly meets the Dragon King’s “daughter” Joey and feels an instinctive bond with the child. Azriel senses an inexplicable familiarity with Celestia and takes her and her son into the dragon palace. The story culminates in a grand wedding between Celestia and Azriel. The Dragon King swears to love only her for eternity, as their twin children witness their parents finally reunite.
6ab9c22a20b8ff5a830ffba7.title: The Dragon King 's Bride

6ab9c2a17e569c9b2506f8e7.synopsis: After catching her fiancé with her stepsister, Seren Voss storms into an exclusive club and impulsively hires a man for the night—unaware that he is Kael Rizzo, the city’s most feared mafia boss. Amused by her audacity and determined to keep her close, Kael binds her to a three-month debt agreement. What begins as a dangerous game of attraction soon becomes something neither can resist. But as family betrayal, rival gangs, abduction, and a jealous former partner close in, Seren becomes Kael’s greatest weakness—and the only woman capable of capturing his heart. To claim their future, they must survive the enemies determined to tear them apart.
6ab9c2a17e569c9b2506f8e7.title: The Boss Forces My Heart.

6ab9c31abd062a47400e0059.synopsis: Pregnant Emily Whitmore repeatedly begs her husband, Daniel Cole, to protect their family—only to be met with suspicion and abandonment. Blinded by his supposedly dying former lover, Jessica, Daniel ignores his daughter’s abuse and makes a devastating choice that costs Emily their unborn child. Heartbroken, Emily takes her daughter and leaves, but a car accident soon leads everyone to believe they are dead. Three years later, a guilt-ridden Daniel walks into a church and sees the impossible: his “dead” wife in a wedding dress, ready to marry another man. Desperate to reclaim the family he destroyed, Daniel begins an obsessive pursuit for forgiveness. But Emily has rebuilt her life, and even the greatest sacrifice may not be enough to restore a love shattered beyond repair.
6ab9c31abd062a47400e0059.title: His Dead Wife Is Getting Married

6ab9c3ce58ea8ed2c40dbdc9.synopsis: Betrayed husband Reid Cole is secretly the billionaire running wife Vanessa's family empire. She and lover Derek humiliate Reid and her parents, whose trauma kills them. Vanessa divorces Reid, marries Derek, attends her parents' funeral in a wedding dress. Reid, named heir, exposes Derek's debts and Vanessa's fake-death plot. Years later, Vanessa uses their daughter to blackmail Reid and tries murdering him — but walks into his trap. Reid finds happiness with Eva and raises the girl as his own.
6ab9c3ce58ea8ed2c40dbdc9.title: She Dumped a CEO for Her Sugar Baby

6ab9c8b9c641a6684b078d4a.synopsis: Jessamine spent nine years turning Dashiell Carrington from an undrafted nobody with two blown knees into the captain of the New York Comets. She rebuilt his body, ghostwrote his apologies, and quit her own career to manage his. He repaid her by sleeping with his twenty-one-year-old content producer, handing the girl a training program Jessamine had created, and telling the cameras his family was everything — while his pregnant wife sat in the ER alone. He forgot to take off his mic after the game. She downloaded three copies. Then she called his mother — who happened to chair the team's board — and said two words: "I'm leaving." She didn't take the nursery, the jerseys, or the baby skates with his number on them. She took four rehab journals, a passport, and the original manuscript he told her wasn't worth publishing. Six months later, the Comets had a new president. Her name was Jessamine. No last name required.
6ab9c8b9c641a6684b078d4a.title: The Mic Was Still On

6ab9ccf1569baf55990e3f20.synopsis: Duke’s daughter Violet has died four brutal deaths—burned at the stake, beheaded, hanged, and stabbed. In every lifetime, she meets her end at twenty at the hands of her stepsister Seraphina and former fiancé Dodolo. Reborn for the fifth time, Violet casts aside her wedding gown, dons riding attire, and crashes her stepmother’s wedding. Determined to reclaim her reputation as a villainess, she vows to bring down everyone who once destroyed her. When Malloris, a mysterious silver-masked man with violet eyes, offers an alliance, Violet soon realizes that even she cannot see all the cards in play this time.
6ab9ccf1569baf55990e3f20.title: The Villainess’s Fifth Life

6ab9d804f06224f2d70c890b.synopsis: Lana Samuel, the biological daughter, was banished to the countryside for 18 years over a misunderstanding about her appearance. Meanwhile, the adopted daughter, Bria Samuel, received all the family's love. When Lana returns home as the top scholar, her three brothers despise and mistreat her. But the tables turn when they realize Lana is the girl they have been searching for. Refusing to wallow in self-pity, Lana leverages her stellar grades to pursue a future in scientific research, leaving her guilt-ridden brothers in deep regrets.
6ab9d804f06224f2d70c890b.title: The Comeback Heiress

6ab9de0d65e9f5e86d088812.synopsis: In Divorced A Hockey Star Chose His Biggest Rival, nobody knows Riley Monroe’s family secret: her father owns the NHL. Riley coaches her husband’s Falcon team to a massive victory, earning respect as both a brilliant coach and a hockey heiress. Her husband, NHL star Jace Donnelly, has also become the team’s MVP. During an interview, he even places Riley at the top of his thank-you list. Riley never expects her beloved husband to start caring more about the team doctor than he does about her. Cassandra uses sickness and minor injuries to pull Jace away from his wife, and he falls for it every time. He carries Cassandra around and tends to her every need. Then the man who once treated Riley with love shoves her so hard that she miscarries. Even after losing their baby, Riley is accused of cheating on him. That is enough for Riley. She divorces Jace, rebuilds her career from the ground up, and grows closer to another rising hockey star—Jace’s biggest rival. By the time Jace understands what he has lost, Riley has already moved on. His regret comes far too late. Characters Riley Monroe Riley Monroe is the main female character and is pregnant with Jace’s baby. As a skilled coach and hockey heiress, she plays a major role in Jace’s success. After being betrayed by her husband, Riley decides to rebuild her life and career without him. Jace Donnelly Jace Donnelly is the Falcon team’s MVP and Riley’s husband. He pushes his wife aside and repeatedly puts the manipulative team doctor first. Convinced that Riley has cheated on him, Jace abandons their marriage without understanding what he is about to lose. Cassandra Collins Cassandra Collins is the manipulative and coy team doctor. She enjoys flirting with members of the hockey team, but Jace is the one she wants most. Her obsession with him drives her to interfere in his marriage to Riley. Grant Monroe Grant Monroe is Riley’s caring brother and is better known than she is. Jace mistakes Grant for Riley’s boyfriend, adding to his false belief that she has been unfaithful.
6ab9de0d65e9f5e86d088812.title: Divorced a Hockey Star, Chose His Biggest Rival

6ab9e34b34886c11c4092730.synopsis: Piper spent years secretly tutoring and dating star quarterback Parker, who refused to be seen with her in publicand let his friends mock her weight behind her back. When Piper is cornered after a game and Parker brushesoff her panicked call, it's his biggest rival, quarterback Weston Reyes, who saves her instead — and claims heropenly, proudly, and without a hint of shame. As Piper learns what it feels like to be truly seen and wanted,Parker's life unravels while he repeatedly tries to win her back, revealing exactly how little he ever valued her.
6ab9e34b34886c11c4092730.title: SCORING WITH MY EX'S RIVAL

6ab9e49dc7142fa1b005d0d7.synopsis: Kael raised Selene like a rose for eighteen years and never once let a thorn touch her — never dared to mark her, because everything he treasures gets taken. On the night of her eighteenth birthday, she tore their mate bond apart in front of the entire pack so she could run to Damian. It nearly killed her. But in the end, Damian killed her. She was never his love, only the blade he planned to gut Kael with. And when she died, her soul didn't leave. She watched Kael go through her enemies like a slaughter, then walk to her grave and follow her into the dark. Now she's reborn. This time, she isn't running anywhere. She will love Kael and take revenge on Damian.
6ab9e49dc7142fa1b005d0d7.title: Reborn to Claim My Alpha King

6ab9fd393587575fb4076e37.synopsis: Six years ago, Nadia, a circus clown, had a one-night stand with Aris, president of Sterling Group, and unexpectedly fell pregnant. She raised their daughter Elora alone. Five years later, when Elora was hospitalized with a high fever, the Teng Serpent totem on her collarbone revealed her direct bloodline to the Sterling family. After Nadia took a job at Starlight Amusement Park under the group, she was repeatedly framed by Severin, the operations director. While protecting the mother and daughter, Aris gradually realized Nadia was the woman from six years prior. In the end, the conspiracy was exposed, Severin was expelled from the family. Aris proposed publicly. Nadia gave birth to triplet daughters, and the whole family of seven lived happily together.
6ab9fd393587575fb4076e37.title: The Sterling’s Hidden Heir

6aba0531e585c7314a06155c.synopsis: Silvermoon pureblood Wren waits three years for her fated mate Silas, who rejects her for her half-sister Cora on the full moon. Framed and exiled by her family, Wren flees north and accepts Bloodmoon Alpha Ridge. When Silas learns Cora lied, it is too late. As Wren bonds with Ridge, Cora and Vera are banished, Elias falls comatose, and grief-stricken Silas ends his life in an icy lake.
6aba0531e585c7314a06155c.title: I Burned My Wedding Dress Before He Ever Marked Me

6aba0cb115c52b410803c747.synopsis: Clara, co‑administrator of the Westwood Educational Trust, had been married into a wealthy Boston family for five years. Time and again, for defending her daughter Maya's rights, her husband Julian revoked her trust access for the 28th time. Her stepson Leo and Julian's ex‑wife Eleanor schemed repeatedly: they faked injuries, tried to siphon trust funds, and falsely accused Clara. Determined to divorce, Clara left with Maya. After reviewing surveillance footage and trust logs, Julian uncovered their lies. Overwhelmed with remorse, he begged Clara to take him back. Yet Clara saw through his self‑centeredness and turned him down. Back in California post‑divorce, she set up a trust fund solely for Maya and built a free, peaceful new life with her daughter.
6aba0cb115c52b410803c747.title: 28 Lockouts, I Locked Him Out

6aba38fd8522e0017b0e466e.synopsis: After being betrayed by her boyfriend and sold by her own family, Zora enters a marriage of convenience with Kevin Scott, the supposedly crippled heir to a powerful family. But behind their masks, both are hiding dangerous secrets. Zora is secretly a skilled underworld operative, while Kevin is actually the feared godfather of the Sicilian Mafia, faking his disability to uncover the truth behind his parents' murder. What begins as a strategic alliance slowly turns into genuine love. Just as Zora starts building a new life with Kevin, her past resurfaces when her former lover, Kevin's enemy, discovers that she is still alive. Trapped between old love, a possessive rival, family betrayal, and a deadly power struggle, Zora and Kevin must expose the conspiracies threatening them. Together, they fight back against those who destroyed their lives and turn their fake marriage into an unbreakable bond.
6aba38fd8522e0017b0e466e.title: Married Behind Masks

6abb21baec9ed3c05900a61f.synopsis: On the day Alice was forced to sign a brutal divorce settlement by her cruel ex-husband, she saved Samantha—VP of the Vanderbilt Group—on a New York street. Samantha spotted the heart-shaped birthmark on Alice's arm: the exact mark of Elena's daughter, missing for 25 years. DNA confirmed it. Elena flew to New York overnight, secretly fired Alice's rotten ex Oliver and his mistress Brenda, then promoted Alice and lavished her with a mansion and a supercar. Burning for revenge, the pair wormed their way back and forged proof that Alice took a million-dollar bribe and had an affair—then ambushed her at the board meeting. Just as Alice's world collapsed, Elena and Charles walked in and dropped the truth: Alice is the sole heir to a billion-dollar financial empire. The same people who mocked her now kneel in regret.
6abb21baec9ed3c05900a61f.title: The Day I Got Divorced, My Billionaire Mom Found Me

6abb22ab69b4e879a104d92e.synopsis: Liam Carter was once the brightest young forward in the hockey world, a prodigy whose career was destined for greatness. But after his father dragged him into a match-fixing scandal to cash in on his fame, his career was shattered overnight, sending him from the top of the world to rock bottom. Six years later, Liam makes his long-awaited return to the ice, only to discover that his former high school nemesis, Mateo Torres, has become the backbone of the team. The poor kid from the slums is now a formidable, hard-hitting defenseman who shines on the ice. Forced to play up a “former enemies turned friends” storyline for publicity, the two are moved into the same sponsor-provided apartment, with their every training session and daily interaction filmed for the cameras. As they spend more and more time together, the feelings they never dared to admit back in high school begin to resurface. But when the criminal forces behind the old match-fixing scandal come back for revenge, Liam’s family is threatened. While protecting Liam from the gang, Mateo suffers a devastating ankle injury that could end his career. Now, the two must face the ultimate test: their futures on the ice—and the love they can no longer hide. In the end, they join forces with the police to set a trap for the gang. During the semifinals, they pull off a stunning comeback. Mateo scores the winning goal, then kisses Liam in front of the entire world’s live cameras after the game. The blade that was supposed to end their old feud ultimately cuts through every fear, hesitation, and disguise standing between them.
6abb22ab69b4e879a104d92e.title: Crash Into My Rival’s Obsession

6abb235d54bd74f95d01337a.synopsis: Freya gave up everything for her husband—only to be humiliated, betrayed, and sold to pay off his debts. Her family thinks she is nothing but a useless housewife. They couldn't be more wrong. Freya is secretly the founder of Alysia, one of the world's most powerful luxury empires. Now she's done sacrificing. As Freya reclaims her fortune and identity, the family that threw her away can only watch as the woman they despised becomes the one person they can’t afford to lose.
6abb235d54bd74f95d01337a.title: The Discarded Wife Is the Queen of Luxury

6abb30052371d90e430fc840.synopsis: At a New York auction, heiress Serena Hale and her ailing mother-in-law are attacked by Lorraine, a woman claiming to be billionaire Morgan Kensington's real wife. With stolen proof and Serena's own husband backing the lie, the impostor turns humiliation into torture. But when the real Morgan arrives, one chauffeur's deception unravels—and Serena discovers the cruelest betrayal came from inside her own family.
6abb30052371d90e430fc840.title: The Fake Wife's Fatal Mistake

6abb5c1691bbd6f99000f9b5.synopsis: Freya, the eldest daughter and rightful heir of the Winterbourne family, is betrayed by her fiancé Julian and her younger sister Sigrid on her wedding day, dying tragically on the night of the Blood Moon. Reborn with full knowledge of the future, Freya loses her inheritance rights but uses her spatial powers to stockpile supplies and build an impregnable fortress. Along the way, she rescues the vampire Silas and forms an alliance with him. When the Blood Moon rises, the world is plunged into eternal night. Manipulated by the traitorous witch Morrigan, the Blackwood family seeks to destroy and absorb the other three great families. Freya joins forces with the vampires, Fenrir—the Silver Moon Wolf King—and the surviving members of the Grimm family to fight against an overwhelming army of undead and vampires. In the decisive battle, Fenrir leads his wolf clan in a devastating self-sacrifice, opening a path to survival for the others. In the end, Freya fuses the powers of flame, life, and vampire blood to summon the “Crimson Griffin,” defeating Morrigan once and for all. With the war finally over, Freya is crowned queen, becoming the guardian of peace among all races.
6abb5c1691bbd6f99000f9b5.title: The Reborn Queen Path of Dominion

6abb5d05140ead30d90b69e5.synopsis: Chloe Miller, the legendary head of the Red Fan Family, lived an extraordinary life—only to be murdered by her enemy, Damian Pierce. After her death, she awakens in the body of a timid high school girl, going from a powerful underworld boss to an obedient student overnight. But while everyone sees her new body as an easy target for bullies, it now carries the soul of a queen. Chloe decides it is time to rewrite the rules of the school. All she wants is to enjoy a peaceful student life while putting the school bullies in their place. Instead, she unexpectedly attracts the attention of a domineering CEO, a charming older man, and the campus heartthrob, all of whom begin pursuing her. While dealing with school bullying and her increasingly complicated love life, Chloe secretly investigates the truth behind her own assassination. Eventually, she reunites with her loyal subordinate, Victor Stone, and together they uncover Damian’s conspiracy.
6abb5d05140ead30d90b69e5.title: That Good Girl Is a Boss

6abb5e36af4116b1ea043387.synopsis: Aurora Ashworth built her family’s empire from nothing. Then at a celebration banquet, her parents announced she wasn’t their biological daughter — their real daughter was Juliana. Stripped of everything, Aurora returns to the impoverished Rust Belt with nothing but her business genius. Starting with a single grilled skewer food truck, she rallies the neighborhood, builds a thriving community enterprise, and turns poverty into power. Juliana, desperate to steal Aurora’s engagement and destroy her new life, launches ruthless attacks — stock shorts, supply cuts, demolition plots. Nathaniel stands by Aurora, publicly rejecting his arranged marriage to Juliana. When Frank risks his life to expose Juliana’s bribery, she kidnaps Luna in a final trap — but the scheme collapses, and she’s arrested. The family corporation goes bankrupt. The Rust Belt rises as a new business hub. Aurora gets engaged to Nathaniel and leads an entire neighborhood out of poverty, building a future entirely on her own terms.
6abb5e36af4116b1ea043387.title: The Daughter They Cast Out

6abb68092027710dc506e960.synopsis: Dragged off to the Beast Wars, Ivar returns ten years later with no memory of his family's faces, but the ability to control the very beasts he was fighting. Disguised as a beggar, he uses the beasts to free his enslaved family and destroy the cruel nobles who tore them apart.
6abb68092027710dc506e960.title: The Beasts Kill for Me

6abb6e998ec9b5681103d6c6.synopsis: At St. Clair Academy, Lola clashes with Cade—the school’s most feared King 4 member—on her first day. That night, she discovers the arrogant boy from the pool is now her stepbrother. A mysterious ruby necklace soon binds them together: whenever Lola thinks of Cade, he is pulled to her side. By day, they are enemies; by night, their secret encounters blur the line between anger and desire. As campus queen Chloe targets Lola with rumors and cruelty, gentle Julian becomes her only apparent ally. But when betrayal, scandal, and family pressure threaten to tear everything apart, Cade must prove that he is willing to give up more than his pride for her. Lola must decide whether to leave for a new life—or choose the love she never meant to find.
6abb6e998ec9b5681103d6c6.title: Choked by Desire：My Devil Stepbrother

6abb71a6cfdea42e2f0f5b33.synopsis: Ella's boyfriend Kyle kisses freshman Nina in a truth-or-dare game and tells her not to be a sore loser — so she quietly unfollows him. When the next dare lands on campus golden boy Owen Blackwood, he asks Ella to try him, and she takes his hand. What she thinks is one night of spite is the night Owen has waited three years for. Kyle tries everything to win her back and fails at every turn; when Nina attacks Ella online, Owen's prepared rebuttal destroys her. Owen takes Kyle's punch without dodging, and Ella tells Kyle the truth: Owen is better in every way that counts.
6abb71a6cfdea42e2f0f5b33.title: The Campus King's Hidden Obsession

6abb7747561ddb0d1f054df5.synopsis: Elowen, the eldest daughter of the Winfield family, was framed by her aunt Valera for treason and imprisoned in a high tower. While in captivity, she gave birth to a daughter, Mia; using her final reserves of strength, she sent the child—along with a dragon-crested ring and a red obsidian necklace—onto the back of the dragon Valensa, entrusting the beast to take her to her biological father, Prince Orion of Aetheron. Five-year-old Mia ventured alone into a royal banquet, only to be driven away as an impostor because her father was unaware of the truth. She worked as a cleaner at the Dragon-Taming Academy to earn the coins needed to visit her mother, all while silently guarding the secret her mother had left in her care. As Valera closed in, desperate to seize the secret arts of dragon-taming, Mia’s true identity was finally confirmed by the dragons. Orion, consumed by remorse, rescued Elowen from the execution grounds just as a greater conspiracy loomed; the vengeance of the Mondragon family and an undead army fueled by dark magic would soon sweep the family of three into an ultimate battle determining the fate of the empire.
6abb7747561ddb0d1f054df5.title: The Lost Little Princess of the Dragon Clan

6abb7782ff3826918f0fd400.synopsis: Ten years ago, the five-time champion Knox was betrayed by his protégé and cast into the wasteland. Now, he has reclaimed four legendary cybernetic components and reignited his engines to storm back into Kalendos. Beyond the finish line, the traitor has been waiting for him all these years. Speed ​​dictates life and death; conviction decides who claims the throne. The king returns!
6abb7782ff3826918f0fd400.title: Cybernetic Racer

6abb77f90dc56a4c9005ebaf.synopsis: Raised by dragons and possessing the extraordinary ability to tame them, Leo descends from the mountains in search of his family. After saving Greta, she tries—but fails—to persuade her mother, Freya, to take him in as a younger brother. When the Black Mountain tribe arrives to seize the Storm Dragon King and forcibly claim Freya as a bride, Leo summons the dragon to defeat them. The truth is finally revealed: Leo is Freya’s long-lost son.
6abb77f90dc56a4c9005ebaf.title: The Six Years Old Dragon MasterDragon Trainer

6abb7835d931d4a0a40ac1ad.synopsis: On her very first day in office, Principal Celine was mistaken for a "homewrecker" by her son's girlfriend, Candy. Candy slapped her to the ground, bullied her, and even tore up three top-tier letters of recommendation Celine had prepared for her. The entire scene was left stunned when Pierce stepped in to rescue his mother. Refusing to back down, Candy played her trump card—claiming she was pregnant—but the unborn child had a different father, and a sinister plot involving greed and murder began to surface. When the truth finally came to light, who was the one who truly deserved to be on their knees, begging for mercy?
6abb7835d931d4a0a40ac1ad.title: My Son's Girlfriend Called Me a Mistress—and Tore up Her Future

6abb8af5016305e13d0fa2ac.synopsis: Amelia Montgomery, a wealthy heiress who discovers that her husband Ethan has betrayed her after ten years of marriage and is planning to use her forged signature to make her responsible for a corporate disaster. Forced to confront a shattered marriage and a dangerous conspiracy, Amelia returns to her powerful family and teams up with investigator Caleb Cole to uncover the truth behind the Harbor Tower scandal. From a betrayed wife to a powerful business queen, Amelia fights back and takes control of her destiny.
6abb8af5016305e13d0fa2ac.title: Broken-Mirror Covenant

6abb8b6d75a96675d504095f.synopsis: Three-and-a-half-year-old Maisie arrives at Nathaniel’s estate in a storm, saying he owes her mother three years of “milk money.” A family ring and DNA test pull her into a wealthy inheritance battle and expose a conspiracy: Victor and Evelyn forge tests, intercept letters, seek custody, and destroy evidence. Clara’s recordings, letters, and USB drive reveal the truth. Nathaniel protects his daughter, cleans house, and creates a medical fund—a late but healing redemption.
6abb8b6d75a96675d504095f.title: Not a Scandal. An Heiress

6abbbefd47eb9b78d30825b9.synopsis: Verona spent her whole life as Talia’s little shadow—second pick for parents, leftovers for love. Even her fiancé Bastian saved the best for her twin: the diamond, the perfume, the front seat, the master bedroom. On her wedding day, she finally ran. In a quiet town by the kiln, she learned she was never “hard to love”—just never chosen first. His regret came late. Her happiness didn’t wait.
6abbbefd47eb9b78d30825b9.title: Too Late to Be Your Only One

6abc68af88e27df7ee0d9638.synopsis: Liam, sole heir to the Wilson family’s hundred-billion-dollar empire, hid his identity and worked at his family’s hotel to protect his relationship with Sophia, an ordinary girl. But after returning from studying abroad, Sophia publicly humiliated him at their engagement banquet, calling him “low-class trash” and announcing she would marry Tyler, a wealthy second-generation heir. Liam tore up the billion-dollar Liasoft AI equity agreement he had prepared for her. As guests scorned and drove him out, his grandfather—California’s richest man—and his three powerful sisters, leading figures in Hollywood, Wall Street, and global business, arrived to reveal his true identity as the Wilson family’s sole heir. Later, at his tech empire’s headquarters, when Sophia’s family and their backers tried to humiliate him again, Liam called his second sister Catherine and unleashed the Wilson family’s financial kill order, wiping out his enemies’ assets instantly. Five years later, Liam had built his company into a global leader, while Sophia and her allies were reduced to beggars scavenging by trash cans, forced to watch his figure fade into the distance.
6abc68af88e27df7ee0d9638.title: She Returned Home with Her New Flame, And I Came Clean About My Identity as the Heir

6abc6a1767c7bf663e087129.synopsis: Eighteen-year-old noble Leia lost her mother young. Her father raised seven slave boys as her knights and suitors. For ten years, Leia loved their leader, Marcus, wholeheartedly. When maid Livia arrived, she feigned weakness and turned the seven knights against Leia. Marcus shielded Livia in the arena, leaving Leia wounded by a beast, and later destroyed Leia’s mother’s keepsake bracelet. Leia’s heart turned cold. Commander Augustus, who had secretly loved Leia for ten years while pretending to be paralyzed, proposed after learning of her suffering. Leia agreed. At Leia’s birthday banquet, Livia plotted to ruin her reputation, and the knights still sided with Livia. Augustus revealed he was never disabled and expelled them. When they later discovered Livia’s lies and begged forgiveness, Leia refused, revealing she, not Livia, had saved Marcus during the plague. She chose Augustus, who truly cherished her. Desperate, Marcus imprisoned Livia and died with her. The remaining knights left in remorse. Leia married Augustus and found true happiness.
6abc6a1767c7bf663e087129.title: None of the Seven Knights

6abc6caa88951971af09f17b.synopsis: Alice is a born wealthy heiress. At ten, she saved vampire Edward, werewolf Lucas and human John during a bloody battle between the vampire and werewolf clans. She soon lost her memory in a terrible fire and was adopted by the greedy, vicious Betty. Seeking revenge for her husband’s death in the Claire family fire and craving Alice’s fortune, Betty swapped Alice’s identity with her biological daughter Ella. For fifteen years, Ella lived as the true Alice. Once Alice was fully exploited, Betty tricked her into becoming the legal representative of a shell company, saddling her with huge debts before abandoning her. Tormented by debt collectors, Alice recovered her memories. Meanwhile, Edward, Lucas and John — heirs of three powerful families and Alice’s long-promised fiancés — had searched for her for fifteen years and finally found clues leading to Betty. Betty held a grand party for the fake Alice’s inheritance, plotting to let Ella take Alice’s wealth, status and fiancés and destroy the real Alice. Alice* family just as the three fiancés arrived. They distinguished the real Alice from the fake one by her unique scent. After reclaiming her identity and restoring her family’s status, Alice chose her lifelong true love from the three suitors of different races.
6abc6caa88951971af09f17b.title: Alice and Her Three Fiancés

6abc6d5f86686c9cb40ff60f.synopsis: Dragon Emperor Waldric is betrayed by his adopted son Draven, poisoned, stripped of power, and cast into the abyss. Draven’s attempt to steal his essence backfires, trapping his soul in the void. Waldric awakens in Kane Westland, a frail half-blood mocked for having no dragon bond. At his grandfather’s celebration, Kane claims the Dragon Emperor’s Scepter, walks across lava, and awakens the ancient dragon Zepharion, which bows only to him. He defeats the Sterling family’s strongest rider and becomes Lord of Westland, but his sister Layla fears he is no longer her brother. A forbidden ritual pulls Draven’s soul into Waldric’s corpse, creating a false Dragon Emperor. At the memorial, the scepter rejects him, exposing the fraud. In the final battle, Kane purifies Draven’s soul, revealing he had already bonded with an ancient dragon, and his hatred destroyed him for nothing. Kane abolishes the pure-blood system, ruling that dragon bonds depend on soul compatibility. But when Layla asks if her real brother remains inside him, Kane has no answer. As she walks away, an ancient dragon eye opens in the void. The war for Kane’s soul has only begun.
6abc6d5f86686c9cb40ff60f.title: The Last Dragon King‘s Bonded

6abc6e8a0b371f39510b781f.synopsis: Former CIA advisor Ethan Cole returns with ex-Mossad officer Mia after his “Super Quantum” tech is stolen by ex-girlfriend Valentina and broker Damian. They reactivate Project Aegis and strike back. Cornered, Valentina allies with tycoon Vane; Damian hires the Bloodwolf syndicate. Hitman Jack discovers Ethan’s bodyguard is his savior—Valentina’s father Victor—and leaks the plot. Ethan stages a nationally televised fake death. Believing him gone, Valentina betrays Damian, mortgages everything, even steals Victor’s pension, forcing him to disown her. Mia secretly saves Damian and records his crimes. At the Global Military-Industry Summit, Ethan reappears with special forces, broadcasting the truth, Damian’s confession, and the illegal contract. Valentina is arrested for life; Bloodwolf is wiped out. Ethan secures North America’s military industry and proposes to Mia at a global victory gala.
6abc6e8a0b371f39510b781f.title: Ex Stole My Empire The Commander’s Revenge

6abc74dd69f0130bc4048506.synopsis: In The Billionaire’s Sister Strikes Back, Catherine Sanderson is nine months pregnant and preparing to attend her little brother William’s wedding. She chooses to fly economy but books two seats to make the journey easier. Catherine even brings along a jar of William’s favorite pickles. She can’t wait to meet the lucky woman who is about to marry her baby brother, now the wealthiest man alive. The trip turns ugly when Catherine encounters an entitled, overbearing mother named Linda and her spoiled son, Tommy. The trouble begins when Catherine refuses to give up the extra seat she paid for. Linda and Tommy bully her, twist what happened, and then accuse Catherine of injuring Tommy’s head. Their behavior grows so reckless that they nearly cause the plane to crash, putting every passenger’s life at risk. Linda demands that the flight attendant and captain take Tommy to the hospital. Once there, Catherine meets Chloe—the so-called lucky woman engaged to William. Like Linda, Chloe takes one look at Catherine and assumes she is a broke loser. She accuses Catherine without knowing who she really is. That is when the billionaire’s sister finally strikes back. Characters Catherine Sanderson Catherine Sanderson is the main female character and is expecting her baby at any moment. She appears weak and harmless because of her condition, but that changes when she reveals her connection to William. The people who mistreat her have no idea whom they are dealing with. William “Will” Sanderson William “Will” Sanderson is Catherine’s younger brother and the wealthy CEO of Sanderson Group. He loves pickles and can’t wait to meet his sister at LAX. William is also one of the animated movie’s main characters. Chloe Chloe is William’s fiancée and the future vice president of Sanderson Group. She cares deeply about money and is quick to judge people by their appearance. Without knowing Catherine’s identity, Chloe dismisses her as a broke loser. Linda Linda is Chloe’s sister and one of the story’s minor villains. She is quick-tempered, demanding, and travels with her equally troublesome son, Tommy. When Catherine refuses to surrender her seat, Linda turns the entire situation against her.
6abc74dd69f0130bc4048506.title: The Billionaire's Sister Strikes Back

6abc7af7147958ea14077eeb.synopsis: Tilly, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Oliver instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?
6abc7af7147958ea14077eeb.title: I Sexted the Hockey Captain

6abca52604c1da6a130eca89.synopsis: Ethan, codename Ares, is released from Blackstone, a top-secret maximum-security prison, returning to investigate the wrongful arson case at St. Mary’s Orphanage from fifteen years ago. He discovers that seven sisters, each with extraordinary talents, are being persecuted one after another by criminal forces. Ethan reveals his formidable strength, thwarting conspiracies along the way and uncovering the mastermind politician Cross. Once the crisis ends, however, a secret involving a mysterious committee still lies hidden beneath the prison. He sets off into danger once more—the battle to protect his family is far from over.
6abca52604c1da6a130eca89.title: The Return of Ares

6abcb7346798a55c8e0f95d8.synopsis: After a publisher twists a writer's novel, turning its villain into a victim, a gas explosion sends her family into the story itself. Now wealthy but doomed to lose everything in three years, they must rewrite their fate before the plot destroys them.
6abcb7346798a55c8e0f95d8.title: Honey, We Are In a Novel

6abcbeb1b68f8046430a740a.synopsis: Maria, a lop-eared rabbit orphan, grew up in a boar-folk village. Because whatever she said always came true, the villagers saw her as a cursed child and drove her into a cowshed to live alone. Duchess Ethelyn stumbled upon Maria while lost, and Maria's blessing unexpectedly cured Ethelyn of a chronic illness she'd suffered for years. Ethelyn brought Maria back to Avalon Ducal Manor, and Maria's arrival filled the lifeless castle with laughter again. With her power, she healed the crippled legs of the third young master, Cyrus, and slowly thawed the frozen heart of Duke Regulus. Yet Maria foresaw a conspiracy against the manor—Regulus would be assassinated, Ethelyn would die a horrible death, Cyrus would be crushed, and the entire manor would be reduced to ashes. How will Maria rewrite it all?
6abcbeb1b68f8046430a740a.title: Maria the Little Lucky Star

6abcbfdeb4fc9da29c0ba756.synopsis: Valentina, daughter of a mafia godfather, hides her identity to love middle-class Ethan. She puts herself through college and secretly builds his career from the shadows. When Ethan’s mother tries to pair him with heiress Carlotta, Valentina builds her own conglomerate in four years, planning to gift it to him. But Ethan returns with Carlotta and their child, publicly humiliating Valentina. She vows revenge, cutting all business ties at her company. When his family taunts her outside, her secretary reveals she is the CEO. They grovel for forgiveness. At the godfather’s daughter’s birthday banquet, Carlotta’s cousin bars Valentina from entering and joins Ethan’s family in mocking her. Then the godfather arrives, and Valentina’s true identity is exposed. Ethan and his family beg for mercy—but the mafia executes them all.
6abcbfdeb4fc9da29c0ba756.title: Never Look Back

6abcc092756675fd810521da.synopsis: Avery Vance, the true heiress, was swapped at birth and raised on a rural farm. In her past life, the imposter Serena used the mysterious Plunder Book to steal Avery’s beauty, talents, and fortune, ultimately pushing her off a rooftop to her death. Reborn on the day she returns to the Vance mansion, Avery seizes the Plunder Book and reverses its blood-bound contract. Shedding her former plain appearance, she transforms into a striking young woman, while Serena, deprived of the stolen life-force, gradually loses her beauty and vitality. At Saint Grace High, Avery makes a sensational entrance and captures the attention of Chase, the star quarterback. Though she initially uses him for revenge, Avery is slowly won over by his sincere affection. Desperate, Serena resorts to bribery, arson, theft, and sabotage. At the cheerleading competition, Avery wins with genuine strength, forcing Serena to publicly humiliate herself. Serena’s final attempt—framing Avery and sabotaging a chandelier—exposes her crimes. Arrested and driven mad as all stolen gifts boomerang back, she is confined to a psychiatric facility. Cleared of all slander, Avery reclaims her inheritance and becomes cheer captain. Chase confesses his love with a four-leaf-clover bracelet, and the pair walk hand-in-hand toward a bright future at the graduation dance.
6abcc092756675fd810521da.title: Reborn, I Am the Campus Queen

6abcc182043bccf7ff02eae8.synopsis: In ancient Olympia, priestess Kassandra was betrayed by her fiancé Dionysios and sister Myrto, falling into the abyss with her newborn. Reborn on the eve of the priestess selection, she seizes her fate, outshining Myrto to become the chosen priestess. She journeys to the abyss and unites with the gatekeeper Alexios, bearing triplets marked with dark-gold lightning runes. Dionysios and Myrto plot repeatedly, but their schemes fail. When the infants' resonance test reveals the truth, Myrto's conspiracy is exposed and Dionysios's reverse sealing wedge is shattered. Desperate, Dionysios unleashes the abyss, only for Alexios to manifest his divine form and destroy the artifact. As Kassandra and Alexios grow closer, Dionysios abducts their eldest son Telemachus. At the public trial, Kassandra exposes his crimes, but he reveals the third inscribed key is sewn into his chest. Facing his threat and the gatekeeper's fated death, Kassandra proposes "Converge the Three Powers into One." At the final judgment, Myrto's conscience awakens. She testifies and takes a fatal blow meant for Kassandra. Alexios shatters the key, restores his godhood, and permanently seals the abyss. Myrto survives. Kassandra and Alexios are crowned, their three sons acknowledged, and the family finds their happy ending.
6abcc182043bccf7ff02eae8.title: She Took My Place, I Took a God

6abccc85ec84a1a54803ff3c.synopsis: Chloe is murdered by her husband Leonard and his mistress Eve, who posed as a companion robot. Reborn, she hosts a product expo to expose their affair, trapping Leonard into confessing on live TV. With a shrewd divorce deal, she seizes all his assets. She launches authentic AI Companion Robot 2.0, fends off smear attacks, and sends the conspirators to jail. Years later, Leonard and Eve destroy each other, while Chloe’s company flourishes.
6abccc85ec84a1a54803ff3c.title: The Robot in My Husband's Bed

6abcccc5d2ed84e2c80f51da.synopsis: She was wolfless. All her life, Holly Ambrose had been longing for her family to reciprocate the love she had been working hard to get from her father and her sister, Irina. Unfortunately, they only saw her as an embarrassment to the pack and used her instead so that Irina could refuse to marry Alpha Evander Edgerton: the ruthless and cold-blooded Alpha of the Blackwood Pack. Thinking that it was the only way to escape them, Holly accepted the proposal. Alpha Alec, her former mate and her sister’s fiance begged her not to. He confessed he still had feelings for her and wanted her back as his mate. Too late because there was no stopping her from having her freedom. But would Holly be truly free if Irina had no intention to stop destroying her life after Alec left Irina to claim Holly back?
6abcccc5d2ed84e2c80f51da.title: Saved and Fated by The Ruthless Alpha

6abcccfdf36814d23a0e5c9d.synopsis: Six years ago, Elena was falsely accused of data theft and arson that killed Adrian’s sister. She fled and secretly gave birth to Sophie. Years later, Elena—who had been gathering evidence—fell into a coma after an accident. To save her, Sophie burst into Adrian’s engagement ceremony, claimed him as her father, and accused his fiancée of harming her mother. Adrian initially doubted her, but eventually uncovered the six‑year‑old truth.
6abcccfdf36814d23a0e5c9d.title: The Daughter He Hated

6abd01b9dad9e551c60fad59.synopsis: As William and Fiona's relationship begins to crumble, Fiona's younger brother, Leon, sees his chance to make a move. He urges the ever-honorable William to get back at Fiona by cheating, and even offers to help him "practice." William still sees Leon as the boy he's looked after since childhood, unaware that Leon has spent years plotting to make him his. But as they cross one boundary after another, William is horrified to realize he's falling for Leon. Consumed by guilt, he tries to walk away, only for Leon to chase after him and finally confess the love he's kept buried for ten years.
6abd01b9dad9e551c60fad59.title: Seducing My Sister's Husband Behind Her Back

6abe6cc5d018445df206aac9.synopsis: Top engineer Evelyn and her husband Julian once planned to chase their aerospace dream together in Silicon Valley. Yet Julian secretly altered their plans for Clara, taking it for granted that Evelyn would keep sacrificing for him. Instead of lingering on conflict, Evelyn chose divorce and moved to California for research. After marrying Clara, Julian uncovered her true identity as a foreign spy and ended up trapped, dying in a foreign land. Having healed from heartbreak, Evelyn completed the hypersonic drone test flight on her own and realized their former shared dream.
6abe6cc5d018445df206aac9.title: No Longer Waiting for Your Return

6abe6cc8d19ff37a890320f9.synopsis: Serena, only daughter of the Black Dragon King and wife of Frost Dragon King Varian, hid three years to protect a Golden Dragon egg—blood extinct for ten thousand years. Coming home for her father's birthday, she was mistaken for a seductress by Dalia, the fox woman newly taken by her father. Dalia bound her with curse shackles, slashed her face, snapped her horns, stole her heart-protecting scale, cut open her belly, crushed the golden egg, and dragged her to the banquet as a "mistress." Serena survived and rose as Frost Queen. She exposed that Dalia's pregnancy was a lie, and watched Dalia get killed by her father.
6abe6cc8d19ff37a890320f9.title: Vengeance of the Dragon Princess

6abf46f91bdbe323c30f5769.synopsis: Wall Street analyst Clara is betrayed by her fiancé Richard, who steals her algorithm and abandons her. She gives birth alone in a storm to Harry, a baby who never cries or speaks. Her former assistant Liam silently protects them. Four years later, Clara discovers Harry has an IQ of 260 and can hack Wall Street databases. Richard kidnaps Harry to seize a $100 billion family trust. Liam reveals he is the head of Sterling Group, and a DNA test confirms Harry is his son. Richard is exposed as infertile and imprisoned. Clara returns to Wall Street, Liam proposes publicly, and the family finds happiness.
6abf46f91bdbe323c30f5769.title: I Raised a Silent Genius

6abfeb8375b6b07d830d6b99.synopsis: The world's greatest secret agent must protect and care for his six-year-old daughter while posing as her nanny. Now, without revealing his true identity, he must win his daughter's (and her mother's) trust, while secretly thwarting corrupt suitors, mafioso strongmen, and even a megalomaniacal billionaire who's using his family to get to him.
6abfeb8375b6b07d830d6b99.title: Agent of Shadows

6ac1c311042fd1c0bf050908.synopsis: When Alex enters his stepbrother Liam’s world of privilege and power, the only thing they share is mutual contempt. But hate is a dangerous game—and the closer they become, the more they stand to lose. Two boys, one secret, and a line neither of them can cross. Until they do.
6ac1c311042fd1c0bf050908.title: Scoring on My Football Captain Stepbrother

6ac6f03942473242df0a1135.synopsis: Daniel takes his family to a high‑end private medical center. His son Tyler causes serious trouble: snatching a blind woman’s cane, misbehaving in the ladies’ restroom, knocking down an elderly man in a wheelchair, and pushing Claire, the pregnant wife of his boss Richard, into premature labor. Daniel’s mother Margaret blindly shields Tyler and fails to discipline him. Later at a Mexican grill, Tyler steals robbers’ belongings and throws them into a hot pot. Enraged, the robbers cause Tyler’s instant death. Daniel and his spouse blame each other. Heart‑broken Emily files for divorce. Margaret is overcome with regret, yet it is too late. Excessive indulgence finally brings tragedy to the whole family.
6ac6f03942473242df0a1135.title: The Price of Spoiling

6ac6f0751dd37f0d79031ca7.synopsis: Fifteen years ago, gravely‑ill Victoria was coerced by her father Conrad to give up young Ethan, who lost his memory and lived in poverty. Ethan’s invention patent was stolen by his girlfriend and her lover. Mother and son reunite through a half‑coin token. Back in the wealthy family, they collect evidence, expose Conrad’s 15‑year‑long conspiracy of money‑laundering and attempted murder, bring him to justice, and Ethan becomes the new CEO of Aegis Group.
